diff --git a/Complexity/Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Internal/PolyTimeBinaryPrimitives.lean b/Complexity/Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Internal/PolyTimeBinaryPrimitives.lean
index c727abb8..43ccda28 100644
--- a/Complexity/Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Internal/PolyTimeBinaryPrimitives.lean
+++ b/Complexity/Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Internal/PolyTimeBinaryPrimitives.lean
@@ -145,5 +145,20 @@ theorem binary_lt : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (p.1 < p.
   refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => forall₂_congr fun j _ => ?_
   rw [← Nat.not_le, imp_iff_not_or, not_not]
 
+/-- Non-strict binary comparison, composed from the existing strict comparison certificate.
+Automatic composition uses the computed-operand rule `binary_le'`. -/
+theorem binary_le : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (p.1 ≤ p.2))
+    (encPair encNat encNat) encBool := by
+  simpa only [Function.comp_def, ← decide_not, Nat.not_lt] using
+    bool_not.comp (binary_lt.comp ((snd encNat encNat).prod (fst encNat encNat)))
+
+/-- Compare two binary naturals computed uniformly from the same encoded input. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem binary_le' {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {left right : α → ℕ}
+    (hleft : ComputableInPolyTime left input encNat)
+    (hright : ComputableInPolyTime right input encNat) :
+    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => decide (left a ≤ right a)) input encBool :=
+  binary_le.comp (hleft.prod hright)
+
 end ComputableInPolyTime
 end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # Computational capabilities of pair, option and list encodings
+
+The classes contain proofs of plain computational capabilities, not selected machines or clocks.
+Pairing retains independent time and workspace bounds and explicitly charges the output pair.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+universe u
+
+/-! ### Encodings of pairs, options and lists -/
+
+section Classes
+
+variable {α β : Type u}
+
+/-- `enc` encodes pairs compatibly with `enc₁` and `enc₂`. -/
+public class PairEncoding (enc₁ : α ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β ↪ List Bool)
+    (enc : α × β ↪ List Bool) : Prop where
+  /-- Pairing is a combinator: functions `f` and `g` computable from a common input within
+  common bounds combine into `fun x => (f x, g x)`, within a constant factor of those bounds, plus
+  space for the encoded pair. Different bounds are covered by
+  `Turing.MultiTapeTM.PairEncoding.pair_mono`. -/
+  pair {γ : Type u} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : γ → α} {g : γ → β} {t s : γ → ℕ} :
+    ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn enc₁ t s →
+    ComputableInTimeAndSpace g encIn enc₂ t s →
+    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc
+      (fun x => c * (t x + 1)) (fun x => c * (s x + (enc (f x, g x)).length + 1))
+  /-- The first projection is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  fst : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace Prod.fst enc enc₁
+  /-- The second projection is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  snd : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace Prod.snd enc enc₂
+
+/-- `enc` encodes options compatibly with `enc₁`: `none` is encoded by the empty word. -/
+public class OptionEncoding (enc₁ : α ↪ List Bool) (enc : Option α ↪ List Bool) : Prop where
+  /-- `none` is encoded by the empty word. -/
+  none_eq : enc none = []
+  /-- `some` is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  some : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace some enc₁ enc
+  /-- `Option.getD` is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  getD (d : α) : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun o => o.getD d) enc enc₁
+
+/-- `enc` encodes lists compatibly with `enc₁`. -/
+public class ListEncoding (enc₁ : α ↪ List Bool) (enc : List α ↪ List Bool) : Prop where
+  /-- `List.headD` is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  headD (d : α) : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun l => l.headD d) enc enc₁
+  /-- `List.tail` is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  tail : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace List.tail enc enc
+  /-- Testing a list for emptiness is computable in linear time and space. -/
+  isEmpty : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace List.isEmpty enc encBool
+
+/-- Pairing functions computable within different bounds. -/
+public theorem PairEncoding.pair_mono {enc₁ : α ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc : α × β ↪ List Bool} [h : PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc] {γ : Type u}
+    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {f : γ → α} {g : γ → β} {t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : γ → ℕ}
+    (hf : ComputableInTimeAndSpace f encIn enc₁ t₁ s₁)
+    (hg : ComputableInTimeAndSpace g encIn enc₂ t₂ s₂) :
+    ∃ c, ComputableInTimeAndSpace (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc
+      (fun x => c * (t₁ x + t₂ x + 1))
+      (fun x => c * (s₁ x + s₂ x + (enc (f x, g x)).length + 1)) :=
+  h.pair (hf.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _))
+    (hg.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _))
+
+end Classes
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+# Word operations for encodings
+
+The building blocks of concrete encodings of pairs, options and lists, and their plain computability
+in linear time and space (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace`).
+
+A word `w` is *framed* by writing each symbol `b` as `[true, b]` and appending `[false]`. A framed
+word marks its own end, so it can be followed by any word and still be read back.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame`: the framed word.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.unframe`, `Turing.MultiTapeTM.dropFrame`: the word framed at the start of a
+  word, and what follows the frame.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.frame_append_inj`: a framed word followed by another word determines both.
+* Functions that act on encoded values by `frame`, `unframe`, `dropFrame`, `List.cons true`,
+  `List.tail` or `List.take 1`, or that test the encoded value for emptiness, are computable
+  in linear time and space.

+@[expose] public section

+/-! ### Transducers for the word operations -/
+
+namespace Encodings
+
+open Internal.FrameMachines
+
+/-- Emits a word determined by its input's first symbol, if any, and by `drop`: `[true]` followed by
+the input (`drop = none`), the input without its first symbol (`drop = some false`), or just the
+first symbol (`drop = some true`). -/
+@[simps -isSimp q₀ step final]
+def headT (drop : Option Bool) : Transducer Bool Bool where
+  q₀ := false
+  step
+    | false, b => (true, match drop with | none => [true, b] | some false => [] | some true => [b])
+    | true, b => (true, match drop with | none => [b] | some false => [b] | some true => [])
+  final
+    | false => match drop with | none => [true] | _ => []
+    | true => []
+  length_step_le q b := by cases q <;> rcases drop with _ | _ | _ <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by cases q <;> rcases drop with _ | _ | _ <;> simp
+
+lemma headT_run_true (drop : Option Bool) (v : List Bool) :
+    (headT drop).run true v = if drop = some true then [] else v := by
+  induction v <;> rcases drop with _ | _ | _ <;> simp_all [headT_step, headT_final]
+
+/-- Emits `[true]` on the empty word and `[false]` on every other word. -/
+@[simps -isSimp q₀ step final]
+def isEmptyT : Transducer Bool Bool where
+  q₀ := false
+  step q _ := (true, if q then [] else [false])
+  final q := if q then [] else [true]
+  length_step_le q _ := by cases q <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by cases q <;> simp
+
+lemma isEmptyT_run_true (v : List Bool) : isEmptyT.run true v = [] := by
+  induction v <;> simp [isEmptyT_step, isEmptyT_final, *]
+
+end Encodings
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # A conditional assembled from supplied machine witnesses
+
+This is the machine-witness portion of the existing conditional computability proof. Its constant
+absorbs the finite Boolean code and machine overhead; time and workspace remain independent.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM.Internal
+
+/-- Assemble the existing test/composition/conditional machines at independent branch bounds. -/
+theorem conditional {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool}
+    {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
+    {tc sc tf sf tg sg : α → ℕ} {kc kf kg : ℕ} {Qc Qf Qg : Type}

+    {tmc : MultiTapeTM kc Bool Qc} {tmf : MultiTapeTM kf Bool Qf}
+    {tmg : MultiTapeTM kg Bool Qg}
+    (hc : ∀ a, tmc.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn a) (encC (c a)) (tc a) (sc a))
+    (hf : ∀ a : {a // c a = true}, tmf.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+      (encIn a) (encOut (f a)) (tf a) (sf a))
+    (hg : ∀ a : {a // c a = false}, tmg.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+      (encIn a) (encOut (g a)) (tg a) (sg a)) :
+    ∃ C, ∃ (k : ℕ) (Q : Type) (_ : Finite Q) (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q), ∀ a,
+      tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace (encIn a) (encOut (if c a then f a else g a))
+        (tc a + (if c a then tf a else tg a) + C)
+        (sc a + (if c a then sf a else sg a) + C) := by
+  let τ := eqWordT (encC true)
+  have htest (a : α) : (τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Bool)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+      (encC (c a)) (encTest (c a)) (4 * (encC (c a)).length + 8) 0 := by
+    convert τ.computesTidily (encC (c a)) using 1
+    simp only [τ, eqWordT_run_q₀, encC.injective.eq_iff]
+    cases c a <;> simp [encTest_true, encTest_false]
+  let l := (encC true).length + (encC false).length
+  have hl (a : α) : (encC (c a)).length ≤ l := by cases c a <;> dsimp [l] <;> omega
+  let K := 8 * l + 6 * max kc 0 + 40
+  have hct (a : α) := ((hc a).comp (htest a) true).mono
+    (t' := tc a + K) (s' := sc a + K)
+    (by have hb := hl a; dsimp [l] at hb; dsimp [K, l]; omega)
+    (by have hb := hl a; dsimp [l] at hb; dsimp [K, l]; omega)
+  refine ⟨K + 5 * max (max kc 0 + 2) (max kf kg) + 20,
+    _, _, inferInstance, iteTM ((τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Bool)).comp tmc true) tmf tmg,
+    fun a => ?_⟩
+  have h := (hct a).ite (tm₁ := tmf) (tm₂ := tmg)
+    (y := encOut (if c a then f a else g a))
+    (t₁ := tf a) (s₁ := sf a) (t₂ := tg a) (s₂ := sg a)
+    (fun hw => by
+      have ha : c a = true := by cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
+      simpa [ha] using hf ⟨a, ha⟩)
+    (fun hw => by
+      have ha : c a = false := by cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
+      simpa [ha] using hg ⟨a, ha⟩)
+  refine h.mono ?_ ?_ <;> cases ha : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false] <;> omega
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM.Internal

+/-! # The existing composition machine and its run theorem
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource
+formulas. Higher computability-calculus theorems remain in the original facade.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} {Symbol S₁ S₂ : Type*}
+
+/-- `tm₂` after `tm₁`, both with their work tapes padded to `max k₁ k₂`: run `tm₁` with its output
+written to the work tape `Fin.natAdd (max k₁ k₂) 0`, run `tm₂` reading its input from that tape
+(using `mark` on the last work tape to flag the left end of the input), then clear that tape. -/
+public noncomputable def comp (tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂) (tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁)
+    (mark : Symbol) : MultiTapeTM (max k₁ k₂ + 2) Symbol
+      ((S₁ ⊕ RewindWorkState) ⊕ (MarkWorkState ⊕ S₂ ⊕ MarkWorkState) ⊕ Unit ⊕ RewindWorkState) :=
+  ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₁ k₂))).outputToWord.extendTapes
+      Fin.castSuccEmb).seq
+    (((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_right k₁ k₂))).inputFromWord mark).seq
+      ((clearWork Symbol).extendTapes (tapeEmb (Fin.natAdd (max k₁ k₂) 0))))
+
+/-- Clearing the only non-blank work tape leaves all work tapes blank. -/
+public theorem transformsTapes_clearWork_only {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) :
+    TransformsTapes ((clearWork Symbol).extendTapes (tapeEmb i))
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) i w)
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ e = []) (3 * (w.length + 1)) (w.length + 1 + k) :=
+  (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb i w).imp (fun _ _ hws => by rw [hws, Function.update_self])
+    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by simp [hws', hws], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+
+/-- If `tm₁` computes `w` from `x` tidily and `tm₂` computes `y` from `w` tidily, then
+`tm₂.comp tm₁ mark` computes `y` from `x` tidily. -/
+public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁}
+    {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂} {x w y : List Symbol} {t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ}
+    (h₁ : tm₁.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x w t₁ s₁)
+    (h₂ : tm₂.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace w y t₂ s₂) (mark : Symbol) :
+    (tm₂.comp tm₁ mark).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y (t₁ + t₂ + 4 * w.length + 9)
+      (s₁ + s₂ + 5 * w.length + (6 * max k₁ k₂ + 20)) := by
+  set K := max k₁ k₂
+  -- the work tape holding the intermediate word `w`
+  set A : Fin (K + 2) := Fin.natAdd K 0
+  have hA : Fin.append (fun _ : Fin K => ([] : List Symbol)) ![w, []] =
+      Function.update (fun _ => []) A w := by
+    funext l
+    cases l using Fin.addCases with
+    | left j => simp [A, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd j 0)]
+    | right i => match i with | 0 | 1 => simp [A]
+  -- phase 1: `tm₁` writes `w` to `A`
+  have hQ₁ (ws' : Fin (K + 1 + 1) → List Symbol)
+      (hv : (fun j => ws' (Fin.castSuccEmb j)) = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w)
+      (hx : ∀ l ∉ Set.range Fin.castSuccEmb, ws' l = []) :
+      ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w := by
+    funext l
+    induction l using Fin.lastCases with
+    | last =>
+      rw [hx _ fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j hj]
+      simp [A, Fin.ext_iff]
+    | cast j =>
+      rw [show ws' j.castSucc = _ from congrFun hv j]
+      simp [A, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
+  have hp₁ := ((h₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₁ k₂))).outputToWord.extendTapes
+    Fin.castSuccEmb).imp (P' := fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w ∧ e = [])
+    (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hws]⟩)
+    (fun _ _ ws' _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨⟨hv, he⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨hQ₁ ws' hv fun l hl => (hx l hl).trans
+      (congrFun hws l), he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  -- phase 2: `tm₂` reads `w` from `A` and emits `y`
+  have hp₂ := (transformsTapes_inputFromWord mark
+      (computesTidily_iff.mp (h₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_right k₁ k₂))))).imp
+    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w)
+    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w ∧ e = y)
+    (fun _ _ hws => hws.trans hA.symm) (fun _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨hws'.trans hA, he⟩)
+    le_rfl le_rfl
+  -- phase 3: clear `A`
+  have hclear : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => []) A w) A [] = fun _ => [] := by
+    rw [Function.update_idem]
+    exact Function.update_eq_self A _
+  have hp₃ := (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb (Symbol := Symbol) A w).imp
+    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) A w)
+    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ e = [])
+    (fun _ _ hws => by rw [hws, Function.update_self])
+    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by rw [hws', hws, hclear], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  refine (transformsTapes_seq hp₁ (transformsTapes_seq hp₂ hp₃ fun _ _ _ _ _ hQ => hQ.1)
+    fun _ _ _ _ _ hQ => hQ.1).imp (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ (by omega) (by omega)
+  rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨hws, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+  exact ⟨hws, by simp⟩
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # Basic semantic facts for tidy machine runs
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource
+formulas. Higher computability-calculus theorems remain in the original facade.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {t s : ℕ}
+
+namespace ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+
+variable {input output : List Symbol}
+
+/-- A tidy computation is a computation in the sense of
+`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputesInTimeAndSpace`. -/
+theorem computesInTimeAndSpace (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t s) :
+    tm.ComputesInTimeAndSpace input output t s := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, ht, hs⟩ := computesTidily_iff.mp h
+  have hhead : p.head = tm.initCfg input := hh.trans (Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg tm.q₀ input).symm
+  have hrun : tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) p.time = wordsCfg input none (fun _ => []) output :=
+    hhead ▸ (runPath_apply_eq_runFrom p (.last _)).symm.trans hl
+  have hhalt : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) p.time).Halted := by rw [hrun]; rfl
+  exact ⟨⟨p.time, hhalt, by rw [hrun]; rfl⟩,
+    runsInTime_of_halted (runFrom_eq_of_halt tm _ ht hhalt ▸ hhalt),
+    runsInSpace_of_runPath hhead (by rw [hl]; rfl) hs⟩
+
+/-- A tidy computation within `t` steps emits at most `t` symbols. -/
+theorem length_output_le (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t s) :
+    output.length ≤ t := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, ht, -⟩ := computesTidily_iff.mp h
+  simpa [hh, hl, wordsCfg] using p.length_output_last_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ht _)
+
+/-- A tidy computation stays tidy with more work tapes, at one cell per added tape. -/
+theorem extendTapes {k' : ℕ} (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t s)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
+    (tm.extendTapes e).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t (s + (k' - k)) := by
+  refine (TransformsTapes.extendTapes h e).imp (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by subst hws; rfl⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨⟨hv, hout⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨funext fun l => ?_, hout⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
+  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hl
+    exact congrFun hv j
+  · rw [hx l hl, hws]
+
+end ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # The existing conditional machine and its run theorem
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource
+formulas. Higher computability-calculus theorems remain in the original facade.

+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k₀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ} {Symbol S₀ S₁ S₂ : Type*}

+/-- Run `tmc` with its output on a new last work tape, then `tm₁` if that word is non-empty and
+`tm₂` otherwise, and clear the tape. All three machines are padded to `max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)` work
+tapes. -/
+public noncomputable def iteTM (tmc : MultiTapeTM k₀ Symbol S₀) (tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁)
+    (tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂) : MultiTapeTM (max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 1) Symbol
+      ((S₀ ⊕ RewindWorkState) ⊕ Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂) ⊕ Unit ⊕ RewindWorkState) :=
+  (tmc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left _ _))).outputToWord.seq
+    ((branch (Fin.last _)
+        ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
+          (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+        ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
+          (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)).seq
+      ((clearWork Symbol).extendTapes (tapeEmb (Fin.last _))))
+
+namespace Ite
+
+/-- A tidy machine, padded to `K` work tapes and placed below a last work tape that holds `w`
+throughout. -/
+lemma transformsTapes_padded {k K : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ K) {S : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S}
+    {x w y : List Symbol} {t s : ℕ} (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t s) :
+    TransformsTapes ((tm.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb hk)).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w)
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      t (s + (K - k) + (K + 1 - K)) := by
+  refine (TransformsTapes.extendTapes (h.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb hk)) Fin.castSuccEmb).imp
+    (fun _ ws ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, ?_⟩)
+    (fun _ ws ws' _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨⟨hv, he⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨?_, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  · subst hws
+    funext j
+    simp [Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
+  · funext l
+    induction l using Fin.lastCases with
+    | last => rw [hx _ fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j hj, hws]
+    | cast j =>
+      rw [show ws' j.castSucc = _ from congrFun hv j]
+      simp [Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
+
+end Ite
+
+open Ite in
+/-- If `tmc` computes `w` from `x` tidily, `tm₁` computes `y` from `x` tidily when `w` is non-empty
+and `tm₂` does when `w` is empty, then `iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂` computes `y` from `x` tidily, within the
+bounds of `tmc` plus those of the machine that runs. -/
+public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite {tmc : MultiTapeTM k₀ Symbol S₀}
+    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁} {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂} {x w y : List Symbol}
+    {tc sc t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ} (hc : tmc.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x w tc sc)
+    (h₁ : w ≠ [] → tm₁.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₁ s₁)
+    (h₂ : w = [] → tm₂.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₂ s₂) :
+    (iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y
+      (tc + (if w = [] then t₂ else t₁) + 4 * w.length + 6)
+      (sc + (if w = [] then s₂ else s₁) + 3 * w.length + 5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 10) := by
+  set K := max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)
+  -- phase 1: the test word on the last tape
+  have hp₁ := (hc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord
+  -- phase 2: the branch, with the machine that does not run specified vacuously
+  have hM₁ : TransformsTapes ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
+        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
+        ws (Fin.last K) ≠ [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      (if w = [] then 0 else t₁) (if w = [] then 0 else s₁ + (K - k₁) + (K + 1 - K)) := by
+    split_ifs with hw
+    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hne⟩
+      simp [hw] at hne
+    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₁ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
+        le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hM₂ : TransformsTapes ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
+        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
+        ws (Fin.last K) = [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      (if w = [] then t₂ else 0) (if w = [] then s₂ + (K - k₂) + (K + 1 - K) else 0) := by
+    split_ifs with hw
+    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₂ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
+        le_rfl le_rfl
+    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, he⟩
+      simp [hw] at he
+  have hp₂ := transformsTapes_branch (Fin.last K) hM₁ hM₂
+  -- phase 3: clear the last tape
+  have hp₃ := transformsTapes_clearWork_only (Symbol := Symbol) (Fin.last K) w
+  refine (transformsTapes_seq hp₁ (hp₂.seq_eq hp₃) fun _ _ _ _ hP hQ => ⟨hP.1, hQ.1⟩).imp
+    (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨hws, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨hws, by simp⟩
+  · split_ifs <;> omega
+  · split_ifs <;> omega
+
+/-- The test word of a condition: empty exactly for `false`. -/
+@[expose] public def encTest : Bool ↪ List Bool :=
+  ⟨fun b => if b then [true] else [], fun a b h => by cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all⟩
+
+public lemma encTest_true : encTest true = [true] := rfl
+public lemma encTest_false : encTest false = [] := rfl
+
+/-- Emits `[true]` on the word `w` and nothing on every other word. Its state is the rest of `w`
+still to be read, or `none` once the input differs from `w`. -/
+@[expose, simps -isSimp step final]
+public def eqWordT (w : List Bool) : Transducer Bool (Option {v // v ∈ w.tails}) where
+  q₀ := some ⟨w, (List.mem_tails _ _).mpr (List.suffix_refl w)⟩
+  step q a := match q with
+    | some ⟨b :: v, h⟩ =>
+      (if a = b then some ⟨v, (List.mem_tails _ _).mpr ((List.suffix_cons b v).trans
+        ((List.mem_tails _ _).mp h))⟩ else none, [])
+    | _ => (none, [])
+  final q := if q.map Subtype.val = some [] then [true] else []
+  length_step_le q a := by rcases q with _ | ⟨_ | _, _⟩ <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by split_ifs <;> simp
+
+lemma eqWordT_run_none (w u : List Bool) : (eqWordT w).run none u = [] := by
+  induction u <;> simp [eqWordT_step, eqWordT_final, *]
+
+lemma eqWordT_run (w : List Bool) (u : List Bool) (v : {v // v ∈ w.tails}) :
+    (eqWordT w).run (some v) u = if u = v.1 then [true] else [] := by
+  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := v
+  induction u generalizing v with
+  | nil => cases v <;> simp [eqWordT_final]
+  | cons a u ih =>
+    rcases v with _ | ⟨b, v⟩
+    · simp [eqWordT_step, eqWordT_run_none]
+    · by_cases hab : a = b <;> simp [eqWordT_step, eqWordT_run_none, hab, ih]
+
+public lemma eqWordT_run_q₀ (w u : List Bool) :
+    (eqWordT w).run (eqWordT w).q₀ u = if u = w then [true] else [] :=
+  eqWordT_run w u _
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # The existing single-machine tidy normalization construction
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource
+formulas. Higher computability-calculus theorems remain in the original facade.
+-/

+@[expose] public section

+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM

+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {input : List Symbol} {m₀ m₁ : Symbol}

+/-! ### Clearing a work tape and its shadow -/
+
+/-- The embedding of work tape `i` and its shadow `k + i`. -/
+def pairEmb (i : Fin k) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin (k + k) :=
+  Function.Embedding.embFinTwo (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd i i)
+
+@[simp] theorem pairEmb_zero (i : Fin k) : pairEmb i 0 = Fin.castAdd k i := rfl
+
+/-- The shadow of work tape `i` is tape `k + i`, written `i.addNat k` in simp normal form. -/
+@[simp] theorem pairEmb_one (i : Fin k) : pairEmb i 1 = i.addNat k :=
+  Fin.natAdd_eq_addNat k i
+
+/-- The tapes of the pair `i` are work tape `i` and its shadow. -/
+theorem pairIdx_eq_iff {j : Fin (k + k)} {i : Fin k} :
+    pairIdx j = i ↔ j = Fin.castAdd k i ∨ j = i.addNat k := by
+  refine Fin.addCases (fun j' => ?_) (fun j' => ?_) j
+  · simp only [pairIdx_castAdd, Fin.castAdd_inj, ← Fin.natAdd_eq_addNat, Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd,
+      or_false]
+  · simp only [pairIdx_natAdd, ← Fin.natAdd_eq_addNat, Fin.natAdd_inj,
+      (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd _ _).symm, false_or]
+
+/-- Tape `j` is a tape of the pair `i` exactly when it is work tape `i` or its shadow. -/
+theorem partialInv_pairEmb (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (k + k)) :
+    partialInv (pairEmb i) j =
+      if j = Fin.castAdd k i then some 0 else if j = i.addNat k then some 1 else none := by
+  split_ifs with h₀ h₁
+  · exact h₀ ▸ partialInv_embed (pairEmb i) 0
+  · exact h₁ ▸ pairEmb_one i ▸ partialInv_embed (pairEmb i) 1
+  · refine partialInv_eq_none _ ?_
+    rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
+    fin_cases a <;> simp_all [pairEmb_one]
+
+variable {σ σ' : Type*}
+
+/-- Work tape `i` of `C` and its shadow `k + i` are ready to be cleared: the heads of both are on
+cell `c - a`, the shadow marks cells `V` that together with `c - a` form the interval `[-a, b]`,
+and the work tape is blank outside it. -/
+structure PairReady (m₀ m₁ : Symbol) (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) (i : Fin k) (a b c : ℕ)
+    (V : Finset ℤ) : Prop where
+  /-- The head of the work tape is on cell `c - a`. -/
+  pos_castAdd : C.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd k i) = c - a
+  /-- The head of the shadow is on cell `c - a`. -/
+  pos_natAdd : C.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd k i) = c - a
+  /-- The marked cells and the cell under the heads form the interval `[-a, b]`. -/
+  insert_eq : insert ((c : ℤ) - a) V = Finset.Icc (-(a : ℤ)) b
+  /-- The shadow marks the cells `V`. -/
+  shadow_eq : C.workTapes (Fin.natAdd k i) = shadowTape m₀ m₁ V
+  /-- The work tape is blank outside `[-a, b]`. -/
+  blank : ∀ y ∉ Finset.Icc (-(a : ℤ)) b, C.workTapes (Fin.castAdd k i) y = none
+
+/-- `C`, halted, with the work tapes in `l` and their shadows blank and their heads on the start
+cell. -/
+def clearedCfg (l : List (Fin k)) (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) :
+    Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ' input :=
+  ⟨none, C.inputPos, fun j => if pairIdx j ∈ l then fun _ => none else C.workTapes j,
+    fun j => if pairIdx j ∈ l then 0 else C.workTapePos j, C.output⟩
+
+omit [DecidableEq Symbol] in
+@[simp] theorem clearedCfg_nil (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) :
+    clearedCfg (σ' := σ') [] C = C.withState none := by
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext j <;>
+    simp only [clearedCfg, List.not_mem_nil, ↓reduceIte, Cfg.withState]
+
+omit [DecidableEq Symbol] in
+theorem clearedCfg_cons {σ₁ : Type*} (i : Fin k) (l : List (Fin k))
+    (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) :
+    clearedCfg (σ' := σ') (i :: l) C =
+      clearedCfg (σ' := σ') l (clearedCfg (σ' := σ₁) [i] C) := by
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext j <;>
+    simp only [clearedCfg, List.mem_cons] <;>
+    by_cases hj : pairIdx j = i <;> by_cases hj' : pairIdx j ∈ l <;> simp [hj, hj']
+
+omit [DecidableEq Symbol] in
+@[simp] theorem Sequential.rightCfg_clearedCfg {State₀ State₁ : Type*} (l : List (Fin k))
+    (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) :
+    Sequential.rightCfg (State₀ := State₀) (clearedCfg (σ' := State₁) l C) =
+      clearedCfg (σ' := State₀ ⊕ State₁) l C := rfl
+
+omit [DecidableEq Symbol] in
+/-- Clearing tapes `l` preserves `PairReady` on any tape `i ∉ l`. -/
+theorem PairReady.clearedCfg {C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input} {i : Fin k} {a b c : ℕ}
+    {V : Finset ℤ} {l : List (Fin k)} (h : PairReady m₀ m₁ C i a b c V) (hil : i ∉ l) :
+    PairReady m₀ m₁ (Turing.MultiTapeTM.clearedCfg (σ' := σ') l C) i a b c V where
+  pos_castAdd := by simp [Turing.MultiTapeTM.clearedCfg, hil, h.pos_castAdd]
+  pos_natAdd := by simpa [Turing.MultiTapeTM.clearedCfg, hil] using h.pos_natAdd
+  insert_eq := h.insert_eq
+  shadow_eq := by simpa [Turing.MultiTapeTM.clearedCfg, hil] using h.shadow_eq
+  blank y hy := by simp [Turing.MultiTapeTM.clearedCfg, hil, h.blank y hy]
+
+/-- **Clearing one work tape and its shadow** inside a machine with `k + k` work tapes. -/
+theorem runFrom_clearShadowed_pairEmb (hm : m₀ ≠ m₁) {C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input} {i : Fin k}
+    {a b c : ℕ} {V : Finset ℤ} (h : PairReady m₀ m₁ C i a b c V) :
+    ((clearShadowed m₀ m₁).extendTapes (pairEmb i)).runFrom (C.withState (some .start))
+        (a + 2 * b + c + 5) = clearedCfg [i] C := by
+  have hview : viewCfg (pairEmb i) (C.withState (some .start)) =
+      ClearShadowed.cfg (some .start) C.inputPos (C.workTapes (Fin.castAdd k i))
+        (shadowTape m₀ m₁ V) (c - a) C.output := by
+    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext j <;> fin_cases j
+    · rfl
+    · exact h.shadow_eq
+    · exact h.pos_castAdd
+    · exact h.pos_natAdd
+  rw [runFrom_extendTapes, hview, runFrom_clearShadowed hm h.insert_eq h.blank]
+  have hne : i.addNat k ≠ Fin.castAdd k i := by
+    rw [← Fin.natAdd_eq_addNat]
+    exact (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd i i).symm
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext j <;>
+    simp only [embed, partialInv_pairEmb, clearedCfg, List.mem_singleton, Cfg.withState,
+      pairIdx_eq_iff] <;>
+    by_cases h₀ : j = Fin.castAdd k i <;> by_cases h₁ : j = i.addNat k <;>
+    simp [h₀, h₁, hne]
+
+/-- The control states of `clearList` for a list of length `n`. -/
+def ClearListState : ℕ → Type
+  | 0 => Unit
+  | n + 1 => ClearShadowedState ⊕ ClearListState n
+
+instance instFiniteClearListState : (n : ℕ) → Finite (ClearListState n)
+  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)
+  | n + 1 =>
+    haveI := instFiniteClearListState n
+    inferInstanceAs (Finite (ClearShadowedState ⊕ ClearListState n))
+
+variable (m₀ m₁) in
+/-- Clear the work tapes in `l` along their shadows, one after the other. -/
+noncomputable def clearList :
+    (l : List (Fin k)) → MultiTapeTM (k + k) Symbol (ClearListState l.length)
+  | [] => nop (k + k) Symbol
+  | i :: l => ((clearShadowed m₀ m₁).extendTapes (pairEmb i)).seq (clearList l)
+
+/-- **Clearing a list of work tapes** with their shadows, each ready to be cleared: a run path of
+`clearList m₀ m₁ l` to the configuration with these tapes cleared. -/
+theorem exists_runPath_clearList (hm : m₀ ≠ m₁) (l : List (Fin k)) (hl : l.Nodup)
+    (a b c : Fin k → ℕ) (V : Fin k → Finset ℤ) (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input)
+    (hC : ∀ i ∈ l, PairReady m₀ m₁ C i (a i) (b i) (c i) (V i)) :
+    ∃ p : (clearList m₀ m₁ l).RunPath input,
+      p.head = C.withState (some (clearList m₀ m₁ l).q₀) ∧ p.last = clearedCfg l C ∧
+        p.time ≤ (l.map fun i => a i + 2 * b i + c i + 5).sum + 1 := by
+  induction l generalizing C σ with
+  | nil =>
+    exact ⟨.ofDeterministic _ _ 1, rfl,
+      (runFrom_nop_withState C).trans (clearedCfg_nil C).symm, le_rfl⟩
+  | cons i l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨hil, hl⟩ := List.nodup_cons.1 hl
+    have hmid := runFrom_clearShadowed_pairEmb hm (hC i List.mem_cons_self)
+    obtain ⟨p₁, hh₁, hl₁, ht₁⟩ := ih hl (clearedCfg (σ' := σ) [i] C) fun j hj =>
+      (hC j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj)).clearedCfg (by simp [ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hil])
+    -- clear tape `i`, then the others
+    obtain ⟨p, hh, hl', ht, -⟩ := exists_runPath_seq
+      (p₀ := .ofDeterministic ((clearShadowed m₀ m₁).extendTapes (pairEmb i))
+        (C.withState (some .start)) (a i + 2 * b i + c i + 5)) (p₁ := p₁)
+      (by rw [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hmid]; rfl)
+      (by rw [hh₁, MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hmid]; rfl) (by rw [hl₁]; rfl)
+    refine ⟨p, hh, hl'.trans ?_, ?_⟩
+    · rw [hl₁, Sequential.rightCfg_clearedCfg]
+      exact (clearedCfg_cons i l C).symm
+    · change p.length ≤ a i + 2 * b i + c i + 5 + p₁.length at ht
+      change p₁.length ≤ _ at ht₁
+      change p.length ≤ _
+      rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
+      omega
+
+/-! ### The tidy normal form -/
+
+variable {State : Type*}
+
+variable (m₀ m₁) in
+/-- The tidy normal form of `tm`: run `tm` with shadowed work tapes, clear every work tape along
+its shadow, and rewind the input head. The symbols `m₀` and `m₁` mark the shadows. -/
+noncomputable def tidy (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) :
+    MultiTapeTM (k + k) Symbol
+      ((Option State ⊕ ClearListState (List.finRange k).length) ⊕ RewindState) :=
+  ((shadow m₀ m₁ tm).seq (clearList m₀ m₁ (List.finRange k))).seq
+    ((rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes (k + k)))
+
+variable {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+
+omit [DecidableEq Symbol] in
+/-- The configuration in which the clearing phase ends: halted, with blank work tapes and every
+head on its start cell. -/
+private theorem clearedCfg_finRange (C : Cfg (k + k) Symbol σ input) :
+    clearedCfg (σ' := σ') (List.finRange k) C = ⟨none, C.inputPos, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0,
+      C.output⟩ := by
+  simp [clearedCfg]
+
+/-- **The run of the tidy normal form.** If `tm` first halts at step `u`, having used `S` cells,
+then `tidy m₀ m₁ tm` has a run path to the halted configuration with blank work tapes, every head on
+its start cell and the output of `tm`, taking at most `2 u + 3 S + 2 k + 4` steps and visiting at
+most `2 S + 2 k (3 S + 2 k + 3)` cells. -/
+theorem exists_runPath_tidy (hm : m₀ ≠ m₁) {u : ℕ}
+    (hlt : ∀ m < u, ¬(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) m).Halted)
+    (hu : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) u).Halted) :
+    ∃ p : (tidy m₀ m₁ tm).RunPath input, p.head = (tidy m₀ m₁ tm).initCfg input ∧
+      p.last = wordsCfg input none (fun _ => []) (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) u).output ∧
+      p.time ≤ 2 * u + 3 * tm.space (tm.initCfg input) u + 2 * k + 4 ∧
+      p.space ≤ 2 * tm.space (tm.initCfg input) u +
+        2 * k * (3 * tm.space (tm.initCfg input) u + 2 * k + 3) := by
+  set c₀ := tm.initCfg input
+  set D := tm.runFrom c₀ u
+  set S := tm.space c₀ u
+  set C₁ := Shadow.cfg m₀ m₁ D (Shadow.visited tm c₀ u)
+  -- the visited cells of each tape form an interval `[L i, R i]` around the start cell
+  choose L R hLR using fun i => exists_visitedByTapeHead_eq_Icc (tm := tm) c₀ u i
+  have h0 : ∀ i, (0 : ℤ) ∈ Finset.Icc (L i) (R i) := fun i =>
+    hLR i ▸ mem_visitedByTapeHead.2 ⟨0, by omega, rfl⟩
+  have hp : ∀ i, D.workTapePos i ∈ Finset.Icc (L i) (R i) := fun i =>
+    hLR i ▸ mem_visitedByTapeHead_self c₀ u i
+  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at h0 hp
+  set a : Fin k → ℕ := fun i => (-L i).toNat
+  set b : Fin k → ℕ := fun i => (R i).toNat
+  set c : Fin k → ℕ := fun i => (D.workTapePos i - L i).toNat
+  have ha : ∀ i, (a i : ℤ) = -L i := fun i => Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by have := h0 i; omega)
+  have hb : ∀ i, (b i : ℤ) = R i := fun i => Int.toNat_of_nonneg (h0 i).2
+  have hc : ∀ i, (c i : ℤ) = D.workTapePos i - L i := fun i =>
+    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by have := hp i; omega)
+  have hready : ∀ i ∈ List.finRange k,
+      PairReady m₀ m₁ C₁ i (a i) (b i) (c i) (Shadow.visited tm c₀ u i) := fun i _ => by
+    have hIcc : Finset.Icc (-(a i : ℤ)) (b i) = Finset.Icc (L i) (R i) := by rw [ha, hb, neg_neg]
+    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
+    · simp only [C₁, Shadow.cfg, Fin.append_left, ha, hc]
+      ring
+    · simp only [C₁, Shadow.cfg, Fin.append_right, ha, hc]
+      ring
+    · rw [hIcc, ← hLR, Shadow.visitedByTapeHead_eq_insert, ha, hc]
+      congr 1
+      ring
+    · simp only [C₁, Shadow.cfg, Fin.append_right]
+    · rw [hIcc, ← hLR] at hy
+      simp only [C₁, Shadow.cfg, Fin.append_left]
+      exact workTapes_runFrom_eq_of_notMem_visitedByTapeHead hy
+  -- the three phases: shadowing, clearing, rewinding the input head
+  have hA : (shadow m₀ m₁ tm).runFrom ((shadow m₀ m₁ tm).initCfg input) (u + 1) = C₁ :=
+    runFrom_shadow hlt
+  have hC₁ : C₁.Halted := by
+    simp only [Cfg.Halted, C₁, Shadow.cfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff]
+    exact hu
+  obtain ⟨pB, hhB, hlB, htB⟩ := exists_runPath_clearList hm (List.finRange k)
+    (List.nodup_finRange k) a b c (Shadow.visited tm c₀ u) C₁ hready
+  rw [clearedCfg_finRange] at hlB
+  obtain ⟨pAB, hhAB, hlAB, htAB, hsAB⟩ := exists_runPath_seq_space_le
+    (p₀ := .ofDeterministic (shadow m₀ m₁ tm) ((shadow m₀ m₁ tm).initCfg input) (u + 1))
+    (p₁ := pB) (by rw [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hA]; exact hC₁)
+    (by rw [hhB, MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hA]) (by rw [hlB])
+  set R₀ : Cfg (k + k) Symbol RewindState input :=
+    (Sequential.rightCfg (State₀ := Option State)
+      (⟨none, C₁.inputPos, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, C₁.output⟩ :
+        Cfg (k + k) Symbol (ClearListState (List.finRange k).length) input)).withState
+      (some ((rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes (k + k))).q₀)
+  have hR : ((rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes (k + k))).runFrom R₀
+      (C₁.inputPos.val - 1 + 2) = ⟨none, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, C₁.output⟩ := by
+    rw [runFrom_noTapes]
+    simp only [R₀, noTapesCfg, Cfg.withState, Sequential.rightCfg, Cfg.mapState, extendTapes_q₀,
+      runFrom_rewindInput]
+  obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, ht, hs⟩ := exists_runPath_seq_space_le (p₀ := pAB)
+    (p₁ := .ofDeterministic ((rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes (k + k))) R₀
+      (C₁.inputPos.val - 1 + 2))
+    (by rw [hlAB, hlB]; rfl) (by rw [hlAB, hlB]; rfl)
+    (by rw [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hR])
+  -- the time bound
+  set Tc := ((List.finRange k).map fun i => a i + 2 * b i + c i + 5).sum + 1
+  have hcard : ∀ i, a i + b i + 1 = tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ u i := fun i => by
+    rw [spaceUsedByTape, hLR, Int.card_Icc]
+    have := ha i
+    have := hb i
+    omega
+  have hTc : Tc ≤ 3 * S + 2 * k + 1 := by
+    have hsum : ((List.finRange k).map fun i => a i + 2 * b i + c i + 5).sum ≤
+        ∑ i, (3 * tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ u i + 2) := by
+      rw [← Fin.sum_univ_def]
+      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
+      have := hcard i
+      have := hp i
+      have := ha i
+      have := hb i
+      have := hc i
+      omega
+    have : ∑ i, (3 * tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ u i + 2) = 3 * S + 2 * k := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
+      simp [S, space_eq_sum_spaceUsedByTape, mul_comm]
+    omega
+  have hTr : C₁.inputPos.val - 1 + 2 ≤ u + 2 := by
+    have h₁ : (D.inputPos : ℕ) ≤ (c₀.inputPos : ℕ) + u := inputPos_runFrom_le tm c₀ u
+    have h₂ : (c₀.inputPos : ℕ) = 1 := rfl
+    change (D.inputPos : ℕ) - 1 + 2 ≤ u + 2
+    omega
+  change pB.length ≤ Tc at htB
+  refine ⟨p, hh.trans (by rw [hhAB]; rfl), hl.trans ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.last_ofDeterministic, hR]
+    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ rfl rfl
+    funext i
+    exact tapeOfList_nil.symm
+  · change p.length ≤ pAB.length + (C₁.inputPos.val - 1 + 2) at ht
+    change pAB.length ≤ u + 1 + pB.length at htAB
+    change p.length ≤ _
+    omega
+  · -- the shadowing phase visits `2 S` cells, the clearing phase at most one new cell per tape and
+    -- step, and the rewinding phase one cell per tape
+    refine hs.trans ?_
+    have hsA : (MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic (shadow m₀ m₁ tm)
+        ((shadow m₀ m₁ tm).initCfg input) (u + 1)).space = 2 * S := space_shadow hlt
+    have hsB : pB.space ≤ (k + k) * pB.length + (k + k) :=
+      pB.space_le_mul_time_add_one.trans_eq (Nat.mul_add_one _ _)
+    have hsR : (MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic
+        ((rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes (k + k))) R₀ (C₁.inputPos.val - 1 + 2)).space ≤
+        k + k :=
+      space_noTapes_le _ _ _
+    have h₂ : (k + k) * pB.length ≤ 2 * k * (3 * S + 2 * k + 1) :=
+      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (htB.trans hTc)).trans_eq (by ring)
+    have h₃ : 2 * k * (3 * S + 2 * k + 3) = 2 * k * (3 * S + 2 * k + 1) + 4 * k := by ring
+    omega
+
+/-- **The tidy normal form.** What `tm` computes within `t` steps and `s` cells,
+`tidy m₀ m₁ tm` computes tidily within `2 t + 3 s + 2 k + 4` steps and `2 s + 2 k (3 s + 2 k + 3)`
+cells, for any two distinct marks `m₀` and `m₁`. -/
+theorem ComputesInTimeAndSpace.computesTidily_tidy (hm : m₀ ≠ m₁) {output : List Symbol}
+    {t s : ℕ} (h : tm.ComputesInTimeAndSpace input output t s) :
+    (tidy m₀ m₁ tm).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output (2 * t + 3 * s + 2 * k + 4)
+      (2 * s + 2 * k * (3 * s + 2 * k + 3)) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨u', hu', hout⟩, ht, hs⟩ := h
+  -- the first step at which `tm` has halted
+  obtain ⟨u, -, hu, hlt⟩ := exists_haltsAt hu'
+  have hut : u ≤ t := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun h => hlt t h (runsInTime_iff_halted.mp ht)
+  have hout' : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) u).output = output := by
+    rw [← hout, runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_lt fun h => hlt u' h hu') hu]
+  have hS := space_le_of_runsInSpace hs u
+  obtain ⟨p, hhead, hlast, htime, hspace⟩ := exists_runPath_tidy hm hlt hu
+  rw [computesTidily_iff]
+  refine ⟨p, hhead.trans (initCfg_eq_wordsCfg input), hlast.trans (by rw [hout']), by omega,
+    hspace.trans (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hS) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_))⟩
+  omega
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # Finite-state transducers and their machine semantics
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource
+formulas. Higher computability-calculus theorems remain in the original facade.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-- A finite-state transducer with input and output alphabet `Symbol` and states `Q`. In state `q`
+on the symbol `a` it moves to `(step q a).1` and emits `(step q a).2`; at the end of the input it
+emits `final q`. -/
+public structure Transducer (Symbol Q : Type*) where
+  /-- The initial state. -/
+  q₀ : Q
+  /-- The successor state and the emitted word on reading a symbol. -/
+  step : Q → Symbol → Q × List Symbol
+  /-- The word emitted at the end of the input. -/
+  final : Q → List Symbol
+  /-- At most two symbols are emitted per input symbol. -/
+  length_step_le : ∀ q a, (step q a).2.length ≤ 2
+  /-- At most two symbols are emitted at the end of the input. -/
+  length_final_le : ∀ q, (final q).length ≤ 2
+
+namespace Transducer
+
+variable {Symbol Q : Type*} (τ : Transducer Symbol Q)
+
+/-- The word `τ` emits on `w`, started in state `q`. -/
+@[expose] public def run : Q → List Symbol → List Symbol
+  | q, [] => τ.final q
+  | q, a :: w => (τ.step q a).2 ++ run (τ.step q a).1 w
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma run_nil (q : Q) : τ.run q [] = τ.final q := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma run_cons (q : Q) (a : Symbol) (w : List Symbol) :
+    τ.run q (a :: w) = (τ.step q a).2 ++ τ.run (τ.step q a).1 w := rfl
+
+/-- `τ` as a machine without work tapes. Its states are the states of `τ`, a pending output
+symbol, and whether the end of the input has been reached. -/
+public def toTM : MultiTapeTM 0 Symbol (Q × Option Symbol × Bool) :=
+  ofTr (τ.q₀, none, false) fun st inp _ =>
+    match st with
+    | (q, some b, fin) =>
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := some b, state := some (q, none, fin) }
+    | (_, none, true) =>
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := none }
+    | (q, none, false) =>
+      match inp with
+      | some a =>
+        { inputTape := 1, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := (τ.step q a).2.head?,
+          state := some ((τ.step q a).1, (τ.step q a).2.tail.head?, false) }
+      | none =>
+        { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := (τ.final q).head?,
+          state := some (q, (τ.final q).tail.head?, true) }
+
+/-- A word of length at most two is its head followed by the head of its tail. -/
+lemma toList_head?_append {w : List Symbol} (h : w.length ≤ 2) :
+    w.head?.toList ++ w.tail.head?.toList = w := by
+  match w, h with
+  | [], _ => rfl
+  | [_], _ => rfl
+  | [_, _], _ => rfl
+
+variable {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- The configuration of `τ.toTM` in state `st` with the input head at `pos`, having emitted `o`. -/
+def cfg (input : List Symbol) (st : Option (Q × Option Symbol × Bool))
+    (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    Cfg 0 Symbol (Q × Option Symbol × Bool) input :=
+  ⟨st, pos, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, o⟩
+
+/-- A pending symbol is emitted. -/
+lemma step_pending (q : Q) (b : Symbol) (fin : Bool) (pos : Fin (input.length + 2))
+    (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, some b, fin)) pos o) = cfg input (some (q, none, fin)) pos
+      (o ++ [b]) := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- After the end of the input, the machine halts. -/
+lemma step_halt (q : Q) (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, true)) pos o) = cfg input none pos o := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- Flushing a possibly pending symbol takes at most one step. -/
+lemma exists_runFrom_flush (q : Q) (p : Option Symbol) (fin : Bool)
+    (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    ∃ u ≤ 1, τ.toTM.runFrom (cfg input (some (q, p, fin)) pos o) u =
+      cfg input (some (q, none, fin)) pos (o ++ p.toList) := by
+  cases p with
+  | none => exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, by simp [runFrom]⟩
+  | some b => exact ⟨1, le_rfl, by simp [runFrom, step_pending]⟩
+
+/-- Reading the input symbol at position `i`. -/
+lemma step_read (q : Q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < input.length) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o) =
+      cfg input (some ((τ.step q input[i]).1, (τ.step q input[i]).2.tail.head?, false))
+        ⟨i + 1 + 1, by omega⟩ (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2.head?.toList) := by
+  have hsym : (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o).inputSymbol =
+      some input[i] := inputSymbolInner i (by simp only [cfg]; omega) hi
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, hsym]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes (by simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]) ?_
+    (by simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply])
+  simp only [cfg, toTM, tr_ofTr, Action.apply]
+  exact moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp only; omega)
+
+/-- Reaching the end of the input. -/
+lemma step_end (q : Q) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ o) =
+      cfg input (some (q, (τ.final q).tail.head?, true)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩
+        (o ++ (τ.final q).head?.toList) := by
+  have hsym : (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ o).inputSymbol =
+      none := inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inr rfl)
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, hsym]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- From input position `i` on, the machine halts within `2 * (input.length - i) + 3` steps,
+having emitted what `τ` emits on the rest of the input. -/
+lemma exists_runFrom_halt (q : Q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ input.length) (o : List Symbol) :
+    ∃ u ≤ 2 * (input.length - i) + 3, ∃ pos,
+      τ.toTM.runFrom (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o) u =
+        cfg input none pos (o ++ τ.run q (input.drop i)) := by
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, input.length - i = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  induction n generalizing i q o with
+  | zero =>
+    obtain rfl : i = input.length := by omega
+    obtain ⟨u, hu, hflush⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_flush (input := input) q (τ.final q).tail.head?
+      true ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ (o ++ (τ.final q).head?.toList)
+    refine ⟨1 + u + 1, by omega, ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
+    rw [runFrom_add, runFrom_add, runFrom_one, runFrom_one, step_end, hflush, step_halt]
+    rw [List.drop_length, run_nil, List.append_assoc, toList_head?_append (τ.length_final_le q)]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    have hi' : i < input.length := by omega
+    obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁, hflush⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_flush (input := input) (τ.step q input[i]).1
+      (τ.step q input[i]).2.tail.head? false ⟨i + 1 + 1, by omega⟩
+      (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2.head?.toList)
+    obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂, pos, hrest⟩ := ih (τ.step q input[i]).1 (i := i + 1) (by omega)
+      (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2) (by omega)
+    refine ⟨1 + u₁ + u₂, by omega, pos, ?_⟩
+    rw [runFrom_add, runFrom_add, runFrom_one, step_read _ _ hi', hflush,
+      List.append_assoc, toList_head?_append (τ.length_step_le _ _), hrest,
+      List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi', run_cons, List.append_assoc]
+
+/-- `τ.toTM` emits `τ.run τ.q₀ input` on `input`, in `2 * input.length + 3` steps and zero
+space. -/
+public theorem computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM (input : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.ComputesInTimeAndSpace input (τ.run τ.q₀ input) (2 * input.length + 3) 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨u, hu, pos, hrun⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_halt τ.q₀ (Nat.zero_le input.length) []
+  have hinit : τ.toTM.initCfg input = cfg input (some (τ.q₀, none, false)) ⟨0 + 1, by omega⟩ [] :=
+    Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl (Fin.ext (by simp [MultiTapeNTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, cfg])) rfl
+  rw [← hinit, List.drop_zero, List.nil_append] at hrun
+  have hhalt : (τ.toTM.runFrom (τ.toTM.initCfg input) u).Halted := by
+    rw [hrun]
+    rfl
+  refine ⟨⟨u, hhalt, by rw [hrun]; rfl⟩, runsInTime_iff_halted.mpr ?_, by simp⟩
+  rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ (by omega : u ≤ 2 * input.length + 3) hhalt]
+  exact hhalt
+
+/-- Followed by a rewind of the input head, `τ.toTM` emits `τ.run τ.q₀ input` tidily. -/
+public theorem computesTidily (input : List Symbol) :
+    (τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input (τ.run τ.q₀ input)
+      (4 * input.length + 8) 0 :=
+  TransformsTapes.mono (τ.computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM input).computesTidily_seq_rewindInput
+    (by omega) le_rfl
+
+end Transducer
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-! # The existing zero-workspace rewind and copy machines
+
+Machine declarations are moved from their original module without changing programs or resource

+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM

+variable {Symbol : Type*} {input : List Symbol}

+/-! ### Machines without work tapes -/
+
+section NoWorkTapes
+
+variable {State : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Symbol State}
+
+open Sequential in
+/-- If a machine without work tapes has a run path from its start to a halted configuration, then
+following it with `Turing.MultiTapeTM.rewindInput` computes the output of that configuration
+tidily: the rewind returns the input head from its position `p` in `p - 1 + 2` further steps. -/
+public theorem computesTidily_seq_rewindInput_of_runPath {q : tm.RunPath input}
+    (hh : q.head = wordsCfg input (some tm.q₀) (fun _ => []) []) (hl : q.last.Halted) :
+    (tm.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input q.last.output
+      (q.time + (q.last.inputPos.val - 1 + 2)) 0 := by
+  let r := MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic (rewindInput Symbol)
+    (q.last.withState (some (rewindInput Symbol).q₀)) (q.last.inputPos.val - 1 + 2)
+  have hr : r.last = wordsCfg input none (fun _ => []) q.last.output :=
+    (runFrom_rewindInput q.last.inputPos q.last.workTapes q.last.workTapePos q.last.output).trans
+      (Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl rfl rfl)
+  obtain ⟨p, hph, hpl, hpt, -⟩ := exists_runPath_seq hl rfl (by rw [hr]; rfl)
+  exact computesTidily_iff.mpr ⟨p, by rw [hph, hh]; rfl, by simp [hpl, hr, rightCfg], hpt,
+    by simp [MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.space]⟩
+
+/-- A machine without work tapes that computes `output` in time `t`, followed by
+`Turing.MultiTapeTM.rewindInput`, computes `output` tidily in time `2 * t + 2`: in `t` steps the
+input head moves at most `t` cells, so the rewind takes at most `t + 2` steps. -/
+public theorem ComputesInTimeAndSpace.computesTidily_seq_rewindInput {output : List Symbol}
+    {t s : ℕ} (h : ComputesInTimeAndSpace tm input output t s) :
+    (tm.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output (2 * t + 2) 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨u, hu_halt, hu_out⟩, htime, -⟩ := h
+  -- the computation path of `t` steps ends halted
+  let q := MultiTapeNTM.ComputationPath.ofDeterministic tm input t
+  have hl : q.last.Halted := htime q le_rfl
+  -- the machine has halted after both `t` and `u` steps, so the outputs agree
+  have hout : q.last.output = output := by
+    change (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).output = output
+    rcases le_total u t with hut | htu
+    · rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ hut hu_halt, hu_out]
+    · rw [← runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ htu hl, hu_out]
+  have hpos : q.last.inputPos.val ≤ 1 + t := by
+    change ((tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg input) t).inputPos : ℕ) ≤ 1 + t
+    simpa [Cfg.init] using inputPos_runFrom_le tm (tm.initCfg input) t
+  have h := computesTidily_seq_rewindInput_of_runPath (q := q.toRunPath)
+    (q.head_eq.trans (Cfg.init_eq_wordsCfg _ _)) hl
+  rw [hout] at h
+  exact h.mono (by change t + _ ≤ _; omega) le_rfl
+
+end NoWorkTapes
+
+/-! ### Zero space -/
+
+/-! ### The identity -/
+
+/-- The identity as a tidy machine without work tapes: copy the input to the output, then move the
+input head back to the start. -/
+public noncomputable def tidyCopy (Symbol : Type*) : MultiTapeTM 0 Symbol (Unit ⊕ RewindState) :=
+  copyInput.seq (rewindInput Symbol)
+
+/-- `tidyCopy` computes the identity tidily, in time linear in the length of the word. -/
+public theorem computesTidily_tidyCopy (w : List Symbol) :
+    (tidyCopy Symbol).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace w w (2 * w.length + 4) 0 :=
+  (CopyInput.computesInTimeAndSpace w).computesTidily_seq_rewindInput.mono (by omega) le_rfl
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-- Restrict a certificate to the inputs satisfying a proposition, using the same machine. -/

+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype p).trans encIn) encMid :=
+  let ⟨c, k, Q, hfin, tm, htm⟩ := h

+/-- Prepend the marker of the existing option encoding. -/
+theorem of_cons_true {f : α → β} (h : ∀ a, encMid (f a) = true :: encIn a) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid :=
+  of_transducer (Encodings.headT none) fun a => by
+    rw [h]; cases encIn a <;> simp [Encodings.headT_run_true, Encodings.headT_q₀,
+      Encodings.headT_step, Encodings.headT_final]

+  of_transducer (Encodings.headT (some false)) fun a => by
+    rw [h]; cases encIn a <;> simp [Encodings.headT_run_true, Encodings.headT_q₀,
+      Encodings.headT_step, Encodings.headT_final]

+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid :=
+  of_transducer (Encodings.headT (some true)) fun a => by
+    rw [h]; cases encIn a <;> simp [Encodings.headT_run_true, Encodings.headT_q₀,
+      Encodings.headT_step, Encodings.headT_final]
+
+/-- Test the encoded input for emptiness using the existing finite transducer. -/
+theorem of_isEmpty {f : α → Bool} (h : ∀ a, f a = (encIn a).isEmpty) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encBool :=
+  of_transducer Encodings.isEmptyT fun a => by
+    rw [h]; cases encIn a <;> simp [Encodings.isEmptyT_run_true, Encodings.isEmptyT_q₀,
+      Encodings.isEmptyT_step, Encodings.isEmptyT_final]

+/-- Concatenate two encoded outputs within a common linear bound. -/
+theorem append {δ : Type*} {enc₂ : δ ↪ List Bool} {f₁ : α → β} {f₂ : α → δ} {g : α → γ}
+    (h₁ : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f₁ encIn encMid)
+    (h₂ : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f₂ encIn enc₂)
+    (hg : ∀ a, encOut (g a) = encMid (f₁ a) ++ enc₂ (f₂ a)) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace g encIn encOut := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, k₁, Q₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear h₁
+  obtain ⟨c₂, k₂, Q₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear h₂
+  refine ⟨c₁ + c₂ + 2 * max k₁ k₂, _, _, inferInstance, appendTM tm₁ tm₂, fun a => ?_⟩

+    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hk
+    simp only [Nat.add_mul]

+/-- Choose branches on their actual domains; normalize only their realizing machines. -/
+theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
+    (hc : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace c encIn encC)
+    (hf : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid)
+    (hg : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (g ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun a => if c a then f a else g a) encIn encMid := by
+  have ht : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace c encIn encTest := (of_finite id).comp hc
+  obtain ⟨c₀, k₀, Q₀, _, tm₀, h₀⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear ht
+  obtain ⟨c₁, k₁, Q₁, _, tm₁, h₁⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear hf
+  obtain ⟨c₂, k₂, Q₂, _, tm₂, h₂⟩ := Internal.NormalForm.linear hg

+    (y := encMid (if c a then f a else g a))
+    (t₁ := c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1)) (s₁ := c₁ * ((encIn a).length + 1))
+    (t₂ := c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1)) (s₂ := c₂ * ((encIn a).length + 1))
+    (fun hw => by
+      have hca : c a = true := by cases hca : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
+      simpa [hca] using h₁ ⟨a, hca⟩)
+    (fun hw => by
+      have hca : c a = false := by cases hca : c a <;> simp_all [encTest_true, encTest_false]
+      simpa [hca] using h₂ ⟨a, hca⟩)
+  refine (h.mono ?_ ?_).computesInTimeAndSpace <;>
+    cases hca : c a <;> simp_all only [encTest_true, encTest_false, List.length_cons,
+      List.length_nil, List.cons_ne_self, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte] <;>
+    have hk := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 20)
+      (Nat.succ_pos (encIn a).length) <;>
+    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_mul] at * <;> omega
+
+/-- A fixed default on the empty word and a linear certificate on nonempty encoded inputs. -/
+theorem of_isEmpty_ite {f : α → β} (d : β) (hd : ∀ a, encIn a = [] → f a = d)
+    (h : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype fun a => (encIn a).isEmpty = false).trans encIn) encMid) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid := by
+  convert ite (c := fun a => (encIn a).isEmpty) (of_isEmpty fun _ => rfl)
+    ((const d).restrict _) h using 1
+  funext a
+  split_ifs with ha <;> simp_all

+/-- Pairing functions computable in linear time and space. -/
+theorem ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace.pair {α β₁ β₂ : Type u}
+    {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc : β₁ × β₂ ↪ List Bool} [hP : PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc] {f : α → β₁} {g : α → β₂}
+    (hf : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn enc₁)
+    (hg : ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace g encIn enc₂) :
+    ComputableInLinearTimeAndSpace (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hP.pair (h₁.mono (t' := fun x => (c₁ + c₂) * ((encIn x).length + 1))
+    (s' := fun x => (c₁ + c₂) * ((encIn x).length + 1)) (fun x => by ring_nf; omega)
+    (fun x => by ring_nf; omega))
+    (h₂.mono (fun x => by ring_nf; omega) (fun x => by ring_nf; omega))
+  refine ⟨c * (c + 2) * (c₁ + c₂ + 1), h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩
+  · ring_nf
+    omega
+  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (h.length_le x)
+    ring_nf at this ⊢
+    omega
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-

+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Encodings.Nat.Bits
+public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Size
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
+
+/-!
+# Binary word addition and comparison
+
+The carry fold, its value and length laws, and the highest-differing-bit characterization of
+strict order are pure facts about least-significant-first binary words. They do not import a
+computability calculus.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+open NatSucc
+
+namespace NatAdd
+
+/-- The binary digits of `2 * n + b`, if they do not end in a zero. -/
+lemma bits_bit (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) (h : n = 0 → b = true) :
+    (2 * n + b.toNat).bits = b :: n.bits := by
+  rw [← Nat.bit_val]
+  exact Nat.bits_append_bit n b h
+
+/-- The carry of adding three digits. -/
+def carry (a b c : Bool) : Bool := a && b || c && (a ^^ b)
+
+/-- Adds the digits `l` and `r` with the carry `c`, least significant first; `r` is padded with
+zeros. -/
+def addBits : Bool → List Bool → List Bool → List Bool
+  | c, [], r => incr c r
+  | c, a :: l, r => (a ^^ (r.headD false ^^ c)) :: addBits (carry a (r.headD false) c) l r.tail
+
+/-- Incrementing a canonical word represents addition of its incoming carry. -/
+lemma incr_bits (c : Bool) (n : ℕ) : incr c n.bits = (n + c.toNat).bits := by
+  cases c
+  · simp [incr]
+  · exact (bits_succ n).symm
+
+/-- The word adder computes the sum of two natural numbers and an incoming carry. -/
+lemma addBits_bits (c : Bool) (m n : ℕ) : addBits c m.bits n.bits = (m + n + c.toNat).bits := by
+  induction m using Nat.binaryRec' generalizing c n with
+  | zero => simp [addBits, incr_bits]
+  | bit a m hm ih =>
+    rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ hm, addBits]
+    induction n using Nat.binaryRec' with
+    | zero =>
+      have h := ih (carry a false c) 0
+      rw [Nat.zero_bits] at h
+      rw [Nat.zero_bits, List.headD_nil, List.tail_nil, h, Nat.bit_val,
+        show 2 * m + a.toNat + 0 + c.toNat = 2 * (m + 0 + (carry a false c).toNat) +
+          (a ^^ (false ^^ c)).toNat by cases a <;> cases c <;> simp [carry]; omega,
+        bits_bit]
+      cases a <;> cases c <;> simp_all [carry]
+    | bit b n hn _ =>
+      rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ hn, List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, ih, Nat.bit_val,
+        Nat.bit_val, show 2 * m + a.toNat + (2 * n + b.toNat) + c.toNat =
+          2 * (m + n + (carry a b c).toNat) + (a ^^ (b ^^ c)).toNat by
+          cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp [carry] <;> omega, bits_bit]
+      cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all [carry]
+
+/-- One round: add the digit `a`, the next digit of the rest `r` and the carry `c`. -/
+def addStep (s : Bool × List Bool × List Bool) (a : Bool) : Bool × List Bool × List Bool :=
+  (carry a (s.2.1.headD false) s.1, s.2.1.tail, s.2.2 ++ [a ^^ (s.2.1.headD false ^^ s.1)])
+
+/-- The fold invariant splits the accumulated digits from the remaining carry addition. -/
+lemma foldl_addStep (l : List Bool) (c : Bool) (r out : List Bool) :
+    let s := l.foldl addStep (c, r, out)
+    out ++ addBits c l r = s.2.2 ++ incr s.1 s.2.1 := by
+  induction l generalizing c r out with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons a l ih => simp [addBits, ← ih, addStep]
+
+/-- Each round consumes at most one remaining digit and emits exactly one output digit. -/
+lemma length_foldl_addStep (l : List Bool) (s : Bool × List Bool × List Bool) :
+    (l.foldl addStep s).2.1.length ≤ s.2.1.length ∧
+      (l.foldl addStep s).2.2.length = s.2.2.length + l.length := by
+  induction l generalizing s with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih (addStep s a)
+    exact ⟨h₁.trans (by simp [addStep]), h₂.trans (by simp [addStep]; omega)⟩
+
+end NatAdd
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+namespace Nat
+
+/-- `m < n` exactly when some bit position below the length of `n` holds a zero in `m` and a one
+in `n`, and every higher position below the total length agrees. -/
+theorem lt_iff_exists_testBit (m n : ℕ) :
+    m < n ↔ ∃ i < n.size, m.testBit i = false ∧ n.testBit i = true ∧
+      ∀ j < m.size + n.size, i < j → m.testBit j = n.testBit j := by
+  have hbig {k j : ℕ} (hj : k.size ≤ j) : k.testBit j = false :=
+    Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt ((Nat.lt_size_self k).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by lia) hj))
+  constructor
+  · intro hlt
+    obtain ⟨i, hi, hhigh⟩ := Nat.exists_most_significant_bit
+      (show m ^^^ n ≠ 0 from fun h => hlt.ne (Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq fun j => by
+        have := Nat.testBit_xor m n j
+        rw [h, Nat.zero_testBit] at this
+        revert this
+        cases m.testBit j <;> cases n.testBit j <;> simp))
+    rw [Nat.testBit_xor] at hi
+    have heq : ∀ j, i < j → m.testBit j = n.testBit j := fun j hj => by
+      have := hhigh j hj
+      rw [Nat.testBit_xor] at this
+      revert this
+      cases m.testBit j <;> cases n.testBit j <;> simp
+    cases hmi : m.testBit i <;> cases hni : n.testBit i <;> rw [hmi, hni] at hi
+    · simp at hi
+    · refine ⟨i, ?_, hmi, hni, fun j _ hj => heq j hj⟩
+      by_contra h
+      rw [hbig (Nat.le_of_not_lt h)] at hni
+      exact Bool.false_ne_true hni
+    · exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_testBit i hni hmi fun j hj => (heq j hj).symm) (Nat.lt_asymm hlt)
+    · simp at hi
+  · rintro ⟨i, -, hm, hn, h⟩
+    refine Nat.lt_of_testBit i hm hn fun j hj => ?_
+    by_cases hj' : j < m.size + n.size
+    · exact h j hj' hj
+    · rw [hbig (by lia), hbig (by lia)]
+
+
+end Nat

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+/-

+module

+

+/-!
+# Direct polynomial-time binary addition and comparison
+
+The existing carry folds and bit-position scan are certified using plain machine closure.
+Reachable word states are bounded by the encoded input length, not the numeric operands.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+open Cslib NatAdd NatSucc
+
+namespace ComputableInPolyTime
+
+/-- Addition of binary naturals, using the carry and remaining-word folds.
+Compose this certificate with the producers' `.prod` certificate. Global automatic addition
+remains separate from this named rule, since an unconstrained intermediate encoding can select
+a binary branch where a surrounding computation needs a unary size. -/
+theorem binary_add : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2)
+    (encPair encNat encNat) encNat := by
+  let encS := encPair encBool (encPair encBits encBits)
+  have hstep : ComputableInDegree (fun p : (Bool × List Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
+      addStep p.1 p.2) (encPair encS encBool) encS 1 1 := by
+    have hs := ComputableInDegree.fst encS encBool
+    have hrest := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBool (encPair encBits encBits)).comp hs
+    have hr := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBits encBits).comp hrest
+    have hflag := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBool (encPair encBits encBits)).comp hs
+    have hout := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBits encBits).comp hrest
+    have habc := (ComputableInDegree.snd encS encBool).prod
+      (Internal.DecoderWords.bool_degree.comp hr |>.prod hflag)
+    have hcarry := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite
+      (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
+      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => carry t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).comp habc
+    have hdigit := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite
+      (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
+      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => t.1 ^^ (t.2.1 ^^ t.2.2)).comp habc
+    exact (hcarry.prod ((Internal.DecoderWords.tail_degree.comp hr).prod
+      (hout.append hdigit (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl))).mono
+  have hbits : ComputableInPolyTime Nat.bits encNat encBits := of_eq fun _ => rfl
+  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encS)
+    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits) (init := fun p => (false, p.2.bits, []))
+    (hbits.comp (fst encNat encNat))
+    ((const false).prod ((hbits.comp (snd encNat encNat)).prod (const [])))
+    hstep.computableInPolyTime
+    (B := fun p => 2 * (encPair encNat encNat p).length + 4)
+    (PolyBounded.of_forall_le 4 1 fun _ => by simp only [pow_one]; omega) (by
+      intro p i _
+      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := length_foldl_addStep (p.1.bits.take i) (false, p.2.bits, [])
+      simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encBits_apply,
+        encNat_apply, List.length_take, List.length_nil] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
+      omega)
+  let encAcc := encPair encBool encBits
+  have hsuccStep : ComputableInDegree (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool =>
+      succStep p.1 p.2) (encPair encAcc encBool) encAcc 1 1 := by
+    have hs := ComputableInDegree.fst encAcc encBool
+    have hb := ComputableInDegree.snd encAcc encBool
+    have hflag := (ComputableInDegree.fst encBool encBits).comp hs
+    have hout := (ComputableInDegree.snd encBool encBits).comp hs
+    have hc := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+      fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 && q.2).comp (hflag.prod hb)
+    have hd := (ComputableInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+      fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 ^^ q.2).comp (hflag.prod hb)
+    exact (hc.prod (hout.append hd (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl)).mono
+  have hfinish : ComputableInPolyTime succFinish encAcc encBits := by
+    have hword := ComputableInDegree.snd encBool encBits
+    have hyes : ComputableInDegree (fun p : Bool × List Bool => p.2 ++ [true])
+        encAcc encBits 1 1 :=
+      hword.append (ComputableInDegree.const (encMid := encBool) true)
+        (encOut := encBits) (fun _ => rfl)
+    exact ite (fst encBool encBits) hyes.computableInPolyTime (snd encBool encBits)
+  have hs : ComputableInPolyTime id encS encS := id'
+  have hfin := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encAcc)
+    hs.snd'.fst' (hs.fst'.prod hs.snd'.snd') hsuccStep.computableInPolyTime
+    (B := fun s => (encS s).length + 3)
+    (PolyBounded.of_forall_le 3 1 fun _ => by simp only [pow_one]; omega) (by
+      intro s i _
+      simp only [length_foldl_succStep, encS, encAcc, length_encPair, encBool_apply, id_eq,
+        List.length_singleton, encBits_apply, List.length_take]
+      omega)
+  refine ((hfinish.comp hfin).comp hfold).of_enc_eq fun p => ?_
+  simp only [Function.comp_apply, id_eq, encBits_apply, encNat_apply]
+  rw [succFinish_foldl, ← foldl_addStep, List.nil_append, addBits_bits]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Strict comparison by scanning binary bit positions, never the numeric operand range. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem binary_lt : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (p.1 < p.2))
+    (encPair encNat encNat) encBool := by
+  have hbits : ComputableInPolyTime Nat.bits encNat encBits := of_eq fun _ => rfl
+  have hlen : ComputableInPolyTime (fun n : ℕ => n.bits.length) encNat encUnary :=
+    Internal.DecoderWords.unary_degree.computableInPolyTime.comp hbits
+  have hwords : ComputableInDegree (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits ++ p.2.bits)
+      (encPair encNat encNat) encBits 1 1 :=
+    (ComputableInDegree.fst encNat encNat).append (ComputableInDegree.snd encNat encNat)
+      (fun _ => rfl)
+  have hsum : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits.length + p.2.bits.length)
+      (encPair encNat encNat) encUnary := by
+    simpa only [Function.comp_def, List.length_append] using
+      Internal.DecoderWords.unary_degree.computableInPolyTime.comp hwords.computableInPolyTime
+  have hscan : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ =>
+      (List.range p.2.bits.length).any fun i =>
+        !p.1.bits.getD i false && p.2.bits.getD i false &&
+          (List.range (p.1.bits.length + p.2.bits.length)).all fun j =>
+            decide (j ≤ i) || p.1.bits.getD j false == p.2.bits.getD j false)
+      (encPair encNat encNat) encBool := by
+    simp only [List.any_eq_not_all_not]
+    apply bool_not.comp
+    apply allWithInput (range.comp (hlen.comp (snd encNat encNat)))
+    apply bool_not.comp
+    let input := encPair (encPair encNat encNat) encUnary
+    have hlist := range.comp (hsum.comp (fst (encPair encNat encNat) encUnary))
+    have hhigh : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ =>
+        (List.range (p.1.1.bits.length + p.1.2.bits.length)).all fun j =>
+          decide (j ≤ p.2) || p.1.1.bits.getD j false == p.1.2.bits.getD j false)
+        input encBool := by
+      apply allWithInput hlist
+      fun_prop
+    have hflags : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ =>
+        !p.1.1.bits.getD p.2 false && p.1.2.bits.getD p.2 false) input encBool := by
+      fun_prop
+    exact bool_and.comp (hflags.prod hhigh)
+  refine hscan.of_enc_eq fun p => congrArg encBool ?_
+  have hbit (k i : ℕ) : k.bits.getD i false = k.testBit i := by
+    rw [Nat.testBit_eq_inth, ← List.getD_default_eq_getI]
+    rfl
+  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, Nat.lt_iff_exists_testBit]
+  simp only [hbit, Nat.size_eq_bits_len, List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range, Bool.and_eq_true,
+    Bool.not_eq_true', List.all_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq]
+  refine exists_congr fun i => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
+  rw [and_assoc]
+  refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => forall₂_congr fun j _ => ?_
+  rw [← Nat.not_le, imp_iff_not_or, not_not]
+
+end ComputableInPolyTime
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+
+/-! Direct binary arithmetic has no higher tidy calculus in its import environment. -/

+
+-- Production clients use the ordinary named certificate and direct composition.
+example {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {left right : α → ℕ}
+    (hl : ComputableInPolyTime left input encNat)
+    (hr : ComputableInPolyTime right input encNat) :

+
+-- These backend fixtures opt in locally; they are not default-global automation claims.
+section LocalAdditionAutomation
+attribute [local fun_prop] ComputableInPolyTime.binary_add
+
+example {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {left right : α → ℕ}
+    (hl : ComputableInPolyTime left input encNat)
+    (hr : ComputableInPolyTime right input encNat) :
+    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => left a + right a) input encNat := by
+  fail_if_success (clear hr; fun_prop)
+  fail_if_success (clear hl; fun_prop)
+  fun_prop
+
+example : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2)
+    (encPair encNat encNat) encNat := by fun_prop
+
+end LocalAdditionAutomation
+
+example {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {left right : α → ℕ}
+    (hl : ComputableInPolyTime left input encNat)
+    (hr : ComputableInPolyTime right input encNat) :
+    ComputableInPolyTime (fun a => decide (left a < right a)) input encBool := by
+  fail_if_success (clear hl; fun_prop)
+  exact ComputableInPolyTime.binary_lt.comp (hl.prod hr)
+
+example : ComputableInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (p.1 < p.2))
+    (encPair encNat encNat) encBool := by fun_prop
+
+-- Numerically exponential values still have linear-size binary inputs.
+example (n : ℕ) : (encNat (2 ^ n)).length = n + 1 := by
+  rw [encNat_apply, Nat.size_eq_bits_len, Nat.size_pow]
+
+-- All carry lengths are covered, without materializing a numeric-length unary counter.
+example (n : ℕ) : NatAdd.addBits false (2 ^ n - 1).bits (1 : ℕ).bits = (2 ^ n).bits := by
+  rw [NatAdd.addBits_bits]
+  simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Nat.add_zero]

+  have : 0 < 2 ^ n := by positivity
+  omega
+
+example : NatAdd.addBits false [] [] = [] := rfl
+example : NatAdd.addBits false [true] [true] = [false, true] := rfl

+/-

+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate

+
+/-!
+# Mild Average-Case Hardness of Functions Against Efficient Heuristics
+
+This module formalizes generic mild average-case hardness definitions for functions
+`f : List Bool → ℕ` (and `f : List Bool → ℕ∞`) over the uniform distribution on `{0, 1}^n`
+following [Y. Liu and R. Pass, *On One-Way Functions and Kolmogorov Complexity*][LiuPass2020],
+together with monotonicity, one-sided-to-symmetric shifting bridges, rounded-logarithm comparison
+lemmas, and negative nonvacuity witnesses on the constant zero function. All section, definition,
+theorem, lemma, and page locators follow the full version `arXiv:2009.11514v1` (and ECCC TR20-052).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverage`: mild average-case hardness of exact computation for
+  `List Bool → ℕ` against uniform strict PPT heuristics
+  ([Liu and Pass, Definition 2.4, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox`: mild average-case hardness of symmetric
+  $g(n)$-approximation (`Nat.dist v (f x) ≤ g n`, i.e., $|v - f(x)| \le g(|x|)$) for
+  `List Bool → ℕ` against uniform strict PPT heuristics
+  ([Liu and Pass, Definition 2.5, §2.3, p. 8 of arXiv:2009.11514v1][LiuPass2020]).
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToOneSidedApprox`: library helper for one-sided
+  underestimation error (`f x - g n ≤ v ∧ v ≤ f x`) against uniform strict PPT heuristics.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageDet`, `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToApproxDet`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToOneSidedApproxDet`:
+  library specializations to deterministic polynomial-time heuristics.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageIO`, `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToApproxIO`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToOneSidedApproxIO`:
+  library infinitely-often (`∃ᶠ n in atTop`) deterministic companions.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageENat`, `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageIOENat`:
+  library `ℕ∞`-valued companions for `List Bool → ℕ∞`.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox.mono`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToOneSidedApprox.mono`:
+  monotonicity in the approximation error bound `g`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToOneSidedApprox.mildlyHardOnAverageToApprox`:
+  shift + gap-scaling bridge converting one-sided $(2 g)$-approximation hardness into symmetric
+  $g$-approximation hardness whenever `fun x => g x.length` is computable in polynomial time.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.MildlyHardOnAverageToApprox.eventually_real_abs_sub_le`:
+  upper-rounded integer log window `d * (Nat.log 2 n + 1)` implies the real-valued symmetric window
+  $|(v : \mathbb{R}) - f(x)| \le d \log_2 |x|$ of Definition 2.5.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.not_mildlyHardOnAverageIO_zero`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.not_mildlyHardOnAverage_zero`:
+  negative nonvacuity lemmas showing the constant zero function is not mildly hard on average.
+
+## References
+

+  full version `arXiv:2009.11514v1` (Section 2.3).
