+/-!
+# Bounded adaptive probabilistic iteration
+
+`OracleComp.iterate count step initial` repeats a state-dependent program a bounded number of
+times. Its invariant rule reasons only about supported transitions. A common finite seed
+realizing each reachable step presents the complete loop as a deterministic fold over independent
+uniform seeds. State types need not be finite. These are semantic laws; efficiency is separate.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.OracleComp.iterate`: bounded iteration of a state-dependent program.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.OracleComp.iterate_map`: a representation commuting with each step commutes with the loop.
+* `Cslib.ProbComp.iterate_invariant`: supported transitions preserve the final invariant.
+* `Cslib.ProbComp.eval_iterate_of_uniform`: exact evaluation from independent saved seeds.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `Languages/Probabilistic/Iteration.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the typed `PFunctor.FreeM` program interface.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib
+
+namespace OracleComp
+
+universe u v
+
+variable {ι : Type u} {spec : OracleSpec.{u, v} ι} {State : Type v}
+
+/-- Repeat a state-dependent program a bounded number of times. -/
+def iterate : ℕ → (State → OracleComp spec State) → State → OracleComp spec State
+  | 0, _, initial => pure initial
+  | count + 1, step, initial => iterate count step initial >>= step
+
+@[simp] theorem iterate_zero (step : State → OracleComp spec State) (initial : State) :
+    iterate 0 step initial = pure initial := rfl
+
+theorem iterate_succ (count : ℕ) (step : State → OracleComp spec State) (initial : State) :
+    iterate (count + 1) step initial = iterate count step initial >>= step := rfl
+
+/-- A bounded loop may expose its first transition as well as its last. -/
+theorem iterate_succ_bind (count : ℕ) (step : State → OracleComp spec State) (initial : State) :
+    iterate (count + 1) step initial = step initial >>= iterate count step := by
+  induction count generalizing initial with
+  | zero => simp [iterate]
+  | succ count ih => rw [iterate_succ, ih, bind_assoc]; rfl
+
+/-- Repeating a step that leaves the initial state unchanged has no effects. -/
+theorem iterate_eq_pure (count : ℕ) (step : State → OracleComp spec State) (initial : State)
+    (h : step initial = pure initial) : iterate count step initial = pure initial := by
+  induction count <;> simp_all [iterate]
+
+/-- A state representation commuting with one step commutes with the complete loop. -/
+theorem iterate_map {Other : Type v} (count : ℕ) (step : State → OracleComp spec State)
+    (next : Other → OracleComp spec Other) (f : State → Other)
+    (hstep : ∀ state, next (f state) = f <$> step state) (initial : State) :
+    iterate count next (f initial) = f <$> iterate count step initial := by
+  induction count with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ count ih => simp only [iterate_succ, ih, bind_map_left, map_bind, hstep]
+
+end OracleComp
+
+namespace ProbComp
+
+open Probability
+
+variable {State Seed : Type}
+
+/-- Every possible final state satisfies an invariant preserved by every supported transition. -/
+theorem iterate_invariant (count : ℕ) (step : State → ProbComp State) (initial : State)
+    (invariant : ℕ → State → Prop) (hinit : invariant 0 initial)
+    (hpreserve : ∀ i < count, ∀ state, invariant i state →
+      ∀ next ∈ (eval (step state)).support, invariant (i + 1) next) :
+    ∀ state ∈ (eval (OracleComp.iterate count step initial)).support, invariant count state := by
+  have htrace (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ count) :
+      ∀ state ∈ (eval (OracleComp.iterate i step initial)).support, invariant i state := by
+    induction i with
+    | zero => simpa using hinit
+    | succ i ih =>
+      intro next hnext
+      rw [OracleComp.iterate_succ, eval_bind, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff] at hnext
+      obtain ⟨state, hstate, hnext⟩ := hnext
+      exact hpreserve i (by lia) state (ih (by lia) state hstate) next hnext
+  exact htrace count le_rfl
+
+/-- Independent uniform seeds realize an adaptive loop when they realize each reachable step.
+The invariant allows the realization law to be restricted to reachable states. -/
+theorem eval_iterate_of_uniform [Fintype Seed] [Nonempty Seed]
+    (count : ℕ) (step : State → ProbComp State) (initial : State) (evaluate : State → Seed → State)
+    (invariant : ℕ → State → Prop) (hinit : invariant 0 initial)
+    (hpreserve : ∀ i < count, ∀ state, invariant i state →
+      ∀ next ∈ (eval (step state)).support, invariant (i + 1) next)
+    (hlaw : ∀ i < count, ∀ state, invariant i state →
+      eval (step state) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Seed).map (evaluate state)) :
+    eval (OracleComp.iterate count step initial) =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin count → Seed)).map
+        (fun seeds => (List.ofFn seeds).foldl evaluate initial) := by
+  have htrace (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ count) : eval (OracleComp.iterate i step initial) =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin i → Seed)).map
+        (fun seeds => (List.ofFn seeds).foldl evaluate initial) := by
+    induction i with
+    | zero =>
+      rw [OracleComp.iterate_zero, eval_pure]
+      simp only [List.ofFn_zero, List.foldl_nil, Function.const_def, PMF.map_const]
+    | succ i ih =>
+      rw [OracleComp.iterate_succ, eval_bind]
+      trans (eval (OracleComp.iterate i step initial)).bind
+        (fun state => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Seed).map (evaluate state))
+      · apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+        intro state hstate
+        exact hlaw i (by lia) state (iterate_invariant i step initial invariant hinit
+          (fun j hj => hpreserve j (by lia)) state hstate)
+      · rw [ih (by lia), ← PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv
+          ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin i → Seed) Seed).trans (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ => Seed))),
+          PMF.map_comp, ← PMF.uniformOfFintype_prod]
+        simp only [PMF.bind_map, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def,
+          Fin.snocEquiv, Equiv.prodComm, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
+          List.ofFn_succ', Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, Prod.swap,
+          List.concat_eq_append, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
+  exact htrace count le_rfl
+
+end ProbComp
+
+end Cslib

+/-!
+# Independent blocks of uniform bit lists
+
+Reading a uniform list of `count * width` bits as fixed-width rows gives exactly `count`
+independent uniform bit strings. This includes zero-width rows and zero rows.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.BitString.uniformList_ofList`: a uniform list gives a uniform finite bit string.
+* `Cslib.BitString.uniformList_blocks`: fixed-width blocks are jointly uniform.
+* `Cslib.BitString.uniformList_listRows`: the same law for the ordinary list-of-lists program.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `Probability/WordBits.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the shared block representation.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.BitString
+
+open Probability
+
+/-- A uniform list gives exactly a uniform finite bit string. -/
+theorem uniformList_ofList (n : ℕ) :
+    (uniformList n).map (ofList n) = PMF.uniformOfFintype (BitString n) := by
+  simp only [uniformList, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, ofList_ofFn]
+  exact PMF.map_id _
+
+/-- Disjoint fixed-width blocks of a uniform list are jointly uniform. -/
+theorem uniformList_blocks (count width : ℕ) :
+    (uniformList (count * width)).map (fun word => block (ofList (count * width) word)) =
+      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin count → BitString width) := by
+  change (uniformList (count * width)).map (blocksEquiv ∘ ofList (count * width)) = _
+  rw [← PMF.map_comp, uniformList_ofList]
+  exact PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv blocksEquiv
+
+/-- Extracting fixed-width rows realizes the joint law of independent uniform seeds. -/
+theorem uniformList_listRows (count width : ℕ) :
+    (uniformList (count * width)).map (listRows count width) =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin count → BitString width)).map
+        (fun rows => List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (rows i))) := by
+  rw [← uniformList_blocks count width, PMF.map_comp]
+  congr 1
+  funext word
+  exact listRows_eq_ofFn count width word
+
+end Cslib.BitString

+/-

+
+import Complexity.Tactic.PPT
+import Complexity.Probability.BitString.List
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.BitString
+import Mathlib.Logic.Relation
+
+/-! Adaptive closed programs, invariant-based resource proofs and independent saved blocks. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.AdaptivePPT
+
+open Cslib Cslib.Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+example : BitString.listRows 3 2 [true, false, true] =
+    [[true, false], [true, false], [false, false]] := by rfl
+
+example : BitString.listRows 3 0 [true] = [[], [], []] := by rfl
+
+example : BitString.listRows 0 4 [true] = [] := by rfl
+
+-- Both dimensions are runtime values; short inputs are padded and all output cells are charged.
+example : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+    (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × List Bool => BitString.listRows p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
+    (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBits) (encList encBits) := by fun_prop
+
+-- The joint law contains two independent fair bits, including the probability of disagreement.
+example : (BitString.uniformList 2).map (BitString.listRows 2 1) =
+    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin 2 → BitString 1)).map
+      (fun rows => List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (rows i))) :=
+  BitString.uniformList_listRows 2 1
+
+private noncomputable def grow (state : List Bool) : ProbComp (List Bool) := do
+  let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+  return bit :: state
+
+private theorem grow_ppt : IsPPTOn encBits encBits grow := by unfold grow; ppt
+
+private theorem grow_length (state next : List Bool)
+    (h : next ∈ (ProbComp.eval (grow state)).support) : next.length ≤ state.length + 1 := by
+  simp only [grow, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure] at h
+  obtain ⟨bit, _, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp h
+  simp [← heq]
+
+-- A full functional client certifies a quadratic number of state-dependent transitions.
+example : IsPPTOn encUnary encBits (fun n => OracleComp.iterate (n * n) grow []) := by
+  have hstep := grow_ppt
+  have hgrowth := grow_length
+  ppt
+
+-- A polynomial iteration count alone cannot certify an exponentially growing output.
+example : True := by
+  fail_if_success
+    have : IsPPTOn encUnary encUnary
+        (fun n => OracleComp.iterate n (fun state => pure (2 * state)) n) := by ppt
+  trivial
+
+-- An implicit binary graph is supplied by an efficient transition function. The loop contract
+-- certifies both its machine time and that every possible output is reachable from its input.
+example (neighbor : List Bool → Bool → List Bool)
+    (hefficient : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × Bool => neighbor p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encBits encBool) encBits)
+    (hsize : ∀ state bit, (neighbor state bit).length ≤ state.length) :
+    let step (state : List Bool) : ProbComp (List Bool) := do
+      let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+      return neighbor state bit
+    IsPPTOn encBits encBits (fun start => OracleComp.iterate (start.length ^ 2) step start) ∧
+      ∀ start final, final ∈
+        (ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.iterate (start.length ^ 2) step start)).support →
+        final.length ≤ start.length ∧
+          Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ bit, neighbor a bit = b) start final := by
+  dsimp only
+  let step (state : List Bool) : ProbComp (List Bool) := do
+    let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+    return neighbor state bit
+  have hstep : IsPPTOn encBits encBits step := by dsimp only [step]; ppt
+  exact IsPPTOn.iterate_spec (by fun_prop) ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.id' hstep
+    (fun start _ state => state.length ≤ start.length ∧
+      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ bit, neighbor a bit = b) start state)
+    (fun _ => ⟨le_rfl, .refl⟩)
+    (by
+      intro start i state _ hstate next hnext
+      simp only [step, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure] at hnext
+      obtain ⟨bit, _, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hnext
+      exact ⟨by simpa only [← heq] using (hsize state bit).trans hstate.1,
+        hstate.2.tail ⟨bit, heq⟩⟩)
+    (size := id) (by fun_prop) (fun _ _ _ _ h => h.1)
+
+private noncomputable def cappedStep (limit state : ℕ) : ProbComp ℕ := do
+  let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+  return if bit && decide (state < limit) then state + 1 else state
+
+-- Compound guards retain ordinary functional syntax through deterministic and PPT automation.
+example : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+    (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × Bool =>
+      if p.2 && decide (p.1.2 < p.1.1) then p.1.2 + 1 else p.1.2)
+    (encPair (encPair encUnary encUnary) encBool) encUnary := by fun_prop
+
+example : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+    (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => if p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 < p.1 + 3 then p.1 + 1 else p.2)
+    (encPair encUnary encUnary) encUnary := by polytime
+
+-- Captured input affects every transition, while the invariant bounds only the changing state.
+example : IsPPTOn encUnary encUnary
+    (fun limit => OracleComp.iterate (limit * limit) (cappedStep limit) 0) ∧
+    ∀ limit final,
+      final ∈ (ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.iterate (limit * limit) (cappedStep limit) 0)).support →
+      final ≤ limit := by
+  have hstep : IsPPTOn (encPair encUnary encUnary) encUnary
+      (fun p => cappedStep p.1 p.2) := by
+    unfold cappedStep
+    ppt
+  exact IsPPTOn.iterateWith_spec (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hstep
+    (fun limit _ state => state ≤ limit) (by simp)
+    (by
+      intro limit i state _ hstate next hnext
+      simp only [cappedStep, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure] at hnext
+      obtain ⟨bit, _, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hnext
+      split
+      · next hmove =>
+          have := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hmove).2
+          lia
+      · exact hstate)
+    (size := id) (by fun_prop) (fun _ _ _ _ h => by simpa using h)
+
+-- Zero iterations perform no transition, including for the captured-input client.
+example : ProbComp.eval (OracleComp.iterate 0 (cappedStep 0) 0) = PMF.pure 0 := by simp
+
+end ComplexityTests.AdaptivePPT

+# Efficient saved-coin evaluators for typed PPT programs
+
+A strict PPT witness realizes its result from a uniformly sampled polynomial-length tape. Its
+deterministic saved-coin evaluator has a genuine TM certificate, including tape preparation and
+cleanup. Normalizing arbitrary tapes to the witness budget gives a total typed evaluator whose
+every result belongs to the original program's support. No decoder on arbitrary output words is
+assumed: supported output words have unique preimages under the declared encoding.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_coin_machine`: one finite machine realizes all inputs from
+  uniform saved coins.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_polyTime_coin_evaluator`: efficient evaluation on raw words.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_total_seeded_evaluator`: a total efficient typed evaluator,
+  supported on every seed and exact under any sufficiently long uniform seed.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_seeded_evaluator`: the exact-budget specialization.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_padded_coin_evaluator`,
+  `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_padded_bool_coin_evaluator`: one longer saved tape can be
+  reused across inputs of different lengths.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `Computability/Probabilistic/CoinTape.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common machine, standard pair encoding and
+tidy computability calculus.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Probability
+
+open Turing Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {α β : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {output : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {program : α → ProbComp β}
+
+/-- One finite machine and one polynomial budget realize the whole program family from saved
+fair bits. Neither witness depends on the input value. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_coin_machine (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+      (c d : ℕ), ∀ a,
+      (ProbComp.eval (program a)).map output =
+        (BitString.uniformList (c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d)).map
+          (fun coins => machine.runClosedCoins coins (input a)) := by
+  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, hm⟩ := h
+  exact ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, fun a =>
+    (hm a).trans (machine.eval_runClosed_eq_map_coins _ _)⟩
+
+/-- The encoded evaluator accepts arbitrary raw input and coin words and is uniformly
+polynomial time. Its exact realization law applies to encoded inputs at the stated budget. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_polyTime_coin_evaluator (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool),
+      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits ∧
+      ∀ a, (ProbComp.eval (program a)).map output =
+        (BitString.uniformList (c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d)).map
+          (fun coins => evaluate coins (input a)) := by
+  obtain ⟨k, State, _, machine, c, d, hm⟩ := h.exists_coin_machine
+  exact ⟨c, d, machine.runClosedCoins, machine.computableTidilyInPolyTime_runClosedCoins, hm⟩
+
+/-- Every typed PPT program has a total deterministic polynomial-time evaluator. Every seed
+produces a supported result. Short seeds are padded; longer seeds are truncated to the program's
+budget. Every uniform seed at least that long yields exactly the program's distribution.
+
+Computability is relative to the output encoding and requires no decoder for invalid words. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_total_seeded_evaluator (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : α → List Bool → β),
+      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : α × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+        (encPair input encBits) output ∧
+      (∀ a coins, evaluate a coins ∈ (ProbComp.eval (program a)).support) ∧
+      ∀ a length, c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d ≤ length →
+        ProbComp.eval (program a) = (BitString.uniformList length).map (evaluate a) := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨c, d, raw, hraw, hlaw⟩ := h.exists_polyTime_coin_evaluator
+  let budget (a : α) := c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d
+  let tape (a : α) (coins : List Bool) := (coins ++ List.replicate (budget a) true).take (budget a)
+  have hlength (a : α) (coins : List Bool) : (tape a coins).length = budget a := by
+    simp [tape]
+  have hvalid (a : α) (coins : List Bool) : ∃ result,
+      result ∈ (ProbComp.eval (program a)).support ∧
+        output result = raw (tape a coins) (input a) := by
+    have hs : raw (tape a coins) (input a) ∈
+        ((BitString.uniformList (budget a)).map (fun seed => raw seed (input a))).support :=
+      (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr
+        ⟨tape a coins, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff.mpr (hlength a coins), rfl⟩
+    rw [← hlaw a] at hs
+    exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hs
+  let evaluate (a : α) (coins : List Bool) := (hvalid a coins).choose
+  have hencode (a : α) (coins : List Bool) :
+      output (evaluate a coins) = raw (tape a coins) (input a) := (hvalid a coins).choose_spec.2
+  refine ⟨c, d, evaluate, ?_, fun a coins => (hvalid a coins).choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
+  · have hinput : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime input input encBits := .of_eq fun _ => rfl
+    have hbudget : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime budget input encUnary := by
+      dsimp only [budget]
+      fun_prop
+    have hpad : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun a => List.replicate (budget a) true)
+        input encBits := hbudget.of_enc_eq (fun _ => rfl)
+    have ht : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+        (fun p : α × List Bool => (tape p.1 p.2, input p.1))
+        (encPair input encBits) (encPair encBits encBits) := by
+      have hfirst := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.fst input encBits
+      have hsecond := ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.snd input encBits
+      exact (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime.bitsTakeWithInput
+        (hsecond.bitsAppend (hpad.comp hfirst)) (hbudget.comp hfirst)).prod (hinput.comp hfirst)
+    exact (hraw.comp ht).of_enc_eq (fun p => hencode p.1 p.2)
+  · intro a length hbudget
+    apply PMF.map_injective output.injective
+    rw [hlaw, PMF.map_comp, ← BitString.uniformList_take hbudget, PMF.map_comp]
+    apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+    intro coins hcoins
+    change PMF.pure (raw (coins.take (budget a)) (input a)) =
+      PMF.pure (output (evaluate a coins))
+    congr 1
+    have hcoinsLength := BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hcoins
+    simp only [hencode, tape, List.take_append_of_le_length
+      (show budget a ≤ coins.length by simpa only [budget, hcoinsLength] using hbudget)]
+
+/-- The exact-budget specialization of the total seeded evaluator. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_seeded_evaluator (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : α → List Bool → β),
+      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : α × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+        (encPair input encBits) output ∧
+      ∀ a, ProbComp.eval (program a) =
+        (BitString.uniformList (c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d)).map (evaluate a) := by
+  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, _, hlaw⟩ := h.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
+  exact ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, fun a => hlaw a _ le_rfl⟩
+
+/-- A typed program can use one larger saved tape across inputs of different lengths. The
+raw word evaluator trims to each input's own budget and accepts arbitrary encoded words. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_padded_coin_evaluator (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool),
+      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits ∧
+      ∀ a length, c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d ≤ length →
+        (ProbComp.eval (program a)).map output = (BitString.uniformList length).map
+          (fun coins => evaluate coins (input a)) := by
+  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, hlaw⟩ := h.exists_polyTime_coin_evaluator
+  refine ⟨c, d, fun coins input => evaluate (coins.take (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d)) input,
+    ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact hefficient.comp (show ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => (p.1.take (c * (p.2.length + 1) ^ d), p.2))
+      (encPair encBits encBits) (encPair encBits encBits) by fun_prop)
+  · intro a length hlength
+    rw [hlaw, ← BitString.uniformList_take hlength, PMF.map_comp]
+    rfl
+
+/-- Reading the raw evaluator's first bit preserves a Boolean program's distribution. The
+shared tape budget may depend only on a bound on the encoded input size. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_padded_bool_coin_evaluator {program : α → ProbComp Bool}
+    (h : IsPPTOn input encBool program) :
+    ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool),
+      ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+        (encPair encBits encBits) encBits ∧
+      ∀ a length, c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d ≤ length →
+        ProbComp.eval (program a) = (BitString.uniformList length).map
+          (fun coins => (evaluate coins (input a)).headD false) := by
+  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, hlaw⟩ := h.exists_padded_coin_evaluator
+  refine ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, fun a length hlength => ?_⟩
+  have heq := congrArg (PMF.map (fun word : List Bool => word.headD false)) (hlaw a length hlength)
+  simpa [PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, encBool_apply, PMF.map] using heq
+
+end Cslib.Probability

+/-

+-/
+
+import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.CoinTape
+import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.Sampling
+import Complexity.Tactic.PPT
+
+/-! Typed saved-coin evaluation, arbitrary seeds, and one shared tape for distinct inputs. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.SeededEvaluator
+
+open Cslib Cslib.Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+private noncomputable def markedSample (n : ℕ) : ProbComp (List Bool) := do
+  let word ← BitString.sampleList n
+  return true :: word
+
+-- A nontrivial support invariant survives every supplied seed, including the empty seed.
+example : ∃ evaluate : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool,
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encUnary encBits) encBits ∧
+    ∀ n coins, (evaluate n coins).length = n + 1 ∧ (evaluate n coins).headD false = true := by
+  have hp : IsPPTOn encUnary encBits markedSample := by unfold markedSample; ppt
+  obtain ⟨_, _, evaluate, hefficient, hsupported, _⟩ := hp.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
+  refine ⟨evaluate, hefficient, fun n coins => ?_⟩
+  have hs := hsupported n coins
+  simp only [markedSample, ProbComp.eval_bind, BitString.eval_sampleList, ProbComp.eval_pure] at hs
+  obtain ⟨word, hw, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hs
+  rw [← heq]
+  simp [BitString.length_of_mem_support_uniformList hw]
+
+-- A unary output encoding is not a decoder for arbitrary words. The evaluator still returns
+-- a valid natural number on every seed, and preserves the entire distribution for longer seeds.
+example : ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : ℕ → List Bool → ℕ),
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : ℕ × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encUnary encBits) encUnary ∧
+    (∀ n coins, evaluate n coins = n ∨ evaluate n coins = n + 1) ∧
+    ∀ n extra, ProbComp.eval (do
+      let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+      return if bit then n else n + 1) =
+        (BitString.uniformList (c * (n + 1) ^ d + extra)).map (evaluate n) := by
+  let program (n : ℕ) : ProbComp ℕ := do
+    let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+    return if bit then n else n + 1
+  have hp : IsPPTOn encUnary encUnary program := by dsimp only [program]; ppt
+  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, hsupported, hlaw⟩ := hp.exists_total_seeded_evaluator
+  refine ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro n coins
+    have hs := hsupported n coins
+    simp only [program, ProbComp.eval_bind, ProbComp.eval_pure] at hs
+    obtain ⟨bit, _, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hs
+    cases bit with
+    | false => exact Or.inr heq.symm
+    | true => exact Or.inl heq.symm
+  · intro n extra
+    simpa only [encUnary_apply, List.length_replicate] using
+      hlaw n (c * (n + 1) ^ d + extra) (by simp)
+
+-- The same efficient raw predictor can use a common tape for two different input lengths.
+-- This asserts the two marginal laws; it does not assert independence when coins are reused.
+example : ∃ (c d : ℕ) (evaluate : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool),
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => evaluate p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits ∧
+    ∀ (a b : List Bool) length,
+      c * (a.length + 1) ^ d ≤ length → c * (b.length + 1) ^ d ≤ length →
+      (BitString.uniformList length).map (fun coins => (evaluate coins a).headD false) =
+        ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform Bool) ∧
+      (BitString.uniformList length).map (fun coins => (evaluate coins b).headD false) =
+        ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform Bool) := by
+  obtain ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, hlaw⟩ :=
+    (isPPTOn_uniform_bool encBits).exists_padded_bool_coin_evaluator
+  exact ⟨c, d, evaluate, hefficient, fun a b length ha hb =>
+    ⟨(hlaw a length ha).symm, (hlaw b length hb).symm⟩⟩
+
+end ComplexityTests.SeededEvaluator

+/-!
+# Preparing both components of an encoded pair
+
+The two certified pair projections write their outputs to separate work tapes. Both output
+heads finish at zero, every scratch tape is cleared, and the input head is restored. The
+preparation cost includes both computations and both rewinds.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.PairEncoding.exists_prepare`: one finite machine prepares both words in
+  linear time and space, uniformly over all encoded pairs.
+
+## References
+
+This uses Christian Reitwiessner's `PairEncoding` interface and output-to-word compiler.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM.PairEncoding
+
+universe u
+
+private def firstTapes (k l : ℕ) : Fin (k + 1) ↪ Fin (k + l + 2) :=
+  Fin.Embedding.snoc ((Fin.castAddEmb l).trans (Fin.castAddEmb 2))
+    (a := Fin.natAdd (k + l) 0) (by
+      rintro ⟨i, h⟩
+      have : (i : ℕ) = k + l := congrArg Fin.val h
+      lia)
+
+private def secondTapes (k l : ℕ) : Fin (l + 1) ↪ Fin (k + l + 2) :=
+  Fin.Embedding.snoc ((Fin.natAddEmb k).trans (Fin.castAddEmb 2))
+    (a := Fin.natAdd (k + l) 1) (by
+      rintro ⟨i, h⟩
+      have : k + (i : ℕ) = k + l + 1 := congrArg Fin.val h
+      lia)
+
+private lemma secondTapes_ne_first_last (k l : ℕ) (j : Fin (l + 1)) :
+    secondTapes k l j ≠ firstTapes k l (Fin.last k) := by
+  induction j using Fin.lastCases <;>
+    simp [firstTapes, secondTapes, Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd]
+
+/-- Prepare the two encoded components on the last two work tapes, clearing all scratch tapes
+and restoring all heads. The machine and its linear bound are independent of the pair. -/
+theorem exists_prepare {α β : Type u} (enc₁ : α ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β ↪ List Bool)
+    (enc : α × β ↪ List Bool) [PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc] :
+    ∃ (r : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapeTM (r + 2) Bool State)
+      (c : ℕ), ∀ p : α × β,
+      TransformsTapes machine (fun input ws => input = enc p ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+        (fun _ _ ws' emitted =>
+          ws' = Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => []) ![enc₁ p.1, enc₂ p.2] ∧ emitted = [])
+        (c * ((enc p).length + 1)) (c * ((enc p).length + 1)) := by
+  obtain ⟨c₀, k, Q₀, _, m₀, h₀⟩ := PairEncoding.fst (enc₁ := enc₁) (enc₂ := enc₂) (enc := enc)
+  obtain ⟨c₁, l, Q₁, _, m₁, h₁⟩ := PairEncoding.snd (enc₁ := enc₁) (enc₂ := enc₂) (enc := enc)
+  refine ⟨k + l, (Q₀ ⊕ RewindWorkState) ⊕ (Q₁ ⊕ RewindWorkState), inferInstance,
+    (m₀.outputToWord.extendTapes (firstTapes k l)).seq
+      (m₁.outputToWord.extendTapes (secondTapes k l)),
+    3 * (c₀ + c₁) + 3 * (k + l) + 12, fun p => ?_⟩
+  have hfirst := ((h₀ p).outputToWord_extendTapes (firstTapes k l)).imp
+    (P' := fun input ws => input = enc p ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+    (fun _ _ h => ⟨h.1, fun _ => congrFun h.2 _⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hsecond := (h₁ p).outputToWord_extendTapes (secondTapes k l)
+  have hseq := transformsTapes_seq hfirst hsecond (by
+    rintro input ws ws' emitted ⟨hin, rfl⟩ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨hin, fun j => Function.update_of_ne (secondTapes_ne_first_last k l j) _ _⟩)
+  refine hseq.imp (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
+    funext i
+    cases i using Fin.addCases with
+    | left i => simp [firstTapes, secondTapes, Fin.Embedding.snoc_last,
+        Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd]
+    | right i =>
+      match i with
+      | 0 | 1 => simp [firstTapes, secondTapes, Fin.Embedding.snoc_last, Function.update_apply]
+  · have hlen₀ := (h₀ p).length_output_le
+    have hlen₁ := (h₁ p).length_output_le
+    dsimp only at hlen₀ hlen₁ ⊢
+    nlinarith
+  · have hlen₀ := (h₀ p).length_output_le
+    have hlen₁ := (h₁ p).length_output_le
+    dsimp only at hlen₀ hlen₁ ⊢
+    nlinarith [Nat.sub_le (k + l + 2) (k + 1), Nat.sub_le (k + l + 2) (l + 1)]
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM.PairEncoding

+/-!
+# Writing a word on selected tapes
+
+A tidy computation can write its output onto a selected work tape, using selected blank scratch
+tapes and preserving every other tape. The output head and scratch heads finish at cell zero.
+This is a specification of the existing output redirection and tape embedding combinators.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.outputToWord_extendTapes`: write a word without
+  disturbing the unselected tapes or the ambient output.
+
+## References
+
+This combines Christian Reitwiessner's `outputToWord` and `TransformsTapes.extendTapes`
+specifications from cslib PR #1111.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-- A tidy computation writes its output on the selected last tape, leaves its selected scratch
+tapes blank, and preserves all unselected words. All selected tapes must initially be blank. -/
+theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.outputToWord_extendTapes
+    {k n : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} {machine : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+    {input output : List Symbol} {t s : ℕ}
+    (h : machine.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input output t s) (e : Fin (k + 1) ↪ Fin n) :
+    TransformsTapes (machine.outputToWord.extendTapes e)
+      (fun inp ws => inp = input ∧ ∀ j, ws (e j) = [])
+      (fun _ ws ws' emitted => ws' = Function.update ws (e (Fin.last k)) output ∧ emitted = [])
+      (t + output.length + 2) (s + 2 * output.length + k + 4 + (n - (k + 1))) := by
+  refine (h.outputToWord.extendTapes e).imp (fun _ _ h => ⟨h.1, funext h.2⟩) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
+  rintro inp ws ws' emitted hP ⟨⟨hv, rfl⟩, hx⟩
+  refine ⟨funext fun i => ?_, rfl⟩
+  by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
+  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
+    simpa [Function.update_apply, e.injective.eq_iff, hP.2] using congrFun hv j
+  · rw [hx i hi, Function.update_of_ne]
+    exact fun h => hi ⟨Fin.last k, h.symm⟩
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Efficient replay from an encoded input and saved coins
+
+Replay receives an ordinary encoded pair of coins and input. A pair preparer writes both words,
+a marker enables virtual input, and the saved-coin controller executes the supplied transitions.
+The final tidy normalization clears the working storage and restores all heads.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace_runClosedCoins`: deterministic replay
+  has a uniform linear time and space bound in the encoded pair length.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch's `MultiTape/Oracle/ReplayInput.lean` at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common machine and the tidy pair calculus.
+-/

+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k r : ℕ} {State PrepareState : Type}
+
+namespace Replay
+
+private def tapes (k r : ℕ) : Fin (k + 1) ↪ Fin (k + r + 1) :=
+  Fin.Embedding.snoc ((Fin.castAddEmb r).trans Fin.castSuccEmb)
+    (a := Fin.last (k + r)) (by
+    rintro ⟨i, h⟩
+    have : (i : ℕ) = k + r := congrArg Fin.val h
+    lia)
+
+private def prepareTapes (k r : ℕ) : Fin (r + 2) ↪ Fin (k + r + 3) :=
+  (Fin.natAddEmb k).trans Fin.castSuccEmb
+
+private def words (k r : ℕ) (coins input : List Bool) : Fin (k + r + 3) → List Bool :=
+  Fin.snoc (Fin.append (n := r + 2) (fun _ : Fin k => [])
+    (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => []) ![coins, input])) []
+
+private def initial {Q : Type} (k r : ℕ) (coins input : List Bool) (q : Option Q) :
+    Cfg (k + r + 1) Bool Q input :=
+  wordsCfg input q (Fin.snoc (fun _ => []) coins) []
+
+private theorem words_eq (k r : ℕ) (coins input : List Bool) :
+    words k r coins input = Fin.append (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin (k + r) => []) coins)
+      ![input, []] := by
+  simp only [words, ← Fin.append_snoc, Fin.append_left_snoc]
+  simpa [Fin.append_const, Function.comp_def] using
+    (Fin.append_assoc (fun _ : Fin k => ([] : List Bool)) (fun _ : Fin r => [])
+      (![coins, input, []] : Fin 3 → List Bool)).symm
+
+private theorem runFrom_mark (coins input outer : List Bool) :
+    (markFlag (k + r + 1) (some true)).runFrom
+        (wordsCfg outer (some (markWork Bool (some true)).q₀) (words k r coins input) []) 2 =
+      inCfg true (initial k r coins input (Q := MarkWorkState) none) outer := by
+  rw [words_eq, markFlag, runFrom_tapeEmb]
+  have hv : oneTapeCfg (Fin.natAdd (k + r + 1) 1)
+      (wordsCfg outer (some (markWork Bool (some true)).q₀)
+        (Fin.append (Fin.snoc (fun _ : Fin (k + r) => []) coins) ![input, []]) []) =
+      ⟨some (markWork Bool (some true)).q₀, 1, fun _ => (fun _ => none), fun _ => 0, []⟩ := by
+    simp [oneTapeCfg, wordsCfg]
+  rw [hv, runFrom_markWork, embed_tapeEmb]
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;>
+    cases i using Fin.addCases with
+    | left j => simp [initial, wordsCfg,
+        Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd]
+    | right j => match j with
+      | 0 | 1 => simp [initial, wordsCfg]
+
+private theorem embed_initial (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (coins input : List Bool) :
+    embed (tapes k r) (config (machine.initialConfig input) (tapeOfList coins) 0)
+      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) = initial k r coins input (some (some machine.initial)) := by
+  have hc : config (machine.initialConfig input) (tapeOfList coins) 0 =
+      wordsCfg input (some (some machine.initial)) (Fin.snoc (fun _ => []) coins) [] := by
+    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;>
+      induction i using Fin.lastCases <;> simp [config, MultiTapeMachine.initialConfig, wordsCfg]
+  rw [hc]
+  simp only [initial]
+  have he := embed_wordsCfg (input := input) (tapes k r) (ws := fun _ => [])
+    (q := some (some machine.initial)) (out := [])
+    (v := Fin.snoc (fun _ => []) coins) (ws' := Fin.snoc (fun _ => []) coins)
+    (by
+      intro j
+      induction j using Fin.lastCases <;>
+        simp [tapes, Fin.Embedding.snoc_last, Fin.Embedding.snoc_castSucc,
+          Function.Embedding.trans_apply, Fin.castAddEmb_apply])
+    (by
+      intro i hi
+      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
+      | last => exact (hi ⟨Fin.last k, by simp [tapes, Fin.Embedding.snoc_last]⟩).elim
+      | cast i => simp)
+  simpa only [tapeOfList_nil] using he
+
+private theorem runFrom_initial (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (coins input : List Bool) :
+    (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).runFrom
+        (initial k r coins input (some (some machine.initial))) (coins.length + 1) =
+      embed (tapes k r)
+        (stopped (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins (machine.initialConfig input))
+          (tapeOfList coins) coins.length) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) := by
+  rw [← embed_initial machine coins input, ← embedHom_apply machine.replay, runFrom_map,
+    runFrom_replay, embedHom_apply]
+
+private theorem runFrom_prepare (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 2) Bool PrepareState)
+    (coins input outer : List Bool) (t s : ℕ)
+    (h : TransformsTapes prepare (fun inp ws => inp = outer ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' emitted =>
+        ws' = Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => []) ![coins, input] ∧ emitted = []) t s) :
+    (prepare.extendTapes (prepareTapes k r)).runFrom
+        ((prepare.extendTapes (prepareTapes k r)).initCfg outer) t =
+      wordsCfg outer none (words k r coins input) [] := by
+  obtain ⟨ws', _, hrun, ⟨⟨hv, rfl⟩, hx⟩, _⟩ :=
+    transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp (h.extendTapes (prepareTapes k r))
+      outer (fun _ => []) [] ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+  have hw : ws' = words k r coins input := by
+    funext i
+    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
+    | last =>
+      rw [hx]
+      · simp [words]
+      · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
+        have : k + (j : ℕ) = k + r + 2 := congrArg Fin.val hj
+        lia
+    | cast i =>
+      cases i using (Fin.addCases (m := k) (n := r + 2)) with
+      | left i =>
+        rw [hx]
+        · simp [words]
+        · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
+          have : (Fin.natAdd k j).castSucc = (i.castAdd (r + 2)).castSucc := hj
+          exact Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd i j (Fin.castSucc_injective _ this).symm
+      | right j =>
+        have hj : ws' (Fin.natAdd k j).castSucc = Fin.append (fun _ => []) ![coins, input] j :=
+          congrFun hv j
+        simpa only [words, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.append_right] using hj
+  simpa only [initCfg_eq_wordsCfg, hw, List.nil_append] using hrun
+
+private noncomputable def compile (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+    (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 2) Bool PrepareState) :
+    MultiTapeTM (k + r + 3) Bool (PrepareState ⊕ MarkWorkState ⊕ Option State) :=
+  (prepare.extendTapes (prepareTapes k r)).seq
+    ((markFlag (k + r + 1) (some true)).seq
+      (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inputFromTape)
+
+private def finish (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (coins input outer : List Bool) :
+    Cfg (k + r + 3) Bool (PrepareState ⊕ MarkWorkState ⊕ Option State) outer :=
+  Sequential.rightCfg (Sequential.rightCfg (inCfg true
+    (embed (tapes k r)
+      (stopped (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins (machine.initialConfig input))
+        (tapeOfList coins) coins.length) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)) outer))
+
+private theorem runFrom_compile (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+    (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 2) Bool PrepareState) (coins input outer : List Bool) (t s : ℕ)
+    (h : TransformsTapes prepare (fun inp ws => inp = outer ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' emitted =>
+        ws' = Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => []) ![coins, input] ∧ emitted = []) t s) :
+    (compile machine prepare).runFrom ((compile machine prepare).initCfg outer)
+        (t + (2 + (coins.length + 1))) = finish machine coins input outer := by
+  have hr := runFrom_map ((machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inCfgHom true outer)
+    (initial k r coins input (some (some machine.initial))) (coins.length + 1)
+  simp only [inCfgHom_apply, runFrom_initial] at hr
+  have hq : (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inputFromTape.q₀ = some machine.initial := by
+    simp [inputFromTape, q₀_ofTr, replay]
+  have hm := runFrom_mark (k := k) (r := r) coins input outer
+  have hs := runFrom_seq (tm₁ := (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inputFromTape) hm rfl
+    (by simpa only [hq, Cfg.withState, initial, wordsCfg, inCfg] using hr) rfl
+  have hp := runFrom_prepare (k := k) prepare coins input outer t s h
+  have hqseq : ((markFlag (k + r + 1) (some true)).seq
+      (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inputFromTape).q₀ =
+        Sum.inl (markWork Bool (some true)).q₀ := by
+    simp [MultiTapeTM.seq, q₀_ofTr, markFlag]
+  have hc := runFrom_seq (tm₁ := (markFlag (k + r + 1) (some true)).seq
+      (machine.replay.extendTapes (tapes k r)).inputFromTape) hp rfl
+    (by simpa [hqseq, Cfg.withState, Sequential.leftCfg, wordsCfg, Cfg.mapState] using hs) rfl
+  simpa [compile, initCfg_eq_wordsCfg, Sequential.leftCfg, wordsCfg, Cfg.mapState,
+    MultiTapeTM.seq, q₀_ofTr, finish, inCfg] using hc
+
+end Replay
+
+/-- Running a fixed machine on a supplied pair of coins and input is tidily computable in linear
+time and space. The bound charges input preparation, every supplied coin, and final cleanup;
+it does not assume that the source machine halts. -/
+theorem computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace_runClosedCoins [Finite State]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace
+      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => machine.runClosedCoins p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits := by
+  obtain ⟨r, PrepareState, _, prepare, c, hp⟩ :=
+    PairEncoding.exists_prepare encBits encBits (encPair encBits encBits)
+  let size (p : List Bool × List Bool) := (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 1
+  let time (p : List Bool × List Bool) := c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1))
+  let n := k + r + 3
+  let b := (n + 1) * (c + 5)
+  have hraw : ComputableInTimeAndSpace
+      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => machine.runClosedCoins p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits (fun p => b * size p) (fun p => b * size p) := by
+    refine ⟨n, PrepareState ⊕ MarkWorkState ⊕ Option State, inferInstance,
+      Replay.compile machine prepare, fun p => ?_⟩
+    have hr := Replay.runFrom_compile machine prepare p.1 p.2 (encPair encBits encBits p)
+      (c * size p) (c * size p) (hp p)
+    have hh : ((Replay.compile machine prepare).runFrom
+        ((Replay.compile machine prepare).initCfg (encPair encBits encBits p))
+        (time p)).Halted := by
+      rw [show time p = c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1)) from rfl, hr]
+      rfl
+    have hlen := length_le_encPair_left encBits encBits p
+    have ht₀ : time p + 1 ≤ (c + 5) * size p := by
+      dsimp only [time, size]
+      simp only [encBits_apply] at hlen
+      nlinarith
+    have ht : time p ≤ b * size p :=
+      (Nat.le_succ _).trans (ht₀.trans
+        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (c + 5) (Nat.succ_pos n))))
+    have hs : n * (time p + 1) ≤ b * size p := by
+      calc
+        _ ≤ n * ((c + 5) * size p) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n ht₀
+        _ ≤ (n + 1) * ((c + 5) * size p) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ n)
+        _ = _ := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
+    refine ⟨⟨time p, hh, ?_⟩, (runsInTime_of_halted hh).mono ht,
+      runsInSpace_of_halted hh ?_⟩
+    · change ((Replay.compile machine prepare).runFrom _
+        (c * size p + (2 + (p.1.length + 1)))).output = _
+      rw [hr]
+      rfl
+    · exact (MultiTapeNTM.RunPath.ofDeterministic (Replay.compile machine prepare)
+        ((Replay.compile machine prepare).initCfg (encPair encBits encBits p))
+        (time p)).space_le_mul_time_add_one.trans hs
+  obtain ⟨d, htidy⟩ := hraw.exists_computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace
+  refine ⟨(d + 5) * (b + 1), htidy.mono (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_)⟩ <;>
+    dsimp only [size] <;>
+    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (d * b * (encPair encBits encBits p).length)]
+
+/-- The ordinary functional polynomial-time API can invoke saved-coin replay directly. -/
+@[fun_prop] theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_runClosedCoins [Finite State]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime
+      (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => machine.runClosedCoins p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBits :=
+  .of_linear (computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace_runClosedCoins machine)
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

index 00000000..8ce6c2f4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Complexity/Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Probabilistic/CoinTape.lean
@@ -0,0 +1,252 @@
+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 Samuel Schlesinger. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger
+-/
+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Closed
+public import Complexity.Probability.BitString
+import Cslib.Foundations.Control.Monad.IsMonadHom.List
+
+/-!
+# Execution with saved coins
+
+Replay is a fold of one-step calls to the shared interpreter, with each supplied coin returned
+by a pure program. Exhausting the list retains the complete current configuration; a halted
+machine ignores the remaining coins. Query handlers can still have effects.
+
+Sampling all coins in advance preserves the joint final configuration and private oracle state,
+provided the original coin program denotes a stateless fair bit. The query handler may be
+randomized and share state across its operations. This is a semantic equality; a deterministic
+machine implementing replay from an encoded input and coin tape needs a separate certificate.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runConfigFromCoins`: replay from an arbitrary configuration.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runConfigFromCoins_append`: pause and resume at a tape boundary.
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.run_interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins`: average fixed-coin runs, retaining
+  the complete configuration and private state.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch's
+`Computability/Machines/Turing/MultiTape/Probabilistic/CoinTape.lean` at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common interpreter and typed program API.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib Cslib.Probability MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle Query : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query}
+  {input : List Symbol} [DecidableEq Oracle]
+
+/-- Replay the shared interpreter with a supplied coin per step. Only the query handler can
+have effects; the replay itself does not draw randomness. -/
+def runConfigFromCoins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    OracleComp spec (Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :=
+  coins.foldlM (fun cfg bit => machine.runConfigFrom (pure bit) query 1 cfg) cfg
+
+@[simp] theorem runConfigFromCoins_nil (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    machine.runConfigFromCoins query [] cfg = pure cfg := rfl
+
+/-- The first coin supplies one instruction before replay resumes on the tail. -/
+theorem runConfigFromCoins_cons (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (bit : Bool) (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    machine.runConfigFromCoins query (bit :: coins) cfg =
+      (machine.runConfigFrom (pure bit) query 1 cfg >>= machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins) :=
+  List.foldlM_cons
+
+/-- A halted machine ignores all remaining coins and performs no further queries. -/
+@[simp] theorem runConfigFromCoins_halted (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (h : cfg.tapes.state = none) : machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg = pure cfg := by
+  induction coins with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons bit coins ih =>
+    simp [runConfigFromCoins_cons, runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_halted, h, ih]
+
+/-- Concatenating tapes agrees with pausing and resuming, as an equality of typed programs. -/
+theorem runConfigFromCoins_append (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (coins more : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    machine.runConfigFromCoins query (coins ++ more) cfg =
+      (machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg >>= machine.runConfigFromCoins query more) :=
+  List.foldlM_append
+
+/-- Interpretation commutes with the replay fold, without resetting any handler state. -/
+theorem interpret_runConfigFromCoins {m : Type → Type*} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → m (spec q)) (coins : List Bool)
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg) =
+      coins.foldlM (fun cfg bit =>
+        OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFrom (pure bit) query 1 cfg)) cfg :=
+  (PFunctor.FreeM.isMonadHom_liftM (P := ⟨Query, spec⟩) oracle).map_listFoldlM _ _ _
+
+/-- A single instruction can use a pre-sampled coin when the coin program is stateless and fair.
+The entire query handler state is retained. -/
+theorem run_interpret_runConfigFrom_one {OracleState : Type}
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q))
+    (hcoin : ∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).map (fun bit => (bit, s)))
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (s : OracleState) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFrom coin query 1 cfg)).run s =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).bind (fun bit =>
+        (OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFrom (pure bit) query 1 cfg)).run s) := by
+  cases hs : cfg.tapes.state <;>
+    simp [runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, hs, bind_map_left,
+      OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind, hcoin, PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def]
+
+/-- Sampling the entire private coin tape in advance preserves the joint configuration and
+private oracle state, including randomized query handlers sharing that state. -/
+theorem run_interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins {OracleState : Type}
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q))
+    (hcoin : ∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s =
+      (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).map (fun bit => (bit, s)))
+    (fuel : ℕ) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (s : OracleState) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel cfg)).run s =
+      (BitString.uniformList fuel).bind (fun coins =>
+        (OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg)).run s) := by
+  induction fuel generalizing cfg s with
+  | zero => simp [runConfigFrom]
+  | succ fuel ih =>
+    rw [BitString.uniformList_succ, show fuel + 1 = 1 + fuel by lia, runConfigFrom,
+      MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_add]
+    change (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+      (machine.runConfigFrom coin query 1 cfg >>= machine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel)).run s = _
+    simp only [OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind, PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind,
+      run_interpret_runConfigFrom_one machine coin query oracle hcoin, PMF.bind_bind, ih,
+      PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def, runConfigFromCoins_cons]
+    congr 1
+    funext bit
+    exact PMF.bind_comm _ _ _
+
+/-- Without private state, the clocked run is the average of its fixed-coin programs. -/
+theorem interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → PMF (spec q))
+    (hcoin : OracleComp.interpret oracle coin = PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool)
+    (fuel : ℕ) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel cfg) =
+      (BitString.uniformList fuel).bind (fun coins =>
+        OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg)) := by
+  have h := run_interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins machine coin query
+    (fun q (s : Unit) => (fun a => (a, s)) <$> oracle q)
+    (fun s => by rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless, hcoin]; rfl) fuel cfg ()
+  simp_rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless] at h
+  have hout := congrArg (PMF.map Prod.fst) h
+  simpa [PMF.map, PMF.bind_bind, Function.comp_def] using hout
+
+/-- Observe the output of a replay program, retaining any effects of its query handler. -/
+def runFromCoins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :
+    OracleComp spec (List Symbol) :=
+  (fun final => final.tapes.output) <$> machine.runConfigFromCoins query coins cfg
+
+/-- Replay from blank work and communication tapes. -/
+def runCoins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (coins : List Bool) (input : List Symbol) : OracleComp spec (List Symbol) :=
+  machine.runFromCoins query coins (machine.initialConfig input)
+
+/-- Fix one Boolean branch of a closed table, retaining its original states and tapes. -/
+def withCoin (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State) (bit : Bool) :
+    MultiTapeMachine k Symbol State Empty Id where
+  initial := machine.initial
+  tr state symbol work answer := machine.tr state symbol work answer bit
+
+/-- Closed replay is a deterministic fold of the selected one-step transition tables. -/
+def runClosedConfigFromCoins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Empty input) :
+    Config k Symbol State Empty input :=
+  coins.foldl (fun cfg bit => (machine.withCoin bit).step cfg) cfg
+
+/-- A closed one-step program with a fixed coin is a pure deterministic transition. -/
+theorem runConfigFrom_pure_coin (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State) (bit : Bool)
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Empty input) :
+    machine.runConfigFrom (spec := spec) (pure bit) Empty.elim 1 cfg =
+      pure ((machine.withCoin bit).step cfg) := by
+  cases hs : cfg.tapes.state with
+  | none => simp [runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.step, hs]
+  | some state =>
+    simp only [runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.step,
+      withCoin, hs, map_pure, pure_bind]
+    cases machine.tr state cfg.tapes.inputSymbol cfg.tapes.workTapeSymbols
+        cfg.answerSymbols bit with
+    | step action symbol move => rfl
+    | query oracle _ => exact oracle.elim
+
+/-- With no oracle channels, the entire fixed-coin program is pure. -/
+theorem runConfigFromCoins_closed (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Empty input) :
+    machine.runConfigFromCoins (spec := spec) Empty.elim coins cfg =
+      pure (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins cfg) := by
+  induction coins generalizing cfg with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons bit coins ih =>
+    simp [runConfigFromCoins_cons, runConfigFrom_pure_coin, ih, runClosedConfigFromCoins]
+
+/-- The output of a closed replay from blank tapes, as a deterministic function. -/
+def runClosedCoins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (coins : List Bool) (input : List Symbol) : List Symbol :=
+  (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins (machine.initialConfig input)).tapes.output
+
+/-- The complete closed configuration is a deterministic function of uniform saved coins. -/
+theorem eval_runClosedConfigFrom_eq_map_coins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (fuel : ℕ) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Empty input) :
+    ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosedConfigFrom fuel cfg) =
+      (BitString.uniformList fuel).map
+        (fun coins => machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins cfg) := by
+  rw [runClosedConfigFrom, ProbComp.eval, interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins machine _ _ _
+    (ProbComp.eval_uniform Bool)]
+  simp [runConfigFromCoins_closed, PMF.map, Function.comp_def]
+
+/-- A closed fair-coin run is a deterministic function of a uniform tape of clock length. -/
+theorem eval_runClosed_eq_map_coins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol) :
+    ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed fuel input) =
+      (BitString.uniformList fuel).map (fun coins => machine.runClosedCoins coins input) := by
+  rw [runClosed_eq_map, ProbComp.eval_map, eval_runClosedConfigFrom_eq_map_coins, PMF.map_comp]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Every saved tape yields a supported configuration at the corresponding clock. -/
+theorem runClosedConfigFromCoins_mem_support (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (coins : List Bool) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Empty input) :
+    machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins cfg ∈
+      (ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosedConfigFrom coins.length cfg)).support := by
+  rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_eq_map_coins]
+  exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr
+    ⟨coins, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff.mpr rfl, rfl⟩
+
+/-- Every saved tape yields a supported output, including inputs that run to the clock cutoff. -/
+theorem runClosedCoins_mem_support (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (coins : List Bool) (input : List Symbol) :
+    machine.runClosedCoins coins input ∈
+      (ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed coins.length input)).support := by
+  rw [eval_runClosed_eq_map_coins]
+  exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr
+    ⟨coins, BitString.mem_support_uniformList_iff.mpr rfl, rfl⟩
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+/-

+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger
+-/
+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.CoinTape
+public import Cslib.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.WordsCfg
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Deterministic
+import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic
+
+/-!
+# A deterministic controller for saved-coin replay
+
+The controller reads the supplied coins from a fresh last work tape. Each stored bit supplies
+one source instruction. After the source halts, only the coin head continues moving; the first
+blank coin cell halts the controller. Thus a tape of `t` coins takes exactly `t + 1` transitions,
+even if the source does not halt within its supplied clock.
+
+This module accounts for execution from preloaded tapes. Writing the coins and preparing the
+input are separate machine computations, not free initial data in a complexity certificate.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.replay`: deterministic replay with one additional read-only work tape.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runFrom_replay`: agreement with fixed-coin execution and actual halting.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch's `Oracle/Replay.lean` at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common closed machine directly.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {State : Type} {input : List Bool}
+
+namespace Replay
+
+/-- Add a read-only coin tape, keeping the source's possibly halted state in live control. -/
+def config (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input) (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    Cfg (k + 1) Bool (Option State) input where
+  state := some cfg.tapes.state
+  inputPos := cfg.tapes.inputPos
+  workTapes := Fin.lastCases tape cfg.tapes.workTapes
+  workTapePos := Fin.lastCases position cfg.tapes.workTapePos
+  output := cfg.tapes.output
+
+/-- Move only the coin head and update the controller. -/
+def idle (next : Option (Option State)) (move : SignType) :
+    Turing.Action (k + 1) Bool (Option State) where
+  inputTape := 0
+  workTapes := Fin.lastCases (none, move) (fun _ => (none, 0))
+  output := none
+  state := next
+
+/-- Simulate an ordinary source action while advancing the coin head. -/
+def liftAction (action : Turing.Action k Bool State) :
+    Turing.Action (k + 1) Bool (Option State) where
+  inputTape := action.inputTape
+  workTapes := Fin.lastCases (none, 1) action.workTapes
+  output := action.output
+  state := some action.state
+
+/-- Stop the controller without changing any tape or head. -/
+def stopped (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input) (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    Cfg (k + 1) Bool (Option State) input :=
+  (config cfg tape position).withState none
+
+/-- A lifted action updates the source tapes and consumes one stored coin. -/
+theorem apply_liftAction (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) (action : Turing.Action k Bool State)
+    (symbol : Empty → Option Bool) (move : Empty → SignType) :
+    (liftAction action).apply (config cfg tape position) =
+      config (cfg.step action symbol move) tape (position + 1) := by
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;> induction i using Fin.lastCases <;>
+    simp [config, liftAction, Config.step, Turing.Action.apply]
+
+/-- Once the source halts, only the saved-coin head moves. -/
+theorem apply_tick (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    (idle (some cfg.tapes.state) 1).apply (config cfg tape position) =
+      config cfg tape (position + 1) := by
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl (by simp [idle, config, Turing.Action.apply]) ?_ ?_
+    (by simp [idle, config, Turing.Action.apply]) <;>
+    funext i <;> induction i using Fin.lastCases <;> simp [idle, config, Turing.Action.apply]
+
+/-- Halting preserves every tape and head position. -/
+theorem apply_stop (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    (idle none 0).apply (config cfg tape position) = stopped cfg tape position := by
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl (by simp [idle, config, stopped, Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.withState]) ?_ ?_
+    (by simp [idle, config, stopped, Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.withState]) <;>
+    funext i <;> induction i using Fin.lastCases <;>
+    simp [idle, config, stopped, Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.withState]
+
+@[simp] theorem config_inputSymbol (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    (config cfg tape position).inputSymbol = cfg.tapes.inputSymbol := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem config_workTapeSymbols_castSucc (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) (i : Fin k) :
+    (config cfg tape position).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc = cfg.tapes.workTapeSymbols i := by
+  simp [config, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]
+
+@[simp] theorem config_workTapeSymbols_last (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) :
+    (config cfg tape position).workTapeSymbols (Fin.last k) = tape position := by
+  simp [config, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]
+
+end Replay
+
+/-- A deterministic replay controller. Its control is finite whenever the source control is. -/
+def replay (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool (Option State) :=
+  MultiTapeTM.ofTr (some machine.initial) fun state symbol work =>
+    match work (Fin.last k) with
+    | none => Replay.idle none 0
+    | some bit => match state with
+      | none => Replay.idle (some none) 1
+      | some state => Replay.liftAction
+          (Action.emptyOracleEquiv
+            (machine.tr state symbol (fun i => work i.castSucc) Empty.elim bit))
+
+namespace Replay
+
+/-- An available coin supplies exactly one deterministic source transition. -/
+theorem step_some (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) (bit : Bool) (hcell : tape position = some bit) :
+    machine.replay.step (config cfg tape position) =
+      config ((machine.withCoin bit).step cfg) tape (position + 1) := by
+  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_state (show (config cfg tape position).state = some cfg.tapes.state
+    from rfl)]
+  have hread : cfg.answerSymbols = Empty.elim := funext fun oracle => oracle.elim
+  simp only [replay, MultiTapeTM.tr_ofTr, config_inputSymbol, config_workTapeSymbols_last,
+    hcell, config_workTapeSymbols_castSucc, MultiTapeMachine.step, withCoin]
+  cases hs : cfg.tapes.state with
+  | none => simpa only [hs] using apply_tick cfg tape position
+  | some state =>
+    simp only [hread]
+    cases machine.tr state cfg.tapes.inputSymbol cfg.tapes.workTapeSymbols Empty.elim bit with
+    | step action symbol move => exact apply_liftAction cfg tape position action symbol move
+    | query oracle _ => exact oracle.elim
+
+/-- The first blank saved-coin cell halts the controller. -/
+theorem step_none (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ) (hcell : tape position = none) :
+    machine.replay.step (config cfg tape position) = stopped cfg tape position := by
+  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_state (show (config cfg tape position).state = some cfg.tapes.state
+    from rfl)]
+  simpa only [replay, MultiTapeTM.tr_ofTr, config_workTapeSymbols_last, hcell] using
+    apply_stop cfg tape position
+
+/-- Replay a stored sequence starting at any coin position. The source may halt early or remain
+live when the supplied sequence ends; the controller reaches the following blank in either case. -/
+theorem runFrom_coins (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (cfg : Config k Bool State Empty input)
+    (coins : List Bool) (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (position : ℤ)
+    (hcoins : ∀ i : ℕ, i < coins.length → tape (position + i) = coins[i]?)
+    (hstop : tape (position + coins.length) = none) :
+    machine.replay.runFrom (config cfg tape position) (coins.length + 1) =
+      stopped (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins cfg) tape (position + coins.length) := by
+  induction coins generalizing cfg position with
+  | nil =>
+    simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, runClosedConfigFromCoins] using
+      step_none machine cfg tape position (by simpa using hstop)
+  | cons bit coins ih =>
+    have hcell : tape position = some bit := by simpa using hcoins 0 (by simp)
+    have htail (i : ℕ) (hi : i < coins.length) :
+        tape (position + 1 + i) = coins[i]? := by
+      have h := hcoins (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; lia)
+      simpa [Int.natCast_add, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h
+    have hend : tape (position + 1 + coins.length) = none := by
+      simpa [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hstop
+    rw [List.length_cons, show coins.length + 1 + 1 = 1 + (coins.length + 1) by lia,
+      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
+      step_some machine cfg tape position bit hcell, ih _ _ htail hend]
+    simp [runClosedConfigFromCoins, add_comm, add_left_comm]
+
+end Replay
+
+/-- From preloaded coins and blank source tapes, replay agrees with the fixed-coin interpreter
+and halts in the number of coins plus one transitions. -/
+theorem runFrom_replay (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (coins input : List Bool) :
+    machine.replay.runFrom
+        (Replay.config (machine.initialConfig input) (tapeOfList coins) 0) (coins.length + 1) =
+      Replay.stopped (machine.runClosedConfigFromCoins coins (machine.initialConfig input))
+        (tapeOfList coins) coins.length := by
+  simpa using Replay.runFrom_coins machine (machine.initialConfig input) coins
+    (tapeOfList coins) 0 (by intros; simp) (by simp)
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+/-

+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger
+-/
+
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Replay
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Sampling
+
+/-! Saved-coin replay with shared state, early halting, cutoff and nontrivial work tapes. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.CoinTape
+
+open Cslib Cslib.Probability Turing MultiTapeMachine
+
+private def queryMachine : MultiTapePTM 0 Bool (Fin 4) Bool where
+  initial := 0
+  tr state _ _ answer bit :=
+    if state = 0 then
+      .step { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := some 1 }
+        (fun op => some (if op then bit else !bit)) (fun _ => 0)
+    else if state = 1 then .query bit (if bit then 3 else 2)
+    else .step
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := answer (state == 3), state := none }
+      (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
+
+private abbrev Request := Bool × List Bool
+private abbrev Query := Unit ⊕ Request
+
+private def spec : OracleSpec Query
+  | .inl _ => Bool
+  | .inr _ => List Bool
+
+private def coin : OracleComp spec Bool := OracleComp.query (spec := spec) (.inl ())
+
+private def query (op : Bool) (word : List Bool) : OracleComp spec (List Bool) :=
+  OracleComp.query (spec := spec) (.inr (op, word))
+
+private def record : (q : Query) → StateT (List Request) Id (spec q)
+  | .inl _ => pure false
+  | .inr request => modifyGet fun history => (request.1 :: request.2, history ++ [request])
+
+private def observe (cfg : Config 0 Bool (Fin 4) Bool []) :=
+  (cfg.tapes.output, (cfg.channels false).queryBuffer, (cfg.channels true).queryBuffer,
+    (cfg.channels false).answer, cfg.tapes.state)
+
+-- The first bit is written, the next bit selects the queried channel, and surplus coins are inert.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret record (observe <$>
+    queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query [true, false, true, false]
+      (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run [(true, [])] =
+    (([false], [], [true], [false, false], none), [(true, []), (false, [false])]) := by rfl
+
+-- Pausing before the query retains the pending buffers and the earlier private history.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret record (do
+    let cfg ← queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query [true] (queryMachine.initialConfig [])
+    observe <$> queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query [false, true, false] cfg)).run [(true, [])] =
+    (([false], [], [true], [false, false], none), [(true, []), (false, [false])]) := by
+  rfl
+
+private noncomputable def randomOracle : (q : Query) → StateT ℕ PMF (spec q)
+  | .inl _ => fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).map (fun bit => (bit, s))
+  | .inr (op, _) => fun s => (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).map
+      (fun bit => ([bit ^^ op ^^ (s % 2 == 0)], s + 1))
+
+-- The averaging law applies to randomized replies, coin-dependent queries, and shared state.
+example (fuel s : ℕ) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret randomOracle
+      (queryMachine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run s =
+      (BitString.uniformList fuel).bind (fun coins =>
+        (OracleComp.interpret randomOracle
+          (queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query coins
+            (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run s) := by
+  exact MultiTapePTM.run_interpret_runConfigFrom_eq_coins queryMachine coin query randomOracle
+    (fun s => congrArg (fun p => p.run s) (OracleComp.interpret_query randomOracle (.inl ()))) _ _ _
+
+-- Fixed-coin replay draws no coins, even if the installed coin handler would mutate state.
+private def countCoins : (q : Query) → StateT ℕ Id (spec q)
+  | .inl _ => modifyGet fun s => (false, s + 1)
+  | .inr _ => pure []
+
+example : ((OracleComp.interpret countCoins (queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query
+    [false, false, false] (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run 0).2 = 0 := by rfl
+
+-- A state-changing coin handler does not satisfy the open averaging claim without its hypothesis.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret countCoins (queryMachine.runConfigFrom coin query 1
+      (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run 0 ≠
+    (OracleComp.interpret countCoins (queryMachine.runConfigFromCoins query [false]
+      (queryMachine.initialConfig []))).run 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have : (1 : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd h
+  contradiction
+
+private def writeForever : MultiTapePTM 1 Bool Unit where
+  initial := ()
+  tr _ _ _ _ bit := .step
+    { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun _ => (some bit, -1), output := some bit, state := some () }
+    Empty.elim Empty.elim
+
+-- The supplied tape bounds a source that never halts, including its negative work-head movement.
+example :
+    let final := writeForever.replay.runFrom
+      (MultiTapePTM.Replay.config (writeForever.initialConfig [])
+        (tapeOfList [true, false]) 0) 3
+    (final.output, final.state, final.workTapePos 0, final.workTapePos 1,
+      final.workTapes 0 0, final.workTapes 0 (-1)) =
+      ([true, false], none, -2, 2, some true, some false) := by
+  dsimp only
+  have h := MultiTapePTM.runFrom_replay writeForever [true, false] []
+  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd] at h
+  rw [h]
+  rfl
+
+-- An empty tape halts the controller before executing any instruction of a live source.
+example :
+    let final := writeForever.replay.runFrom
+      (MultiTapePTM.Replay.config (writeForever.initialConfig []) (tapeOfList []) 0) 1
+    (final.output, final.state, final.workTapePos 0, final.workTapePos 1) = ([], none, 0, 0) := by
+  dsimp only
+  have h := MultiTapePTM.runFrom_replay writeForever [] []
+  simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd] at h
+  rw [h]
+  rfl
+
+-- A source that halts early ignores the unused bits while the controller finishes its scan.
+example :
+    let final := MultiTapePTM.uniformListMachine.replay.runFrom
+      (MultiTapePTM.Replay.config (MultiTapePTM.uniformListMachine.initialConfig [false])
+        (tapeOfList [true, false, false, true]) 0) 5
+    (final.output, final.state, final.workTapePos 0) = ([true], none, 4) := by
+  dsimp only
+  have h := MultiTapePTM.runFrom_replay MultiTapePTM.uniformListMachine
+    [true, false, false, true] [false]
+  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd] at h
+  rw [h]
+  rfl
+
+private def halted : Config 1 Bool Unit Empty [] :=
+  { writeForever.initialConfig [] with
+    tapes := { (writeForever.initialConfig []).tapes with state := none, output := [true] } }
+
+-- An already-halted source retains its output; stored false bits are not tape boundaries.
+example :
+    let final := writeForever.replay.runFrom
+      (MultiTapePTM.Replay.config halted (tapeOfList [false, true]) 0) 3
+    (final.output, final.state, final.workTapePos 0, final.workTapePos 1) =
+      ([true], none, 0, 2) := by
+  have h := MultiTapePTM.Replay.runFrom_coins writeForever halted [false, true]
+    (tapeOfList [false, true]) 0 (by intros; simp) (by rfl)
+  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd, zero_add] at h
+  dsimp only
+  rw [h]
+  rfl
+
+-- Every supplied tape produces a supported output, even for a nonhalting source.
+example (coins : List Bool) : writeForever.runClosedCoins coins [] ∈
+    (ProbComp.eval (writeForever.runClosed coins.length [])).support :=
+  MultiTapePTM.runClosedCoins_mem_support _ _ _
+
+end ComplexityTests.CoinTape
