+/-!
+# Composing closed probabilistic machines through a buffered word
+
+The first machine writes to a fresh buffer. A deterministic handoff rewinds the buffer and
+marks its left boundary. The second machine then reads this word as its input, starting with
+separate blank work tapes. Preparation costs the intermediate word length plus four transitions.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.comp`: feed one closed machine's output to another.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.eval_comp`: the compiled output distribution is monadic composition.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `MultiTape/Oracle/Composition.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common machine compilers. As for upstream
+deterministic composition, `second.comp first mark` executes `first` and then `second`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+namespace Composition
+
+variable {k₀ k₁ : ℕ} {Symbol State₀ State₁ : Type} {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- Reserve blank continuation tapes before the source's work tapes. -/
+def reserve (k₁ : ℕ) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    Config (k₁ + k₀) Symbol State₀ Empty input :=
+  cfg.embed (Fin.natAddEmb k₁) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
+
+/-- Buffer the source result and reserve a blank boundary-marker tape. -/
+def buffer (k₁ : ℕ) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    Config (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol State₀ Empty input :=
+  (OutputToTape.config (reserve k₁ cfg)).embed Fin.castSuccEmb (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
+
+/-- Run the source on its own tapes, redirecting its output to the virtual input buffer. -/
+def source (machine : MultiTapePTM k₀ Symbol State₀) (k₁ : ℕ) :
+    MultiTapePTM (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol State₀ :=
+  ((machine.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k₁)).outputToTape).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb
+
+/-- Run the continuation on separate work tapes, reading the virtual input. -/
+def consumer (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (k₀ : ℕ) :
+    MultiTapePTM (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol State₁ :=
+  (machine.extendTapes (Fin.castAddEmb k₀)).inputFromTape
+
+/-- Retain the first machine's scratch tapes while the continuation runs on its output. -/
+def consumerConfig (mark : Symbol) (cfg₀ : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+    (cfg₁ : Config k₁ Symbol State₁ Empty cfg₀.tapes.output) :
+    Config (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol State₁ Empty input :=
+  InputFromTape.config mark
+    (cfg₁.embed (Fin.castAddEmb k₀)
+      (reserve k₁ cfg₀).tapes.workTapes (reserve k₁ cfg₀).tapes.workTapePos)
+    input cfg₀.tapes.inputPos
+
+/-- The prepared virtual input, with every source work tape retained. -/
+def ready (mark : Symbol) (k₁ : ℕ) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    Config (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol (MultiTapeTM.MarkWorkState ⊕ MultiTapeTM.RewindWorkState)
+      Empty input where
+  tapes := ⟨none, cfg.tapes.inputPos,
+    Fin.append (reserve k₁ cfg).tapes.workTapes
+      ![tapeOfList cfg.tapes.output, Function.update (fun _ => none) (-1) (some mark)],
+    Fin.append (reserve k₁ cfg).tapes.workTapePos (fun _ => 0), []⟩
+  channels := cfg.channels
+
+/-- Rewind and mark the intermediate word before starting the continuation. -/
+noncomputable def continuation (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (k₀ : ℕ)
+    (mark : Symbol) : MultiTapePTM (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol
+      ((MultiTapeTM.MarkWorkState ⊕ MultiTapeTM.RewindWorkState) ⊕ State₁) :=
+  (ofDeterministic (MultiTapeTM.prepareInput (k₁ + k₀) mark)).seq (consumer machine k₀)
+
+/-- Buffering the source preserves its complete configuration program. -/
+theorem runClosedConfigFrom_source (machine : MultiTapePTM k₀ Symbol State₀) (k₁ fuel : ℕ)
+    (input : List Symbol) :
+    (source machine k₁).runClosedConfigFrom fuel ((source machine k₁).initialConfig input) =
+      buffer k₁ <$> machine.runClosedConfigFrom fuel (machine.initialConfig input) := by
+  simp only [source, runClosedConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.initialConfig_extendTapes,
+    MultiTapeMachine.initialConfig_outputToTape, runConfigFrom_embed,
+    runConfigFrom_outputToTape, Functor.map_map]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The consumer preserves the continuation's complete configuration program. -/
+theorem runClosedConfigFrom_consumer (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (mark : Symbol)
+    (cfg₀ : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+    (cfg₁ : Config k₁ Symbol State₁ Empty cfg₀.tapes.output) (fuel : ℕ) :
+    (consumer machine k₀).runClosedConfigFrom fuel (consumerConfig mark cfg₀ cfg₁) =
+      consumerConfig mark cfg₀ <$> machine.runClosedConfigFrom fuel cfg₁ := by
+  simp only [consumer, consumerConfig, runClosedConfigFrom, runConfigFrom_inputFromTape,
+    runConfigFrom_embed, Functor.map_map]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The two new tapes are the completed output buffer and a blank boundary tape. -/
+theorem buffer_tapes (k₁ : ℕ) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    (buffer k₁ cfg).tapes =
+      ⟨cfg.tapes.state, cfg.tapes.inputPos,
+        Fin.append (reserve k₁ cfg).tapes.workTapes ![tapeOfList cfg.tapes.output, fun _ => none],
+        Fin.append (reserve k₁ cfg).tapes.workTapePos ![(cfg.tapes.output.length : ℤ), 0], []⟩ := by
+  have happend {α : Type} (f : Fin (k₁ + k₀) → α) (a b : α) :
+      Fin.lastCases b (Fin.lastCases a f) = Fin.append f ![a, b] := by
+    have hsnoc {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → α) (a : α) :
+        (Fin.lastCases a f : Fin (n + 1) → α) = Fin.snoc f a := by
+      funext i
+      induction i using Fin.lastCases <;> simp
+    change Fin.lastCases b (Fin.lastCases a f) = Fin.append f (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b Fin.elim0))
+    rw [hsnoc, hsnoc, Fin.append_right_cons, Fin.append_right_eq_snoc]
+    rfl
+  simp only [buffer, Config.embed, OutputToTape.config, MultiTapeTM.embed_castSucc,
+    MultiTapeTM.outCfg, happend]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The handoff costs the buffered word length plus four, with no assumptions on source scratch. -/
+theorem runFrom_prepare (mark : Symbol) (k₁ : ℕ) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    (MultiTapeTM.prepareInput (k₁ + k₀) mark).runFrom
+        ((buffer k₁ cfg).tapes.withState
+          (some (MultiTapeTM.prepareInput (k₁ + k₀) mark).q₀)) (cfg.tapes.output.length + 4) =
+      (ready mark k₁ cfg).tapes := by
+  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_prepareInput mark _ cfg.tapes.output
+    (by rw [buffer_tapes]; simp) (by rw [buffer_tapes]; simp) (by rw [buffer_tapes]; simp)]
+  rw [buffer_tapes]
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;> induction i using Fin.addCases with
+  | left i => simp [ready, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.castAdd_ne_natAdd i _)]
+  | right i => fin_cases i <;> simp [ready]
+
+/-- The prepared input starts the continuation with blank work tapes. -/
+theorem start_ready (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (mark : Symbol)
+    (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) :
+    Sequential.start (consumer machine k₀) (ready mark k₁ cfg) =
+      consumerConfig mark cfg (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output) := by
+  refine Config.ext ?_ (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
+  simp only [Sequential.start, ready, consumerConfig, InputFromTape.config, Config.embed,
+    MultiTapeTM.embed_castAdd, MultiTapeTM.inCfg, initialConfig, Cfg.init, reserve,
+    MultiTapeTM.embed_natAdd, Cfg.withState]
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;> induction i using Fin.addCases with
+  | left i => induction i using Fin.addCases <;> simp
+  | right i => fin_cases i <;> simp
+
+/-- Virtual-input redirection preserves a halting bound. -/
+theorem consumer_halted (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (mark : Symbol)
+    (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) (fuel : ℕ)
+    (hhalt : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+      (machine.runClosedConfigFrom fuel (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none) :
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((consumer machine k₀).runClosedConfigFrom fuel
+      (consumerConfig mark cfg (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output)))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none := by
+  intro final hfinal
+  rw [runClosedConfigFrom_consumer, ProbComp.eval_map] at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨result, hresult, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
+  exact hhalt result hresult
+
+/-- Once preparation and execution have been paid for, the continuation has its source law. -/
+theorem eval_runClosedConfigFrom_continuation (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁)
+    (mark : Symbol) (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) (prepareTime runTime : ℕ)
+    (hprepare : cfg.tapes.output.length + 4 ≤ prepareTime)
+    (hrun : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+      (machine.runClosedConfigFrom runTime (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none) :
+    ProbComp.eval ((continuation machine k₀ mark).runClosedConfigFrom (prepareTime + runTime)
+      (Sequential.start (continuation machine k₀ mark) (buffer k₁ cfg))) =
+      (ProbComp.eval
+        (machine.runClosedConfigFrom runTime (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output))).map
+        (fun final => Sequential.right (consumerConfig mark cfg final)) := by
+  let prep := MultiTapeTM.prepareInput (k₁ + k₀) mark
+  let initial := Sequential.start (ofDeterministic prep) (buffer k₁ cfg)
+  have hdet := runFrom_prepare mark k₁ cfg
+  change prep.runFrom initial.tapes (cfg.tapes.output.length + 4) = _ at hdet
+  have hprep : prep.runFrom initial.tapes prepareTime = (ready mark k₁ cfg).tapes := by
+    rw [prep.runFrom_eq_of_halt initial.tapes hprepare (by rw [hdet]; rfl), hdet]
+  have hstate : ProbComp.eval ((ofDeterministic prep).runClosedConfigFrom prepareTime initial) =
+      PMF.pure (ready mark k₁ cfg) := by
+    rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_ofDeterministic, hprep]
+    rfl
+  change ProbComp.eval (((ofDeterministic prep).seq (consumer machine k₀)).runClosedConfigFrom
+    _ (Sequential.left (consumer machine k₀) initial)) = _
+  rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_seq _ _ _ prepareTime runTime
+    (by simp [hstate, ready])
+    (by simpa [hstate, start_ready] using consumer_halted machine mark cfg runTime hrun),
+    hstate, PMF.pure_bind, start_ready, runClosedConfigFrom_consumer, ProbComp.eval_map,
+    PMF.map_comp]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The handoff and continuation actually halt within the combined bound. -/
+theorem continuation_halted (machine : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (mark : Symbol)
+    (cfg : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input) (prepareTime runTime : ℕ)
+    (hprepare : cfg.tapes.output.length + 4 ≤ prepareTime)
+    (hrun : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+      (machine.runClosedConfigFrom runTime (machine.initialConfig cfg.tapes.output))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none) :
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((continuation machine k₀ mark).runClosedConfigFrom
+      (prepareTime + runTime)
+      (Sequential.start (continuation machine k₀ mark) (buffer k₁ cfg)))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none := by
+  intro final hfinal
+  rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_continuation machine mark cfg prepareTime runTime hprepare hrun]
+    at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨result, hresult, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
+  change result.tapes.state.map Sum.inr = none
+  rw [hrun result hresult]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The control-state embeddings of a completed composition. -/
+def finalConfig (mark : Symbol) (cfg₀ : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+    (cfg₁ : Config k₁ Symbol State₁ Empty cfg₀.tapes.output) :
+    Config (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol
+      (State₀ ⊕ ((MultiTapeTM.MarkWorkState ⊕ MultiTapeTM.RewindWorkState) ⊕ State₁)) Empty input :=
+  Sequential.right (Sequential.right (consumerConfig mark cfg₀ cfg₁))
+
+@[simp] theorem finalConfig_output (mark : Symbol) (cfg₀ : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+    (cfg₁ : Config k₁ Symbol State₁ Empty cfg₀.tapes.output) :
+    (finalConfig mark cfg₀ cfg₁).tapes.output = cfg₁.tapes.output := rfl
+
+/-- A supported final configuration supplies a supported output word. -/
+theorem output_mem (machine : MultiTapePTM k₀ Symbol State₀) (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol)
+    (final : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+    (hfinal : final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+      (machine.runClosedConfigFrom fuel (machine.initialConfig input))).support) :
+    final.tapes.output ∈ (ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed fuel input)).support := by
+  rw [runClosed_eq_map, ProbComp.eval_map]
+  exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨final, hfinal, rfl⟩
+
+end Composition
+
+/-- Feed `first`'s output to `second`, with separate work tapes and a charged input handoff. -/
+noncomputable def comp {k₀ k₁ : ℕ} {Symbol State₀ State₁ : Type}
+    (second : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁) (first : MultiTapePTM k₀ Symbol State₀)
+    (mark : Symbol) : MultiTapePTM (k₁ + k₀ + 2) Symbol
+      (State₀ ⊕ ((MultiTapeTM.MarkWorkState ⊕ MultiTapeTM.RewindWorkState) ⊕ State₁)) :=
+  (Composition.source first k₁).seq (Composition.continuation second k₀ mark)
+
+variable {k₀ k₁ : ℕ} {Symbol State₀ State₁ : Type}
+  (first : MultiTapePTM k₀ Symbol State₀) (second : MultiTapePTM k₁ Symbol State₁)
+  (mark : Symbol) (input : List Symbol) (firstTime secondTime : ℕ)
+  (hfirst : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+    (first.runClosedConfigFrom firstTime (first.initialConfig input))).support,
+    final.tapes.state = none)
+  (hsecond : ∀ word ∈ (ProbComp.eval (first.runClosed firstTime input)).support,
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+      (second.runClosedConfigFrom secondTime (second.initialConfig word))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none)
+
+include hfirst hsecond
+
+/-- Composition preserves the full configuration distribution and charges the intermediate word.
+The first phase takes `firstTime`, preparation at most `firstTime + 4`, and the second phase
+`secondTime`. Both source bounds concern actual halting, including random stopping times. -/
+theorem eval_runClosedConfigFrom_comp :
+    ProbComp.eval ((second.comp first mark).runClosedConfigFrom
+      (firstTime + (firstTime + 4 + secondTime)) ((second.comp first mark).initialConfig input)) =
+      (ProbComp.eval (first.runClosedConfigFrom firstTime (first.initialConfig input))).bind
+        (fun sourceFinal => (ProbComp.eval (second.runClosedConfigFrom secondTime
+          (second.initialConfig sourceFinal.tapes.output))).map
+          (Composition.finalConfig mark sourceFinal)) := by
+  have hlength (final : Config k₀ Symbol State₀ Empty input)
+      (hfinal : final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+        (first.runClosedConfigFrom firstTime (first.initialConfig input))).support) :
+      final.tapes.output.length ≤ firstTime :=
+    first.length_output_eval_runClosed_le firstTime input final.tapes.output
+      (Composition.output_mem first firstTime input final hfinal)
+  change ProbComp.eval
+    (((Composition.source first k₁).seq
+      (Composition.continuation second k₀ mark)).runClosedConfigFrom
+      _ (Sequential.left (Composition.continuation second k₀ mark)
+        ((Composition.source first k₁).initialConfig input))) = _
+  rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_seq _ _ _ firstTime (firstTime + 4 + secondTime)
+    (by
+      intro result hresult
+      rw [Composition.runClosedConfigFrom_source, ProbComp.eval_map] at hresult
+      obtain ⟨final, hfinal, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hresult
+      exact hfirst final hfinal)
+    (by
+      intro result hresult
+      rw [Composition.runClosedConfigFrom_source, ProbComp.eval_map] at hresult
+      obtain ⟨final, hfinal, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hresult
+      exact Composition.continuation_halted second mark final (firstTime + 4) secondTime
+        (by have := hlength final hfinal; lia)
+        (hsecond _ (Composition.output_mem first firstTime input final hfinal))),
+    Composition.runClosedConfigFrom_source, ProbComp.eval_map, PMF.bind_map]
+  apply Probability.PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+  intro final hfinal
+  dsimp only [Function.comp_def]
+  rw [Composition.eval_runClosedConfigFrom_continuation second mark final
+    (firstTime + 4) secondTime (by have := hlength final hfinal; lia)
+    (hsecond _ (Composition.output_mem first firstTime input final hfinal)), PMF.map_comp]
+  rfl
+
+/-- At the output level, the compiled machine realizes ordinary monadic composition. -/
+theorem eval_comp :
+    ProbComp.eval ((second.comp first mark).runClosed
+      (firstTime + (firstTime + 4 + secondTime)) input) =
+      (ProbComp.eval (first.runClosed firstTime input)).bind
+        (fun word => ProbComp.eval (second.runClosed secondTime word)) := by
+  have h := congrArg (PMF.map (fun final => final.tapes.output))
+    (eval_runClosedConfigFrom_comp first second mark input firstTime secondTime hfirst hsecond)
+  simpa only [runClosed_eq_map, ProbComp.eval_map, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, PMF.bind_map,
+    Function.comp_def, Composition.finalConfig_output] using h
+
+/-- Every supported execution of the composed machine has halted within the combined bound. -/
+theorem comp_halted :
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((second.comp first mark).runClosedConfigFrom
+      (firstTime + (firstTime + 4 + secondTime))
+      ((second.comp first mark).initialConfig input))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none := by
+  intro final hfinal
+  rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_comp first second mark input firstTime secondTime hfirst hsecond]
+    at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨source, hsource, htarget⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_bind_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
+  obtain ⟨target, hmem, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp htarget
+  have hhalt := hsecond _ (Composition.output_mem first firstTime input source hsource)
+    target hmem
+  change (target.tapes.state.map Sum.inr).map Sum.inr = none
+  rw [hhalt]
+  rfl
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+/-!
+# Probabilistic machines reading a buffered input
+
+The common virtual-input compiler applies directly to Boolean-indexed choices, preserving the
+whole typed program, including stateful coin and query effects. Preparing the buffer is separate.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.inputFromTape`: read the input from a word and a boundary-marker tape.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_inputFromTape`: preserve the source configuration program.
+
+## References
+
+Specializes `MultiTape.Machine.InputFromTape`, adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8` and upstream's deterministic input redirection.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle Query : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query}
+  {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- The common virtual-input compiler specialized to Boolean-indexed transitions. -/
+abbrev inputFromTape (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) :
+    MultiTapePTM (k + 2) Symbol State Oracle := MultiTapeMachine.inputFromTape machine
+
+/-- Read a prepared virtual input, preserving the complete clocked program and oracle channels. -/
+theorem runConfigFrom_inputFromTape [DecidableEq Oracle]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol)) (mark : Symbol) (fuel : ℕ)
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (outerInput : List Symbol)
+    (outerPosition : Fin (outerInput.length + 2)) :
+    machine.inputFromTape.runConfigFrom coin query fuel
+        (InputFromTape.config mark cfg outerInput outerPosition) =
+      (fun final => InputFromTape.config mark final outerInput outerPosition) <$>
+        machine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel cfg :=
+  MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_inputFromTape machine (fun choices => choices <$> coin)
+    (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) query mark fuel cfg outerInput outerPosition
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+# Buffering probabilistic machine output
+
+The common output compiler applies directly to Boolean-indexed choices, preserving the whole
+typed program, including stateful coin and query effects. The buffer starts blank.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.outputToTape`: redirect output to a fresh work tape.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_outputToTape`: preserve the source configuration program.
+
+## References
+
+Specializes `MultiTape.Machine.OutputToTape`, adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch at

+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle Query : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query}
+  {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- The common output compiler specialized to Boolean-indexed transitions. -/
+abbrev outputToTape (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) :
+    MultiTapePTM (k + 1) Symbol State Oracle := MultiTapeMachine.outputToTape machine
+
+/-- Buffer output while retaining the complete clocked program and every oracle channel. -/
+theorem runConfigFrom_outputToTape [DecidableEq Oracle]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol)) (fuel : ℕ)
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) :

+    (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) query fuel cfg
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+/-

+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger

+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.PPT.Clock
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Composition
+import Complexity.Foundations.Data.Nat.PolynomialBound.Closure
+
+/-!
+# Composing uniformly efficient probabilistic programs
+
+Encoded probabilistic programs compose through ordinary monadic `bind`. Each certificate gives
+one finite machine for every input. The output-length bound controls the continuation's clock,
+and the machine compiler charges every instruction needed to prepare its fresh input.
+
+This module also registers deterministic preprocessing and postprocessing with `fun_prop`.
+Continuations here consume the sampled result; retaining a captured caller input requires a
+separate copying construction.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.bind`: monadic composition preserves uniform strict PPT.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.map`: polynomial-time deterministic postprocessing preserves PPT.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.preprocess`: efficiently prepare a probabilistic program's input.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `Computability/Probabilistic/Realization/Composition.lean` and
+`Computability/Probabilistic/Composition.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, reusing the common machine and tidy deterministic
+calculus.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Probability
+
+open Turing.MultiTapePTM
+open Turing.MultiTapeTM (ComputableTidilyInPolyTime)
+
+variable {α β γ : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {middle : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {output : γ ↪ List Bool}
+
+/-- Sequence two uniformly efficient encoded programs. The intermediate output length bounds
+the continuation's time, and input preparation is included in the compiled polynomial clock. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem IsPPTOn.bind {first : α → ProbComp β} {second : β → ProbComp γ}
+    (hfirst : IsPPTOn input middle first) (hsecond : IsPPTOn middle output second) :
+    IsPPTOn input output (fun a => do
+      let b ← first a
+      second b) := by
+  obtain ⟨k₀, State₀, hfinite₀, source, c₀, d₀, hsource, hsourceHalt⟩ :=
+    hfirst.exists_halting_machine
+  obtain ⟨k₁, State₁, hfinite₁, target, c₁, d₁, htarget, htargetHalt⟩ :=
+    hsecond.exists_halting_machine
+  let firstTime := fun length => c₀ * (length + 1) ^ d₀
+  let secondTime := fun length => c₁ * (firstTime length + 1) ^ d₁
+  have hpoly : PolynomiallyBounded
+      (fun length => firstTime length + (firstTime length + 4 + secondTime length)) := by
+    fun_prop
+  obtain ⟨coefficient, degree, htime⟩ := polynomiallyBounded_iff_le.mp hpoly
+  refine ⟨k₁ + k₀ + 2,
+    State₀ ⊕ ((Turing.MultiTapeTM.MarkWorkState ⊕ Turing.MultiTapeTM.RewindWorkState) ⊕ State₁),
+    inferInstance, target.comp source true, coefficient, degree, fun a => ?_⟩
+  let encoded := input a
+  have hbound (word : List Bool)
+      (hword : word ∈
+        (ProbComp.eval (source.runClosed (firstTime encoded.length) encoded)).support) :
+      c₁ * (word.length + 1) ^ d₁ ≤ secondTime encoded.length :=
+    Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₁ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
+      (Nat.add_le_add_right (source.length_output_eval_runClosed_le _ _ _ hword) 1) d₁)
+  have htargetBound (word : List Bool)
+      (hword : word ∈
+        (ProbComp.eval (source.runClosed (firstTime encoded.length) encoded)).support) :
+      ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+        (target.runClosedConfigFrom (secondTime encoded.length)
+          (target.initialConfig word))).support,
+        final.tapes.state = none := by
+    intro final hfinal
+    rw [eval_runClosedConfigFrom_eq_of_halted target _ (hbound word hword) (htargetHalt word)]
+      at hfinal
+    exact htargetHalt word final hfinal
+  have hhalt := comp_halted source target true encoded (firstTime encoded.length)
+    (secondTime encoded.length) (hsourceHalt encoded) htargetBound
+  rw [eval_runClosed_eq_of_halted _ _ (htime encoded.length) hhalt,
+    eval_comp source target true encoded _ _ (hsourceHalt encoded) htargetBound,
+    ← hsource a, PMF.bind_map, ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.map_bind]
+  apply PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+  intro result hresult
+  have hword : middle result ∈
+      (ProbComp.eval (source.runClosed (firstTime encoded.length) encoded)).support := by
+    rw [← hsource a]
+    exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨result, hresult, rfl⟩
+  exact (htarget result).trans
+    (eval_runClosed_eq_of_halted target _ (hbound _ hword) (htargetHalt _)).symm
+
+/-- Prepare the encoded argument of a uniformly efficient probabilistic program. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem IsPPTOn.preprocess {program : β → ProbComp γ} {prepare : α → β}
+    (hprogram : IsPPTOn middle output program)
+    (hprepare : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime prepare input middle) :
+    IsPPTOn input output (fun a => program (prepare a)) := by
+  simpa only [pure_bind] using hprepare.isPPTOn.bind hprogram
+
+/-- Polynomial-time deterministic processing of each sampled result preserves PPT. -/
+@[fun_prop]
+theorem IsPPTOn.map {program : α → ProbComp β} {f : β → γ}
+    (hprogram : IsPPTOn input middle program) (hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f middle output) :
+    IsPPTOn input output (fun a => f <$> program a) := by
+  simpa only [bind_pure_comp] using hprogram.bind hf.isPPTOn
+
+end Cslib.Probability

+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.InputFromTape
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.OutputToTape
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.PrepareInput
+
+/-! Buffering retains stateful effects and correctly clamps both ends of an empty virtual input. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.MachineIOBuffer
+
+open Cslib Turing MultiTapeMachine
+
+private def advance (direction : SignType) : MultiTapePTM 0 Bool Unit Bool where
+  initial := ()
+  tr _ _ _ _ bit := .step
+    { inputTape := direction, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := some bit, state := some () }
+    (fun op => if op then some bit else none) (fun _ => -1)
+
+private def spec : OracleSpec Unit := fun _ => Bool
+
+private def coin : OracleComp spec Bool := OracleComp.query ()
+
+private def countCoins : (q : Unit) → StateT ℕ Id (spec q) :=
+  fun _ => modifyGet fun state => (true, state + 1)
+
+private def initial (position : Fin 2) : Config 0 Bool Unit Bool [] :=
+  { tapes := { ((advance 0).initialConfig []).tapes with inputPos := position, output := [false] }
+    channels := fun _ => { queryBuffer := [false], answer := [true], answerPos := 2 } }
+
+private def observeInput (cfg : Config 2 Bool Unit Bool [true, false]) :=
+  (cfg.tapes.inputPos.val, cfg.tapes.workTapePos 0, cfg.tapes.workTapePos 1, cfg.tapes.output,
+    (cfg.channels false).queryBuffer, (cfg.channels true).queryBuffer,
+    (cfg.channels true).answerPos)
+
+-- Repeated left moves at the left end stay at -1 on both virtual tapes. The real head stays at 2.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret countCoins (observeInput <$>
+    (advance (-1)).inputFromTape.runConfigFrom coin (fun _ _ => pure []) 3
+      (InputFromTape.config true (initial 0) [true, false] 2))).run 4 =
+    ((2, -1, -1, [false, true, true, true], [false], [false, true, true, true], -1), 7) := by
+  rw [MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_inputFromTape]
+  rfl
+
+-- At the right end of the empty input, repeated right moves stay at cell zero.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret countCoins (observeInput <$>
+    (advance 1).inputFromTape.runConfigFrom coin (fun _ _ => pure []) 3
+      (InputFromTape.config false (initial 1) [true, false] 2))).run 4 =
+    ((2, 0, 0, [false, true, true, true], [false], [false, true, true, true], -1), 7) := by
+  rw [MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_inputFromTape]
+  rfl
+
+private def observeOutput (cfg : Config 1 Bool Unit Bool []) :=
+  (cfg.tapes.output, cfg.tapes.workTapePos 0, cfg.tapes.workTapes 0 0,
+    cfg.tapes.workTapes 0 1, cfg.tapes.workTapes 0 3, cfg.tapes.workTapes 0 4,
+    (cfg.channels false).queryBuffer, (cfg.channels true).queryBuffer)
+
+-- Existing output is retained in the buffer, followed by all three new bits, with no real output.
+example : (OracleComp.interpret countCoins (observeOutput <$>
+    (advance 0).outputToTape.runConfigFrom coin (fun _ _ => pure []) 3
+      (OutputToTape.config (initial 1)))).run 4 =
+    (([], 4, some false, some true, some true, none, [false], [false, true, true, true]), 7) := by
+  rw [MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_outputToTape]
+  rfl
+
+end ComplexityTests.MachineIOBuffer

+
+namespace ComplexityTests.PPTComposition
+
+open Cslib Cslib.Probability Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+-- The result length can depend on randomness, and can be zero.
+example : IsPPTOn encBits encBits (fun _ => do
+    let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+    pure (if bit then [true, false, true] else [])) := by
+  fun_prop
+
+example : IsPPTOn encBits encBool (fun _ => do
+    let bit ← ProbComp.uniform Bool
+    pure (!bit)) := by
+  fun_prop
+
+example {α β γ : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool} {middle : β ↪ List Bool}
+    {output : γ ↪ List Bool} {sample : α → ProbComp β} {finish : β → ProbComp γ}
+    (hsample : IsPPTOn input middle sample) (hfinish : IsPPTOn middle output finish) :
+    IsPPTOn input output (fun a => do
+      let b ← sample a
+      finish b) := by
+  fun_prop
+
+-- GGM's existing evaluator proof works after any certified seed/path sampler.
+example {α : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {sample : α → ProbComp (List Bool × List Bool)} {generator : List Bool → List Bool}
+    (hsample : IsPPTOn input (encPair encBits encBits) sample)
+    (hgenerator : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime generator encBits encBits) :
+    IsPPTOn input encBits (fun a => do
+      let pair ← sample a
+      pure (Crypto.GGM.eval generator pair.1 pair.2)) := by
+  fun_prop
+
+-- Preprocessing can traverse unbounded encoded inputs before invoking a certified sampler.
+example {sample : List Bool → ProbComp Bool} (hsample : IsPPTOn encBits encBool sample) :
+    IsPPTOn encBits encBool (fun word => sample word.reverse) := by
+  fun_prop
+
+-- Composition does not turn arbitrary finite-uniform sampling into strict fair-coin PPT.
+example : True := by
+  let encFin3 : Fin 3 ↪ List Bool := Fin.valEmbedding.trans encNat
+  fail_if_success have : IsPPTOn encBits encFin3 (fun _ => ProbComp.uniform (Fin 3)) := by fun_prop
+  trivial
+
+end ComplexityTests.PPTComposition

+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Composition
+
+/-! Fresh-input composition with random stopping times, dirty scratch, and empty output. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.ProbabilisticComposition
+
+open Cslib Turing MultiTapeMachine
+
+-- A true coin emits a bit and halts immediately. False emits nothing and halts one step later.
+-- Both paths dirty the source scratch tape and move the real input head.
+private def chooseWord : MultiTapePTM 1 Bool Bool where
+  initial := false
+  tr state _ _ _ bit := .step
+    { inputTape := 1, workTapes := fun _ => (some (some false), -1)
+      output := if !state && bit then some true else none
+      state := if state || bit then none else some true }
+    Empty.elim Empty.elim
+
+-- The consumer must see its own blank scratch and the generated input, not the real input.
+private def readFirst : MultiTapePTM 1 Bool Unit where
+  initial := ()
+  tr _ symbol work _ _ := .step
+    { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun _ => (none, 0)
+      output := if work 0 = none then symbol else some false, state := none }
+    Empty.elim Empty.elim
+
+private theorem chooseWord_halts (input : List Bool) : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+    (chooseWord.runClosedConfigFrom 2 (chooseWord.initialConfig input))).support,
+    final.tapes.state = none := by
+  intro final hfinal
+  simp only [MultiTapePTM.runClosedConfigFrom, MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom,
+    MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, initialConfig, Cfg.init, chooseWord,
+    Bool.not_false, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_or, bind_map_left,
+    ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff] at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨bit, _, hbit⟩ := hfinal
+  cases bit <;> aesop (add simp [Config.step, Turing.Action.apply])
+
+private theorem readFirst_halts (word : List Bool) : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval
+    (readFirst.runClosedConfigFrom 1 (readFirst.initialConfig word))).support,
+    final.tapes.state = none := by
+  intro final hfinal
+  simp only [MultiTapePTM.runClosedConfigFrom, MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom,
+    MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, initialConfig, Cfg.init, readFirst, bind_map_left,
+    ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.mem_support_bind_iff] at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨bit, _, hbit⟩ := hfinal
+  aesop (add simp [Config.step, Turing.Action.apply])
+
+private theorem chooseWord_output (input : List Bool) :
+    ProbComp.eval (chooseWord.runClosed 2 input) =
+      (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform Bool)).map (fun bit => if bit then [true] else []) := by
+  simp only [MultiTapePTM.runClosed, MultiTapePTM.run, MultiTapePTM.runFrom,
+    MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, initialConfig, Cfg.init,
+    chooseWord, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_or, bind_map_left,
+    ProbComp.eval_map, ProbComp.eval_bind, PMF.map_bind]
+  rw [PMF.map]
+  apply Probability.PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+  intro bit _
+  cases bit <;> simp [Config.step, Turing.Action.apply, PMF.map]
+
+-- The real input is [false]. Correct virtual-input routing instead gives [true] or [].
+example : ProbComp.eval ((readFirst.comp chooseWord true).runClosed 9 [false]) =
+    (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform Bool)).map (fun bit => if bit then [true] else []) := by
+  rw [MultiTapePTM.eval_comp chooseWord readFirst true [false] 2 1 (chooseWord_halts _)
+    (fun word _ => readFirst_halts word), chooseWord_output, PMF.bind_map]
+  rw [PMF.map]
+  apply Probability.PMF.bind_congr_on_support
+  intro bit _
+  cases bit <;> simp [MultiTapePTM.runClosed, MultiTapePTM.run, MultiTapePTM.runFrom,
+    MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, initialConfig, Cfg.init,
+    readFirst, Config.step, Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.inputSymbol, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
+    PMF.map, Function.comp_def]
+
+example : ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval ((readFirst.comp chooseWord true).runClosedConfigFrom
+    9 ((readFirst.comp chooseWord true).initialConfig [false]))).support,
+    final.tapes.state = none :=
+  MultiTapePTM.comp_halted chooseWord readFirst true [false] 2 1 (chooseWord_halts _)
+    (fun word _ => readFirst_halts word)
+
+end ComplexityTests.ProbabilisticComposition

@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 Samuel Schlesinger. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger
+-/
+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Machine.Halting
+public import Cslib.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.ExtendTapes
+
+/-!
+# Reserving work tapes for effectful machines
+
+Reindexing the source's tapes leaves every additional tape and head unchanged. The construction
+uses upstream's configuration embedding and preserves the entire typed execution program, hence
+also the joint distribution of configuration and private interpreter state. It requires only that
+the choice interpreter commute with mapping; coin draws may be stateful.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeMachine.extendTapes`: run on tapes selected by an embedding.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeMachine.Config.embed`: retain arbitrary data on the additional tapes.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_embed`: reindexing preserves the full clocked program.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeMachine.toTM_extendTapes`: agreement with upstream's deterministic compiler.
+
+## References
+
+Adapted from `MultiTape/Oracle/ExtendTapes.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8` to the common machine and typed program interface.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeMachine
+
+open Cslib
+
+universe u v
+
+variable {k k' : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle : Type} {Query : Type u}
+  {Choose : Type → Type v} {spec : OracleSpec.{u, 0} Query} {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- Reindex a tape action, leaving every additional tape and head untouched. -/
+def extendAction (action : Turing.Action k Symbol State) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
+    Turing.Action k' Symbol State where
+  inputTape := action.inputTape
+  workTapes := fun i => match MultiTapeTM.partialInv e i with
+    | some j => action.workTapes j
+    | none => (none, 0)
+  output := action.output
+  state := action.state
+
+/-- Reindex ordinary tapes while retaining communication instructions verbatim. -/
+def Action.extendTapes (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
+    Action k Symbol State Oracle → Action k' Symbol State Oracle
+  | .step action symbol move => .step (extendAction action e) symbol move
+  | .query oracle next => .query oracle next
+
+/-- Run on the tapes selected by `e`, preserving all other tapes and every oracle interaction. -/
+@[simps! initial] def extendTapes [Functor Choose]
+    (machine : MultiTapeMachine k Symbol State Oracle Choose) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
+    MultiTapeMachine k' Symbol State Oracle Choose where
+  initial := machine.initial
+  tr state symbol work answer :=
+    Action.extendTapes e <$> machine.tr state symbol (fun i => work (e i)) answer
+
+/-- Unfold a reindexed transition without unfolding its machine in a recursive continuation. -/
+theorem extendTapes_tr [Functor Choose] (machine : MultiTapeMachine k Symbol State Oracle Choose)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (state : State) (symbol : Option Symbol)
+    (work : Fin k' → Option Symbol) (answer : Oracle → Option Symbol) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).tr state symbol work answer =
+      Action.extendTapes e <$> machine.tr state symbol (fun i => work (e i)) answer := rfl
+
+/-- A source configuration with arbitrary contents and head positions on additional tapes. -/
+def Config.embed (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
+    (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    Config k' Symbol State Oracle input :=
+  { cfg with tapes := MultiTapeTM.embed e cfg.tapes extraTapes extraPos }
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_state (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
+    (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).tapes.state = cfg.tapes.state := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_inputSymbol (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).tapes.inputSymbol = cfg.tapes.inputSymbol := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_workTapeSymbols (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ)
+    (i : Fin k) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).tapes.workTapeSymbols (e i) =
+      cfg.tapes.workTapeSymbols i :=
+  MultiTapeTM.embed_workTapeSymbols_embed e cfg.tapes extraTapes extraPos i
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_channels (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).channels = cfg.channels := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_answerSymbols (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).answerSymbols = cfg.answerSymbols := rfl
+
+@[simp] theorem Config.embed_output (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).tapes.output = cfg.tapes.output := rfl
+
+theorem Config.step_embed (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
+    (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ)
+    (action : Turing.Action k Symbol State) (symbol : Oracle → Option Symbol)
+    (move : Oracle → SignType) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).step (extendAction action e) symbol move =
+      (cfg.step action symbol move).embed e extraTapes extraPos := by
+  refine Config.ext ?_ rfl
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;>
+    simp only [Config.step, Config.embed, extendAction, Turing.Action.apply, MultiTapeTM.embed] <;>
+    cases MultiTapeTM.partialInv e i <;> simp
+
+theorem Config.receive_embed [DecidableEq Oracle] (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ)
+    (oracle : Oracle) (next : State) (answer : List Symbol) :
+    (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos).receive oracle next answer =
+      (cfg.receive oracle next answer).embed e extraTapes extraPos := rfl
+
+variable [Functor Choose] [DecidableEq Oracle]
+  (machine : MultiTapeMachine k Symbol State Oracle Choose) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k')
+  (choose : {α : Type} → Choose α → OracleComp spec α)
+  (hchoose : ∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (choices : Choose α),
+    choose (f <$> choices) = f <$> choose choices)
+  (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+
+include hchoose
+
+/-- Reindexing preserves the entire program, including all unused tape contents and heads. -/
+theorem runConfigFrom_embed (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (fuel : ℕ) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).runConfigFrom choose query fuel (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos) =
+      (fun final => final.embed e extraTapes extraPos) <$>
+        machine.runConfigFrom choose query fuel cfg := by
+  induction fuel generalizing cfg with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ fuel ih =>
+    cases hs : cfg.tapes.state with
+    | none => simp [runConfigFrom, hs]
+    | some state =>
+      simp only [runConfigFrom, Config.embed_state, hs, Config.embed_inputSymbol,
+        Config.embed_workTapeSymbols, Config.embed_answerSymbols, extendTapes_tr, hchoose,
+        bind_map_left, map_bind]
+      congr 1
+      funext action
+      cases action <;> simp [Action.extendTapes, Config.step_embed, Config.receive_embed, ih,
+        map_bind]
+
+/-- The additional work tapes do not affect the observable output program. -/
+theorem runFrom_embed (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input)
+    (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol) (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (fuel : ℕ) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).runFrom choose query fuel (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos) =
+      machine.runFrom choose query fuel cfg := by
+  simp [runFrom, runConfigFrom_embed machine e choose hchoose query, Functor.map_map]
+
+omit hchoose [DecidableEq Oracle] in
+/-- Reserving additional tapes starts them blank, with every work head at zero. -/
+theorem initialConfig_extendTapes (input : List Symbol) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).initialConfig input =
+      (machine.initialConfig input).embed e (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) := by
+  refine Config.ext ?_ rfl
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;>
+    simp only [initialConfig, Cfg.init, Config.embed, MultiTapeTM.embed] <;>
+    cases MultiTapeTM.partialInv e i <;> rfl
+
+/-- Reserving blank scratch tapes preserves the clocked output program. -/
+theorem run_extendTapes (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).run choose query fuel input = machine.run choose query fuel input := by
+  rw [run, initialConfig_extendTapes, runFrom_embed machine e choose hchoose query]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Tape extension preserves a halting bound against every stateful interpreter. -/
+theorem HaltsWithin.extendTapes {fuel : ℕ} {input : List Symbol}
+    (h : machine.HaltsWithin choose query fuel input) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).HaltsWithin choose query fuel input := by
+  intro OracleState oracle s final s' hfinal
+  rw [initialConfig_extendTapes, runConfigFrom_embed machine e choose hchoose query,
+    OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map] at hfinal
+  obtain ⟨⟨cfg, state⟩, hcfg, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
+  exact (congrArg (fun result => result.1.tapes.state) heq).symm.trans
+    (h OracleState oracle s cfg state hcfg)
+
+omit hchoose in
+/-- In the effect-free deterministic case, tape extension is exactly upstream's compiler. -/
+theorem toTM_extendTapes (machine : MultiTapeMachine k Symbol State Empty Id) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).toTM = machine.toTM.extendTapes e := by
+  simp only [toTM, MultiTapeTM.extendTapes, MultiTapeTM.tr_ofTr, extendTapes]
+  congr 1
+  funext state symbol work
+  cases machine.tr state symbol (fun i => work (e i)) Empty.elim with
+  | step action symbol move => rfl
+  | query oracle next => exact oracle.elim
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeMachine

+module
+-- upstream: candidate

+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic
+
+/-!
+# Reserving work tapes for probabilistic machines
+
+The common tape compiler applies to Boolean-indexed choices by naturality of mapping a coin
+program. It preserves the program itself, allowing stateful coin and query interpreters.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.extendTapes`: reindex the source tapes, retaining unused tapes.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom_embed`: preserve the clocked configuration program.
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.runClosed_extendTapes`: preserve the closed fair-coin program.
+
+## References
+
+The common proof in `MultiTape.Machine.ExtendTapes` adapts the cslib `crypto` branch's
+`MultiTape/Oracle/ExtendTapes.lean` at `5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k k' : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle Query : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query}
+  {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- The common tape compiler specialized to Boolean-indexed transitions. -/
+abbrev extendTapes (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle) (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') :
+    MultiTapePTM k' Symbol State Oracle := MultiTapeMachine.extendTapes machine e
+
+/-- Reindexing preserves the entire program and all contents on additional tapes. -/
+theorem runConfigFrom_embed [DecidableEq Oracle] (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (extraTapes : Fin k' → ℤ → Option Symbol)
+    (extraPos : Fin k' → ℤ) (fuel : ℕ) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).runConfigFrom coin query fuel (cfg.embed e extraTapes extraPos) =
+      (fun final => final.embed e extraTapes extraPos) <$>
+        machine.runConfigFrom coin query fuel cfg :=
+  MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_embed machine e (fun choices => choices <$> coin)
+    (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) query cfg extraTapes extraPos fuel
+
+/-- Reserving blank scratch tapes preserves the closed program, before interpretation. -/
+theorem runClosed_extendTapes (machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State)
+    (e : Fin k ↪ Fin k') (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol) :
+    (machine.extendTapes e).runClosed fuel input = machine.runClosed fuel input :=
+  MultiTapeMachine.run_extendTapes machine e
+    (fun choices => choices <$> ProbComp.uniform Bool)
+    (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) Empty.elim fuel input
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

@@ -0,0 +1,224 @@
+/-

+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Clock
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.Deterministic
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.ExtendTapes

+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.PrepareClock
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.ExtendTapesView
+import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Run
+
+/-!
+# Compiling polynomial clocks
+
+A deterministic preparation program writes a unary budget on the last work tape. The common
+tape embedding and sequential compiler then run the common clock consumer. Preparation scratch
+tapes and source tapes are disjoint; all tapes start blank. Every preparation and controller
+instruction is charged to the compiled machine's polynomial bound.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.PolynomialClock.compile`: prepare a budget and consume it.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.PolynomialClock.run_interpret_compile`: retain the joint configuration
+  and private interpreter state, apart from the source's discarded control state.
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.exists_polynomialClock`: a finite-control machine implements the cutoff
+  and halts within a uniform polynomial, against any query interpreter and stateless coin law.
+
+## References
+
+Adapts the role of `MultiTape/Oracle/PolynomialClock.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using functional budget generation and the shared
+machine compilers.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM.PolynomialClock
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k r : ℕ} {State PrepareState Oracle : Type}
+
+/-- Reserve disjoint source and preparation tapes, then run the budget controller. -/
+noncomputable def compile (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State Oracle)
+    (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 1) Bool PrepareState) :
+    MultiTapePTM (k + r + 1) Bool (PrepareState ⊕ Clock.Control State) Oracle :=
+  (ofDeterministic (prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k))).seq
+    (machine.extendTapes (Fin.castAddEmb r)).withClock
+
+/-- A prepared word stays on the last tape when disjoint source tapes are added in front. -/
+theorem embed_budget (input word : List Bool) (state : Option PrepareState) :
+    MultiTapeTM.embed (Fin.natAddEmb k)
+      (wordsCfg input state (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last r) word) [])
+      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) =
+      wordsCfg input state (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last (k + r)) word) [] := by
+  have hlast : (Fin.natAddEmb k) (Fin.last r) = Fin.last (k + r) := by ext; simp
+  have h := MultiTapeTM.embed_wordsCfg (input := input) (q := state) (out := [])
+      (Fin.natAddEmb k) (v := Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last r) word)
+      (ws := fun _ => []) (ws' := Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last (k + r)) word)
+      (fun j => by
+        rw [← hlast]
+        simp only [Function.update_apply, Function.Embedding.apply_eq_iff_eq])
+      (fun i hi => by
+        have hne : i ≠ Fin.last (k + r) := by
+          rintro rfl
+          exact hi ⟨Fin.last r, hlast⟩
+        simp [hne])
+  simp only [tapeOfList_nil] at h
+  exact h
+
+/-- The preparation phase has halted, with only its last work tape nonempty. -/
+def ready (input word : List Bool) : Config (k + r + 1) Bool PrepareState Oracle input where
+  tapes := wordsCfg input none (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last (k + r)) word) []
+
+/-- Handoff supplies precisely the initial source configuration and its prepared budget. -/
+theorem start_ready (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State Oracle) (input word : List Bool) :
+    Sequential.start (machine.extendTapes (Fin.castAddEmb r)).withClock
+      (ready (PrepareState := PrepareState) input word) =
+      Clock.config ((machine.extendTapes (Fin.castAddEmb r)).initialConfig input)
+        (tapeOfList word) 0 false := by
+  refine Config.ext ?_ rfl
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext i <;>
+    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;>
+      simp [Sequential.start, ready, Cfg.withState, wordsCfg, Clock.config, initialConfig, Cfg.init]
+
+/-- The embedded deterministic preparation reaches the exact ready configuration. -/
+theorem prepare_runFrom (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 1) Bool PrepareState)
+    (input word : List Bool) (time : ℕ)
+    (hprepare : prepare.runFrom (prepare.initCfg input) time =
+      wordsCfg input none (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last r) word) []) :
+    (prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k)).runFrom
+      ((prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k)).initCfg input) time =
+      wordsCfg input none (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last (k + r)) word) [] := by
+  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_extendTapes]
+  have hview : MultiTapeTM.viewCfg (Fin.natAddEmb k)
+      ((prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k)).initCfg input) = prepare.initCfg input := rfl
+  rw [hview, hprepare]
+  exact embed_budget input word none
+
+/-- The source data after exhaustion, embedded alongside the consumed budget and halted control. -/
+def finish {input : List Bool} (cfg : Config k Bool State Oracle input) (budget : ℕ) :
+    Config (k + r + 1) Bool (PrepareState ⊕ Clock.Control State) Oracle input :=
+  Sequential.right (Clock.stopped
+    (cfg.embed (Fin.castAddEmb r) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0))
+    (tapeOfList (List.replicate budget true)) budget)
+
+variable {Query OracleState : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query} [DecidableEq Oracle]
+
+/-- Preparing and consuming a budget preserves the entire source data and private interpreter
+state. Both preparation time and every controller instruction are included in the bound. -/
+theorem run_interpret_compile (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State Oracle)
+    (prepare : MultiTapeTM (r + 1) Bool PrepareState)
+    (coin : OracleComp spec Bool) (query : Oracle → List Bool → OracleComp spec (List Bool))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q)) (coinLaw : PMF Bool)
+    (hcoin : ∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s = coinLaw.map (fun bit => (bit, s)))
+    (input : List Bool) (budget time padding : ℕ) (s : OracleState)
+    (hprepare : prepare.runFrom (prepare.initCfg input) time =
+      wordsCfg input none (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last r)
+        (List.replicate budget true)) []) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret oracle ((compile machine prepare).runConfigFrom coin query
+      (time + (2 * budget + 1 + padding)) ((compile machine prepare).initialConfig input))).run s =
+      ((OracleComp.interpret oracle
+        (machine.runConfigFrom coin query budget (machine.initialConfig input))).run s).map
+        (fun (final, s') => (finish final budget, s')) := by
+  let source := machine.extendTapes (Fin.castAddEmb r)
+  let first : MultiTapePTM (k + r + 1) Bool PrepareState Oracle :=
+    ofDeterministic (prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k))
+  have hclock := run_interpret_runConfigFrom_withClock_add source coin query oracle coinLaw hcoin
+    (source.initialConfig input) (tapeOfList (List.replicate budget true)) 0 budget padding s
+    (fun i hi => by simp [tapeOfList_ofNat, hi]) (by simp [tapeOfList_ofNat])
+  simp only [zero_add, MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom] at hclock
+  have hfirst : (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+      (first.runConfigFrom coin query time (first.initialConfig input))).run s =
+      PMF.pure (ready input (List.replicate budget true), s) := by
+    rw [run_interpret_runConfigFrom_ofDeterministic (prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k))
+      coin query oracle coinLaw hcoin]
+    change PMF.pure ({ first.initialConfig input with
+      tapes := (prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k)).runFrom
+        ((prepare.extendTapes (Fin.natAddEmb k)).initCfg input) time }, s) = _
+    rw [prepare_runFrom prepare input (List.replicate budget true) time hprepare]
+    rfl
+  have hseq := MultiTapeMachine.run_interpret_runConfigFrom_seq_pure first source.withClock
+    (fun choices => choices <$> coin) (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) query oracle
+    (first.initialConfig input) (ready input (List.replicate budget true)) time
+    (2 * budget + 1 + padding) s hfirst rfl (by
+      intro final hfinal
+      rw [start_ready, hclock] at hfinal
+      obtain ⟨⟨cfg, state⟩, _, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hfinal
+      exact (congrArg (fun result => result.1.tapes.state) heq).symm)
+  change (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+    ((compile machine prepare).runConfigFrom coin query _ _)).run s = _ at hseq
+  rw [start_ready, hclock] at hseq
+  simp only [source, MultiTapeMachine.initialConfig_extendTapes,
+    MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom_embed machine _ (fun choices => choices <$> coin)
+      (fun _ _ => by rw [Functor.map_map]; rfl) query,
+    OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map,
+    PMF.map_comp] at hseq
+  exact hseq
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM.PolynomialClock
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine PolynomialClock
+open MultiTapeTM (PolyBounded)
+
+/-- A finite-control machine implements a polynomial cutoff uniformly and actually halts.
+Its polynomial charges budget generation, rewinding, and clock consumption. Oracle calls keep their
+abstract instruction cost; no efficiency of an arbitrary supplied query program is asserted. -/
+theorem exists_polynomialClock {k : ℕ} {State Oracle : Type} [Finite State] [DecidableEq Oracle]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State Oracle) (coefficient degree : ℕ) :
+    ∃ (k' : ℕ) (State' : Type) (_ : Finite State') (target : MultiTapePTM k' Bool State' Oracle)
+      (c d : ℕ), ∀ (input : List Bool) (Query OracleState : Type) (spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query)
+      (coin : OracleComp spec Bool) (query : Oracle → List Bool → OracleComp spec (List Bool))
+      (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q)) (coinLaw : PMF Bool),
+      (∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s = coinLaw.map (fun bit => (bit, s))) →
+      ∀ s,
+      (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+        (target.run coin query (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) input)).run s =
+        (OracleComp.interpret oracle (machine.run coin query
+          (coefficient * (input.length + 1) ^ degree) input)).run s ∧
+      ∀ result ∈ ((OracleComp.interpret oracle (target.runConfigFrom coin query
+        (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) (target.initialConfig input))).run s).support,
+        result.1.tapes.state = none := by
+  obtain ⟨r, PrepareState, hfinite, prepare, cp, dp, hprepare⟩ :=
+    MultiTapeTM.PolynomialClock.exists_prepare coefficient degree
+  have hb : PolyBounded List.length
+      (fun input : List Bool => coefficient * (input.length + 1) ^ degree) :=
+    ⟨coefficient, degree, fun _ => le_rfl⟩
+  have hp : PolyBounded List.length (fun input : List Bool => cp * (input.length + 1) ^ dp) :=
+    ⟨cp, dp, fun _ => le_rfl⟩
+  obtain ⟨c, d, hbound⟩ := hp.add (((PolyBounded.const 2).mul hb).add (PolyBounded.const 1))
+  refine ⟨k + r + 1, PrepareState ⊕ Clock.Control State, inferInstance, compile machine prepare,
+    c, d, fun input Query OracleState spec coin query oracle coinLaw hcoin s => ?_⟩
+  let budget := coefficient * (input.length + 1) ^ degree
+  let time := cp * (input.length + 1) ^ dp
+  let padding := c * (input.length + 1) ^ d - (time + (2 * budget + 1))
+  have htime : time + (2 * budget + 1 + padding) = c * (input.length + 1) ^ d := by
+    have := hbound input
+    dsimp only [time, budget, padding]
+    lia
+  have hrun := run_interpret_compile machine prepare coin query oracle coinLaw hcoin input budget
+    time padding s (hprepare input)
+  rw [htime] at hrun
+  constructor
+  · have hout := congrArg (PMF.map (fun result => (result.1.tapes.output, result.2))) hrun
+    simpa only [run, runFrom, OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map, PMF.monad_map_eq_map,
+      PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, finish, Sequential.right, Cfg.mapState,
+      Clock.stopped_output, Config.embed_output] using hout
+  · intro result hresult
+    rw [hrun] at hresult
+    obtain ⟨⟨cfg, state⟩, _, heq⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hresult
+    exact (congrArg (fun result => result.1.tapes.state) heq).symm
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM

+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.PPT
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic.PolynomialClock
+
+/-!
+# Intrinsically halting PPT realizations
+
+Every strict clocked PPT certificate admits a finite machine that actually halts in polynomial
+time with the same output distribution. The clock compiler starts with blank tapes and charges
+preparation of its unary budget. Its bound and finite control are uniform over all inputs.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.exists_halting_clock`: compile a polynomial cutoff under fair-coin semantics.
+* `Cslib.Probability.IsPPTOn.exists_halting_machine`: choose an intrinsically halting PPT witness.
+
+## References
+
+Adapts `Computability/Probabilistic/Clock.lean` on the cslib `crypto` branch at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, using the common machine compilers and existing
+tidy functional budget generation.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib
+
+/-- A polynomial cutoff can be implemented by a finite machine that halts under fair-coin
+semantics, with one polynomial bound on all inputs and every supported execution. -/
+theorem exists_halting_clock {k : ℕ} {State : Type} [Finite State]
+    (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State) (coefficient degree : ℕ) :
+    ∃ (k' : ℕ) (State' : Type) (_ : Finite State') (target : MultiTapePTM k' Bool State')
+      (c d : ℕ), ∀ input,
+      ProbComp.eval (target.runClosed (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) input) =
+        ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed (coefficient * (input.length + 1) ^ degree) input) ∧
+      ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval (target.runConfigFrom (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+        (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) (target.initialConfig input))).support,
+        final.tapes.state = none := by
+  obtain ⟨k', State', hfinite, target, c, d, htarget⟩ :=
+    machine.exists_polynomialClock coefficient degree
+  refine ⟨k', State', hfinite, target, c, d, fun input => ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨hout, hhalt⟩ := htarget input ℕ Unit unifSpec (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+    (fun q (s : Unit) => (fun a => (a, s)) <$> ProbComp.unifOracle q)
+    (Probability.PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool)
+    (fun s => by
+      rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless]
+      exact congrArg (PMF.map (fun bit => (bit, s))) (ProbComp.eval_uniform Bool)) ()
+  simp only [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless] at hout
+  constructor
+  · have h := congrArg (PMF.map Prod.fst) hout
+    simp only [PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.map_comp] at h
+    change PMF.map id _ = PMF.map id _ at h
+    simp only [PMF.map_id] at h
+    exact h
+  · intro final hfinal
+    apply hhalt (final, ())
+    rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless, PMF.monad_map_eq_map]
+    exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨final, hfinal, rfl⟩
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+namespace Cslib.Probability
+
+/-- Replace a strict clocked certificate by an intrinsically halting finite realization.
+The new machine and bound are fixed before choosing an input. It halts on every raw word,
+including words outside the declared input encoding. -/
+theorem IsPPTOn.exists_halting_machine {α β : Type} {input : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {output : β ↪ List Bool} {program : α → ProbComp β} (h : IsPPTOn input output program) :
+    ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : Turing.MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+      (c d : ℕ),
+      (∀ a, (ProbComp.eval (program a)).map output =
+        ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed (c * ((input a).length + 1) ^ d) (input a))) ∧
+      ∀ word,
+      ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval (machine.runConfigFrom (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+        (c * (word.length + 1) ^ d) (machine.initialConfig word))).support,
+        final.tapes.state = none := by
+  obtain ⟨k, State, hfinite, machine, c, d, hmachine⟩ := h
+  obtain ⟨k', State', hfinite', target, c', d', htarget⟩ := machine.exists_halting_clock c d
+  exact ⟨k', State', hfinite', target, c', d',
+    fun a => (hmachine a).trans (htarget (input a)).1.symm, fun word => (htarget word).2⟩
+
+end Cslib.Probability

+import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.PPT.Clock
+import Complexity.Computability.Probabilistic.Sampling
+
+/-! End-to-end clock compilation from blank tapes, with genuinely nonhalting sources. -/
+
+namespace ComplexityTests.PolynomialClock
+
+open Cslib Turing MultiTapeMachine MultiTapePTM.PolynomialClock
+
+private def emitForever : MultiTapePTM 1 Bool Unit where
+  initial := ()
+  tr _ _ _ _ coin := .step
+    { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun _ => (some coin, 1), output := some coin, state := some () }
+    Empty.elim Empty.elim
+
+private noncomputable def prepareOne : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool Unit := MultiTapeTM.ofTr ()
+  fun _ _ _ =>
+    { inputTape := 0
+      workTapes := fun _ => (some true, 0)
+      output := none
+      state := none }
+
+private theorem prepareOne_ready (input : List Bool) :
+    prepareOne.runFrom (prepareOne.initCfg input) 1 =
+      wordsCfg input none (Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last 0) [true]) [] := by
+  simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom, Function.iterate_one]
+  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_state (by rfl)]
+  simp only [prepareOne, MultiTapeTM.tr_ofTr]
+  refine Cfg.ext rfl (by simp [Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.init, wordsCfg]) ?_ ?_
+    (by simp [Turing.Action.apply, Cfg.init, wordsCfg])
+  · funext i z
+    fin_cases i
+    simp only [Turing.Action.apply, wordsCfg,
+      tapeOfList, Function.update_apply]
+    cases z with
+    | ofNat n =>
+      cases n with
+      | zero => simp
+      | succ n => simp [show (n : ℤ) + 1 ≠ 0 by lia]
+    | negSucc n => simp
+  · funext i
+    rfl
+
+-- The source never halts: even after a hundred emitted bits its control state is still active.
+example : ((OracleComp.interpret (fun _ : Unit => (pure () : Id Unit))
+    (emitForever.runConfigFrom (spec := fun _ : Unit => Unit) (pure true) Empty.elim 100
+      (emitForever.initialConfig []))).tapes.state) = some () := by rfl
+
+-- A single-cell budget is prepared from blank tapes; every larger clock gives the same halted run.
+example (input : List Bool) (padding : ℕ) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret (fun _ : Unit => (pure () : StateT ℕ PMF Unit))
+      ((compile emitForever prepareOne).runConfigFrom
+        (spec := fun _ : Unit => Unit) (pure true) Empty.elim (4 + padding)
+        ((compile emitForever prepareOne).initialConfig input))).run 9 =
+      PMF.pure (finish (r := 0) (PrepareState := Unit)
+        ((emitForever.initialConfig input).step
+          { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun _ => (some true, 1),
+            output := some true, state := some () } Empty.elim Empty.elim) 1, 9) := by
+  have h := run_interpret_compile emitForever prepareOne (pure true) Empty.elim
+    (fun _ : Unit => (pure () : StateT ℕ PMF Unit)) (PMF.pure true) (fun _ => by simp)
+    input 1 1 padding 9 (prepareOne_ready input)
+  simpa [← Nat.add_assoc, MultiTapePTM.runConfigFrom, MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom,
+    emitForever, initialConfig, Cfg.init] using h
+
+-- The uniform finite compiler applies to a nonhalting source and a quadratic input-size budget.
+example : ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+    (c d : ℕ), ∀ input,
+    ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) input) =
+      ProbComp.eval (emitForever.runClosed (3 * (input.length + 1) ^ 2) input) ∧
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval (machine.runConfigFrom (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+      (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) (machine.initialConfig input))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none := emitForever.exists_halting_clock 3 2
+
+-- A functional random program obtains a witness that also halts on malformed encoded inputs.
+example : ∃ (k : ℕ) (State : Type) (_ : Finite State) (machine : MultiTapePTM k Bool State)
+    (c d : ℕ),
+    (∀ bit : Bool, (ProbComp.eval (ProbComp.uniform Bool)).map MultiTapeTM.encBool =
+      ProbComp.eval (machine.runClosed (c * ((MultiTapeTM.encBool bit).length + 1) ^ d)
+        (MultiTapeTM.encBool bit))) ∧
+    ∀ input,
+    ∀ final ∈ (ProbComp.eval (machine.runConfigFrom (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+      (c * (input.length + 1) ^ d) (machine.initialConfig input))).support,
+      final.tapes.state = none :=
+  (show Probability.IsPPTOn MultiTapeTM.encBool MultiTapeTM.encBool
+    (fun _ => ProbComp.uniform Bool) by fun_prop).exists_halting_machine
+
+end ComplexityTests.PolynomialClock

index 00000000..454e5a73

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 Samuel Schlesinger. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger
+-/
+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Probabilistic
+
+/-!
+# Deterministic machines inside probabilistic programs
+
+The embedding ignores each coin and never submits a query. With a stateless coin interpretation,
+it preserves the entire communication state and every oracle's private state. The number of
+instructions, ordinary tapes and output agree exactly with the upstream deterministic run.
+
+Adapted from the cslib `crypto` branch's `Oracle/Deterministic.lean` at
+`5ff69ca93402e7c947208dc56396d6d86203ccd8`, for the common machine and typed program interface.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.ofDeterministic`: repeat the deterministic action on both coin branches.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.run_interpret_ofDeterministic`: preserve joint output and private state.
+* `Turing.MultiTapePTM.eval_runClosed_ofDeterministic`: the closed deterministic run distribution.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapePTM
+
+open Cslib MultiTapeMachine
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State Oracle Query OracleState : Type} {spec : OracleSpec.{0, 0} Query}
+  {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- Ignore the coin and oracle channels, retaining the deterministic states and ordinary tapes. -/
+noncomputable def ofDeterministic (machine : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) :
+    MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle where
+  initial := machine.q₀
+  tr state symbol work _ _ := .step (machine.tr state symbol work) (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
+
+/-- A deterministic embedding leaves all channels and the oracle's private state unchanged.
+The coin may have any fixed distribution, provided drawing it has no effect on private state. -/
+theorem run_interpret_runConfigFrom_ofDeterministic [DecidableEq Oracle]
+    (machine : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q)) (coinLaw : PMF Bool)
+    (hcoin : ∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s = coinLaw.map (fun bit => (bit, s)))
+    (fuel : ℕ) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (s : OracleState) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+      ((ofDeterministic machine).runConfigFrom coin query fuel cfg)).run s =
+      PMF.pure ({ cfg with tapes := machine.runFrom cfg.tapes fuel }, s) := by
+  change (OracleComp.interpret oracle
+    (MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom _ _ _ _ _)).run s = _
+  have htr : (ofDeterministic machine : MultiTapePTM k Symbol State Oracle).tr =
+      fun state symbol work _ _ =>
+        .step (machine.tr state symbol work) (fun _ => none) (fun _ => 0) := rfl
+  induction fuel generalizing cfg with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ fuel ih =>
+    cases hs : cfg.tapes.state with
+    | none =>
+      have hh : machine.runFrom cfg.tapes (fuel + 1) = cfg.tapes :=
+        Function.iterate_fixed (MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hs) _
+      simp [MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, hs, hh]
+    | some state =>
+      simp only [MultiTapeMachine.runConfigFrom, hs, htr, bind_map_left,
+        OracleComp.interpret_bind, StateT.run_bind, hcoin,
+        Probability.PMF.monad_bind_eq_bind, PMF.bind_map, Function.comp_def, PMF.bind_const]
+      rw [ih]
+      congr 1
+      simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
+      rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_state hs]
+      simp [Config.step]
+
+/-- The output of a deterministic embedding agrees with upstream and leaves private state intact. -/
+theorem run_interpret_ofDeterministic [DecidableEq Oracle]
+    (machine : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (coin : OracleComp spec Bool)
+    (query : Oracle → List Symbol → OracleComp spec (List Symbol))
+    (oracle : (q : Query) → StateT OracleState PMF (spec q)) (coinLaw : PMF Bool)
+    (hcoin : ∀ s, (OracleComp.interpret oracle coin).run s = coinLaw.map (fun bit => (bit, s)))
+    (fuel : ℕ) (cfg : Config k Symbol State Oracle input) (s : OracleState) :
+    (OracleComp.interpret oracle ((ofDeterministic machine).runFrom coin query fuel cfg)).run s =
+      PMF.pure ((machine.runFrom cfg.tapes fuel).output, s) := by
+  simp [runFrom, OracleComp.interpret_map, StateT.run_map,
+    run_interpret_runConfigFrom_ofDeterministic machine coin query oracle coinLaw hcoin]
+
+/-- Closed fair-coin execution of a deterministic embedding has a point-mass output distribution. -/
+theorem eval_runClosed_ofDeterministic (machine : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
+    (fuel : ℕ) (input : List Symbol) :
+    ProbComp.eval ((ofDeterministic machine).runClosed fuel input) =
+      PMF.pure (machine.runFrom (machine.initCfg input) fuel).output := by
+  have h := run_interpret_ofDeterministic machine (ProbComp.uniform Bool) Empty.elim
+    (fun q (s : Unit) => (fun a => (a, s)) <$> ProbComp.unifOracle q)
+    (Probability.PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool)
+    (fun s => by
+      rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless]
+      exact congrArg (PMF.map (fun bit => (bit, s))) (ProbComp.eval_uniform Bool)) fuel
+    ((ofDeterministic machine).initialConfig input) ()
+  rw [OracleComp.run_interpret_stateless] at h
+  have hout := congrArg (PMF.map Prod.fst) h
+  rw [PMF.monad_map_eq_map, PMF.map_comp, PMF.pure_map] at hout
+  change PMF.map id _ = _ at hout
+  rw [PMF.map_id] at hout
+  exact hout
+
+end Turing.MultiTapePTM
