+/-!
+# Case distinction
+
+If `c`, `f` and `g` are tidily computable from a common input, so is
+`fun x => if c x then f x else g x`, within the bounds of `c` plus those of the branch taken.
+
+`iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂` runs `tmc` with its output written to a new work tape, runs `tm₁` if that word
+is non-empty and `tm₂` otherwise (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.branch`), and clears the tape. The condition
+`c` may be computed with any encoding of `Bool`: a finite-state transducer turns its output into a
+word that is empty exactly for `false`.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.iteTM`: the machine for a case distinction.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite`: the machine-level case distinction.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite`: case distinctions are tidily computable;
+  each branch need only be computable on the inputs where it is taken.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k₀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ} {Symbol S₀ S₁ S₂ : Type*}
+
+/-- Run `tmc` with its output on a new last work tape, then `tm₁` if that word is non-empty and
+`tm₂` otherwise, and clear the tape. All three machines are padded to `max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)` work
+tapes. -/
+public noncomputable def iteTM (tmc : MultiTapeTM k₀ Symbol S₀) (tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁)
+    (tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂) : MultiTapeTM (max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 1) Symbol
+      ((S₀ ⊕ RewindWorkState) ⊕ Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂) ⊕ Unit ⊕ RewindWorkState) :=
+  (tmc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left _ _))).outputToWord.seq
+    ((branch (Fin.last _)
+        ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
+          (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+        ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
+          (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)).seq
+      ((clearWork Symbol).extendTapes (tapeEmb (Fin.last _))))
+
+namespace Ite
+
+/-- A tidy machine, padded to `K` work tapes and placed below a last work tape that holds `w`
+throughout. -/
+lemma transformsTapes_padded {k K : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ K) {S : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S}
+    {x w y : List Symbol} {t s : ℕ} (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t s) :
+    TransformsTapes ((tm.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb hk)).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w)
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      t (s + (K - k) + (K + 1 - K)) := by
+  refine (TransformsTapes.extendTapes (h.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb hk)) Fin.castSuccEmb).imp
+    (fun _ ws ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, ?_⟩)
+    (fun _ ws ws' _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨⟨hv, he⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨?_, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  · subst hws
+    funext j
+    simp [Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
+  · funext l
+    induction l using Fin.lastCases with
+    | last => rw [hx _ fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j hj, hws]
+    | cast j =>
+      rw [show ws' j.castSucc = _ from congrFun hv j]
+      simp [Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
+
+end Ite
+
+open Ite in
+/-- If `tmc` computes `w` from `x` tidily, `tm₁` computes `y` from `x` tidily when `w` is non-empty
+and `tm₂` does when `w` is empty, then `iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂` computes `y` from `x` tidily, within the
+bounds of `tmc` plus those of the machine that runs. -/
+public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite {tmc : MultiTapeTM k₀ Symbol S₀}
+    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k₁ Symbol S₁} {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k₂ Symbol S₂} {x w y : List Symbol}
+    {tc sc t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ} (hc : tmc.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x w tc sc)
+    (h₁ : w ≠ [] → tm₁.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₁ s₁)
+    (h₂ : w = [] → tm₂.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y t₂ s₂) :
+    (iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x y
+      (tc + (if w = [] then t₂ else t₁) + 4 * w.length + 6)
+      (sc + (if w = [] then s₂ else s₁) + 3 * w.length + 5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂) + 10) := by
+  set K := max k₀ (max k₁ k₂)
+  -- phase 1: the test word on the last tape
+  have hp₁ := (hc.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb (le_max_left k₀ (max k₁ k₂)))).outputToWord
+  -- phase 2: the branch, with the machine that does not run specified vacuously
+  have hM₁ : TransformsTapes ((tm₁.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_left k₁ k₂).trans
+        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
+        ws (Fin.last K) ≠ [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      (if w = [] then 0 else t₁) (if w = [] then 0 else s₁ + (K - k₁) + (K + 1 - K)) := by
+    split_ifs with hw
+    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hne⟩
+      simp [hw] at hne
+    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₁ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
+        le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hM₂ : TransformsTapes ((tm₂.extendTapes (Fin.castLEEmb ((le_max_right k₁ k₂).trans
+        (le_max_right k₀ _)))).extendTapes Fin.castSuccEmb)
+      (fun inp ws => (inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w) ∧
+        ws (Fin.last K) = [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' e => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last K) w ∧ e = y)
+      (if w = [] then t₂ else 0) (if w = [] then s₂ + (K - k₂) + (K + 1 - K) else 0) := by
+    split_ifs with hw
+    · exact (transformsTapes_padded _ (h₂ hw)).imp (fun _ _ h => h.1) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h)
+        le_rfl le_rfl
+    · rintro _ _ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, he⟩
+      simp [hw] at he
+  have hp₂ := transformsTapes_branch (Fin.last K) hM₁ hM₂
+  -- phase 3: clear the last tape
+  have hp₃ := transformsTapes_clearWork_only (Symbol := Symbol) (Fin.last K) w
+  refine (transformsTapes_seq hp₁ (hp₂.seq_eq hp₃) fun _ _ _ _ hP hQ => ⟨hP.1, hQ.1⟩).imp
+    (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨hws, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨hws, by simp⟩
+  · split_ifs <;> omega
+  · split_ifs <;> omega
+
+/-- The test word of a condition: empty exactly for `false`. -/
+def encTest : Bool ↪ List Bool :=
+  ⟨fun b => if b then [true] else [], fun a b h => by cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all⟩
+
+@[simp] lemma encTest_true : encTest true = [true] := rfl
+@[simp] lemma encTest_false : encTest false = [] := rfl
+
+/-- Emits `[true]` on the word `w` and nothing on every other word. Its state is the rest of `w`
+still to be read, or `none` once the input differs from `w`. -/
+@[simps step final]
+def eqWordT (w : List Bool) : Transducer Bool (Option {v // v ∈ w.tails}) where
+  q₀ := some ⟨w, (List.mem_tails _ _).mpr (List.suffix_refl w)⟩
+  step q a := match q with
+    | some ⟨b :: v, h⟩ =>
+      (if a = b then some ⟨v, (List.mem_tails _ _).mpr ((List.suffix_cons b v).trans
+        ((List.mem_tails _ _).mp h))⟩ else none, [])
+    | _ => (none, [])
+  final q := if q.map Subtype.val = some [] then [true] else []
+  length_step_le q a := by rcases q with _ | ⟨_ | _, _⟩ <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by split_ifs <;> simp
+
+@[simp]
+lemma eqWordT_run_none (w u : List Bool) : (eqWordT w).run none u = [] := by
+  induction u <;> simp [*]
+
+lemma eqWordT_run (w : List Bool) (u : List Bool) (v : {v // v ∈ w.tails}) :
+    (eqWordT w).run (some v) u = if u = v.1 then [true] else [] := by
+  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := v
+  induction u generalizing v with
+  | nil => cases v <;> simp
+  | cons a u ih =>
+    rcases v with _ | ⟨b, v⟩
+    · simp
+    · by_cases hab : a = b <;> simp [hab, ih]
+
+lemma eqWordT_run_q₀ (w u : List Bool) :
+    (eqWordT w).run (eqWordT w).q₀ u = if u = w then [true] else [] :=
+  eqWordT_run w u _
+
+/-- A function tidily computable on all inputs is tidily computable on the inputs satisfying `p`, by
+the same machine. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.restrict {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {t s : α → ℕ}
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut t s) (p : α → Prop) :
+    ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val) ((Function.Embedding.subtype p).trans encIn)
+      encOut (t ∘ Subtype.val) (s ∘ Subtype.val) :=
+  let ⟨k, S, hS, tm, htm⟩ := h
+  ⟨k, S, hS, tm, fun x => htm x⟩
+
+/-- Case distinctions are tidily computable: if `c` is tidily computable, `f` on the inputs where
+`c` holds and `g` on the others, then `fun x => if c x then f x else g x` is tidily computable,
+within the bounds of `c` plus those of the branch taken, up to a constant. The condition may be
+computed with any encoding of `Bool`. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite {γ β : Type*} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
+    {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {c : γ → Bool} {f g : γ → β}
+    {tc sc tf sf tg sg : γ → ℕ}
+    (hc : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace c encIn encC tc sc)
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encOut (tf ∘ Subtype.val)
+      (sf ∘ Subtype.val))
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (g ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encOut (tg ∘ Subtype.val)
+      (sg ∘ Subtype.val)) :
+    ∃ k, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encOut
+      (fun x => tc x + (if c x then tf x else tg x) + k)
+      (fun x => sc x + (if c x then sf x else sg x) + k) := by
+  -- the test word of the condition, in time bounded by the longer encoding of a truth value
+  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, ∀ b, (encC b).length ≤ l :=
+    ⟨(encC true).length + (encC false).length, fun b => by cases b <;> omega⟩
+  have htest := (eqWordT (encC true)).computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace (f := id) (encIn := encC)
+    (encOut := encTest) fun b => by rw [eqWordT_run_q₀]; cases b <;> simp
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨ct, hct⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear htest hc
+  have hb (x : γ) : 4 * (encC (c x)).length + 8 + ct * ((encC (c x)).length + 1) ≤
+      (ct + 4) * (l + 2) := by
+    have := hl (c x)
+    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ct this
+    simp only [Nat.mul_add_one, Nat.add_mul]; omega
+  obtain ⟨k₀, S₀, _, tmc, htmc⟩ := hct.mono (t' := fun x => tc x + (ct + 4) * (l + 2))
+    (s' := fun x => sc x + (ct + 4) * (l + 2)) (fun x => by have := hb x; omega)
+    (fun x => by have := hb x; omega)
+  obtain ⟨k₁, S₁, _, tm₁, htm₁⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨k₂, S₂, _, tm₂, htm₂⟩ := hg
+  refine ⟨(ct + 4) * (l + 2) + 15 + 5 * max k₀ (max k₁ k₂), _, _, inferInstance,
+    iteTM tmc tm₁ tm₂, fun x => ?_⟩
+  have h := (htmc x).ite (tm₁ := tm₁) (tm₂ := tm₂) (y := encOut (if c x then f x else g x))
+    (t₁ := tf x) (s₁ := sf x) (t₂ := tg x) (s₂ := sg x)
+    (fun hw => by
+      have hcx : c x = true := by cases hcx : c x <;> simp_all
+      simpa [hcx] using htm₁ ⟨x, hcx⟩)
+    (fun hw => by
+      have hcx : c x = false := by cases hcx : c x <;> simp_all
+      simpa [hcx] using htm₂ ⟨x, hcx⟩)
+  refine TransformsTapes.mono h ?_ ?_ <;> cases hcx : c x <;> simp [hcx] <;> omega
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Multi-pass streaming folds
+
+A multi-pass fold reads its input several times, from left to right, keeping a state on a work tape
+between the passes. A pass is a streaming loop over the tokens of the input, followed by an end
+round that computes the state for the next pass, and a flag on a separate tape that says whether
+another pass follows. Like a streaming fold, it never copies the input.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.passTM`: one pass.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.multiPassTM`: the passes, between the initial state and the final emission.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapes_passTM`: the specification of a pass.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.computesTidily_multiPassTM`: the passes compute tidily.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {K : ℕ} {Q SI SE SN SEe SNe SC SF SP : Type*} {r : InputReader Bool Q}
+  {I : MultiTapeTM K Bool SI} {E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE} {Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN}
+  {Ee : MultiTapeTM K Bool SEe} {Ne : MultiTapeTM K Bool SNe} {Cm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SC}
+  {Fm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SF} {V N F C : Fin K}
+
+/-- One pass: clear the flag tape `C`, run the streaming loop with the rounds `E`, `Nm`, run the
+end round `Ee`, `Ne` with the input head frozen, write the flag with `Cm` and rewind the input. -/
+public noncomputable def passTM (r : InputReader Bool Q) (E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE)
+    (Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN) (Ee : MultiTapeTM K Bool SEe) (Ne : MultiTapeTM K Bool SNe)
+    (Cm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SC) (V N F C : Fin K) (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) :=
+  ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb C)).seq
+    ((whileInput (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)).seq
+      ((frozenRound Ee Ne V N F hVN hVF hNF).freezeInput.seq
+        (Cm.freezeInput.seq (rewindInputOn K Bool))))
+
+/-- The multi-pass fold: write the initial state to tape `V` with `I`, run passes until the flag
+tape `C` is blank, emit from the final state with `Fm` and clear tape `V`. -/
+public noncomputable def multiPassTM (I : MultiTapeTM K Bool SI) (pass : MultiTapeTM K Bool SP)
+    (Fm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SF) (V C : Fin K) :=
+  I.seq ((repeatUntilBlank C pass).seq (Fm.seq ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))))
+
+/-- The tapes between two passes: the state `v` on tape `V` and the flag `c` on tape `C`. -/
+@[expose] public def passTapes (V C : Fin K) (v c : List Bool) : Fin K → List Bool :=
+  Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => []) V v) C c
+
+lemma passTapes_nil (hVC : V ≠ C) (v : List Bool) :
+    passTapes V C v [] = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v := by
+  funext l
+  by_cases hl : l = C
+  · subst hl; simp [passTapes, hVC.symm]
+  · simp [passTapes, hl]
+
+/-- **A pass.** If the streaming loop takes the state `vs 0` on tape `V` to `vs toks.length`,
+emitting the words `es j`, the end round emits `ee` and computes the next state `v'`, and `Cm`
+writes the flag `c'` from it, then a pass takes the state `vs 0` and any flag `c` to `v'` and the
+flag `c'`. -/
+public theorem transformsTapes_passTM (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) (hVC : V ≠ C)
+    (toks : List (List Bool)) (htoks : ∀ t ∈ toks, t ≠ []) (cont vs es : ℕ → List Bool)
+    (ee v' c c' : List Bool) {sR tEe sEe tNe sNe tC sC : ℕ} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ → ℕ}

+    (hE : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes E
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = es j) (tE j) (sE j))
+    (hN : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes Nm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N (vs (j + 1)) ∧ em = []) (tN j) (sN j))
+    (hsR : ∀ j < toks.length, (vs j ++ cont j).length + 2 + (K - 1) +
+        (sE j + (sN j + (((vs j ++ cont j).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * (vs (j + 1)).length + K + 15) +
+          ((vs (j + 1)).length + 1 + K))))) ≤ sR)
+    (hEe : TransformsTapes Ee (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = ee) tEe sEe)
+    (hNe : TransformsTapes Ne (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N v' ∧ em = []) tNe sNe)
+    (hC : TransformsTapes Cm (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v')
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws C c' ∧ em = []) tC sC) :
+    TransformsTapes (passTM r E Nm Ee Ne Cm V N F C hVN hVF hNF)
+      (fun inp ws => inp = toks.flatten ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs 0) c)
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = passTapes V C v' c' ∧
+        em = ((List.range toks.length).map es).flatten ++ ee)
+      (3 * (c.length + 1) +
+        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range toks.length, (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN j + 1) + 1) +
+        ((tEe + (tNe + (3 * ((vs toks.length).length + 1) + ((3 * v'.length + 10) +

+      (c.length + 1 + K + ((2 * K * sR + K) +
+        ((sEe + (sNe + (((vs toks.length).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * v'.length + K + 15) +
+          (v'.length + 1 + K))))) + (sC + K)))) := by
+  set x := toks.flatten with hx
+  have hclear := ((transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb C c).imp
+    (P' := fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs 0) c)
+    (Q' := fun inp _ ws' em => inp = x ∧ ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0) ∧ em = [])
+    (fun _ _ ⟨_, h⟩ => by simp [h, passTapes])
+    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, h⟩ ⟨h', he⟩ => ⟨hin, by rw [h', h, passTapes, Function.update_idem,
+      ← passTapes, passTapes_nil hVC], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl).transformsTapesAt
+  have hloop := transformsTapesAt_streamLoop (r := r) hVN hVF hNF toks htoks cont vs es hread
+    hE hN hsR
+  have hend := (transformsTapes_frozenRound hVN hVF hNF hEe hNe).freezeInput.imp
+    (P' := fun inp _ ws => inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+    (fun _ _ _ h => h.2) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => h) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hflag := hC.freezeInput.imp
+    (P' := fun inp _ ws => inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v')
+    (Q' := fun inp _ _ _ ws' em => inp = x ∧ ws' = passTapes V C v' c' ∧ em = [])
+    (fun _ _ _ h => h.2) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, h⟩ ⟨_, h', he⟩ => ⟨hin, by rw [h', h]; rfl, he⟩)
+    le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hrw := transformsTapesAt_seq hflag (transformsTapesAt_rewindInput (k := K) x)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ h _ => h.1)
+  have h₃ := transformsTapesAt_seq hend hrw fun _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _⟩ ⟨_, h, _⟩ => ⟨hin, h⟩
+  have h₂ := transformsTapesAt_seq hloop h₃ fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _, h, _⟩ => ⟨hin, h⟩
+  have h₁ := transformsTapesAt_seq hclear h₂
+    fun _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hp, _⟩ ⟨hp', hin, h, _⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hp'], h⟩
+  refine (h₁.transformsTapes ?_).imp (fun _ _ h => ⟨rfl, h⟩) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨_, _, _, _, -,
+      ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨hp, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩
+    exact hp
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, -, -, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, -, -, -, rfl⟩,
+      ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, -, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, h, rfl⟩, ⟨-, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨h, by simp⟩
+
+/-- **The multi-pass fold.** If `I` writes the initial state `vs 0` to tape `V`, each pass `i`
+takes the state `vs i` and the flag `cs i` to the state `vs (i + 1)` and the flag `cs (i + 1)`,
+emitting `es i`, where the flag is blank at the start and exactly after the last pass `passes`, and
+`Fm` emits `ef` from the final state, then `multiPassTM` emits the words `es i` followed by `ef`,
+tidily. -/
+public theorem computesTidily_multiPassTM {pass : MultiTapeTM K Bool SP} (hVC : V ≠ C)
+    (x : List Bool) (passes : ℕ) (vs cs es : ℕ → List Bool) (ef : List Bool)
+    {tI sI tP sP tF sF : ℕ}
+    (hI : TransformsTapes I (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0) ∧ em = []) tI sI)
+    (hpass : ∀ i ≤ passes, TransformsTapes pass
+      (fun inp ws => inp = x ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs i) (cs i))
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = passTapes V C (vs (i + 1)) (cs (i + 1)) ∧ em = es i) tP sP)
+    (hfirst : cs 0 = []) (hcs : ∀ i < passes, cs (i + 1) ≠ []) (hlast : cs (passes + 1) = [])
+    (hF : TransformsTapes Fm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = ef) tF sF) :
+    (multiPassTM I pass Fm V C).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace x
+      (((List.range (passes + 1)).map es).flatten ++ ef)
+      (tI + ((passes + 1) * (tP + 1) + (tF + 3 * ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1))))
+      (sI + ((2 * K * sP + K) + (sF + ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1 + K)))) := by
+  let P (n : ℕ) (inp : List Bool) (ws : Fin K → List Bool) (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
+    inp = x ∧ ws = passTapes V C (vs n) (cs n) ∧ em = ((List.range n).map es).flatten
+  have hround : ∀ n < passes, ∀ acc, TransformsTapes pass (fun inp ws => P n inp ws acc)
+      (fun inp _ ws' e => P (n + 1) inp ws' (acc ++ e) ∧ ws' C ≠ []) tP sP := by
+    -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+    refine fun n hn acc => transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr ?_
+    rintro inp ws out ⟨hin, hws, rfl⟩
+    obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hsp⟩ :=
+      transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp (hpass n hn.le) inp ws out ⟨hin, hws⟩
+    refine ⟨ws', _, hrun, ⟨⟨hin, h, by simp [List.range_succ]⟩, ?_⟩, hsp⟩
+    simpa [h, passTapes] using hcs n hn
+  let R (inp : List Bool) (ws : Fin K → List Bool) (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
+    inp = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)) ∧
+      em = ((List.range (passes + 1)).map es).flatten
+  have hstop : ∀ acc, TransformsTapes pass (fun inp ws => P passes inp ws acc)
+      (fun inp _ ws' e => R inp ws' (acc ++ e) ∧ ws' C = []) tP sP := by
+    -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+    refine fun acc => transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr ?_
+    rintro inp ws out ⟨hin, hws, rfl⟩
+    obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hsp⟩ :=
+      transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp (hpass passes le_rfl) inp ws out ⟨hin, hws⟩
+    refine ⟨ws', _, hrun, ⟨⟨hin, by rw [h, hlast, passTapes_nil hVC], by simp [List.range_succ]⟩,
+      ?_⟩, hsp⟩
+    simp [h, passTapes, hlast]
+  have hloop := transformsTapes_repeatUntilBlank C hround hstop
+  have hclear : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs (passes + 1)))
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ em = [])
+      (3 * ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1)) ((vs (passes + 1)).length + 1 + K) :=
+    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V (vs (passes + 1))).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h])
+      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; simp, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hfin := (hF.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl
+    le_rfl).seq_eq hclear
+  have hmain := transformsTapes_seq hloop hfin fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h.2.1
+  refine (transformsTapes_seq hI hmain fun _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _⟩ ⟨h, _⟩ =>
+    ⟨hin, by rw [h, hfirst, passTapes_nil hVC], rfl⟩).imp (fun _ _ h => h) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
+  rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, ⟨-, -, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+  simp
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+-- upstream: vendored crei:crei/tidy-universal @7f7c0696 (unsubmitted)

+/-!
+# Streaming folds
+
+A streaming fold reads its input once, from left to right, one token at a time. It keeps a state
+on a work tape; for each token it appends the token's content to the state, computes the next
+state from the result and emits a word to the output. The input is never copied, so a round costs
+time and space in the size of the state and the token only.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.frozenRound`: the part of a round that does not use the input.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapes.extendTapes_update`: a specification that writes one word,
+  on the tapes selected by an embedding.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapes_frozenRound`: the specification of `frozenRound`.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {m K : ℕ} {Symbol S : Type*}
+
+/-! ### Specifications on selected tapes -/
+
+/-- A specification that starts with the word `w` on tape `i` and every other tape blank and writes
+`out` to tape `o`, on the tapes selected by `e`. -/
+public theorem TransformsTapes.extendTapes_update {tm : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S}
+    {I : List Symbol → Prop} {i o : Fin m} {w out y : List Symbol} {t s : ℕ}
+    (h : TransformsTapes tm (fun inp ws => I inp ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) i w)
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws o out ∧ em = y) t s) (e : Fin m ↪ Fin K) :
+    TransformsTapes (tm.extendTapes e)
+      (fun inp ws => I inp ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (e i) w)
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws (e o) out ∧ em = y) t (s + (K - m)) := by
+  refine (h.extendTapes e).imp (fun _ ws ⟨hI, hws⟩ => ⟨hI, ?_⟩)
+    (fun _ ws ws' _ _ ⟨⟨hv, hy⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨?_, hy⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  · subst hws
+    funext j
+    by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [e.injective.eq_iff, hj]
+  · funext l
+    by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
+    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hl
+      have := congrFun hv j
+      by_cases hj : j = o <;> simp_all [Function.update_apply, e.injective.eq_iff]
+    · rw [hx l hl, Function.update_of_ne fun h => hl ⟨o, h.symm⟩]
+
+/-- An embedding of `Fin m` into a larger `Fin K` sending `i` to `a`. -/
+public theorem exists_embedding_eq (h : m ≤ K) (i : Fin m) (a : Fin K) :
+    ∃ e : Fin m ↪ Fin K, e i = a :=
+  ⟨(Fin.castLEEmb h).trans (Equiv.swap (Fin.castLE h i) a).toEmbedding, by simp⟩
+
+/-- An embedding of `Fin m` into a larger `Fin K` sending `i` to `a` and `o` to `b`. -/
+public theorem exists_embedding_eq₂ (h : m ≤ K) {i o : Fin m} (hio : i ≠ o) {a b : Fin K}
+    (hab : a ≠ b) : ∃ e : Fin m ↪ Fin K, e i = a ∧ e o = b := by
+  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_embedding_eq h i a
+  refine ⟨e.trans (Equiv.swap (e o) b).toEmbedding, ?_, by simp⟩
+  have hoa : e o ≠ a := fun h => hio (e.injective (h.trans he.symm)).symm
+  simp [he, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hoa.symm hab]
+
+/-- The work tapes in which `inputFromWord` starts and halts, for a tidy machine. -/
+lemma append_nil_eq_update {k : ℕ} (w : List Symbol) :
+    Fin.append (fun _ : Fin k => ([] : List Symbol)) ![w, []] =
+      Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.natAdd k 0) w := by
+  rw [← Fin.append_const (m := k) (n := 2) [], ← Fin.append_update_right]
+  congr 1
+  simp [funext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two]
+
+/-- A tidy machine run on the word on a work tape, emitting what it computes. -/
+public theorem ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace.inputFromWord {k : ℕ} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S}
+    (mark : Symbol) {w y : List Symbol} {t s : ℕ} (h : tm.ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace w y t s) :
+    TransformsTapes (tm.inputFromWord mark)
+      (fun _ ws => True ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.natAdd k 0) w)
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws (Fin.natAdd k 0) w ∧ em = y)
+      -- vendored: `+ 8` rather than crei's `+ 6`, as cslib #1111's `inputFromWord` uses two more
+      -- cells
+      (t + 4) (s + 2 * (w.length + 2) + 2 * k + 8) := by
+  -- vendored: `computesTidily_iff` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+  obtain ⟨hrun, hspace⟩ := computesTidily_iff_runFrom.mp h
+  refine (transformsTapes_inputFromWord_of_runFrom mark hrun hspace).imp
+    (fun _ ws ⟨_, hws⟩ => by rw [hws, append_nil_eq_update])
+    (fun _ ws ws' _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨hws', hy⟩ => ⟨?_, hy⟩) le_rfl (by omega)
+  rw [hws', hws, append_nil_eq_update, Function.update_idem]
+
+/-! ### The part of a round that does not use the input -/
+
+section Frozen
+
+variable {SE SN : Type*} {E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE} {Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN}
+  {V N F : Fin K}
+
+/-- The three tapes `V`, `N`, `F` of `copyWord`: target, source and flag. -/
+public def threeTapes (V N F : Fin K) (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) :
+    Fin (0 + 1 + 2) ↪ Fin K :=
+  ⟨![V, N, F], by intro a b h; fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all [eq_comm]⟩
+
+/-- Emit with `E` from the word on tape `V`, write the next state to tape `N` with `Nm`, and move
+it to tape `V`, using tape `F` to flag the left end of the word. -/
+public noncomputable def frozenRound (E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE) (Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN)
+    (V N F : Fin K) (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) :=
+  E.seq (Nm.seq (((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V)).seq
+    ((copyWord (threeTapes V N F hVN hVF hNF) true).seq
+      ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb N)))))
+
+open Sequential in
+/-- `frozenRound` takes the word `w` on tape `V` and every other tape blank to `next` on tape `V`
+and every other tape blank, emitting `emit`, if `E` emits `emit` from `w` and `Nm` writes `next`
+to tape `N`. -/
+public theorem transformsTapes_frozenRound (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
+    {w emit next : List Bool} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ}
+    (hE : TransformsTapes E (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = emit) tE sE)
+    (hN : TransformsTapes Nm (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N next ∧ em = []) tN sN) :
+    TransformsTapes (frozenRound E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V w)
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next ∧ em = emit)
+      (tE + (tN + (3 * (w.length + 1) + ((3 * next.length + 10) + 3 * (next.length + 1)))))
+      (sE + (sN + ((w.length + 1 + K) + ((4 * next.length + K + 15) +
+        (next.length + 1 + K))))) := by
+  set W₀ := Function.update (fun _ => ([] : List Bool)) V w
+  set W₁ := Function.update W₀ N next
+  set W₂ := Function.update W₁ V []
+  set W₃ := Function.update W₂ V next
+  have hW₄ : Function.update W₃ N [] = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next := by
+    funext l
+    simp only [W₃, W₂, W₁, W₀, Function.update_apply]
+    split_ifs <;> simp_all
+  have h₀ : TransformsTapes E (fun _ ws => ws = W₀) (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₀ ∧ em = emit)
+      tE sE := hE.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have h₁ : TransformsTapes Nm (fun _ ws => ws = W₀) (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₁ ∧ em = [])
+      tN sN := hN.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws], he⟩)
+      le_rfl le_rfl
+  have h₂ : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V)) (fun _ ws => ws = W₁)
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₂ ∧ em = []) (3 * (w.length + 1)) (w.length + 1 + K) :=
+    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V w).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h, W₁, W₀, hVN])
+      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have h₃ := (transformsTapes_copyWord (threeTapes V N F hVN hVF hNF) true next).imp
+    (P' := fun _ ws => ws = W₂) (Q' := fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = W₃ ∧ em = [])
+    (fun _ _ h => by
+      subst h
+      change W₂ N = next ∧ W₂ V = [] ∧ W₂ F = []
+      simp [W₂, W₁, W₀, hVN.symm, hVF.symm, hNF.symm])
+    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; rfl, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have h₄ : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb N)) (fun _ ws => ws = W₃)
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next ∧ em = [])
+      (3 * (next.length + 1)) (next.length + 1 + K) :=
+    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb N next).imp
+      (fun _ _ h => by simp [h, W₃, W₂, W₁, hVN.symm])
+      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws, hW₄], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  refine (h₀.seq_eq (h₁.seq_eq (h₂.seq_eq (h₃.seq_eq h₄)))).imp (fun _ _ h => h)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h, by simp [he]⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+
+end Frozen
+
+/-! ### Rounds and the whole machine -/
+
+section Stream
+
+variable {Q SI SE SN SF : Type*} {r : InputReader Bool Q} {I : MultiTapeTM K Bool SI}
+  {E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE} {Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN} {Fm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SF}
+  {V N F : Fin K}
+
+/-- One round: append the content of the next token to the state on tape `V`, then run
+`frozenRound` with the input head frozen. -/
+public noncomputable def streamRound (r : InputReader Bool Q) (E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE)
+    (Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN) (V N F : Fin K) (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) :=
+  (appendRead r V).seq (frozenRound E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF).freezeInput
+
+/-- The streaming fold: write the initial state to tape `V` with `I`, run rounds while there is
+input left, emit from the final state with `Fm`, clear tape `V` and rewind the input. -/
+public noncomputable def streamTM (r : InputReader Bool Q) (I : MultiTapeTM K Bool SI)
+    (E : MultiTapeTM K Bool SE) (Nm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SN) (Fm : MultiTapeTM K Bool SF)
+    (V N F : Fin K) (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F) :=
+  I.seq ((whileInput (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)).seq
+    ((Fm.seq ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))).freezeInput.seq (rewindInputOn K Bool)))
+
+/-- One round at the input position `p₀` of `x`, on the state `v`: if `E` emits `emit` from the
+state with the token's content appended and `Nm` computes `next` from it, the round leaves `next`
+on tape `V`, emits `emit` and moves the input head over the token. -/
+public theorem transformsTapesAt_streamRound (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
+    (x : List Bool) (p₀ : Fin (x.length + 2)) (hp₀ : p₀.val ≠ 0) (v : List Bool)
+    {emit next : List Bool} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ}
+    (hE : TransformsTapes E
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V
+        (v ++ (r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1))).1))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = emit) tE sE)
+    (hN : TransformsTapes Nm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V
+        (v ++ (r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1))).1))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N next ∧ em = []) tN sN) :
+    let rd := r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1))
+    TransformsTapesAt (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)
+      (fun input p ws => input = x ∧ p.val = p₀.val ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v)
+      (fun _ _ _ p' ws' em => p'.val = p₀.val + rd.2 ∧
+        ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V next ∧ em = emit)
+      (v.length + 1 + ((rd.2 + 1) + ((v ++ rd.1).length + 2)) +
+        (tE + (tN + (3 * ((v ++ rd.1).length + 1) + ((3 * next.length + 10) +
+          3 * (next.length + 1))))))
+      ((v ++ rd.1).length + 2 + (K - 1) +
+        (sE + (sN + (((v ++ rd.1).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * next.length + K + 15) +
+          (next.length + 1 + K)))))) := by
+  intro rd
+  have hread := (transformsTapesAt_appendRead r V x p₀ hp₀ v).imp
+    (P' := fun input p ws => input = x ∧ p.val = p₀.val ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V v)
+    (fun _ _ ws ⟨hx, hp, hws⟩ => ⟨hx, hp, by simp [hws]⟩) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => h) le_rfl le_rfl
+  refine (transformsTapesAt_seq hread
+    (transformsTapes_frozenRound hVN hVF hNF hE hN).freezeInput ?_).imp
+    (fun _ _ _ h => h) ?_ le_rfl le_rfl
+  · rintro _ _ ws _ _ _ ⟨-, -, hws⟩ ⟨-, hws', -⟩
+    rw [hws', hws, Function.update_idem]
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨hp, -, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, hws, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    exact ⟨hp, hws, rfl⟩
+
+/-- The input position after the first `j` tokens. -/
+public lemma streamPos_lt (toks : List (List Bool)) (j : ℕ) :
+    1 + ((toks.take j).flatten).length < toks.flatten.length + 2 := by
+  have := (List.take_sublist j toks).flatten.length_le
+  omega
+
+public lemma drop_flatten_take (toks : List (List Bool)) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < toks.length) :
+    toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length =
+      toks[j] ++ (toks.drop (j + 1)).flatten := by
+  calc toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length
+      = ((toks.take j).flatten ++ (toks.drop j).flatten).drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length := by
+        rw [← List.flatten_append, List.take_append_drop]
+    _ = (toks.drop j).flatten := List.drop_left
+    _ = toks[j] ++ (toks.drop (j + 1)).flatten := by
+        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj, List.flatten_cons]
+
+public lemma length_flatten_take_succ (toks : List (List Bool)) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < toks.length) :
+    ((toks.take (j + 1)).flatten).length = ((toks.take j).flatten).length + toks[j].length := by
+  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hj, List.flatten_append, List.length_append]
+  simp
+
+/-- The time of round `j` of the streaming loop. -/
+@[expose] public def streamRoundTime (toks : List (List Bool)) (cont vs : ℕ → List Bool)
+    (tE tN : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  (vs j).length + 1 + ((toks[j]?.getD []).length + 1 + ((vs j ++ cont j).length + 2)) +
+    (tE j + (tN j + (3 * ((vs j ++ cont j).length + 1) + ((3 * (vs (j + 1)).length + 10) +
+      3 * ((vs (j + 1)).length + 1)))))
+
+/-- **The streaming loop.** The input `x` is the concatenation of the non-empty tokens `toks`, from
+each of which the reader `r` reads the content `cont j`. If for every token `j` the machine `E`
+emits `es j` and `Nm` computes the next state `vs (j + 1)` from the state `vs j` followed by
+`cont j`, then the loop of rounds, started on the state `vs 0` at the start of the input, leaves
+the final state on tape `V`, emits the words `es j` and stops at the end of the input. -/
+public theorem transformsTapesAt_streamLoop (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
+    (toks : List (List Bool)) (htoks : ∀ t ∈ toks, t ≠ []) (cont vs es : ℕ → List Bool)
+    {sR : ℕ} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hread : ∀ j (hj : j < toks.length),
+      r.read r.q₀ (toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length) = (cont j, toks[j].length))
+    (hE : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes E
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = es j) (tE j) (sE j))
+    (hN : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes Nm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N (vs (j + 1)) ∧ em = []) (tN j) (sN j))
+    (hsR : ∀ j < toks.length, (vs j ++ cont j).length + 2 + (K - 1) +
+        (sE j + (sN j + (((vs j ++ cont j).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * (vs (j + 1)).length + K + 15) +
+          ((vs (j + 1)).length + 1 + K))))) ≤ sR) :
+    TransformsTapesAt (whileInput (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF))
+      (fun input p ws => input = toks.flatten ∧ p.val = 1 ∧
+        ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0))
+      (fun input _ _ p' ws' em => input = toks.flatten ∧ p'.val = 1 + toks.flatten.length ∧
+        ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length) ∧
+        em = ((List.range toks.length).map es).flatten)
+      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range toks.length, (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN j + 1) + 1)
+      (2 * K * sR + K) := by
+  set x := toks.flatten with hx
+  let L (j : ℕ) : ℕ := ((toks.take j).flatten).length
+  let P (n : ℕ) (input : List Bool) (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (ws : Fin K → List Bool)
+      (em : List Bool) : Prop :=
+    input = x ∧ p.val = 1 + L n ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs n) ∧
+      em = ((List.range n).map es).flatten
+  have hround : ∀ n < toks.length, ∀ acc, TransformsTapesAt (streamRound r E Nm V N F hVN hVF hNF)
+      (fun input p ws => P n input p ws acc)
+      (fun input _ _ p' ws' e => P (n + 1) input p' ws' (acc ++ e))
+      (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN n) sR := by
+    intro n hn acc
+    let p₀ : Fin (x.length + 2) := ⟨1 + L n, streamPos_lt toks n⟩
+    have hrd : r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1)) = (cont n, toks[n].length) := by
+      simpa [p₀, L] using hread n hn
+    have h := transformsTapesAt_streamRound (r := r) hVN hVF hNF x p₀ (by simp [p₀]) (vs n)
+      (hE := by rw [hrd]; exact hE n hn) (hN := by rw [hrd]; exact hN n hn)
+    simp only [hrd] at h
+    refine h.imp (fun _ _ _ ⟨hin, hp, hws, _⟩ => ⟨hin, hp, hws⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_
+    · rintro _ _ _ p' ws' em ⟨rfl, -, -, rfl⟩ ⟨hp', hws', rfl⟩
+      refine ⟨rfl, ?_, hws', by simp [List.range_succ]⟩
+      rw [hp']
+      change (1 + ((toks.take n).flatten).length) + toks[n].length =
+        1 + ((toks.take (n + 1)).flatten).length
+      rw [length_flatten_take_succ toks hn]
+      omega
+    · simp [streamRoundTime, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hn]
+    · exact hsR n hn
+  have hmore : ∀ n < toks.length, ∀ input p ws em, P n input p ws em →
+      inputSymbolAt input p ≠ none := by
+    rintro n hn input p ws em ⟨rfl, hp, -, -⟩
+    have hlt : ((toks.take n).flatten).length < x.length := by
+      have h₁ := length_flatten_take_succ toks hn
+      have h₂ := streamPos_lt toks (n + 1)
+      have : 0 < toks[n].length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (htoks _ (List.getElem_mem hn))
+      have : x.length = toks.flatten.length := rfl
+      omega
+    simp only [inputSymbolAt, hp, L]
+    split_ifs
+    · omega
+    · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
+      simp
+  have hL : L toks.length = x.length := by simp only [L, List.take_length]; rfl
+  refine (transformsTapesAt_whileInput hround hmore
+    (R := fun input p ws em => P toks.length input p ws em)
+    (fun input p ws em h => ⟨by
+      obtain ⟨rfl, hp, -, -⟩ := h
+      simp [inputSymbolAt, hp, hL], h⟩)).imp
+    (fun _ _ _ ⟨hin, hp, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hp, L], hws, rfl⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, hp, hws, he⟩ => ⟨hin, hp.trans (by rw [hL]), hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+
+/-- **The streaming fold on words.** The input `x` is the concatenation of the non-empty tokens
+`toks`, from each of which the reader `r` reads the content `cont j`. If `I` writes the initial
+state `vs 0` to tape `V`, and for every token `j` the machine `E` emits `es j` and `Nm` computes
+the next state `vs (j + 1)` from the state `vs j` followed by `cont j`, and `Fm` emits `ef` from
+the final state, then `streamTM` emits the words `es j` followed by `ef`, tidily. -/
+public theorem computesTidily_streamTM (hVN : V ≠ N) (hVF : V ≠ F) (hNF : N ≠ F)
+    (toks : List (List Bool)) (htoks : ∀ t ∈ toks, t ≠ []) (cont vs es : ℕ → List Bool)
+    (ef : List Bool) {tI sI tF sF sR : ℕ} {tE sE tN sN : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hread : ∀ j (hj : j < toks.length),
+      r.read r.q₀ (toks.flatten.drop ((toks.take j).flatten).length) = (cont j, toks[j].length))
+    (hI : TransformsTapes I (fun inp ws => inp = toks.flatten ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs 0) ∧ em = []) tI sI)
+    (hE : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes E
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = es j) (tE j) (sE j))
+    (hN : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes Nm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs j ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N (vs (j + 1)) ∧ em = []) (tN j) (sN j))
+    (hF : TransformsTapes Fm (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = ef) tF sF)
+    (hsR : ∀ j < toks.length, (vs j ++ cont j).length + 2 + (K - 1) +
+        (sE j + (sN j + (((vs j ++ cont j).length + 1 + K) + ((4 * (vs (j + 1)).length + K + 15) +
+          ((vs (j + 1)).length + 1 + K))))) ≤ sR) :
+    (streamTM r I E Nm Fm V N F hVN hVF hNF).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace toks.flatten
+      (((List.range toks.length).map es).flatten ++ ef)
+      (tI + ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range toks.length, (streamRoundTime toks cont vs tE tN j + 1)) + 1) +
+        ((tF + 3 * ((vs toks.length).length + 1)) + (toks.flatten.length + 2)))
+      (sI + ((2 * K * sR + K) + ((sF + ((vs toks.length).length + 1 + K)) + K))) := by
+  set x := toks.flatten with hx
+  have hloop := transformsTapesAt_streamLoop (r := r) hVN hVF hNF toks htoks cont vs es hread
+    hE hN hsR
+  -- emitting from the final state and clearing it, with the input head frozen
+  have hF' : TransformsTapes Fm
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length) ∧ em = ef)
+      tF sF :=
+    hF.imp (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨h.trans hws, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hclear : TransformsTapes ((clearWork Bool).extendTapes (tapeEmb V))
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = (fun _ => []) ∧ em = [])
+      (3 * ((vs toks.length).length + 1)) ((vs toks.length).length + 1 + K) :=
+    (transformsTapes_clearWork_tapeEmb V (vs toks.length)).imp (fun _ _ h => by simp [h])
+      (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws]; simp, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hfin := (hF'.seq_eq hclear).freezeInput.imp
+    (P' := fun input _ ws => input = x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (vs toks.length))
+    (fun _ _ _ h => h.2) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => h) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hend := transformsTapesAt_seq hfin (transformsTapesAt_rewindInput (k := K) x)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ h _ => h.1)
+  have hmain := transformsTapesAt_seq hloop hend
+    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hin, _, hws, _⟩ => ⟨hin, hws⟩)
+  have hall := transformsTapesAt_seq hI.transformsTapesAt hmain
+    (fun _ _ _ p' _ _ ⟨_, hin, _⟩ ⟨hp', hws', he⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hp'], hws'⟩)
+  refine (hall.transformsTapes ?_).imp (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨rfl, hin, hws⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨_, _, _, _, -, ⟨hp, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩, -⟩
+    exact hp
+  · rintro _ _ _ _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, -, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, -, -, rfl⟩,
+      ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨-, rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨-, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+    simp
+  · omega
+  · omega
+
+end Stream
+

+/-!
+# Finite-state transducers
+
+A finite-state transducer reads its input once from left to right. In state `q`, on the symbol
+`a`, it moves to state `(τ.step q a).1` and emits the word `(τ.step q a).2`; at the end of the
+input it emits `τ.final q`. Every emitted word has length at most two.
+
+`τ.toTM` runs a transducer as a Turing machine without work tapes, so every function computed by a
+transducer is tidily computable in linear time and zero space.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Transducer`: finite-state transducers.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Transducer.run`: the word a transducer emits on a word.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Transducer.toTM`: the transducer as a machine without work tapes.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Transducer.computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM`: `τ.toTM` emits `τ.run τ.q₀ w` on
+  `w` within `2 * w.length + 3` steps and zero space.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Transducer.computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace`: a function computed by a
+  transducer with finitely many states is tidily computable in linear time and zero space.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-- A finite-state transducer with input and output alphabet `Symbol` and states `Q`. In state `q`
+on the symbol `a` it moves to `(step q a).1` and emits `(step q a).2`; at the end of the input it
+emits `final q`. -/
+public structure Transducer (Symbol Q : Type*) where
+  /-- The initial state. -/
+  q₀ : Q
+  /-- The successor state and the emitted word on reading a symbol. -/
+  step : Q → Symbol → Q × List Symbol
+  /-- The word emitted at the end of the input. -/
+  final : Q → List Symbol
+  /-- At most two symbols are emitted per input symbol. -/
+  length_step_le : ∀ q a, (step q a).2.length ≤ 2
+  /-- At most two symbols are emitted at the end of the input. -/
+  length_final_le : ∀ q, (final q).length ≤ 2
+
+namespace Transducer
+
+variable {Symbol Q : Type*} (τ : Transducer Symbol Q)
+
+/-- The word `τ` emits on `w`, started in state `q`. -/
+@[expose] public def run : Q → List Symbol → List Symbol
+  | q, [] => τ.final q
+  | q, a :: w => (τ.step q a).2 ++ run (τ.step q a).1 w
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma run_nil (q : Q) : τ.run q [] = τ.final q := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma run_cons (q : Q) (a : Symbol) (w : List Symbol) :
+    τ.run q (a :: w) = (τ.step q a).2 ++ τ.run (τ.step q a).1 w := rfl
+
+/-- `τ` as a machine without work tapes. Its states are the states of `τ`, a pending output
+symbol, and whether the end of the input has been reached. -/
+public def toTM : MultiTapeTM 0 Symbol (Q × Option Symbol × Bool) :=
+  ofTr (τ.q₀, none, false) fun st inp _ =>
+    match st with
+    | (q, some b, fin) =>
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := some b, state := some (q, none, fin) }
+    | (_, none, true) =>
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := none, state := none }
+    | (q, none, false) =>
+      match inp with
+      | some a =>
+        { inputTape := 1, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := (τ.step q a).2.head?,
+          state := some ((τ.step q a).1, (τ.step q a).2.tail.head?, false) }
+      | none =>
+        { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.elim0, output := (τ.final q).head?,
+          state := some (q, (τ.final q).tail.head?, true) }
+
+/-- A word of length at most two is its head followed by the head of its tail. -/
+lemma toList_head?_append {w : List Symbol} (h : w.length ≤ 2) :
+    w.head?.toList ++ w.tail.head?.toList = w := by
+  match w, h with
+  | [], _ => rfl
+  | [_], _ => rfl
+  | [_, _], _ => rfl
+
+variable {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- The configuration of `τ.toTM` in state `st` with the input head at `pos`, having emitted `o`. -/
+def cfg (input : List Symbol) (st : Option (Q × Option Symbol × Bool))
+    (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    Cfg 0 Symbol (Q × Option Symbol × Bool) input :=
+  ⟨st, pos, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, o⟩
+
+/-- A pending symbol is emitted. -/
+lemma step_pending (q : Q) (b : Symbol) (fin : Bool) (pos : Fin (input.length + 2))
+    (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, some b, fin)) pos o) = cfg input (some (q, none, fin)) pos
+      (o ++ [b]) := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- After the end of the input, the machine halts. -/
+lemma step_halt (q : Q) (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, true)) pos o) = cfg input none pos o := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- Flushing a possibly pending symbol takes at most one step. -/
+lemma exists_runFrom_flush (q : Q) (p : Option Symbol) (fin : Bool)
+    (pos : Fin (input.length + 2)) (o : List Symbol) :
+    ∃ u ≤ 1, τ.toTM.runFrom (cfg input (some (q, p, fin)) pos o) u =
+      cfg input (some (q, none, fin)) pos (o ++ p.toList) := by
+  cases p with
+  | none => exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, by simp [runFrom]⟩
+  | some b => exact ⟨1, le_rfl, by simp [runFrom, step_pending]⟩
+
+/-- Reading the input symbol at position `i`. -/
+lemma step_read (q : Q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < input.length) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o) =
+      cfg input (some ((τ.step q input[i]).1, (τ.step q input[i]).2.tail.head?, false))
+        ⟨i + 1 + 1, by omega⟩ (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2.head?.toList) := by
+  have hsym : (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o).inputSymbol =
+      some input[i] := inputSymbolInner i (by simp only [cfg]; omega) hi
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, hsym]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes (by simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]) ?_
+    (by simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply])
+  simp only [cfg, toTM, tr_ofTr, Action.apply]
+  exact moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp only; omega)
+
+/-- Reaching the end of the input. -/
+lemma step_end (q : Q) (o : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.step (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ o) =
+      cfg input (some (q, (τ.final q).tail.head?, true)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩
+        (o ++ (τ.final q).head?.toList) := by
+  have hsym : (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ o).inputSymbol =
+      none := inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inr rfl)
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, hsym]
+  refine Cfg.ext_zero_tapes ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [cfg, toTM, Action.apply]
+
+/-- From input position `i` on, the machine halts within `2 * (input.length - i) + 3` steps,
+having emitted what `τ` emits on the rest of the input. -/
+lemma exists_runFrom_halt (q : Q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ input.length) (o : List Symbol) :
+    ∃ u ≤ 2 * (input.length - i) + 3, ∃ pos,
+      τ.toTM.runFrom (cfg input (some (q, none, false)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ o) u =
+        cfg input none pos (o ++ τ.run q (input.drop i)) := by
+  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, input.length - i = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  induction n generalizing i q o with
+  | zero =>
+    obtain rfl : i = input.length := by omega
+    obtain ⟨u, hu, hflush⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_flush (input := input) q (τ.final q).tail.head?
+      true ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩ (o ++ (τ.final q).head?.toList)
+    refine ⟨1 + u + 1, by omega, ⟨input.length + 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
+    rw [runFrom_add, runFrom_add, runFrom_one, runFrom_one, step_end, hflush, step_halt]
+    rw [List.drop_length, run_nil, List.append_assoc, toList_head?_append (τ.length_final_le q)]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    have hi' : i < input.length := by omega
+    obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁, hflush⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_flush (input := input) (τ.step q input[i]).1
+      (τ.step q input[i]).2.tail.head? false ⟨i + 1 + 1, by omega⟩
+      (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2.head?.toList)
+    obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂, pos, hrest⟩ := ih (τ.step q input[i]).1 (i := i + 1) (by omega)
+      (o ++ (τ.step q input[i]).2) (by omega)
+    refine ⟨1 + u₁ + u₂, by omega, pos, ?_⟩
+    rw [runFrom_add, runFrom_add, runFrom_one, step_read _ _ hi', hflush,
+      List.append_assoc, toList_head?_append (τ.length_step_le _ _), hrest,
+      List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi', run_cons, List.append_assoc]
+
+/-- `τ.toTM` emits `τ.run τ.q₀ input` on `input`, in `2 * input.length + 3` steps and zero
+space. -/
+public theorem computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM (input : List Symbol) :
+    τ.toTM.ComputesInTimeAndSpace input (τ.run τ.q₀ input) (2 * input.length + 3) 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨u, hu, pos, hrun⟩ := τ.exists_runFrom_halt τ.q₀ (Nat.zero_le input.length) []
+  have hinit : τ.toTM.initCfg input = cfg input (some (τ.q₀, none, false)) ⟨0 + 1, by omega⟩ [] :=
+    Cfg.ext_zero_tapes rfl (Fin.ext (by simp [MultiTapeNTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, cfg])) rfl
+  rw [← hinit, List.drop_zero, List.nil_append] at hrun
+  have hhalt : (τ.toTM.runFrom (τ.toTM.initCfg input) u).Halted := by
+    rw [hrun]
+    rfl
+  refine ⟨⟨u, hhalt, by rw [hrun]; rfl⟩, runsInTime_iff_halted.mpr ?_, by simp⟩
+  rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ (by omega : u ≤ 2 * input.length + 3) hhalt]
+  exact hhalt
+
+/-- Followed by a rewind of the input head, `τ.toTM` emits `τ.run τ.q₀ input` tidily. -/
+public theorem computesTidily (input : List Symbol) :
+    (τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Symbol)).ComputesTidilyInTimeAndSpace input (τ.run τ.q₀ input)
+      (4 * input.length + 8) 0 :=
+  TransformsTapes.mono (τ.computesInTimeAndSpace_toTM input).computesTidily_seq_rewindInput
+    (by omega) le_rfl
+
+/-- A function computed by a transducer with finitely many states is tidily computable in linear
+time and zero space. -/
+public theorem computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace {Q : Type} [Finite Q] (τ : Transducer Bool Q)
+    {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β}
+    (hf : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = τ.run τ.q₀ (encIn a)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut (fun a => 4 * (encIn a).length + 8)
+      (fun _ => 0) :=
+  ⟨0, _, inferInstance, τ.toTM.seq (rewindInput Bool), fun a =>
+    hf a ▸ τ.computesTidily (encIn a)⟩
+
+end Transducer

+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Addition and multiplication with bounds of given degrees
+
+Natural numbers are encoded in binary (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.encNat`). Addition is a left fold over
+the digits of the first summand that keeps the carry, the rest of the digits of the second summand
+and the digits of the sum so far; at the end the carry is added to the rest of the second summand.
+Multiplication is a left fold over the digits of the first factor that keeps the product so far and
+the second factor shifted by the digits read, adding the shifted factor for every digit `1`.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableTidilyInDegree_add`: addition in quadratic time and space.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.computableTidilyInDegree_mul`: multiplication in cubic time and space.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM

+open NatSucc

+namespace NatAdd

+/-- The binary digits of `2 * n + b`, if they do not end in a zero. -/
+lemma bits_bit (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) (h : n = 0 → b = true) :
+    (2 * n + b.toNat).bits = b :: n.bits := by
+  rw [← Nat.bit_val]
+  exact Nat.bits_append_bit n b h
+
+/-- The carry of adding three digits. -/
+def carry (a b c : Bool) : Bool := a && b || c && (a ^^ b)
+
+/-- Adds the digits `l` and `r` with the carry `c`, least significant first; `r` is padded with
+zeros. -/
+def addBits : Bool → List Bool → List Bool → List Bool
+  | c, [], r => incr c r
+  | c, a :: l, r => (a ^^ (r.headD false ^^ c)) :: addBits (carry a (r.headD false) c) l r.tail
+
+lemma incr_bits (c : Bool) (n : ℕ) : incr c n.bits = (n + c.toNat).bits := by
+  cases c
+  · simp [incr]
+  · exact (bits_succ n).symm
+
+lemma addBits_bits (c : Bool) (m n : ℕ) : addBits c m.bits n.bits = (m + n + c.toNat).bits := by
+  induction m using Nat.binaryRec' generalizing c n with
+  | zero => simp [addBits, incr_bits]
+  | bit a m hm ih =>
+    rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ hm, addBits]
+    induction n using Nat.binaryRec' with
+    | zero =>
+      have h := ih (carry a false c) 0
+      rw [Nat.zero_bits] at h
+      rw [Nat.zero_bits, List.headD_nil, List.tail_nil, h, Nat.bit_val,
+        show 2 * m + a.toNat + 0 + c.toNat = 2 * (m + 0 + (carry a false c).toNat) +
+          (a ^^ (false ^^ c)).toNat by cases a <;> cases c <;> simp [carry]; omega,
+        bits_bit]
+      cases a <;> cases c <;> simp_all [carry]
+    | bit b n hn _ =>
+      rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ hn, List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, ih, Nat.bit_val,
+        Nat.bit_val, show 2 * m + a.toNat + (2 * n + b.toNat) + c.toNat =
+          2 * (m + n + (carry a b c).toNat) + (a ^^ (b ^^ c)).toNat by
+          cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp [carry] <;> omega, bits_bit]
+      cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all [carry]
+
+/-- One round: add the digit `a`, the next digit of the rest `r` and the carry `c`. -/
+def addStep (s : Bool × List Bool × List Bool) (a : Bool) : Bool × List Bool × List Bool :=
+  (carry a (s.2.1.headD false) s.1, s.2.1.tail, s.2.2 ++ [a ^^ (s.2.1.headD false ^^ s.1)])
+
+lemma foldl_addStep (l : List Bool) (c : Bool) (r out : List Bool) :
+    let s := l.foldl addStep (c, r, out)
+    out ++ addBits c l r = s.2.2 ++ incr s.1 s.2.1 := by
+  induction l generalizing c r out with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons a l ih => simp [addBits, ← ih, addStep]
+
+lemma length_foldl_addStep (l : List Bool) (s : Bool × List Bool × List Bool) :
+    (l.foldl addStep s).2.1.length ≤ s.2.1.length ∧
+      (l.foldl addStep s).2.2.length = s.2.2.length + l.length := by
+  induction l generalizing s with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih (addStep s a)
+    exact ⟨h₁.trans (by simp [addStep]), h₂.trans (by simp [addStep]; omega)⟩
+
+end NatAdd

+open NatAdd ComputableTidilyInDegree

+/-- **Addition is tidily computable in quadratic time and space**, in the binary encoding. -/

+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2) (encPair encNat encNat) encNat 2 1 := by
+  let encS := encPair encBool (encPair encBits encBits)

+    have hcarry := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))

+    have hdigit := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool))
+      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool => t.1 ^^ (t.2.1 ^^ t.2.2)).comp habc
+    exact (hcarry.prod ((tail (enc₁ := encBool)).comp hr |>.prod
+      (hs.snd'.snd'.append hdigit (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl))).mono
+  have hsize : DegreeBounded (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (encPair encNat encNat p).length)
+      (fun p => 2 * (encPair encNat encNat p).length + 4) 1 :=
+    (DegreeBounded.self.smul 2).add_const 4
+  -- the first fold, over the digits of the first summand
+  have hfold := foldl' (encL := encBits) (encB := encS)
+    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.bits) (init := fun p => (false, p.2.bits, []))

+  · intro p i hi
+    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := length_foldl_addStep (p.1.bits.take i) (false, p.2.bits, [])
+    simp only [encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encBits_apply,

+    omega

+    refine ((of_linear linear_succFinish).comp (foldl' (encL := encBits) (encB := encAcc)

+      (of_linear linear_succStep) (B := fun s => (encS s).length + 3)
+      (DegreeBounded.self.add_const 3) fun s i hi => ?_)).mono
+    simp only [length_foldl_succStep, encS, length_encPair, encBool_apply, id_eq,
+      List.length_singleton, encBits_apply, List.length_take]

+namespace NatMul
+
+/-- One round: add the shifted factor `s.2` to the product `s.1` if the digit `a` is `1`, and shift
+the factor. -/
+def mulStep (s : ℕ × ℕ) (a : Bool) : ℕ × ℕ := (if a then s.1 + s.2 else s.1, s.2 + s.2)
+
+lemma foldl_mulStep (m acc sh : ℕ) : (m.bits.foldl mulStep (acc, sh)).1 = acc + m * sh := by
+  induction m using Nat.binaryRec' generalizing acc sh with
+  | zero => simp
+  | bit a m hm ih =>
+    rw [Nat.bits_append_bit _ _ hm, List.foldl_cons, mulStep, ih, Nat.bit_val]
+    cases a <;> simp <;> ring

+lemma foldl_mulStep_le (l : List Bool) (acc sh : ℕ) :
+    (l.foldl mulStep (acc, sh)).1 + sh ≤ acc + 2 ^ l.length * sh ∧
+      (l.foldl mulStep (acc, sh)).2 = 2 ^ l.length * sh := by
+  induction l generalizing acc sh with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih (if a then acc + sh else acc) (sh + sh)
+    have h : (if a then acc + sh else acc) ≤ acc + sh := by split <;> omega
+    simp only [List.foldl_cons, mulStep, List.length_cons, pow_succ] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
+    refine ⟨?_, by rw [h₂]; ring⟩
+    nlinarith
+
+lemma size_le_of_le {x n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (h : x ≤ 2 ^ i * n) : x.size ≤ i + n.size :=
+  Nat.size_le.2 (h.trans_lt (by
+    rw [pow_add]; exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.lt_size_self n) (Nat.two_pow_pos i)))
+
+end NatMul

+open NatMul in
+/-- **Multiplication is tidily computable in cubic time and space**, in the binary encoding. -/
+public theorem computableTidilyInDegree_mul :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 * p.2) (encPair encNat encNat) encNat 3 1 := by
+  let encS := encPair encNat encNat

+module

+/-!
+# Tidy computability within given bounds, up to constants
+
+`ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encOut T S`: `f` is tidily computable within time `O(T a)` and space
+`O(S a)` on the input `a`, and its encoded value has length `O(S a)`. Unlike
+`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree`, the bounds are any functions of the input, not of the
+length of its encoding, so that they can be stated in several measures of the input, such as the
+length of a description, the length of an input and a number of steps.
+
+The closure properties are exact up to constants: composition adds the bounds of the outer function
+at the intermediate value, a case distinction adds the bounds of the branch taken, and a left fold
+adds, for every round, a bound on the round and on the state to the time, but only once to the
+space. The encoded value counts towards the space since a combinator keeps it on a work tape.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO`: tidy computability within given bounds.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.listMax`: the largest value of a function on a list, to bound rounds.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.comp`, `.ite`, `.prod`: closure properties.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.foldl`, `.foldlWith`: left folds.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.findWith`, `.filterWith`, `.mapWith`: list operations
+  with a parameter.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.inO`: bounds of a given degree.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-- `f` is tidily computable within time `O(T a)` and space `O(S a)` on the input `a`, and its
+encoded value has length `O(S a)`. -/
+@[expose] public def ComputableTidilyInO {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (encIn : α ↪ List Bool)
+    (encOut : β ↪ List Bool) (T S : α → ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut (fun a => c * (T a + 1))
+    (fun a => c * (S a + 1)) ∧ ∀ a, (encOut (f a)).length ≤ c * (S a + 1)
+
+/-- The largest value of `f` on the elements of `l`, or `0`. -/
+@[expose] public def listMax {α : Type*} (f : α → ℕ) (l : List α) : ℕ := (l.map f).foldr max 0
+
+public lemma le_listMax {α : Type*} {f : α → ℕ} {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) :
+    f a ≤ listMax f l := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => simp at ha
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | ha
+    · exact le_max_left _ _
+    · exact (ih ha).trans (le_max_right _ _)
+
+public lemma listMax_le {α : Type*} {f : α → ℕ} {l : List α} {b : ℕ} (h : ∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ b) :
+    listMax f l ≤ b := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => exact Nat.zero_le _
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    exact max_le (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (ih fun a ha => h a (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha))
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInO
+
+variable {α β γ δ : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encMid : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {encOut : γ ↪ List Bool} {T T₁ T₂ S S₁ S₂ : α → ℕ}
+
+/-- Bounds within a constant factor. -/
+public theorem of_bounds {f : α → β} {t s : α → ℕ}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid t s) (k : ℕ)
+    (ht : ∀ a, t a ≤ k * (T a + 1)) (hs : ∀ a, s a ≤ k * (S a + 1))
+    (hl : ∀ a, (encMid (f a)).length ≤ k * (S a + 1)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S :=
+  ⟨k, hf.mono ht hs, hl⟩
+
+/-- Weakening the bounds, up to a constant factor. -/
+public theorem mono {f : α → β} {T' S' : α → ℕ} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S)
+    (k : ℕ) (hT : ∀ a, T a ≤ k * (T' a + 1)) (hS : ∀ a, S a ≤ k * (S' a + 1)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T' S' :=
+  let ⟨c, hc, hl⟩ := h
+  of_bounds hc (c * (k + 1)) (fun a => by nlinarith [hT a]) (fun a => by nlinarith [hS a])
+    (fun a => by nlinarith [hS a, hl a])
+
+/-- Weakening the bounds. -/
+public theorem mono_le {f : α → β} {T' S' : α → ℕ} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S)
+    (hT : ∀ a, T a ≤ T' a) (hS : ∀ a, S a ≤ S' a) : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T' S' :=
+  h.mono 1 (fun a => by have := hT a; omega) fun a => by have := hS a; omega
+
+/-- The encoded values are within the space bound. -/
+public theorem length_le {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S) :
+    ∃ c, ∀ a, (encMid (f a)).length ≤ c * (S a + 1) :=
+  let ⟨c, _, hl⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, hl⟩
+
+/-- The encoded values are within the time bound. -/
+public theorem length_le_time {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S) :
+    ∃ c, ∀ a, (encMid (f a)).length ≤ c * (T a + 1) :=
+  let ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, hc.length_le⟩
+
+public theorem of_linear {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid (fun a => (encIn a).length) fun a => (encIn a).length :=
+  let ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, hc, hc.length_le⟩
+
+public theorem comp {f : β → γ} {g : α → β} {T₂ S₂ : β → ℕ}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encMid encOut T₂ S₂)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn encMid T₁ S₁) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (f ∘ g) encIn encOut (fun a => T₁ a + T₂ (g a))
+      fun a => S₁ a + S₂ (g a) := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, l₁⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂, l₂⟩ := hf
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := h₂.comp_linear h₁
+  refine of_bounds h (c₁ + c₂ + c * (c₁ + 1)) (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_)
+  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (h₁.length_le a)
+    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (c * c₁ * T₂ (g a)), Nat.zero_le (c * T₂ (g a)), Nat.zero_le (c * T₁ a)]
+  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (l₁ a)
+    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (c * c₁ * S₂ (g a)), Nat.zero_le (c * S₂ (g a)), Nat.zero_le (c * S₁ a)]
+  · exact (l₂ (g a)).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega))
+
+public theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β}
+    {Tc Tf Tg Sc Sf Sg : α → ℕ} (hc : ComputableTidilyInO c encIn encC Tc Sc)
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid Tf Sf)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn encMid Tg Sg) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encMid
+      (fun x => Tc x + if c x then Tf x else Tg x) fun x => Sc x + if c x then Sf x else Sg x := by
+  obtain ⟨c₀, h₀, -⟩ := hc
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, l₁⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂, l₂⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := h₀.ite (h₁.restrict _) (h₂.restrict _)
+  refine of_bounds h (c₀ + c₁ + c₂ + k) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) <;>
+  · split_ifs <;> nlinarith [l₁ x, l₂ x]
+
+public theorem append {enc₂ : δ ↪ List Bool} {f₁ : α → β} {f₂ : α → δ} {g : α → γ}
+    (h₁ : ComputableTidilyInO f₁ encIn encMid T₁ S₁) (h₂ : ComputableTidilyInO f₂ encIn enc₂ T₂ S₂)
+    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = encMid (f₁ x) ++ enc₂ (f₂ x)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO g encIn encOut (fun x => T₁ x + T₂ x) fun x => S₁ x + S₂ x := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, l₁⟩ := h₁
+  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂, l₂⟩ := h₂
+  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := h₁.append h₂ hg
+  refine of_bounds h (c₁ + c₂ + k) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
+  · nlinarith
+  · nlinarith
+  · rw [hg, List.length_append]
+    nlinarith [l₁ x, l₂ x]
+
+public theorem pair {α β₁ β₂ : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool} {T₁ T₂ S₁ S₂ : α → ℕ}
+    {enc : β₁ × β₂ ↪ List Bool} [hP : PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc] {f : α → β₁} {g : α → β₂}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn enc₁ T₁ S₁) (hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn enc₂ T₂ S₂) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc (fun x => T₁ x + T₂ x)
+      fun x => S₁ x + S₂ x + (enc (f x, g x)).length := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, -⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨c₂, h₂, -⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hP.pair_mono h₁ h₂
+  refine of_bounds h ((c + 1) * (c + 1) * (c₁ + c₂ + 1)) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
+  · ring_nf
+    omega
+  · ring_nf
+    omega
+  · ring_nf
+    omega
+
+/-- Pairing with the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem prod {α β₁ β₂ : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool} {T₁ T₂ S₁ S₂ : α → ℕ} {f : α → β₁}
+    {g : α → β₂} (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn enc₁ T₁ S₁)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn enc₂ T₂ S₂) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) (fun x => T₁ x + T₂ x)
+      fun x => S₁ x + S₂ x := by
+  obtain ⟨c₁, l₁⟩ := hf.length_le
+  obtain ⟨c₂, l₂⟩ := hg.length_le
+  refine (hf.pair hg).mono (2 * c₁ + c₂ + 2) (fun x => by nlinarith) fun x => ?_
+  have := l₁ x
+  have := l₂ x
+  rw [length_encPair]
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- Bounds polynomial in the length of the encoded input give polynomial time. -/
+public theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S)
+    (hT : PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) T)
+    (hS : PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) S) :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encIn encMid :=
+  let ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := h
+  have hb {U : α → ℕ} (hU : PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) U) :
+      PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) fun a => c * (U a + 1) :=
+    let ⟨k, d, hk⟩ := hU
+    ⟨c * (k + 1), d, fun a => by
+      have := hk a
+      have := Nat.one_le_pow d ((encIn a).length + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)
+      nlinarith⟩
+  ⟨_, _, hb hT, hb hS, hc⟩
+
+/-- A function whose encoded values are those of a function computable within the bounds. -/
+public theorem of_enc_eq {f : α → β} {g : α → γ} (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encMid T S)
+    (h : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = encMid (f x)) : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn encOut T S :=
+  let ⟨c, ⟨k, S', hS', tm, htm⟩, hl⟩ := hf
+  ⟨c, ⟨k, S', hS', tm, fun a => h a ▸ htm a⟩, fun a => (h a).symm ▸ hl a⟩
+
+/-- A function computed within the length of its encoded value, after one computed within `T` and
+`S`, is computed within `T` and `S`. -/
+public theorem comp_linear {f : β → γ} {g : α → β}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInO f encMid encOut (fun b => (encMid b).length)
+      fun b => (encMid b).length)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInO g encIn encMid T₁ S₁) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (f ∘ g) encIn encOut T₁ S₁ := by
+  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hg.length_le_time
+  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hg.length_le
+  exact (hf.comp hg).mono (c + d + 1) (fun a => by nlinarith [hc a]) fun a => by nlinarith [hd a]
+
+public theorem const (b : β) : ComputableTidilyInO (fun _ : α => b) encIn encMid
+    (fun a => (encIn a).length) fun a => (encIn a).length :=
+  of_linear (.const b)
+
+/-- The first projection of the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem fst {β₁ β₂ : Type} (enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO Prod.fst (encPair enc₁ enc₂) enc₁ (fun p => (encPair enc₁ enc₂ p).length)
+      fun p => (encPair enc₁ enc₂ p).length :=
+  of_linear (.of_unframe fun p => by simp)
+
+/-- The second projection of the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem snd {β₁ β₂ : Type} (enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO Prod.snd (encPair enc₁ enc₂) enc₂ (fun p => (encPair enc₁ enc₂ p).length)
+      fun p => (encPair enc₁ enc₂ p).length :=
+  of_linear (.of_dropFrame fun p => by simp)
+
+/-- The first component of a pair computed within bounds. -/
+public theorem fst' {β₁ β₂ : Type} {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {f : α → β₁ × β₂} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) T S) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (f x).1) encIn enc₁ T S :=
+  (fst enc₁ enc₂).comp_linear h
+
+/-- The second component of a pair computed within bounds. -/
+public theorem snd' {β₁ β₂ : Type} {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {f : α → β₁ × β₂} (h : ComputableTidilyInO f encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) T S) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (f x).2) encIn enc₂ T S :=
+  (snd enc₁ enc₂).comp_linear h
+
+end ComputableTidilyInO
+
+/-- Bounds of degree `d` in the length of the encoded input. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInDegree.inO {α β : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {d e : ℕ}
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encOut d e) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encOut (fun a => ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d)
+      fun a => ((encIn a).length + 1) ^ d :=
+  let ⟨⟨_, _, ⟨ct, ht⟩, ⟨cs, hs⟩, hf⟩, _⟩ := h
+  .of_bounds hf (ct + cs)
+    (fun a => (ht a).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_succ _)))
+    (fun a => (hs a).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (Nat.le_succ _)))
+    (fun a => (hf.length_le a).trans
+      ((ht a).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_succ _))))
+
+/-- Linear bounds in the length of the encoded input. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInDegree.inO_one {α β : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β} {e : ℕ}
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encOut 1 e) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO f encIn encOut (fun a => (encIn a).length) fun a => (encIn a).length :=
+  h.inO.mono 1 (fun a => by simp) fun a => by simp
+
