+/-! ### Left folds -/
+
+section Fold
+
+variable {γ α β π : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {encL : List α ↪ List Bool} {encP : π ↪ List Bool}
+
+lemma fold_time {cl ci cs Tl Ti R L n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ L) :
+    cl * (Tl + 1) + ci * (Ti + 1) + (n + 1) * (cs * (R + 1) + (2 * L + 1 + R) + 1) ≤
+      (cl + ci + 2 * cs + 4) * (Tl + Ti + (n + 1) * (R + L) + 1) := by
+  have ha : (n + 1) * R ≤ (n + 1) * (R + L) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
+  have hb : (n + 1) * L ≤ (n + 1) * (R + L) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
+  have hc : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * (R + L) + 1 := by nlinarith
+  generalize (n + 1) * (R + L) = M at *
+  have : (n + 1) * (cs * (R + 1) + (2 * L + 1 + R) + 1) ≤ 2 * cs * M + cs + 4 * M + 2 := by
+    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs ha
+    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs hc
+    nlinarith
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- **Left folds within given bounds.** If every round is within the time `R x` and the space
+`Q x`, and every state has length at most `B x`, a fold takes the time of the list and of the
+initial state, plus `R x`, `B x` and the length of the encoded list for every round, and the space
+of the list and of the initial state, plus `Q x`, `B x` and the length of the encoded list once. -/
+public theorem foldl [ListEncoding encA encL] [hS : SizedListEncoding encA encL]
+    {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β} {Tl Ti Sl Si R Q B : γ → ℕ}
+    {Ts Ss : β × α → ℕ}
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInO list encIn encL Tl Sl)
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInO init encIn encB Ti Si)
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInO (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2) (encPair encB encA) encB Ts Ss)
+    (hround : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
+      Ts (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i]) ≤ R x)
+    (hspace : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
+      Ss (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i]) ≤ Q x)
+    (hstate : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
+      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB
+      (fun x => Tl x + Ti x + ((list x).length + 1) * (R x + B x + (encL (list x)).length))
+      fun x => Sl x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encL (list x)).length := by
+  obtain ⟨cl, hl, -⟩ := hlist
+  obtain ⟨ci, hi, -⟩ := hinit
+  obtain ⟨cs, hs, -⟩ := hstep
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.foldl (encA := encA) (encL := encL)
+    (encBA := encPair encB encA) (encS := encPair encL encB)
+    (encO := encOption (encPair encL encB))
+    (hl.mono (t' := fun x => cl * (Tl x + 1) + ci * (Ti x + 1))
+      (s' := fun x => cl * (Sl x + 1) + ci * (Si x + 1))
+      (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _))
+    (hi.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _)) hs
+    (tMax := fun x => cs * (R x + B x + 1)) (sMax := fun x => cs * (Q x + 1))
+    (lMax := fun x => 2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x)
+    (fun x i hi => Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (by have := hround x i hi; omega))
+    (fun x i hi => Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.add_le_add_right (hspace x i hi) 1))
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      have h₁ := hstate x i hi
+      have h₂ := hS.length_drop_le (list x) i
+      simp only [length_encPair]
+      omega)
+  set K := cl + ci + 2 * cs + 4
+  refine of_bounds h (c * K + 1) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
+  · have h₁ : ((list x).length + 1) * (cs * (R x + B x + 1) + (2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 +
+        B x) + 1) ≤ ((list x).length + 1) * (cs * (R x + B x + 1) +
+          (2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + (R x + B x)) + 1) :=
+      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
+    refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ((Nat.add_le_add_left h₁ _).trans
+      (fold_time (hS.length_le (list x))))).trans ?_
+    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
+    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)
+  · have : cl * (Sl x + 1) + ci * (Si x + 1) + cs * (Q x + 1) +
+        (2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x) + 1 ≤
+        K * (Sl x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encL (list x)).length + 1) := by
+      simp only [K]
+      nlinarith
+    refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c this).trans ?_
+    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
+    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)
+  · have := hstate x _ le_rfl
+    rw [List.take_length] at this
+    exact this.trans ((show B x ≤ Sl x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encL (list x)).length + 1 by
+      omega).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos _)))
+
+/-- **Left folds with a parameter, within given bounds.** The step may depend on a parameter
+`par x`, which is kept in the state. -/
+public theorem foldlWith [ListEncoding encA encL] [hS : SizedListEncoding encA encL]
+    {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : π → β → α → β}
+    {Tp Tl Ti Sp Sl Si R Q B : γ → ℕ} {Ts Ss : (π × β) × α → ℕ}
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInO par encIn encP Tp Sp)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInO list encIn encL Tl Sl)
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInO init encIn encB Ti Si)
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInO (fun p : (π × β) × α => step p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
+      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) encB Ts Ss)
+    (hround : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
+      Ts ((par x, ((list x).take i).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)), (list x)[i]) ≤ R x)
+    (hspace : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
+      Ss ((par x, ((list x).take i).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)), (list x)[i]) ≤ Q x)
+    (hstate : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
+      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl (step (par x)) (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (list x).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)) encIn encB
+      (fun x => Tp x + Tl x + Ti x +
+        ((list x).length + 1) * (R x + B x + (encP (par x)).length + (encL (list x)).length))
+      fun x => Sp x + Sl x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encP (par x)).length + (encL (list x)).length := by
+  -- fold over the state `(par x, acc)`, keeping the parameter unchanged
+  have heq (l : List α) (s : π × β) :
+      l.foldl (fun s a => (s.1, step s.1 s.2 a)) s = (s.1, l.foldl (step s.1) s.2) := by
+    induction l generalizing s <;> simp [*]
+  have hkeep := (fst encP encB).comp_linear (fst (encPair encP encB) encA)
+  have hfold := foldl (encB := encPair encP encB) hlist (hpar.prod hinit)
+    (step := fun s a => (s.1, step s.1 s.2 a)) (hkeep.prod hstep)
+    (R := fun x => 4 * (encP (par x)).length + 2 * B x + (encL (list x)).length + 3 + R x)
+    (Q := fun x => 4 * (encP (par x)).length + 2 * B x + (encL (list x)).length + 3 + Q x)
+    (B := fun x => 2 * (encP (par x)).length + 1 + B x)
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      have h₁ := hround x i hi
+      have h₂ := hstate x i hi.le
+      have h₃ := hS.length_elem_le (list x) _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
+      rw [heq]
+      simp only [length_encPair] at h₂ ⊢
+      omega)
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      have h₁ := hspace x i hi
+      have h₂ := hstate x i hi.le
+      have h₃ := hS.length_elem_le (list x) _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
+      rw [heq]
+      simp only [length_encPair] at h₂ ⊢
+      omega)
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      have := hstate x i hi
+      rw [heq]
+      simp only [length_encPair]
+      omega)
+  refine (((snd encP encB).comp_linear hfold).mono 8 (fun x => ?_) fun x => ?_).of_enc_eq
+    fun x => ?_
+  · have h₁ := hS.length_le (list x)
+    have h₂ : (list x).length ≤ (list x).length * (encL (list x)).length := by
+      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (list x).length with h | h
+      · simp [h]
+      · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
+    ring_nf
+    omega
+  · omega
+  · rw [Function.comp_apply, heq]
+
+end Fold
+
+/-! ### Equality -/

+/-- Equality of words, within the length of the first word times the length of both, and linear
+space. -/
+public theorem eqWords :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => decide (p.1 = p.2))
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBool
+      (fun p => (p.1.length + 1) * (p.1.length + p.2.length + 1))
+      fun p => p.1.length + p.2.length + 1 := by
+  have hfold := foldl (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encPair encBits encBool)
+    (fst encBits encBits) ((snd encBits encBits).prod (const true))
+    (ComputableTidilyInDegree.inO_one ComputableTidilyInDegree.eqWordsStep)
+    (R := fun p => 4 * (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 8)
+    (Q := fun p => 4 * (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 8)
+    (B := fun p => 4 * (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 8)
+    (fun p i hi => by
+      have := EqWords.foldl_fst (p.1.take i) p.2 true
+      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
+      rw [this, List.length_drop]
+      omega)
+    (fun p i hi => by
+      have := EqWords.foldl_fst (p.1.take i) p.2 true
+      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
+      rw [this, List.length_drop]
+      omega)
+    (fun p i hi => by
+      have := EqWords.foldl_fst (p.1.take i) p.2 true
+      simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
+      rw [this, List.length_drop]
+      omega)
+  refine (((ComputableTidilyInDegree.inO_one ComputableTidilyInDegree.eqWordsResult).comp_linear
+    hfold).mono 64 (fun p => ?_) fun p => ?_).of_enc_eq fun p => ?_
+  · simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply]
+    nlinarith
+  · simp only [length_encPair, encBits_apply]
+    omega
+  · simpa using congrArg encBool (EqWords.foldl_result p.1 p.2 true).symm
+
+/-- Equality, for any encoding. -/
+public theorem eq {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun p : α × α => decide (p.1 = p.2)) (encPair enc enc) encBool
+      (fun p => ((enc p.1).length + 1) * ((enc p.1).length + (enc p.2).length + 1))
+      fun p => (encPair enc enc p).length := by
+  refine ((eqWords.comp (of_linear (.of_eq (f := fun p : α × α => (enc p.1, enc p.2))
+    (encIn := encPair enc enc) (encMid := encPair encBits encBits) fun _ => rfl))).mono 4
+    (fun p => ?_) fun p => ?_).of_enc_eq fun p => ?_
+  · simp only [length_encPair]
+    nlinarith
+  · simp only [length_encPair]
+    omega
+  · simp [enc.injective.eq_iff]
+
+/-! ### Finding, filtering and mapping -/
+
+section Lists
+
+open ComputableTidilyInDegree (findStep foldl_findStep filterStep foldl_filterStep mapStep
+  foldl_mapStep length_encList_filter_le isSome optionSome snoc)
+
+variable {γ α β π : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {encP : π ↪ List Bool} {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α} {Tp Tl Sp Sl : γ → ℕ}
+
+/-- The first element of `list x` passing the test `t` with the parameter `par x`. -/
+public theorem findWith {t : π × α → Bool} {Tt St : π × α → ℕ}
+    (ht : ComputableTidilyInO t (encPair encP enc) encBool Tt St)
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInO par encIn encP Tp Sp)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInO list encIn (encList enc) Tl Sl) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (list x).find? fun a => t (par x, a)) encIn (encOption enc)
+      (fun x => (encIn x).length + Tp x + Tl x + ((list x).length + 1) *
+        ((encP (par x)).length + (encList enc (list x)).length +
+          listMax (fun a => Tt (par x, a)) (list x)))
+      fun x => (encIn x).length + Sp x + Sl x + (encP (par x)).length +
+        (encList enc (list x)).length + listMax (fun a => St (par x, a)) (list x) := by
+  -- the step, as a function of `((p, acc), a)`
+  have hq := fst (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc
+  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc
+  have hisSome := (isSome enc).inO_one.comp_linear hq.snd'
+  have h := hisSome.ite hq.snd' ((ht.comp (hq.fst'.prod hel)).ite
+    ((optionSome (enc₁ := enc)).inO_one.comp_linear hel) (const none))
+  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInO (fun q : (π × Option α) × α => findStep t q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)

+/-!
+# Binary counters
+
+Natural numbers in binary (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.encNat`) can be incremented, decremented and tested
+for zero within time quadratic and space linear in the number of digits. The decrement subtracts
+the borrow digit by digit and then drops a leading zero. A binary counter, counted down to zero,
+iterates a function within the space of a round, plus the length of the counter.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.natSucc`, `.natPred`, `.natIsZero`: the successor, the
+  predecessor and the zero test in binary.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.iterate`: iterating a function a number of times given in
+  binary, within the space of a round and logarithmic space for the counter.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+namespace NatPred
+
+/-- Subtracts a borrow from the binary digits `l`, least significant first, keeping a leading
+zero. -/
+@[expose] public def decr : List Bool → List Bool
+  | [] => []
+  | true :: l => false :: l
+  | false :: l => true :: decr l
+
+/-- Drops a leading zero, the last digit. -/
+@[expose] public def norm (l : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  if l.getLast? = some false then l.dropLast else l
+
+lemma norm_cons {l : List Bool} (hl : l ≠ []) (b : Bool) : norm (b :: l) = b :: norm l := by
+  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (List.getLast?_isSome.mpr hl)
+  simp only [norm, List.getLast?_cons, hx, Option.getD_some, List.dropLast_cons_of_ne_nil hl]
+  split_ifs <;> rfl
+
+lemma bits_ne_nil {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) : m.bits ≠ [] := by
+  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' m with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
+  · rw [Nat.bit0_bits k (by omega)]; simp
+  · rw [Nat.bit1_bits]; simp
+
+lemma decr_ne_nil {l : List Bool} (hl : l ≠ []) : decr l ≠ [] := by
+  rcases l with _ | ⟨_ | _, l⟩ <;> simp_all [decr]
+
+lemma norm_bits (n : ℕ) : norm n.bits = n.bits := by
+  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
+  | _ n ih =>
+    rcases Nat.even_or_odd' n with ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩
+    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
+      · rfl
+      · rw [Nat.bit0_bits m (by omega), norm_cons (bits_ne_nil (by omega)), ih m (by omega)]
+    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
+      · rfl
+      · rw [Nat.bit1_bits, norm_cons (bits_ne_nil (by omega)), ih m (by omega)]
+
+public lemma bits_pred (n : ℕ) : (n - 1).bits = norm (decr n.bits) := by
+  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
+  | _ n ih =>
+    rcases Nat.even_or_odd' n with ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩
+    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
+      · rfl
+      · rw [Nat.bit0_bits m (by omega), decr, show 2 * m - 1 = 2 * (m - 1) + 1 by omega,
+          Nat.bit1_bits, ih m (by omega), norm_cons (decr_ne_nil (bits_ne_nil (by omega)))]
+    · rw [Nat.bit1_bits, decr, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
+      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
+      · rfl
+      · rw [Nat.bit0_bits m (by omega), norm_cons (bits_ne_nil (by omega)), norm_bits]
+
+/-- One round of the decrement: subtract the borrow from the digit `b`, append the result and keep
+the borrow. -/
+@[expose] public def decrStep (p : Bool × List Bool) (b : Bool) : Bool × List Bool :=
+  (p.1 && !b, p.2 ++ [p.1 ^^ b])
+
+lemma length_decr (l : List Bool) : (decr l).length = l.length := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons b l ih => cases b <;> simp [decr, ih]
+
+lemma foldl_decrStep (l : List Bool) (c : Bool) (out : List Bool) :
+    (l.foldl decrStep (c, out)).2 = out ++ if c then decr l else l := by
+  induction l generalizing c out with
+  | nil => cases c <;> simp [decr]
+  | cons b l ih => cases c <;> cases b <;> simp [decrStep, ih, decr]
+
+/-- One round of dropping a leading zero: append the pending digit and keep the new one. -/
+@[expose] public def normStep (p : Option Bool × List Bool) (b : Bool) :
+    Option Bool × List Bool :=
+  (some b, p.2 ++ p.1.toList)
+
+/-- Appends the pending digit unless it is a zero. -/
+@[expose] public def normFinish (p : Option Bool × List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  if p.1 = some true then p.2 ++ [true] else p.2
+
+lemma length_foldl_normStep (l : List Bool) (p : Option Bool) (acc : List Bool) :
+    (l.foldl normStep (p, acc)).2.length ≤ acc.length + p.toList.length + l.length := by
+  induction l generalizing p acc with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    rw [List.foldl_cons, normStep]
+    have := ih (some b) (acc ++ p.toList)
+    simp only [Option.toList_some, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
+      at this ⊢
+    omega
+
+lemma normFinish_foldl (l : List Bool) (p : Option Bool) (acc : List Bool) :
+    normFinish (l.foldl normStep (p, acc)) = acc ++ norm (p.toList ++ l) := by
+  induction l generalizing p acc with
+  | nil => rcases p with _ | _ | _ <;> simp [normFinish, norm]
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    rw [List.foldl_cons, normStep, ih]
+    rcases p with _ | p
+    · simp
+    · simp [norm_cons]
+
+end NatPred

+/-! ### The rounds, in linear time -/
+
+section Rounds
+
+open ComputableTidilyInDegree NatPred
+
+lemma decrStep_deg :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : (Bool × List Bool) × Bool => decrStep p.1 p.2)
+    (encPair (encPair encBool encBits) encBool) (encPair encBool encBits) 1 1 := by
+  have hacc := fst (encPair encBool encBits) encBool
+  have hb := snd (encPair encBool encBits) encBool
+  have hc := hacc.fst'
+  have hbor := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+    fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 && !q.2).comp (hc.prod hb)
+  have hdig := (of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+    fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 ^^ q.2).comp (hc.prod hb)
+  exact (hbor.prod (hacc.snd'.append hdig (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl)).mono
+
+lemma normStep_deg :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : (Option Bool × List Bool) × Bool => normStep p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair (encPair (encOption encBool) encBits) encBool)
+      (encPair (encOption encBool) encBits) 1 1 := by
+  have hacc := fst (encPair (encOption encBool) encBits) encBool
+  have hb := snd (encPair (encOption encBool) encBits) encBool
+  have hpend := (of_linear (.of_tail (encIn := encOption encBool) (encOut := encBits)
+    (f := fun o : Option Bool => o.toList) fun o => by cases o <;> rfl)).comp hacc.fst'
+  exact (((optionSome (enc₁ := encBool)).comp hb).prod
+    (hacc.snd'.append hpend (encOut := encBits) fun _ => rfl)).mono
+
+lemma normFinish_deg :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree normFinish (encPair (encOption encBool) encBits) encBits 1 1 := by
+  have hp := fst (encOption encBool) encBits
+  have hds := snd (encOption encBool) encBits
+  have htest := (of_finite (encIn := encOption encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+    fun o : Option Bool => decide (o = some true)).comp hp
+  have happ := hds.append (const (encMid := encBool) true) (encOut := encBits)
+    (g := fun p : Option Bool × List Bool => p.2 ++ [true]) fun _ => rfl
+  convert (htest.ite (happ.restrict _) (hds.restrict _)).mono (d' := 1) (e' := 1) using 1
+  funext p
+  simp [normFinish]
+
+end Rounds

+namespace ComputableTidilyInO

+open NatPred

+variable {α : Type} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+
+/-- A fold over binary digits, with rounds in linear time, is within time quadratic and space
+linear in the number of digits. -/
+lemma foldl_bits {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {init : β} {step : β → Bool → β}
+    {e : ℕ}
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : β × Bool => step p.1 p.2)
+      (encPair encB encBool) encB 1 e) (b : ℕ)
+    (hb : ∀ (l : List Bool) i, (encB ((l.take i).foldl step init)).length ≤ l.length + b) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun l : List Bool => l.foldl step init) encBits encB
+      (fun l => (l.length + 1) ^ 2) fun l => l.length + 1 := by
+  refine (foldl (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (of_linear (.of_eq fun _ => rfl)) (const init)
+    hstep.inO_one (R := fun l => 2 * l.length + 2 * b + 4)
+    (Q := fun l => 2 * l.length + 2 * b + 4) (B := fun l => l.length + b)
+    (fun l i _ => by have := hb l i; simp; omega) (fun l i _ => by have := hb l i; simp; omega)
+    fun l i _ => hb l i).mono (4 * b + 8) (fun l => ?_) fun l => ?_
+  · simp only [encBits_apply]
+    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (b * l.length)]
+  · simp only [encBits_apply]
+    nlinarith
+
+lemma length_incr_le (c : Bool) (l : List Bool) : (NatSucc.incr c l).length ≤ l.length + 1 := by
+  induction l generalizing c with
+  | nil => cases c <;> simp [NatSucc.incr]
+  | cons b l ih => cases c <;> cases b <;> simp [NatSucc.incr, ih]
+
+/-- The successor in binary. -/
+public theorem natSucc :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (· + 1) encNat encNat (fun n => ((encNat n).length + 1) ^ 2)
+      fun n => (encNat n).length + 1 := by
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace_succ
+  refine of_bounds h (c + 2) (fun n => by nlinarith) (fun n => by nlinarith) fun n => ?_
+  have := length_incr_le true n.bits
+  simp only [encNat_apply, NatSucc.bits_succ] at this ⊢
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- The predecessor in binary, `0 - 1 = 0`. -/
+public theorem natPred :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (· - 1) encNat encNat (fun n => ((encNat n).length + 1) ^ 2)
+      fun n => (encNat n).length + 1 := by
+  have hbits : ComputableTidilyInO (fun n : ℕ => n.bits) encNat encBits
+      (fun n => (encNat n).length) fun n => (encNat n).length :=
+    of_linear (.of_eq fun _ => rfl)
+  have hlen (l : List Bool) : ((l.foldl decrStep (true, [])).2).length = l.length := by
+    rw [foldl_decrStep]
+    simp [length_decr]

+    simp at h₁

+/-- The zero test in binary. -/
+public theorem natIsZero :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun n => decide (n = 0)) encNat encBool (fun n => (encNat n).length)
+      fun n => (encNat n).length :=

+
+section Iterate
+
+variable {γ β : Type} [Inhabited β] {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}

+/-- A round of the counted iteration: stop at zero, otherwise count down and apply `step`. -/
+@[expose] public def countStep (step : β → β) : Option (ℕ × β) → Option (ℕ × β)
+  | some (i + 1, b) => some (i, step b)
+  | _ => none
+
+lemma countStep_eq (step : β → β) (o : Option (ℕ × β)) : countStep step o =
+    if o.isSome && !decide ((o.getD default).1 = 0) then
+      some ((o.getD default).1 - 1, step (o.getD default).2) else none := by
+  rcases o with _ | ⟨_ | i, b⟩ <;> rfl
+
+omit [Inhabited β] in
+lemma iterate_countStep (step : β → β) (t : ℕ) (b : β) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ t) :
+    (countStep step)^[k] (some (t, b)) = some (t - k, step^[k] b) := by
+  induction k with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ k ih =>
+    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega), show t - k = t - (k + 1) + 1 by omega,
+      countStep, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+
+/-- The length of `encNat` is monotone. -/
+public lemma length_encNat_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : (encNat m).length ≤ (encNat n).length := by
+  simpa [Nat.size_eq_bits_len] using Nat.size_le_size h
+
+/-- A round of the counted iteration. -/
+lemma countStep_inO {step : β → β} {Ts Ss : β → ℕ}
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInO step encB encB Ts Ss) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (countStep step) (encOption (encPair encNat encB))
+      (encOption (encPair encNat encB))
+      (fun o => (encOption (encPair encNat encB) o).length +
+        ((encNat (o.getD default).1).length + 1) ^ 2 + Ts (o.getD default).2)
+      fun o => (encOption (encPair encNat encB) o).length + Ss (o.getD default).2 := by
+  have hget := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.getD (enc₁ := encPair encNat encB)
+    (enc := encOption (encPair encNat encB)) default).inO_one
+  have hcond := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool)
+    (encMid := encBool) fun q : Bool × Bool => q.1 && !q.2).inO_one.comp_linear
+    ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.isSome (encPair encNat encB)).inO_one.prod
+      (natIsZero.comp_linear hget.fst'))
+  have hnext := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.optionSome (enc₁ := encPair encNat encB)
+    (enc := encOption (encPair encNat encB))).inO_one.comp_linear
+    ((natPred.comp hget.fst').prod (hstep.comp hget.snd'))
+  refine ((hcond.ite hnext (const none)).mono 8 (fun o => ?_) fun o => ?_).of_enc_eq
+    fun o => by rw [countStep_eq]; rfl
+  all_goals
+    have h₁ : (encNat (o.getD default).1).length + 1 ≤
+        (encOption (encPair encNat encB) o).length + 1 := by
+      rcases o with _ | ⟨i, b⟩
+      · simp only [Option.getD_none, encOption_none]
+        exact Nat.le_of_eq (congrArg (·.length + 1) Nat.zero_bits)
+      · simp only [Option.getD_some, encOption_some, List.length_cons, length_encPair]; omega
+    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
+    split_ifs <;> omega
+
+lemma sum_le {c₀ c₁ k k' A M X Y : ℕ} (hX : X ≤ k * (M + 1)) (hY : Y ≤ c₀ * (A + 1)) :
+    c₀ * (A + 1) + X + c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ (c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + k + k') * (A + M + 1) := by
+  have h₁ : c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ c₁ * (c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1) :=
+    calc c₁ * (Y + 1) ≤ c₁ * (c₀ * (A + 1) + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
+      _ ≤ c₁ * ((c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by nlinarith)
+      _ = _ := by ring
+  have h₂ : X ≤ k * (A + M + 1) := hX.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
+  have h₃ : c₀ * (A + 1) ≤ c₀ * (A + M + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
+  have : (c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + k + k') * (A + M + 1) = c₀ * (A + M + 1) +
+      c₁ * (c₀ + 1) * (A + M + 1) + k * (A + M + 1) + k' * (A + M + 1) := by ring
+  omega
+
+/-- **Iterating `n x` times, with `n x` in binary.** If the rounds are within the time `R x` and
+the space `Q x`, and the iterates have length at most `B x`, the iteration takes the time of the
+counter and of the start, plus `R x`, `B x` and the square of the length of the counter for every
+round, and the space of the counter and of the start, plus `Q x`, `B x` and the length of the
+counter. -/
+public theorem iterate {n : γ → ℕ} {init : γ → β} {step : β → β}
+    {Tn Ti Sn Si R Q B : γ → ℕ} {Ts Ss : β → ℕ}
+    (hn : ComputableTidilyInO n encIn encNat Tn Sn)
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInO init encIn encB Ti Si)
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInO step encB encB Ts Ss)
+    (hround : ∀ x, ∀ k ≤ n x, Ts (step^[k] (init x)) ≤ R x)
+    (hspace : ∀ x, ∀ k ≤ n x, Ss (step^[k] (init x)) ≤ Q x)
+    (hstate : ∀ x, ∀ k ≤ n x, (encB (step^[k] (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => step^[n x] (init x)) encIn encB
+      (fun x => Tn x + Ti x + (n x + 1) * (R x + B x + ((encNat (n x)).length + 1) ^ 2))
+      fun x => Sn x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encNat (n x)).length := by
+  -- the iteration on `Option (ℕ × β)`, until the counter is exhausted
+  obtain ⟨c, hf, -⟩ := countStep_inO (Ts := Ts) (Ss := Ss) hstep
+  have hr (o : Option (ℕ × β)) :
+      IsLeast {m | encOption (encPair encNat encB) ((countStep step)^[m + 1] o) = []}
+        ((o.map Prod.fst).getD 0) := by
+    rcases o with _ | ⟨t, b⟩
+    · refine ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩
+    · refine ⟨?_, fun m hm => ?_⟩
+      · simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
+        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', iterate_countStep step t b le_rfl, Nat.sub_self]
+        rfl
+      · by_contra hlt
+        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, not_le] at hm hlt
+        rw [iterate_countStep step t b hlt] at hm
+        simp at hm
+  obtain ⟨d, hit⟩ := hf.iterateWhile hr
+  -- the start, and its iterates
+  have hstart := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.optionSome (enc₁ := encPair encNat encB)
+    (enc := encOption (encPair encNat encB))).inO_one.comp_linear (hn.prod hinit)
+  obtain ⟨c₀, h₀, l₀⟩ := hstart
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨c₁, h⟩ := hit.comp_linear h₀

+      (countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x)) = some (n x - k, step^[k] (init x)) :=
+    iterate_countStep step _ _ hk
+  have hlen (x : γ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n x) :
+      ((encOption (encPair encNat encB)) ((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x)))).length ≤
+        2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 := by
+    rw [hiter x hk]
+    have := length_encNat_mono (Nat.sub_le (n x) k)
+    have := hstate x k hk
+    simp only [encOption_some, List.length_cons, length_encPair]
+    omega
+  have hcount (x : γ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n x) :
+      (encNat (((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x))).getD default).1).length ≤
+        (encNat (n x)).length := by
+    rw [hiter x hk]
+    exact length_encNat_mono (Nat.sub_le (n x) k)
+  -- the bounds of the rounds and of the iterates
+  have hrx (x : γ) : ((some (n x, init x)).map Prod.fst).getD 0 = n x := rfl
+  have hT (x : γ) : (Finset.Iic (n x)).sup (fun k => c *
+      ((encOption (encPair encNat encB) ((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x)))).length +
+      ((encNat (((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x))).getD default).1).length + 1) ^ 2 +
+      Ts (((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x))).getD default).2 + 1)) ≤
+      c * (2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 + ((encNat (n x)).length + 1) ^ 2 + R x + 1) :=
+    Finset.sup_le fun k hk => by
+      have hk := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk
+      have h₁ := hlen x hk
+      have h₂ := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (hcount x hk) 1) 2

+      rw [hiter x hk] at h₁

+      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
+  have hS (x : γ) : (Finset.Iic (n x)).sup (fun k => c *
+      ((encOption (encPair encNat encB) ((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x)))).length +
+      Ss (((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x))).getD default).2 + 1)) ≤
+      c * (2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 + Q x + 1) :=
+    Finset.sup_le fun k hk => by
+      have hk := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk
+      have h₁ := hlen x hk
+      have h₂ := hspace x k hk
+      rw [hiter x hk] at h₁ ⊢
+      simp only [Option.getD_some]
+      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
+  have hL (x : γ) : (Finset.Iic (n x)).sup (fun k =>
+      (encOption (encPair encNat encB) ((countStep step)^[k] (some (n x, init x)))).length) ≤
+      2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 :=
+    Finset.sup_le fun k hk => hlen x (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk)
+  have hO : ComputableTidilyInO (fun x => (countStep step)^[n x] (some (n x, init x))) encIn
+      (encOption (encPair encNat encB))
+      (fun x => Tn x + Ti x + (n x + 1) * (R x + B x + ((encNat (n x)).length + 1) ^ 2))
+      fun x => Sn x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encNat (n x)).length := by
+    refine of_bounds h (c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + 8 * (c + d + 1) + 4 * d * (c + 1)) (fun x => ?_)
+      (fun x => ?_)
+      (fun x => ?_)
+    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
+      set P := R x + B x + ((encNat (n x)).length + 1) ^ 2
+      have h₁ := hT x
+      have h₂ := hL x
+      have h₃ := h₀.length_le x
+      have h₄ : (encNat (n x)).length + 1 ≤ ((encNat (n x)).length + 1) ^ 2 :=
+        Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _

+          R x + 1) ≤ c * (4 * P) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
+      have e₀ := (Nat.add_le_add_right h₂ 1).trans
+        (show 2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 + 1 ≤ 3 * P by omega)
+      have e₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n x + 1) (Nat.add_le_add (h₁.trans e₁)
+        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d e₀))
+      have e₃ : (n x + 1) * (c * (4 * P) + d * (3 * P)) ≤

+        ring_nf; nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (n x * P), Nat.zero_le P]
+      simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
+      exact sum_le (k' := 4 * d * (c + 1))
+        ((e₂.trans e₃).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))) h₃
+    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
+      set W := Q x + B x + (encNat (n x)).length
+      have h₁ := (hS x).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c
+        (show 2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 + Q x + 1 ≤ 3 * (W + 1) by omega))
+      have h₂ := (Nat.add_le_add_right (hL x) 1).trans
+        (show 2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 + 1 ≤ 3 * (W + 1) by omega)
+      have e₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (Nat.add_le_add h₁ h₂)
+      have e₂ : d * (c * (3 * (W + 1)) + 3 * (W + 1)) ≤ 4 * d * (c + 1) * (W + 1) := by
+        ring_nf; omega
+      have h₃ := l₀ x
+      simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
+      have := sum_le (k := 4 * d * (c + 1)) (k' := 8 * (c + d + 1)) (c₁ := c₁)
+        (e₁.trans e₂) h₃
+      rw [show c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + 4 * d * (c + 1) + 8 * (c + d + 1) =
+        c₀ + c₁ * (c₀ + 1) + 8 * (c + d + 1) + 4 * d * (c + 1) by ring] at this

+      linarith
+    · refine (hlen x le_rfl).trans ((show 2 * (encNat (n x)).length + B x + 2 ≤
+        2 * (Sn x + Si x + Q x + B x + (encNat (n x)).length + 1) by omega).trans
+        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)))
+  refine (((ComputableTidilyInDegree.getD (enc₁ := encPair encNat encB)
+    (enc := encOption (encPair encNat encB))
+    default).inO_one.comp_linear hO).snd').of_enc_eq fun x => ?_
+  simp only [Function.comp_apply, hiter x le_rfl, Option.getD_some]

+end Iterate
+
+end ComputableTidilyInO
+

+/-!
+# Tidy computability with polynomial bounds of a given degree
+
+`ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encOut d e`: `f` is tidily computable within time and space
+`O(n ^ d)`, and its encoded values have length `O(n ^ e)`, where `n` is the length of the encoded
+input. The constants are existential, the degrees are explicit. The closure properties compute the
+degrees: composition multiplies the degree of the outer function by the output degree of the inner
+one, pairing and case distinctions take maxima, and a left fold adds the output degree of the list
+to the degree of a round.
+
+Results are stated with the degrees the closure properties produce; `mono` moves to larger degrees,
+proving the inequalities by `decide` or `omega`. Left folds are in
+`Cslib.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.Fold`.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.DegreeBounded`: a function bounded by `c * (size + 1) ^ d`.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree`: tidy computability with bounds of given degrees.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.computableTidilyInPolyTime`: polynomial time.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.comp`, `.ite`, `.append`, `.pair`, `.prod`: closure
+  properties.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite`: functions on finite types.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+universe u
+
+/-! ### Bounds of a given degree -/
+
+/-- `u` is bounded by a polynomial of degree `d` in `size`. -/
+@[expose] public def DegreeBounded {α : Type*} (size u : α → ℕ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ c, ∀ a, u a ≤ c * (size a + 1) ^ d
+
+namespace DegreeBounded
+
+variable {α β : Type*} {size : α → ℕ} {u v : α → ℕ} {d d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
+
+public theorem mono (h : DegreeBounded size v d) (huv : ∀ a, u a ≤ v a) :
+    DegreeBounded size u d :=
+  let ⟨c, hv⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, fun a => (huv a).trans (hv a)⟩
+
+public theorem mono_deg (h : DegreeBounded size u d₁) (hd : d₁ ≤ d₂) : DegreeBounded size u d₂ :=
+  let ⟨c, hu⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, fun a => (hu a).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) hd))⟩
+
+public theorem const (k : ℕ) : DegreeBounded size (fun _ => k) d :=
+  ⟨k, fun _ => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos _))⟩
+
+public theorem self : DegreeBounded size size 1 :=
+  ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩
+
+public theorem add (hu : DegreeBounded size u d) (hv : DegreeBounded size v d) :
+    DegreeBounded size (fun a => u a + v a) d :=
+  let ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := hu
+  let ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := hv
+  ⟨c₁ + c₂, fun a => (add_le_add (h₁ a) (h₂ a)).trans_eq (Nat.add_mul _ _ _).symm⟩
+
+public theorem smul (k : ℕ) (hu : DegreeBounded size u d) :
+    DegreeBounded size (fun a => k * u a) d :=
+  let ⟨c, h⟩ := hu
+  ⟨k * c, fun a => (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (h a)).trans_eq (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm⟩
+
+public theorem add_const (k : ℕ) (hu : DegreeBounded size u d) :
+    DegreeBounded size (fun a => u a + k) d :=
+  hu.add (const k)
+
+public theorem mul (hu : DegreeBounded size u d₁) (hv : DegreeBounded size v d₂) :
+    DegreeBounded size (fun a => u a * v a) (d₁ + d₂) :=
+  let ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := hu
+  let ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := hv
+  ⟨c₁ * c₂, fun a => (Nat.mul_le_mul (h₁ a) (h₂ a)).trans_eq (by rw [Nat.pow_add]; ring)⟩
+
+/-- Substitution: if `v` has degree `d₂` in `size'` and `size' ∘ g` has degree `d₁` in `size`,
+then `v ∘ g` has degree `d₁ * d₂` in `size`. -/
+public theorem comp {size' : β → ℕ} {v : β → ℕ} {g : α → β} (hv : DegreeBounded size' v d₂)
+    (hg : DegreeBounded size (fun a => size' (g a)) d₁) :
+    DegreeBounded size (fun a => v (g a)) (d₁ * d₂) :=
+  let ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := hg
+  let ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := hv
+  ⟨c₂ * (c₁ + 1) ^ d₂, fun a => by
+    have h : size' (g a) + 1 ≤ (c₁ + 1) * (size a + 1) ^ d₁ := by
+      have := h₁ a
+      dsimp only at this
+      have := Nat.one_le_pow d₁ (size a + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)
+      rw [Nat.add_one_mul]
+      omega
+    refine (h₂ (g a)).trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left c₂ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h d₂)).trans_eq ?_)
+    rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]⟩
+
+public theorem polyBounded (h : DegreeBounded size u d) : PolyBounded size u :=
+  let ⟨c, hu⟩ := h
+  ⟨c, d, hu⟩
+
+end DegreeBounded
+
+/-! ### Tidy computability with bounds of given degrees -/
+
+/-- `f` is tidily computable within time and space bounded by polynomials of degree `d` in the
+length of the encoded input, and its encoded values have length bounded by a polynomial of
+degree `e`. -/
+@[expose] public def ComputableTidilyInDegree {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (encIn : α ↪ List Bool)
+    (encOut : β ↪ List Bool) (d e : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  (∃ t s, DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) t d ∧
+    DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) s d ∧
+    ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut t s) ∧
+  DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) (fun a => (encOut (f a)).length) e
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+variable {α β γ δ : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encMid : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {encOut : γ ↪ List Bool} {d e d₁ e₁ d₂ e₂ : ℕ}
+
+/-- Moving to larger degrees. -/
+public theorem mono {f : α → β} {d' e' : ℕ} (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d e)
+    (hd : d ≤ d' := by first | decide | omega) (he : e ≤ e' := by first | decide | omega) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d' e' :=
+  let ⟨⟨t, s, ht, hs, hf⟩, hl⟩ := h
+  ⟨⟨t, s, ht.mono_deg hd, hs.mono_deg hd, hf⟩, hl.mono_deg he⟩
+
+/-- Bounds of degree `d` give tidy computability of degree `d`, with output of degree `d`. -/
+public theorem of_bounds {f : α → β} {t s : α → ℕ}
+    (ht : DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) t d)
+    (hs : DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) s d)
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid t s) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d d :=
+  ⟨⟨t, s, ht, hs, hf⟩, ht.mono hf.length_le⟩
+
+public theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime {f : α → β}
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d e) : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encIn encMid :=
+  let ⟨⟨_, _, ht, hs, hf⟩, _⟩ := h
+  ⟨_, _, ht.polyBounded, hs.polyBounded, hf⟩
+
+public theorem of_linear {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid 1 1 :=
+  let ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
+  of_bounds ⟨c, fun _ => by simp⟩ ⟨c, fun _ => by simp⟩ hc
+
+public theorem comp {f : β → γ} {g : α → β} (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encMid encOut d₂ e₂)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInDegree g encIn encMid d₁ e₁) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (f ∘ g) encIn encOut (max d₁ (e₁ * d₂)) (e₁ * e₂) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩, hl₁⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩, hl₂⟩ := hf
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear h₂ h₁
+  -- the length of the intermediate value is bounded by the time of `g`
+  have hm := (ht₁.add_const 1).smul c |>.mono fun a =>
+    Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.add_le_add_right (h₁.length_le a) 1)
+  have hd₁ : d₁ ≤ max d₁ (e₁ * d₂) := le_max_left _ _
+  have hd₂ : e₁ * d₂ ≤ max d₁ (e₁ * d₂) := le_max_right _ _
+  exact ⟨⟨_, _, ((ht₁.mono_deg hd₁).add ((ht₂.comp hl₁).mono_deg hd₂)).add (hm.mono_deg hd₁),
+    ((hs₁.mono_deg hd₁).add ((hs₂.comp hl₁).mono_deg hd₂)).add (hm.mono_deg hd₁), h⟩,
+    hl₂.comp hl₁⟩
+
+public theorem restrict {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d e)
+    (p : α → Prop) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (f ∘ Subtype.val) ((Function.Embedding.subtype p).trans encIn) encMid
+      d e :=
+  let ⟨⟨_, _, ⟨ct, ht⟩, ⟨cs, hs⟩, hf⟩, ⟨cl, hl⟩⟩ := h
+  ⟨⟨_, _, ⟨ct, fun a => ht a⟩, ⟨cs, fun a => hs a⟩, hf.restrict p⟩, ⟨cl, fun a => hl a⟩⟩
+
+public theorem ite {encC : Bool ↪ List Bool} {c : α → Bool} {f g : α → β} {dc ec : ℕ}
+    (hc : ComputableTidilyInDegree c encIn encC dc ec)
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree (f ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = true)).trans encIn) encMid d₁ e₁)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInDegree (g ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype (c · = false)).trans encIn) encMid d₂ e₂) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => if c x then f x else g x) encIn encMid
+      (max dc (max d₁ d₂)) (max e₁ e₂) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨tc, sc, htc, hsc, h₀⟩, -⟩ := hc
+  obtain ⟨⟨tf, sf, ⟨ctf, htf⟩, ⟨csf, hsf⟩, h₁⟩, ⟨clf, hlf⟩⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨⟨tg, sg, ⟨ctg, htg⟩, ⟨csg, hsg⟩, h₂⟩, ⟨clg, hlg⟩⟩ := hg
+  -- the bounds of the branches, extended to all inputs
+  let ext (u : {x // c x = true} → ℕ) (v : {x // c x = false} → ℕ) (x : α) : ℕ :=
+    if h : c x = true then u ⟨x, h⟩ else v ⟨x, by simpa using h⟩
+  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.ite h₀ (tf := ext tf tg) (sf := ext sf sg)
+    (tg := ext tf tg) (sg := ext sf sg)
+    (h₁.mono (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]) (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]))
+    (h₂.mono (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]) (fun x => by simp [ext, x.2]))
+  have hext {u v} {cu du cv dv : ℕ}
+      (hu : ∀ x : {x // c x = true}, u x ≤ cu * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ du)
+      (hv : ∀ x : {x // c x = false}, v x ≤ cv * ((encIn x).length + 1) ^ dv) :
+      DegreeBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) (ext u v) (max du dv) :=
+    ((DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨cu, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ (le_max_left du dv)).add
+      (DegreeBounded.mono_deg ⟨cv, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ (le_max_right du dv))).mono fun x => by
+      by_cases hx : c x = true
+      · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_right_of_le (hu ⟨x, hx⟩)
+      · simpa [ext, hx] using Nat.le_add_left_of_le (hv ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩)
+  have hd : max d₁ d₂ ≤ max dc (max d₁ d₂) := le_max_right _ _
+  refine ⟨⟨_, _, ((htc.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add ((hext htf htg).mono_deg hd)).add_const k,
+    ((hsc.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add ((hext hsf hsg).mono_deg hd)).add_const k,
+    h.mono (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)⟩, (hext hlf hlg).mono fun x => ?_⟩ <;>
+  · by_cases hx : c x = true <;> simp [ext, hx]
+
+public theorem const (b : β) : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun _ : α => b) encIn encMid 1 0 :=
+  ⟨(of_linear (.const b)).1, .const _⟩
+
+public theorem of_eq {f : α → β} (h : ∀ a, encMid (f a) = encIn a) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (.of_eq h)
+
+public theorem append {enc₂ : δ ↪ List Bool} {f₁ : α → β} {f₂ : α → δ} {g : α → γ}
+    (h₁ : ComputableTidilyInDegree f₁ encIn encMid d₁ e₁)
+    (h₂ : ComputableTidilyInDegree f₂ encIn enc₂ d₂ e₂)
+    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = encMid (f₁ x) ++ enc₂ (f₂ x)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree g encIn encOut (max d₁ d₂) (max e₁ e₂) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩, hl₁⟩ := h₁
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩, hl₂⟩ := h₂
+  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := h₁.append h₂ hg
+  exact ⟨⟨_, _, (ht₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (ht₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _)),
+    ((hs₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (hs₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))).add_const k, h⟩,
+    ((hl₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (hl₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))).mono fun x => by
+      simp [hg]⟩
+
+/-- A function whose encoded values are those of a function computable with given degrees. -/
+public theorem of_enc_eq {f : α → β} {g : α → γ}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid d e) (h : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = encMid (f x)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree g encIn encOut d e :=
+  let ⟨⟨t, s, ht, hs, ⟨k, S, hS, tm, htm⟩⟩, hl⟩ := hf
+  ⟨⟨t, s, ht, hs, ⟨k, S, hS, tm, fun a => h a ▸ htm a⟩⟩, hl.mono fun a => by rw [h]⟩
+
+public theorem pair {α β₁ β₂ : Type u} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc : β₁ × β₂ ↪ List Bool} [hP : PairEncoding enc₁ enc₂ enc] {f : α → β₁} {g : α → β₂}
+    (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn enc₁ d₁ e₁)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInDegree g encIn enc₂ d₂ e₂) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn enc (max d₁ d₂) (max d₁ d₂) := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩, -⟩ := hf
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩, -⟩ := hg
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := hP.pair_mono h₁ h₂
+  have ht := (((ht₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (ht₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))).add_const
+    1).smul c
+  refine of_bounds ht (((((hs₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add
+    (hs₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))).add ht).add_const 1).smul c)
+    (h.mono (fun _ => le_rfl) (fun x => Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ?_))
+  have := h.length_le x
+  omega
+
+/-- Pairing with the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem prod {α β₁ β₂ : Type u} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {f : α → β₁} {g : α → β₂} (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn enc₁ d₁ e₁)
+    (hg : ComputableTidilyInDegree g encIn enc₂ d₂ e₂) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (f x, g x)) encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) (max d₁ d₂)
+      (max e₁ e₂) :=
+  ⟨(hf.pair hg).1, ((((hf.2.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).smul 2).add_const 1).add
+    (hg.2.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))).mono fun x => by simp⟩
+
+/-- The first projection of the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem fst {β₁ β₂ : Type u} (enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree Prod.fst (encPair enc₁ enc₂) enc₁ 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (.of_unframe fun p => by simp)
+
+/-- The second projection of the framed encoding of pairs. -/
+public theorem snd {β₁ β₂ : Type u} (enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool) (enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree Prod.snd (encPair enc₁ enc₂) enc₂ 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (.of_dropFrame fun p => by simp)
+
+/-- The first component of a pair computed with given degrees. -/
+public theorem fst' {α β₁ β₂ : Type u} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {f : α → β₁ × β₂} (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) d e) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (f x).1) encIn enc₁ (max d e) e :=
+  ((fst enc₁ enc₂).comp h).mono
+
+/-- The second component of a pair computed with given degrees. -/
+public theorem snd' {α β₁ β₂ : Type u} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {enc₁ : β₁ ↪ List Bool} {enc₂ : β₂ ↪ List Bool}
+    {f : α → β₁ × β₂} (h : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn (encPair enc₁ enc₂) d e) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (f x).2) encIn enc₂ (max d e) e :=
+  ((snd enc₁ enc₂).comp h).mono
+
+/-- Functions on finite types, in linear time and zero space, with output of constant length. -/
+public theorem of_finite [Finite α] (f : α → β) : ComputableTidilyInDegree f encIn encMid 1 0 := by
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := computableInTimeAndSpace_of_finite (encIn := encIn) (encOut := encMid) f
+  refine ⟨(of_linear ⟨2 * c + 2, h.computableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.mono
+    (fun _ => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos _)) (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _)⟩).1, ?_⟩
+  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with hα | hα
+  · exact ⟨0, fun a => isEmptyElim a⟩
+  · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := Finite.exists_max fun a => (encMid (f a)).length
+    exact ⟨_, fun a => by simpa using ha₀ a⟩
+
+variable {enc₁ : β ↪ List Bool}
+
+/-- `Option.some`. -/
+public theorem optionSome {enc : Option β ↪ List Bool} [OptionEncoding enc₁ enc] :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree some enc₁ enc 1 1 :=
+  of_linear OptionEncoding.some
+
+/-- `Option.getD`. -/
+public theorem getD {enc : Option β ↪ List Bool} [OptionEncoding enc₁ enc] (d : β) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun o => o.getD d) enc enc₁ 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (OptionEncoding.getD d)
+
+/-- `List.headD`. -/
+public theorem headD {enc : List β ↪ List Bool} [ListEncoding enc₁ enc] (d : β) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun l => l.headD d) enc enc₁ 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (ListEncoding.headD d)
+
+/-- `List.tail`. -/
+public theorem tail {enc : List β ↪ List Bool} [ListEncoding enc₁ enc] :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree List.tail enc enc 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (ListEncoding.tail (enc₁ := enc₁))
+
+/-- `List.isEmpty`. -/
+public theorem isEmpty {enc : List β ↪ List Bool} [ListEncoding enc₁ enc] :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree List.isEmpty enc encBool 1 1 :=
+  of_linear (ListEncoding.isEmpty (enc₁ := enc₁))
+
+end ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Left folds with bounds of given degrees
+
+`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.foldl` asks for bounds on the arguments of the
+step function and on the intermediate states paired with the rest of the list. For list encodings
+whose elements, suffixes and lengths are bounded by the encoded list (`SizedListEncoding`), and the
+framed encodings of pairs and options, only a bound on the intermediate states is left.
+
+A fold whose step also needs a fixed parameter, such as a key to look up, keeps the parameter in its
+state (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldlWith`).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.SizedListEncoding`: list encodings that bound their elements, suffixes and
+  lengths.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldl'`: left folds, with the degree of a round
+  plus the degree of the number of rounds.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldlWith`: the same, with a parameter.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+
+/-- A list encoding whose encoded lists are at least as long as their elements, their suffixes and
+their lengths. -/
+public class SizedListEncoding {α : Type*} (encA : α ↪ List Bool) (encL : List α ↪ List Bool) :
+    Prop where
+  length_le (l : List α) : l.length ≤ (encL l).length
+  length_elem_le (l : List α) : ∀ a ∈ l, (encA a).length ≤ (encL l).length
+  length_drop_le (l : List α) (i : ℕ) : (encL (l.drop i)).length ≤ (encL l).length
+
+public instance {α : Type*} (enc : α ↪ List Bool) : SizedListEncoding enc (encList enc) where
+  length_le l := by induction l <;> grind [encList_cons, length_frame]
+  length_elem_le l a ha := by induction l <;> grind [encList_cons, length_frame]
+  length_drop_le l i := by
+    induction l generalizing i <;> cases i <;> grind [encList_cons, length_frame]
+
+public instance : SizedListEncoding encBool encBits where
+  length_le l := by simp
+  length_elem_le l a ha := by
+    simp only [encBool_apply, List.length_singleton, encBits_apply]
+    exact List.length_pos_of_mem ha
+  length_drop_le l i := by simp
+
+/-- **Left folds with bounds of given degrees.** If the list has output degree `eL`, the states have
+length of degree `b`, and a round has degree `dS`, a fold takes time of degree
+`eL + max 1 dS * max b eL`: at most `O(n ^ eL)` rounds, on arguments of length `O(n ^ max b eL)`. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldl' {γ α β : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
+    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
+    [ListEncoding encA encL] [hS : SizedListEncoding encA encL]
+    {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : β → α → β} {dL eL dI eI dS eS b : ℕ}
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn encL dL eL)
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInDegree init encIn encB dI eI)
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : β × α => step p.1 p.2) (encPair encB encA) encB
+      dS eS)
+    {B : γ → ℕ} (hB : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) B b)
+    (hstates : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
+      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).foldl step (init x)) encIn encB
+      (max (max dL dI) (eL + max 1 dS * max b eL)) b := by
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, s₁, ht₁, hs₁, h₁⟩, hl⟩ := hlist
+  obtain ⟨⟨t₂, s₂, ht₂, hs₂, h₂⟩, -⟩ := hinit
+  obtain ⟨⟨tS, sS, ⟨ct, htS⟩, ⟨cs, hsS⟩, hS'⟩, -⟩ := hstep
+  set a := max b eL
+  set D := max 1 dS * a
+  -- the arguments of a round and the states with the rest of the list
+  have haMax : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
+      (fun x => 2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length) a :=
+    ((hB.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).smul 2 |>.add_const 1).add (hl.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))
+  have hlMax : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
+      (fun x => 2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x) a :=
+    ((hl.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _)).smul 2 |>.add_const 1).add (hB.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _))
+  have hround {c : ℕ} : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length)
+      (fun x => c * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS) D :=
+    (DegreeBounded.comp (size' := id) (v := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ dS) ⟨c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩
+      haMax).mono_deg (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_right _ _))
+  have hargs : ∀ x i (hi : i < (list x).length),
+      (encPair encB encA (((list x).take i).foldl step (init x), (list x)[i])).length ≤
+        2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length := fun x i hi => by
+    have h₁ := hstates x i hi.le
+    have h₂ := hS.length_elem_le (list x) _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
+    simp only [length_encPair]
+    omega
+  have hrest : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
+      (encPair encL encB ((list x).drop i, ((list x).take i).foldl step (init x))).length ≤
+        2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x := fun x i hi => by
+    have h₁ := hstates x i hi
+    have h₂ := hS.length_drop_le (list x) i
+    simp only [length_encPair]
+    omega
+  have haD : a ≤ D := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_pos (le_max_left _ _))
+  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.foldl (encA := encA) (encL := encL)
+    (encBA := encPair encB encA) (encS := encPair encL encB)
+    (encO := encOption (encPair encL encB))
+    (h₁.mono (t' := fun x => t₁ x + t₂ x) (s' := fun x => s₁ x + s₂ x)
+      (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _))
+    (h₂.mono (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _) (fun _ => Nat.le_add_left _ _)) hS'
+    (tMax := fun x => ct * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS)
+    (sMax := fun x => cs * (2 * B x + 1 + (encL (list x)).length + 1) ^ dS)
+    (lMax := fun x => 2 * (encL (list x)).length + 1 + B x)
+    (fun x i hi => (htS _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left ct (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
+      (Nat.add_le_add_right (hargs x i hi) 1) dS)))
+    (fun x i hi => (hsS _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left cs (Nat.pow_le_pow_left
+      (Nat.add_le_add_right (hargs x i hi) 1) dS))) hrest
+  · have hd₀ : max dL dI ≤ max (max dL dI) (eL + D) := le_max_left _ _
+    have hd₁ : eL + D ≤ max (max dL dI) (eL + D) := le_max_right _ _
+    have hlen : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) (fun x => (list x).length + 1) eL :=
+      (hl.add_const 1).mono fun x => Nat.add_le_add_right (hS.length_le _) 1
+    have ht := (ht₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (ht₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))
+    have hs := (hs₁.mono_deg (le_max_left _ _)).add (hs₂.mono_deg (le_max_right _ _))
+    refine ⟨⟨_, _, ((ht.mono_deg hd₀).add ((hlen.mul ((hround.add (hlMax.mono_deg haD)).add_const
+      1)).mono_deg hd₁)).smul c, ((((hs.mono_deg hd₀).add (hround.mono_deg (by omega))).add
+        (hlMax.mono_deg (by omega))).add_const 1).smul c, h⟩, hB.mono fun x => ?_⟩
+    simpa using hstates x _ le_rfl
+
+/-- **Left folds with a parameter, with bounds of given degrees.** The step may depend on a
+parameter `par x`, which is kept in the state. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldlWith {γ α β π : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
+    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {encL : List α ↪ List Bool}
+    {encP : π ↪ List Bool} [ListEncoding encA encL] [SizedListEncoding encA encL]
+    {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α} {init : γ → β} {step : π → β → α → β}
+    {dP eP dL eL dI eI dS eS b : ℕ}
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInDegree par encIn encP dP eP)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn encL dL eL)
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInDegree init encIn encB dI eI)
+    (hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : (π × β) × α => step p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
+      (encPair (encPair encP encB) encA) encB dS eS)
+    {B : γ → ℕ} (hB : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) B b)
+    (hstates : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ (list x).length,
+      (encB (((list x).take i).foldl (step (par x)) (init x))).length ≤ B x) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).foldl (step (par x)) (init x)) encIn encB
+      (max (max dL (max dP dI)) (eL + max 1 dS * max (max eP b) eL)) b := by
+  -- fold over the state `(par x, acc)`, keeping the parameter unchanged
+  have heq (l : List α) (s : π × β) :
+      l.foldl (fun s a => (s.1, step s.1 s.2 a)) s = (s.1, l.foldl (step s.1) s.2) := by
+    induction l generalizing s <;> simp [*]
+  have hfold := ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldl' (encB := encPair encP encB) hlist
+    (hpar.prod hinit) (step := fun s a => (s.1, step s.1 s.2 a))
+    (((ComputableTidilyInDegree.fst encP encB).comp
+      (ComputableTidilyInDegree.fst (encPair encP encB) encA)).prod hstep)
+    (B := fun x => 2 * (encP (par x)).length + 1 + B x)
+    ((((hpar.2.mono_deg (le_max_left eP b)).smul 2).add_const 1).add
+      (hB.mono_deg (le_max_right eP b)))
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      have := hstates x i hi
+      rw [heq]
+      simp only [length_encPair]
+      omega)
+  have h := (ComputableTidilyInDegree.snd encP encB).comp hfold
+  have hf : (Prod.snd ∘ fun x => (list x).foldl (fun s a => (s.1, step s.1 s.2 a))
+      (par x, init x)) = fun x => (list x).foldl (step (par x)) (init x) := by
+    funext x
+    simp [heq]
+  rw [hf, show max 1 (max (max 1 (1 * 1)) dS) = max 1 dS by omega, Nat.mul_one] at h
+  have hY : max eP b ≤ max (max dL (max dP dI)) (eL + max 1 dS * max (max eP b) eL) :=
+    le_max_of_le_right (le_add_left ((le_max_left _ eL).trans
+      (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_pos (le_max_left _ _)))))
+  exact ⟨(h.mono (max_le le_rfl hY) le_rfl).1, hB.mono fun x => by simpa using hstates x _ le_rfl⟩
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+module
+-- upstream: vendored crei:crei/tidy-universal @7f7c0696 (unsubmitted)

+import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

+/-!
+# List operations with bounds of given degrees
+
+Operations on lists encoded by `Turing.MultiTapeTM.encList`, with explicit degrees
+(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree`): adding an element at either end and concatenation
+in linear time; finding the first element that passes a test and keeping the elements that pass a
+test, one degree above the test; and dropping a number of elements in quadratic time. The tests may
+depend on a parameter.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.cons`, `.snoc`, `.listAppend`.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.findWith`: the first element passing a test.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.filterWith`: the elements passing a test.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.dropUnary`: dropping a number of elements, given
+  in unary.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {α : Type}
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encList_append (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (l₁ l₂ : List α) :
+    encList enc (l₁ ++ l₂) = encList enc l₁ ++ encList enc l₂ := by
+  induction l₁ <;> simp [*]
+
+/-- A prefix is no longer than the list. -/
+public lemma length_encList_take_le (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (l : List α) (i : ℕ) :
+    (encList enc (l.take i)).length ≤ (encList enc l).length := by
+  have := congrArg List.length (encList_append enc (l.take i) (l.drop i))
+  rw [List.take_append_drop, List.length_append] at this
+  omega
+
+/-- An element is no longer than the encoded list. -/
+public lemma length_le_encList_of_mem (enc : α ↪ List Bool) {l : List α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ l) :
+    (enc a).length ≤ (encList enc l).length := by
+  induction l <;> grind [encList_cons, length_frame]
+
+/-- The number of elements is at most the length of the encoded list. -/
+public lemma length_le_length_encList (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (l : List α) :
+    l.length ≤ (encList enc l).length := by
+  induction l <;> grind [encList_cons, length_frame]
+
+/-- The element found in a list is no longer than the encoded list. -/
+public lemma length_encOption_find?_le (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
+    (encOption enc (l.find? p)).length ≤ (encList enc l).length + 1 := by
+  rcases h : l.find? p with _ | a
+  · simp
+  · simpa using length_le_encList_of_mem enc (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h)
+
+/-- A list of elements of bounded size has bounded size. -/
+public lemma length_encList_le (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (l : List α) {b : ℕ}
+    (h : ∀ a ∈ l, (enc a).length ≤ b) : (encList enc l).length ≤ l.length * (2 * b + 1) := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    have h₁ := h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
+    have h₂ := ih fun a ha => h a (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha)
+    simp only [encList_cons, List.length_append, length_frame, List.length_cons]
+    nlinarith
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+variable {γ : Type} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
+
+/-- Adding an element in front: the identity on encoded words. -/
+public theorem cons (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : α × List α => p.1 :: p.2) (encPair enc (encList enc))
+      (encList enc) 1 1 :=
+  of_eq fun _ => rfl
+
+/-- Adding an element at the end. -/
+public theorem snoc (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : List α × α => p.1 ++ [p.2]) (encPair (encList enc) enc)
+      (encList enc) 1 1 :=
+  ((fst (encList enc) enc).append ((of_linear
+    (ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_frame (f := id) (encIn := enc)
+      (encOut := encFramed enc) fun _ => rfl)).comp (snd (encList enc) enc))
+    (enc₂ := encFramed enc) fun _ => by simp).mono
+
+/-- Concatenation. -/
+public theorem listAppend (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : List α × List α => p.1 ++ p.2)
+      (encPair (encList enc) (encList enc)) (encList enc) 1 1 :=
+  ((fst (encList enc) (encList enc)).append (snd (encList enc) (encList enc))
+    fun _ => by simp).mono
+
+/-! ### Finding and filtering -/
+
+variable {π : Type} {encP : π ↪ List Bool} {enc : α ↪ List Bool} {dt et dP eP dL : ℕ}
+
+/-- One step of finding the first element passing the test `t`. -/
+@[expose] public def findStep (t : π × α → Bool) (p : π) (acc : Option α) (a : α) : Option α :=
+  if acc.isSome then acc else if t (p, a) then some a else none
+
+public lemma foldl_findStep (t : π × α → Bool) (p : π) (l : List α) (acc : Option α) :
+    l.foldl (findStep t p) acc = acc.or (l.find? fun a => t (p, a)) := by
+  induction l generalizing acc <;> cases acc <;> grind [findStep]
+
+/-- The first element of `list x` passing the test `t` with the parameter `par x`, for a list of
+linear size. -/
+public theorem findWith {t : π × α → Bool} {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α}
+    (ht : ComputableTidilyInDegree t (encPair encP enc) encBool dt et)
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInDegree par encIn encP dP eP)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn (encList enc) dL 1) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).find? fun a => t (par x, a)) encIn
+      (encOption enc) (max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP)) 1 := by
+  -- the step, as a function of `((p, acc), a)`
+  have hq := fst (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc
+  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc
+  have hisSome := (of_finite (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool) (fun b : Bool => !b)).comp
+    ((of_linear (ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_isEmpty (encIn := encOption enc)
+      (f := fun o : Option α => o.isNone) fun o => by cases o <;> simp)).comp hq.snd')
+  have h := hisSome.ite (hq.snd'.restrict _) ((ht.comp (hq.fst'.prod hel)).ite
+    (((optionSome (enc₁ := enc)).comp hel).restrict _) ((const none).restrict _) |>.restrict _)
+  simp only [max_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at h
+  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun q : (π × Option α) × α => findStep t q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
+      (encPair (encPair encP (encOption enc)) enc) (encOption enc) (max 1 dt) 1 := by
+    convert h.mono (d' := max 1 dt) (e' := 1) using 1
+    funext ⟨⟨p, acc⟩, a⟩
+    simp only [findStep, Function.comp_apply]
+    cases acc <;> simp
+  have hfold := foldlWith (encL := encList enc) (encB := encOption enc) hpar hlist
+    (const none) hstep (B := fun x => (encList enc (list x)).length + 1) (hlist.2.add_const 1)
+    (fun x i hi => ?_)
+  · convert hfold.mono (d' := max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP)) (e' := 1)
+      (max_le (by have := le_max_right (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP); omega)
+        (le_max_of_le_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)) 1))) using 1
+    funext x
+    rw [foldl_findStep]
+    rfl
+  · rw [foldl_findStep, Option.none_or]
+    rcases h : (List.take i (list x)).find? (fun a => t (par x, a)) with _ | a
+    · simp
+    · have hmem := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h
+      have := length_le_encList_of_mem enc hmem
+      have := length_encList_take_le enc (list x) i
+      simp only [encOption_some, List.length_cons]
+      omega
+
+/-- One step of keeping the elements that pass the test `t`. -/
+@[expose] public def filterStep (t : π × α → Bool) (p : π) (acc : List α) (a : α) : List α :=
+  if t (p, a) then acc ++ [a] else acc
+
+public lemma foldl_filterStep (t : π × α → Bool) (p : π) (l acc : List α) :
+    l.foldl (filterStep t p) acc = acc ++ l.filter fun a => t (p, a) := by
+  induction l generalizing acc <;> grind [filterStep]
+
+public lemma length_encList_filter_le (enc : α ↪ List Bool) (f : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
+    (encList enc (l.filter f)).length ≤ (encList enc l).length := by
+  induction l with
+  | nil => simp
+  | cons a l ih => by_cases h : f a <;> simp [h] <;> omega
+
+/-- The elements of `list x` passing the test `t` with the parameter `par x`, for a list of linear
+size. -/
+public theorem filterWith {t : π × α → Bool} {par : γ → π} {list : γ → List α}
+    (ht : ComputableTidilyInDegree t (encPair encP enc) encBool dt et)
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInDegree par encIn encP dP eP)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn (encList enc) dL 1) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).filter fun a => t (par x, a)) encIn
+      (encList enc) (max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP)) 1 := by
+  have hq := fst (encPair encP (encList enc)) enc
+  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encList enc)) enc
+  have h := (ht.comp (hq.fst'.prod hel)).ite (((snoc enc).comp (hq.snd'.prod hel)).restrict _)
+    (hq.snd'.restrict _)
+  simp only [max_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at h
+  have hstep : ComputableTidilyInDegree
+      (fun q : (π × List α) × α => filterStep t q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
+      (encPair (encPair encP (encList enc)) enc) (encList enc) (max 1 dt) 1 := by
+    convert h.mono (d' := max 1 dt) (e' := 1) using 1
+    funext ⟨⟨p, acc⟩, a⟩
+    simp [filterStep]
+  have hfold := foldlWith (encL := encList enc) (encB := encList enc) hpar hlist
+    (const []) hstep (B := fun x => (encList enc (list x)).length) hlist.2
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      rw [foldl_filterStep, List.nil_append]
+      exact (length_encList_filter_le enc _ _).trans (length_encList_take_le enc _ _))
+  convert hfold.mono (d' := max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP)) (e' := 1)
+    (max_le (by have := le_max_right (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 dt * max 1 eP); omega)
+      (le_max_of_le_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)) 1))) using 1
+  funext x
+  rw [foldl_filterStep, List.nil_append]
+
+/-- Dropping the first `n` elements, with `n` in unary. -/
+public theorem dropUnary (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : List α × ℕ => p.1.drop p.2)
+      (encPair (encList enc) encUnary) (encList enc) 2 1 := by
+  have hrep (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : (List.replicate n true).foldl (fun acc _ => acc.tail) l =
+      l.drop n := by
+    simp [List.foldl_const, List.tail_iterate]
+  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encList enc)
+    (list := fun p : List α × ℕ => List.replicate p.2 true) (step := fun acc _ => acc.tail)
+    ((of_eq (f := fun n => List.replicate n true) (encIn := encUnary) (encMid := encBits)
+      fun _ => rfl).comp (snd (encList enc) encUnary))
+    (fst (encList enc) encUnary)
+    ((tail (enc₁ := enc)).comp (fst (encList enc) encBool))
+    (B := fun p => (encPair (encList enc) encUnary p).length) .self (fun p i hi => by
+      rw [List.take_replicate, hrep]
+      have := SizedListEncoding.length_drop_le (encA := enc) (encL := encList enc) p.1
+        (min i p.2)
+      simp only [length_encPair]
+      omega)
+  convert hfold.mono (d' := 2) (e' := 1) using 1
+  funext p
+  rw [hrep]
+
+/-- One step of mapping with the parameter `p`. -/
+@[expose] public def mapStep {β : Type} (f : π × α → β) (p : π) (acc : List β) (a : α) :
+    List β :=
+  acc ++ [f (p, a)]
+
+public lemma foldl_mapStep {β : Type} (f : π × α → β) (p : π) (l : List α) (acc : List β) :
+    l.foldl (mapStep f p) acc = acc ++ l.map fun a => f (p, a) := by
+  induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [mapStep, *]
+
+/-- Mapping `f` with the parameter `par x` over `list x`, for a parameter and a list of linear
+size. -/
+public theorem mapWith {β : Type} {encB : β ↪ List Bool} {f : π × α → β} {par : γ → π}
+    {list : γ → List α} {df ef : ℕ} (hf : ComputableTidilyInDegree f (encPair encP enc) encB df ef)
+    (hpar : ComputableTidilyInDegree par encIn encP dP 1)
+    (hlist : ComputableTidilyInDegree list encIn (encList enc) dL 1) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun x => (list x).map fun a => f (par x, a)) encIn
+      (encList encB) (max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1))) (ef + 1) := by
+  obtain ⟨c, hcd⟩ := hf.2
+  -- a bound on the encoded images of the elements
+  set S : γ → ℕ := fun x => 2 * (encP (par x)).length + 1 + (encList enc (list x)).length
+  have hS : DegreeBounded (fun x => (encIn x).length) S 1 :=
+    ((hpar.2.smul 2).add_const 1).add hlist.2
+  have himg (x : γ) (a : α) (ha : a ∈ list x) : (encB (f (par x, a))).length ≤ c * (S x + 1) ^ ef :=
+    (hcd _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by
+      have := length_le_encList_of_mem enc ha
+      simp only [length_encPair, S]
+      omega) ef))
+  have hq := fst (encPair encP (encList encB)) enc
+  have hel := snd (encPair encP (encList encB)) enc
+  have hfold := foldlWith (encL := encList enc) (encB := encList encB) hpar hlist
+    (const []) (step := mapStep f) ((snoc encB).comp (hq.snd'.prod (hf.comp (hq.fst'.prod hel))))
+    (B := fun x => (encList enc (list x)).length * (2 * (c * (S x + 1) ^ ef) + 1))
+    (hlist.2.mul (((DegreeBounded.comp (size' := id) (v := fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ ef)
+      ⟨c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩ hS).smul 2).add_const 1))
+    (fun x i hi => by
+      rw [foldl_mapStep, List.nil_append]
+      refine (length_encList_le encB _ (b := c * (S x + 1) ^ ef) fun b hb => ?_).trans ?_
+      · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
+        exact himg x a (List.mem_of_mem_take ha)
+      · refine Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ?_
+        have := length_le_length_encList enc (list x)
+        simp only [List.length_map, List.length_take]
+        omega)
+  simp only [max_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one] at hfold
+  convert hfold.mono (d' := max (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1))) (e' := ef + 1)
+    (max_le (by have := le_max_right (max dL dP) (1 + max 1 (max df ef) * (ef + 1)); omega)
+      (le_max_of_le_right (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)) 1)))
+    (by omega) using 1
+  funext x
+  rw [foldl_mapStep, List.nil_append]
+
+/-! ### Arithmetic on unary numbers and integers -/
+
+/-- Truncated subtraction of unary numbers. -/
+public theorem unary_sub :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 - p.2) (encPair encUnary encUnary)
+      encUnary 2 1 := by
+  have hrep (a b : ℕ) : (List.replicate b true).foldl (fun n _ => n - 1) a = a - b := by
+    induction b generalizing a with
+    | zero => rfl
+    | succ b ih => rw [List.replicate_succ, List.foldl_cons, ih]; omega
+  have hfold := foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits) (encB := encUnary)
+    (list := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => List.replicate p.2 true) (step := fun n _ => n - 1)
+    ((of_eq (f := fun n => List.replicate n true) (encIn := encUnary) (encMid := encBits)
+      fun _ => rfl).comp (snd encUnary encUnary))
+    (fst encUnary encUnary) (unary_pred.comp (fst encUnary encBool))
+    (B := fun p => (encPair encUnary encUnary p).length) .self (fun p i hi => by
+      rw [List.take_replicate, hrep]
+      simp only [encPair_apply, encUnary_apply, List.length_append, length_frame,
+        List.length_replicate]

+/-- The encoded value of a function computable in polynomial time has polynomial length. -/
+public theorem polyBounded_length {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encIn encMid) :
+    PolyBounded (fun a => (encIn a).length) fun a => (encMid (f a)).length :=
+  let ⟨_, _, ht, _, hf⟩ := h

+public theorem of_linear {f : α → β} (h : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encMid) :
+    ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encIn encMid :=
+  let ⟨c, hc⟩ := h

+public theorem comp {f : β → γ} {g : α → β} (hf : ComputableTidilyInPolyTime f encMid encOut)

+  exact ⟨_, _, (ht₁.add (ht₂.comp hl)).add hm, (hs₁.add (hs₂.comp hl)).add hm, h⟩

+/-- Encodings that convert into each other in polynomial time. -/
+public def EncodingEquiv {α : Type*} (enc₁ enc₂ : α ↪ List Bool) : Prop :=
+  ComputableTidilyInPolyTime id enc₁ enc₂ ∧ ComputableTidilyInPolyTime id enc₂ enc₁

+namespace EncodingEquiv

+variable {α β : Type*} {enc₁ enc₂ enc₃ : α ↪ List Bool}

+@[refl]
+public theorem refl (enc : α ↪ List Bool) : EncodingEquiv enc enc :=
+  ⟨.of_eq fun _ => rfl, .of_eq fun _ => rfl⟩

+@[symm]
+public theorem symm (h : EncodingEquiv enc₁ enc₂) : EncodingEquiv enc₂ enc₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

+@[trans]
+public theorem trans (h₁₂ : EncodingEquiv enc₁ enc₂) (h₂₃ : EncodingEquiv enc₂ enc₃) :
+    EncodingEquiv enc₁ enc₃ :=
+  ⟨h₂₃.1.comp h₁₂.1, h₁₂.2.comp h₂₃.2⟩

+/-- Polynomial-time computability does not depend on the encodings, up to equivalence. -/
+public theorem computableTidilyInPolyTime_iff {encIn encIn' : α ↪ List Bool}
+    {encOut encOut' : β ↪ List Bool} (hIn : EncodingEquiv encIn encIn')
