+/-!
+# Basic functions with bounds of given degrees
+
+Functions on unary numbers and integers, in linear time and space, and equality tests, in quadratic
+time and space.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.encUnary`: natural numbers in unary.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.encInt`: integers as a sign followed by a unary magnitude.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInDegree.eq`: equality, for any encoding.
+* successor, predecessor and zero test in unary, and adding one or subtracting one on integers.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-! ### Unary numbers -/
+
+/-- Natural numbers in unary: `n` is encoded by `n` ones. -/
+@[expose] public def encUnary : ℕ ↪ List Bool :=
+  ⟨fun n => List.replicate n true, fun m n h => by simpa using congrArg List.length h⟩
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encUnary_apply (n : ℕ) : encUnary n = List.replicate n true := rfl
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+public theorem unary_succ : ComputableTidilyInDegree (· + 1) encUnary encUnary 1 1 :=
+  .of_linear (.of_cons_true fun n => by simp [List.replicate_succ])
+
+public theorem unary_pred : ComputableTidilyInDegree (· - 1) encUnary encUnary 1 1 :=
+  .of_linear (.of_tail fun n => by cases n <;> simp [List.replicate_succ])
+
+public theorem unary_isZero :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun n => decide (n = 0)) encUnary encBool 1 1 :=
+  .of_linear (.of_isEmpty fun n => by cases n <;> simp [List.replicate_succ])
+
+end ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+/-! ### Integers -/
+
+/-- Integers: `false` followed by `n` in unary for `n ≥ 0`, and `true` followed by `n` in unary for
+`-(n + 1)`. -/
+@[expose] public def encInt : ℤ ↪ List Bool :=
+  ⟨fun z => match z with
+    | .ofNat n => false :: List.replicate n true
+    | .negSucc n => true :: List.replicate n true,
+   fun a b h => by
+    cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [List.replicate_inj]⟩
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encInt_ofNat (n : ℕ) : encInt (Int.ofNat n) = false :: List.replicate n true := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encInt_natCast (n : ℕ) : encInt (n : ℤ) = false :: List.replicate n true := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encInt_zero : encInt 0 = [false] := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encInt_natCast_add_one (n : ℕ) :
+    encInt ((n : ℤ) + 1) = false :: true :: List.replicate n true :=
+  rfl
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma encInt_negSucc (n : ℕ) : encInt (Int.negSucc n) = true :: List.replicate n true :=
+  rfl
+
+public lemma length_encInt (z : ℤ) :
+    (encInt z).length = if z < 0 then (-z).toNat else z.toNat + 1 := by
+  rcases z with n | n <;> simp [Int.negSucc_lt_zero]
+
+namespace EncInt
+
+/-- Adds one to an encoded integer. -/
+@[simps q₀ step final]
+def succT : Transducer Bool (Fin 3) where
+  q₀ := 0
+  step q b := match q, b with
+    | 0, false => (2, [false, true])
+    | 0, true => (1, [])
+    | 1, b => (2, [b])
+    | _, b => (2, [b])
+  final q := if q = 1 then [false] else []
+  length_step_le q b := by fin_cases q <;> cases b <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by split_ifs <;> simp
+
+/-- Subtracts one from an encoded integer. -/
+@[simps q₀ step final]
+def predT : Transducer Bool (Fin 3) where
+  q₀ := 0
+  step q b := match q, b with
+    | 0, false => (1, [])
+    | 0, true => (2, [true, true])
+    | 1, _ => (2, [false])
+    | _, b => (2, [b])
+  final q := if q = 1 then [true] else []
+  length_step_le q b := by fin_cases q <;> cases b <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by split_ifs <;> simp
+
+lemma run_copy (T : Transducer Bool (Fin 3)) (hT : ∀ b, T.step 2 b = (2, [b]))
+    (hf : T.final 2 = []) (w : List Bool) : T.run 2 w = w := by
+  induction w with
+  | nil => simp [hf]
+  | cons b w ih => simp [hT, ih]
+
+end EncInt
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+open EncInt in
+public theorem int_succ : ComputableTidilyInDegree (· + 1) encInt encInt 1 1 := by
+  refine .of_linear (succT.computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun z => ?_)
+  have hc := run_copy succT (fun b => by cases b <;> rfl) rfl
+  rcases z with n | _ | n
+  · simp [hc]
+  · rfl
+  · change encInt (Int.negSucc n) = _
+    simp [hc, List.replicate_succ]
+
+open EncInt in
+public theorem int_pred : ComputableTidilyInDegree (· - 1) encInt encInt 1 1 := by
+  refine .of_linear (predT.computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun z => ?_)
+  have hc := run_copy predT (fun b => by cases b <;> rfl) rfl
+  rcases z with (_ | n) | n
+  · rfl
+  · simp [hc]
+  · simp [hc, List.replicate_succ]
+
+end ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+/-! ### Equality -/
+
+namespace EqWords
+
+/-- One step of comparing a word with `s.1`, the part of the other word still to be matched;
+`s.2` records whether the words agree so far. -/
+@[expose] public def step (s : List Bool × Bool) (b : Bool) : List Bool × Bool :=
+  (s.1.tail, s.2 && !s.1.isEmpty && (s.1.headD false == b))
+
+public lemma foldl_fst (l r : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
+    (l.foldl step (r, ok)).1 = r.drop l.length := by
+  induction l generalizing r ok with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    cases r <;> simp [step, ih]
+
+public lemma foldl_result (l r : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
+    ((l.foldl step (r, ok)).2 && (l.foldl step (r, ok)).1.isEmpty) = (ok && decide (l = r)) := by
+  induction l generalizing r ok with
+  | nil => cases r <;> simp
+  | cons b l ih =>
+    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
+    cases r <;> grind [step]
+
+end EqWords
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+/-- A step of comparing words. -/
+public theorem eqWordsStep : ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun q : (List Bool × Bool) × Bool =>
+    EqWords.step q.1 q.2) (encPair (encPair encBits encBool) encBool) (encPair encBits encBool)
+    1 1 := by
+  -- the rest of the second word, and the facts it is compared by
+  have hq := fst (encPair encBits encBool) encBool
+  have hrest := hq.fst'
+  have hlast := ((headD (enc₁ := encBool) false).comp hrest).pair
+    (snd (encPair encBits encBool) encBool) (enc := encPair encBool encBool)
+  have hfacts := hq.snd'.prod (((isEmpty (enc₁ := encBool)).comp hrest).prod hlast)
+  exact (((tail (enc₁ := encBool)).comp hrest).prod
+    ((of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool (encPair encBool (encPair encBool encBool)))
+      (encMid := encBool) fun t : Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool =>
+        t.1 && !t.2.1 && (t.2.2.1 == t.2.2.2)).comp hfacts)).mono
+
+/-- The result of comparing words, from the state after the last step. -/
+public theorem eqWordsResult :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun s : List Bool × Bool => s.2 && s.1.isEmpty)
+      (encPair encBits encBool) encBool 1 0 :=
+  ((of_finite (encIn := encPair encBool encBool) (encMid := encBool)
+    fun t : Bool × Bool => t.1 && t.2).comp ((snd encBits encBool).prod
+      ((isEmpty (enc₁ := encBool)).comp (fst encBits encBool)))).mono
+
+/-- Equality of words. -/
+public theorem eqWords :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => decide (p.1 = p.2))
+      (encPair encBits encBits) encBool 2 0 := by
+  have hfold := ComputableTidilyInDegree.foldl' (encA := encBool) (encL := encBits)
+    (encB := encPair encBits encBool) (fst encBits encBits)
+    ((snd encBits encBits).prod (const true)) eqWordsStep
+    (B := fun p => 2 * (encPair encBits encBits p).length + 2)
+    ((DegreeBounded.self.smul 2).add_const 2)
+    (fun p i hi => by
+      rw [show ((p.1.take i).foldl EqWords.step (p.2, true)) =
+        ((p.2.drop (p.1.take i).length), ((p.1.take i).foldl EqWords.step (p.2, true)).2) from
+          Prod.ext (EqWords.foldl_fst _ _ _) rfl]
+      simp only [encPair_apply, encBits_apply, encBool_apply, List.length_append, length_frame,
+        List.length_drop, List.length_singleton]
+      omega)
+  have h : ComputableTidilyInDegree (_ ∘ _) _ encBool 2 0 := (eqWordsResult.comp hfold).mono
+  convert h using 1
+  funext p
+  simpa using (EqWords.foldl_result p.1 p.2 true).symm
+
+/-- Equality, for any encoding. -/
+public theorem eq {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (enc : α ↪ List Bool) :
+    ComputableTidilyInDegree (fun p : α × α => decide (p.1 = p.2)) (encPair enc enc) encBool
+      2 0 := by
+  have h : ComputableTidilyInDegree (_ ∘ _) _ encBool 2 0 := (eqWords.comp (of_eq
+    (f := fun p : α × α => (enc p.1, enc p.2)) (encIn := encPair enc enc)
+    (encMid := encPair encBits encBits) fun _ => rfl)).mono
+  convert h using 1
+  funext p
+  simp [enc.injective.eq_iff]
+
+end ComputableTidilyInDegree
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Folds behind a finite-state translator
+
+A translator reads bits and emits, for each bit, at most one event, with a finite state in between.
+A fold over the events of a word is a fold over its bits, whose state also holds the state of the
+translator: each bit steps the translator and, if it emits an event, steps the inner fold. This
+turns a fold over a convenient encoding into a fold over another one, at the cost of a constant
+amount of state, so it applies to streaming and multi-pass folds alike.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Translator`: finite-state translators from bits to events.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Translator.lift`: the step of a fold on bits from one on events.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.Translator.foldl_lift`: the lifted fold folds over the events.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInO.lift`: the lifted step is tidily computable.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+/-- A translator from bits to events: from each state, a bit leads to a state and at most one
+event. -/
+public structure Translator (Q E : Type*) where
+  /-- The initial state. -/
+  q₀ : Q
+  /-- The next state and the emitted event, if any. -/
+  step : Q → Bool → Q × Option E
+
+namespace Translator
+
+variable {Q E σ : Type*} (tr : Translator Q E)
+
+/-- The state and the events after reading `w` from the state `q`. -/
+@[expose] public def run : Q → List Bool → Q × List E
+  | q, [] => (q, [])
+  | q, b :: w => ((run (tr.step q b).1 w).1, (tr.step q b).2.toList ++ (run (tr.step q b).1 w).2)
+
+/-- The events of `w`. -/
+@[expose] public def events (w : List Bool) : List E := (tr.run tr.q₀ w).2
+
+/-- The step of a fold on bits from the step `next` of a fold on events: step the translator and,
+if it emits an event, the fold. -/
+@[expose] public def lift (next : σ × E → σ) (p : (Q × σ) × Bool) : Q × σ :=
+  ((tr.step p.1.1 p.2).1, (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2.elim p.1.2 fun e => next (p.1.2, e))
+
+/-- **The lifted fold** folds over the events, and ends in the state of the translator. -/
+public theorem foldl_lift (next : σ × E → σ) (q : Q) (s : σ) (w : List Bool) :
+    w.foldl (fun p b => tr.lift next (p, b)) (q, s) =
+      ((tr.run q w).1, (tr.run q w).2.foldl (fun s e => next (s, e)) s) := by
+  induction w generalizing q s with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons b w ih =>
+    rw [List.foldl_cons, lift, ih, run]
+    cases (tr.step q b).2 <;> simp
+
+public lemma run_append (q : Q) (u v : List Bool) :
+    tr.run q (u ++ v) =
+      ((tr.run (tr.run q u).1 v).1, (tr.run q u).2 ++ (tr.run (tr.run q u).1 v).2) := by
+  induction u generalizing q with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons b u ih => simp [run, ih]
+
+/-- The events of a prefix are a prefix of the events. -/
+public lemma run_take (q : Q) (w : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
+    (tr.run q w).2.take (tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length = (tr.run q (w.take k)).2 := by
+  conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop k w, run_append]
+  simp
+
+/-- The bit at position `k` emits the next event, if any. -/
+public lemma run_take_succ (q : Q) (w : List Bool) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < w.length) :
+    tr.run q (w.take (k + 1)) = ((tr.step (tr.run q (w.take k)).1 w[k]).1,
+      (tr.run q (w.take k)).2 ++ (tr.step (tr.run q (w.take k)).1 w[k]).2.toList) := by
+  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hk, run_append]
+  simp [run]
+
+/-- The lifted fold after `k` bits: the state of the translator, and the inner fold after the
+events of the first `k` bits. -/
+public lemma streamState_lift (next : σ × E → σ) (q : Q) (s : σ) (w : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
+    streamState (q, s) (tr.lift next) w k = ((tr.run q (w.take k)).1,
+      streamState s next (tr.run q w).2 (tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length) := by
+  rw [streamState, foldl_lift, streamState, run_take]
+
+/-- The passes of the lifted fold, which restart the translator, are those of the inner fold on
+the events. -/
+public lemma passState_lift (init : σ) (next : σ × E → σ) (passEnd : σ → σ) (w : List Bool)
+    (i : ℕ) : passState (tr.q₀, init) (tr.lift next) (fun p => (tr.q₀, passEnd p.2)) w i =
+      (tr.q₀, passState init next passEnd (tr.events w) i) := by
+  induction i with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ i ih =>
+    rw [passState, ih, streamState_lift, List.take_length, passState]
+    rfl
+
+/-- A bound on the events holds for the event of every bit, if any: the event of bit `k` is the
+event after those of the first `k` bits. -/
+public lemma elim_le (q : Q) (w : List Bool) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < w.length) (F : ℕ → E → ℕ)
+    {m : ℕ} (hF : ∀ j (hj : j < (tr.run q w).2.length), F j (tr.run q w).2[j] ≤ m) :
+    (tr.step (tr.run q (w.take k)).1 w[k]).2.elim 0 (F (tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length) ≤ m := by
+  cases he : (tr.step (tr.run q (w.take k)).1 w[k]).2 with
+  | none => exact Nat.zero_le _
+  | some e =>
+    have h := tr.run_take q w (k + 1)
+    rw [tr.run_take_succ q w hk, he] at h
+    have hj : (tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length < (tr.run q w).2.length := by
+      have := congrArg List.length h
+      simp only [List.length_take, List.length_append, Option.toList_some,
+        List.length_singleton] at this
+      omega
+    have : (tr.run q w).2[(tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length] = e := by
+      have := congrArg (·[(tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length]?) h
+      simp only [List.getElem?_take, ↓reduceIte, Option.toList_some,
+        List.getElem?_append_right le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_singleton] at this
+      simpa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj] using this
+    simpa [this] using hF _ hj
+
+/-- The length of the events of a prefix. -/
+public lemma length_run_take_le (q : Q) (w : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
+    (tr.run q (w.take k)).2.length ≤ (tr.run q w).2.length := by
+  rw [← tr.run_take q w k]
+  exact List.length_take_le' _ _
+
+end Translator
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInO
+
+variable {Q E σ : Type} [Finite Q] [Inhabited E] {encQ : Q ↪ List Bool}
+  {encE : E ↪ List Bool} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool} {next : σ × E → σ} {T S : σ × E → ℕ}
+
+/-- **The lifted step is tidily computable**, within the bounds of the inner step on the emitted
+event, if any, plus the length of its input. -/
+public theorem lift (tr : Translator Q E)
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInO next (encPair encS encE) encS T S) :
+    ComputableTidilyInO (tr.lift next) (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool) (encPair encQ encS)
+      (fun p => (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length +
+        (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2.elim 0 fun e => T (p.1.2, e))
+      (fun p => (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length +
+        (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2.elim 0 fun e => S (p.1.2, e)) := by
+  have hl (p : (Q × σ) × Bool) : (encPair encQ encBool (p.1.1, p.2)).length ≤
+      (encPair (encPair encQ encS) encBool p).length := by
+    simp only [length_encPair, encBool_apply, List.length_singleton]
+    omega
+  have h₁ := fst (encPair encQ encS) encBool
+  have hqb := (fst' h₁).prod (snd (encPair encQ encS) encBool)
+  have hstate := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
+    (encMid := encQ) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).1).inO_one).comp hqb
+  have hsome := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
+    (encMid := encBool) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).2.isSome).inO_one).comp hqb
+  have hevent := ((ComputableTidilyInDegree.of_finite (encIn := encPair encQ encBool)
+    (encMid := encE) fun qb : Q × Bool => (tr.step qb.1 qb.2).2.getD default).inO_one).comp hqb
+  have hs := snd' h₁
+  have hnext := h.comp (hs.prod hevent)
+  have hall := hstate.prod (hsome.ite hnext hs)
+  refine (hall.of_enc_eq (g := tr.lift next) fun p => ?_).mono 20 (fun p => ?_) fun p => ?_
+  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Translator.lift]
+    cases (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2 <;> rfl
+  all_goals
+    have := hl p
+    cases h : (tr.step p.1.1 p.2).2 <;> simp only [Function.comp_apply, h] <;> simp <;> omega
+
+end ComputableTidilyInO
+
+/-! ### Bounds -/
+
+/-- A round of the fold on bits, against the bounds of the fold on events. -/
+lemma round_le (cQ K t l : ℕ) :
+    2 * K * (t + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1) + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1 ≤
+      (2 * K + 1) * (4 * cQ + 7) * (t + l + 1) := by
+  have h1 : t + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1 ≤ (4 * cQ + 7) * (t + l + 1) := by nlinarith
+  rw [Nat.mul_assoc]
+  nlinarith
+
+/-- The time of the fold on bits. -/
+lemma time_le (c cI cF cQ K TI TF t l N P li le : ℕ) (hP : 1 ≤ P) (hli : li ≤ l)
+    (hle : le ≤ 2 * cQ + 1 + l) :
+    c * (cI * (TI + (li + li) + 1) + cF * (le + TF + 1) +
+      P * (N + (N + 1) * (2 * K * (t + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1) + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1))) ≤
+    c * (3 * cI + cF * (2 * cQ + 3) + (2 * K + 1) * (4 * cQ + 7) + 1) *
+      (TI + TF + P * (N + (N + 1) * (t + l + 1))) := by
+  set G := (2 * K + 1) * (4 * cQ + 7)
+  set W := P * (N + (N + 1) * (t + l + 1))
+  have hG : 1 ≤ G := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
+  have hX : t + l + 1 ≤ W := by
+    calc t + l + 1 ≤ (N + 1) * (t + l + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
+      _ ≤ N + (N + 1) * (t + l + 1) := by omega
+      _ ≤ W := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hP
+  have hR : P * (N + (N + 1) * (2 * K * (t + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1) + (4 * cQ + 4 * l + 6) + 1))
+      ≤ G * W := by
+    calc _ ≤ P * (G * N + (N + 1) * (G * (t + l + 1))) := by
+          gcongr
+          · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hG
+          · exact round_le cQ K t l

+lemma headT_run_true (drop : Option Bool) (v : List Bool) :
+    (headT drop).run true v = if drop = some true then [] else v := by
+  induction v <;> rcases drop with _ | _ | _ <;> simp_all
+
+/-- Emits `[true]` on the empty word and `[false]` on every other word. -/
+@[simps q₀ step final]
+def isEmptyT : Transducer Bool Bool where
+  q₀ := false
+  step q _ := (true, if q then [] else [false])
+  final q := if q then [] else [true]
+  length_step_le q _ := by cases q <;> simp
+  length_final_le q := by cases q <;> simp
+
+lemma isEmptyT_run_true (v : List Bool) : isEmptyT.run true v = [] := by
+  induction v <;> simp [*]
+
+end Encodings
+
+open Encodings
+
+namespace ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace

+variable {α β : Type*} {encIn : α ↪ List Bool} {encOut : β ↪ List Bool} {f : α → β}

+/-- Framing an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_frame (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = frame (encIn a)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  frameT.computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a => by rw [h, frameT_run]
+
+/-- Reading the word framed at the start of an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_unframe (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = unframe (encIn a)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  (readFrameT true).computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a =>
+    (h a).trans (readFrameT_run_true _).symm
+
+/-- Dropping the frame at the start of an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_dropFrame (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = dropFrame (encIn a)) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  (readFrameT false).computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a =>
+    (h a).trans (readFrameT_run_false _).symm
+
+/-- Prepending `true` to an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_cons_true (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = true :: encIn a) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  (headT none).computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a => by
+    rw [h]
+    cases encIn a <;> simp [headT_run_true]
+
+/-- Dropping the first symbol of an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_tail (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = (encIn a).tail) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  (headT (some false)).computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a => by
+    rw [h]
+    cases encIn a <;> simp [headT_run_true]
+
+/-- Keeping just the first symbol of an encoded value. -/
+public theorem of_take_one (h : ∀ a, encOut (f a) = (encIn a).take 1) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut :=
+  (headT (some true)).computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a => by
+    rw [h]
+    cases encIn a <;> simp [headT_run_true]
+
+/-- Testing an encoded value for emptiness. -/
+public theorem of_isEmpty {f : α → Bool} (h : ∀ a, f a = (encIn a).isEmpty) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encBool :=
+  isEmptyT.computableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace fun a => by
+    rw [h]
+    cases encIn a <;> simp [isEmptyT_run_true]
+
+/-- A function with a fixed value `d` on the input encoded by the empty word, and tidily computable
+in linear time and space on the other inputs. -/
+public theorem of_isEmpty_ite (d : β) (hd : ∀ a, encIn a = [] → f a = d)
+    (h : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace (f ∘ Subtype.val)
+      ((Function.Embedding.subtype fun a => (encIn a).isEmpty = false).trans encIn) encOut) :
+    ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace f encIn encOut := by
+  convert ite (c := fun a => (encIn a).isEmpty) (of_isEmpty fun _ => rfl) ((const d).restrict _) h
+    using 1
+  funext a
+  split_ifs with ha <;> simp_all
+
+end ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace
+
 end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+/-!
+# Multi-pass folds of tidily computable functions
+
+A multi-pass fold reads a list, encoded as the concatenation of the tokens of its elements, several
+times. Each pass folds `next` over the elements, emitting `emit` for each of them, then emits
+`passEmit` of the resulting state and moves on to `passEnd` of it. The passes stop once `cont` of
+the state is false, and the fold ends by emitting `finish` of the final state. Only the state and
+one element are ever held on the work tapes, so the space does not grow with the input.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.passState`: the state at the start of a pass.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.multiPassFold`: multi-pass folds are tidily
+  computable, in time linear in the input plus the rounds for each pass, and in space independent
+  of the input.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+universe u
+
+variable {α σ : Type*}
+
+/-- The state at the start of pass `i` of a multi-pass fold over `l`: a pass folds `next` over `l`
+and then applies `passEnd`. -/
+@[expose] public def passState (init : σ) (next : σ × α → σ) (passEnd : σ → σ) (l : List α) :
+    ℕ → σ
+  | 0 => init
+  | i + 1 => passEnd (streamState (passState init next passEnd l i) next l l.length)
+
+/-- The flag after a pass: `[true]` if another pass follows, blank otherwise. -/
+@[expose] public def flagWord (b : Bool) : List Bool := if b then [true] else []
+
+open ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace in
+lemma linear_flagWord : ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace flagWord encBool encBits := by
+  convert (of_eq (f := id) (encIn := encBool) (encMid := encBool) fun _ => rfl).ite
+    ((const [true]).restrict _) ((const []).restrict _) using 1
+  funext c
+  cases c <;> rfl
+
+/-! ### Tidy machines on selected tapes -/
+
+section Tapes
+
+variable {β δ : Type*} {k K : ℕ} {S : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S} {encB : β ↪ List Bool}
+  {encD : δ ↪ List Bool} {f : β → δ} {t s : β → ℕ}
+
+/-- A tidy machine writing its output to tape `V`. -/
+lemma transformsTapes_outputToWord (h : ComputesFunTidilyInTimeAndSpace tm encB encD f t s)
+    {e : Fin (k + 1) ↪ Fin K} {V : Fin K} (he : e (Fin.last k) = V) (b : β) :
+    TransformsTapes (tm.outputToWord.extendTapes e) (fun inp ws => inp = encB b ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+      (fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (encD (f b)) ∧ em = [])
+      (t b + (encD (f b)).length + 2) (s b + 2 * (encD (f b)).length + 2 * K + 3) := by
+  have hk : k + 1 ≤ K := by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e
+  have h' := ((h b).outputToWord.imp
+      (P' := fun inp ws => inp = encB b ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last k) [])
+      (Q' := fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws (Fin.last k) (encD (f b)) ∧ em = [])
+      (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hws]⟩)
+      (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by simp [hws', hws], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+    ).extendTapes_update e

+  exact h'.imp (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hws]⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by simp [hws', hws], he⟩) le_rfl (by omega)

+/-- A tidy machine run on the word on tape `V`, emitting its output. -/

+    TransformsTapes ((tm.inputFromWord true).extendTapes e)

+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = encD (f b))
+      (t b + 4) (s b + 2 * (encB b).length + 3 * K + 10) := by
+  have hk : k + 2 ≤ K := by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e
+  have h' := ((h b).inputFromWord true).extendTapes_update e

+/-- A tidy machine run on the word on tape `V`, writing its output to tape `O`. -/
+lemma transformsTapes_onWords (h : ComputesFunTidilyInTimeAndSpace tm encB encD f t s)
+    {e : Fin (k + 1 + 2) ↪ Fin K} {V O : Fin K} (hi : e (Fin.natAdd (k + 1) 0) = V)
+    (ho : e ((Fin.last k).castAdd 2) = O) (b : β) :
+    TransformsTapes ((tm.onWords true).extendTapes e)

+      (s b + 2 * (encB b).length + 2 * (encD (f b)).length + 4 * K + 15) := by
+  have hk : k + 1 + 2 ≤ K := by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e
+  have h' := (((h b).onWords true).imp

+end Tapes
+
+/-- **Multi-pass folds are tidily computable.** The input `x` is encoded by concatenating the
+non-empty tokens `tok a` of the elements `elems x`, from each of which the finite-state reader `r`
+reads `encA a`. Pass `i` starts from `passState … i`; the fold makes `passes x + 1` passes, which
+`cont` signals after each of them. If all the parts are tidily computable and `g x` is encoded by
+what the passes emit followed by `finish` of the final state, then `g` is tidily computable. Its
+time is that of a streaming fold for every pass; its space does not grow with the input. The
+bounds `tMax`, `sMax` and `lMax` bound the time and space of a round and of the end of a pass, and
+the lengths of the states and elements. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.multiPassFold {α σ : Type u} {γ ε ε' φ ω : Type*}
+    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool} {encE : ε ↪ List Bool}
+    {encE' : ε' ↪ List Bool} {encF : φ ↪ List Bool} {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool}
+    {encOut : ω ↪ List Bool} {Q : Type} [Finite Q]
+    (r : InputReader Bool Q) (tok : α → List Bool) (htok : ∀ a, tok a ≠ [])
+    (hread : ∀ a rest, r.read r.q₀ (tok a ++ rest) = (encA a, (tok a).length))
+    (elems : γ → List α) (hL : ∀ x, encIn x = (elems x).flatMap tok)
+    {init : γ → σ} {next : σ × α → σ} {emit : σ × α → ε} {passEmit : σ → ε'}
+    {passEnd : σ → σ} {cont : σ → Bool} {finish : σ → φ} {g : γ → ω} {passes : γ → ℕ}
+    {tI sI : γ → ℕ} {tN sN tE sE : σ × α → ℕ} {tPE sPE tPN sPN tC sC tF sF : σ → ℕ}
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace init encIn encS tI sI)
+    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace next (encPair encS encA) encS tN sN)
+    (hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace emit (encPair encS encA) encE tE sE)
+    (hpassEmit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace passEmit encS encE' tPE sPE)
+    (hpassEnd : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace passEnd encS encS tPN sPN)
+    (hcont : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace cont encS encBool tC sC)
+    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace finish encS encF tF sF)
+    (hpasses : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
+      cont (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) = decide (i < passes x))
+    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = ((List.range (passes x + 1)).map fun i =>
+      streamEmit next (fun p => encE (emit p)) (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i)
+        (elems x) ++ encE' (passEmit (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i)
+          next (elems x) (elems x).length))).flatten ++
+      encF (finish (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (passes x + 1))))
+    {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
+    (htMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j (hj : j < (elems x).length),
+      tN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
+          (elems x)[j]) +
+        tE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
+          (elems x)[j]) ≤ tMax x)
+    (hsMax : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j (hj : j < (elems x).length),
+      sN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
+          (elems x)[j]) +
+        sE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j,
+          (elems x)[j]) ≤ sMax x)
+    (htEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
+      tPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
+          (elems x).length) +
+        tPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
+          (elems x).length) +
+        tC (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) ≤ tMax x)
+    (hsEnd : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x,
+      sPE (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
+          (elems x).length) +
+        sPN (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x)
+          (elems x).length) +
+        sC (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (i + 1)) ≤ sMax x)
+    (hS : ∀ x, ∀ i ≤ passes x, ∀ j ≤ (elems x).length,
+      (encS (streamState (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) i) next (elems x) j)).length ≤
+        lMax x)
+    (hSlast : ∀ x,
+      (encS (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (passes x + 1))).length ≤ lMax x)
+    (hA : ∀ x j (hj : j < (elems x).length), (encA (elems x)[j]).length ≤ lMax x) :
+    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace g encIn encOut
+      (fun x => c * (tI x + tF (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (passes x + 1)) +
+        (passes x + 1) * ((encIn x).length + ((elems x).length + 1) * (tMax x + lMax x + 1))))
+      (fun x => c * (sI x + sF (passState (init x) next passEnd (elems x) (passes x + 1)) +
+        sMax x + lMax x + 1)) := by
+  -- the parts, on framed states
+  obtain ⟨cfr, hfr⟩ := ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_frame (f := id) (encIn := encS)
+    (encOut := encFramed encS) fun _ => rfl
+  obtain ⟨cuf, huf⟩ := ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_unframe (f := id)
+    (encIn := encFramed encS) (encOut := encS) fun s => by simp
+  obtain ⟨cfl, hfl⟩ := linear_flagWord
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨cI, hI'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr hinit
+  obtain ⟨cN, hN'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr hnext
+  obtain ⟨cF, hF'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfinish huf
+  obtain ⟨cPE, hPE'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hpassEmit huf
+  obtain ⟨cPN₁, hPN₁⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hpassEnd huf
+  obtain ⟨cPN, hPN'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr hPN₁
+  obtain ⟨cC₁, hC₁⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hcont huf
+  obtain ⟨cC, hC'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfl hC₁
+  obtain ⟨kI, SI, _, tmI, htmI⟩ := hI'
+  obtain ⟨kE, SE, _, tmE, htmE⟩ := hemit
+  obtain ⟨kN, SN, _, tmN, htmN⟩ := hN'
+  obtain ⟨kF, SF, _, tmF, htmF⟩ := hF'
+  obtain ⟨kPE, SPE, _, tmPE, htmPE⟩ := hPE'

+/-!
+# Streaming folds of tidily computable functions
+
+A list encoded as the concatenation of the *tokens* of its elements, each read by a finite-state
+input reader, can be folded in one pass over the input. The fold keeps a state, starting with
+`init l`; for each element `a` it moves from the state `s` to `next (s, a)` and emits `emit (s, a)`;
+at the end it emits `finish` of the final state. Only the state and one element are ever held on
+the work tapes.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.streamState`: the state of the fold after the first `j` elements.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.streamEmit`: the words the fold emits.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.streamFold`: streaming folds are tidily
+  computable, in time linear in the input plus the rounds, and in space independent of the input.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+universe u
+
+variable {α σ : Type*}
+
+/-- The state of a streaming fold after the first `j` elements of `l`. -/
+@[expose] public def streamState (init : σ) (next : σ × α → σ) (l : List α) (j : ℕ) : σ :=
+  (l.take j).foldl (fun s a => next (s, a)) init
+
+/-- The words emitted by a streaming fold from the state `s` on the list `l`. -/
+@[expose] public def streamEmit (next : σ × α → σ) (emit : σ × α → List Bool) :
+    σ → List α → List Bool
+  | _, [] => []
+  | s, a :: l => emit (s, a) ++ streamEmit next emit (next (s, a)) l
+
+@[simp]
+public lemma streamState_zero (init : σ) (next : σ × α → σ) (l : List α) :
+    streamState init next l 0 = init := rfl
+
+public lemma streamState_succ (init : σ) (next : σ × α → σ) (l : List α) {j : ℕ}
+    (hj : j < l.length) :
+    streamState init next l (j + 1) = next (streamState init next l j, l[j]) := by
+  rw [streamState, List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hj, List.foldl_append]
+  rfl
+
+/-- The emitted words, round by round. -/
+public lemma streamEmit_eq (next : σ × α → σ) (emit : σ × α → List Bool) (s : σ) (l : List α) :
+    streamEmit next emit s l = ((List.range l.length).map fun j =>
+      (l[j]?.map fun a => emit (streamState s next l j, a)).getD []).flatten := by
+  induction l generalizing s with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons a l ih =>
+    rw [streamEmit, ih, List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map,
+      List.flatten_cons]
+    rfl
+
+/-- The lengths of the tokens add up to the length of the input. -/
+public lemma sum_length_getD (toks : List (List Bool)) :
+    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range toks.length, (toks[j]?.getD []).length = toks.flatten.length := by
+  induction toks with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons t toks ih => rw [List.length_cons, Finset.sum_range_succ']; simp [ih, Nat.add_comm]
+
+/-- **Streaming folds are tidily computable.** The input `x` is encoded by concatenating the
+non-empty tokens `tok a` of the elements `elems x`, from each of which the finite-state reader `r`
+reads `encA a`. If `init`, `next`, `emit` and `finish` are tidily computable, and `g x` is encoded
+by the words emitted by the fold over `elems x` followed by `finish` of its final state, then `g`
+is tidily computable. Its time is linear in the input plus the rounds; its space does not grow
+with the input. The bounds `tMax`, `sMax` and `lMax` bound the time and space of a round and the
+lengths of the states and elements. -/
+public theorem ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.streamFold {α σ : Type u} {γ ε φ ω : Type*}
+    {encA : α ↪ List Bool} {encS : σ ↪ List Bool} {encE : ε ↪ List Bool} {encF : φ ↪ List Bool}
+    {encIn : γ ↪ List Bool} {encOut : ω ↪ List Bool} {Q : Type} [Finite Q]
+    (r : InputReader Bool Q) (tok : α → List Bool) (htok : ∀ a, tok a ≠ [])
+    (hread : ∀ a rest, r.read r.q₀ (tok a ++ rest) = (encA a, (tok a).length))
+    (elems : γ → List α) (hL : ∀ x, encIn x = (elems x).flatMap tok)
+    {init : γ → σ} {next : σ × α → σ} {emit : σ × α → ε} {finish : σ → φ} {g : γ → ω}
+    {tI sI : γ → ℕ} {tN sN tE sE : σ × α → ℕ} {tF sF : σ → ℕ}
+    (hinit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace init encIn encS tI sI)
+    (hnext : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace next (encPair encS encA) encS tN sN)
+    (hemit : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace emit (encPair encS encA) encE tE sE)
+    (hfinish : ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace finish encS encF tF sF)
+    (hg : ∀ x, encOut (g x) = streamEmit next (fun p => encE (emit p)) (init x) (elems x) ++
+      encF (finish (streamState (init x) next (elems x) (elems x).length)))
+    {tMax sMax lMax : γ → ℕ}
+    (htMax : ∀ x j (hj : j < (elems x).length),
+      tN (streamState (init x) next (elems x) j, (elems x)[j]) +
+        tE (streamState (init x) next (elems x) j, (elems x)[j]) ≤ tMax x)
+    (hsMax : ∀ x j (hj : j < (elems x).length),
+      sN (streamState (init x) next (elems x) j, (elems x)[j]) +
+        sE (streamState (init x) next (elems x) j, (elems x)[j]) ≤ sMax x)
+    (hS : ∀ x, ∀ j ≤ (elems x).length,
+      (encS (streamState (init x) next (elems x) j)).length ≤ lMax x)
+    (hA : ∀ x j (hj : j < (elems x).length), (encA (elems x)[j]).length ≤ lMax x) :
+    ∃ c, ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace g encIn encOut
+      (fun x => c * (tI x + tF (streamState (init x) next (elems x) (elems x).length) +
+        (encIn x).length + (elems x).length * (tMax x + lMax x + 1) + lMax x + 1))
+      (fun x => c * (sI x + sF (streamState (init x) next (elems x) (elems x).length) + sMax x +
+        lMax x + 1)) := by
+  -- the framed initial state and the framed next state
+  obtain ⟨cfr, hfr⟩ := ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_frame (f := id) (encIn := encS)
+    (encOut := encFramed encS) fun _ => rfl
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨cI, hI'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr hinit
+  obtain ⟨cN, hN'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfr hnext
+  obtain ⟨cuf, huf⟩ := ComputableTidilyInLinearTimeAndSpace.of_unframe (f := id)
+    (encIn := encFramed encS) (encOut := encS) fun s => by simp
+  -- vendored: crei's `comp` is `comp_linear` here, as cslib #1111 restates `comp`
+  obtain ⟨cF, hF'⟩ := ComputableTidilyInTimeAndSpace.comp_linear hfinish huf
+  obtain ⟨kI, SI, _, tmI, htmI⟩ := hI'
+  obtain ⟨kE, SE, _, tmE, htmE⟩ := hemit
+  obtain ⟨kN, SN, _, tmN, htmN⟩ := hN'
+  obtain ⟨kF, SF, _, tmF, htmF⟩ := hF'
+  -- the tapes: those of the machines, then the state `V`, the next state `N` and a flag `F`
+  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, M = kI + kE + kN + kF + 8 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
+  let V : Fin (M + 3) := ⟨M, by omega⟩
+  let N : Fin (M + 3) := ⟨M + 1, by omega⟩
+  let F : Fin (M + 3) := ⟨M + 2, by omega⟩
+  have hVN : V ≠ N := by simp [V, N, Fin.ext_iff]
+  have hVF : V ≠ F := by simp [V, F, Fin.ext_iff]
+  have hNF : N ≠ F := by simp [N, F, Fin.ext_iff]
+  obtain ⟨eI, heI⟩ := exists_embedding_eq (K := M + 3) (by omega) (Fin.last kI) V
+  obtain ⟨eE, heE⟩ := exists_embedding_eq (K := M + 3) (by omega) (Fin.natAdd kE (0 : Fin 2)) V
+  obtain ⟨eN, heN, heN'⟩ := exists_embedding_eq₂ (K := M + 3) (by omega)
+    (i := Fin.natAdd (kN + 1) (0 : Fin 2)) (o := (Fin.last kN).castAdd 2)
+    (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]) hVN
+  obtain ⟨eF, heF⟩ := exists_embedding_eq (K := M + 3) (by omega) (Fin.natAdd kF (0 : Fin 2)) V
+  refine ⟨(40 * M + 200) * (cfr + cN + cI + cuf + cF + M + 100), _, _, inferInstance,
+    streamTM r ((tmI.outputToWord).extendTapes eI)
+    ((tmE.inputFromWord true).extendTapes eE) ((tmN.onWords true).extendTapes eN)
+    ((tmF.inputFromWord true).extendTapes eF) V N F hVN hVF hNF, fun x => ?_⟩
+  set l := elems x with hl
+  -- the run on `l`: its tokens, states, elements and emitted words
+  set n := l.length with hn
+  let st := streamState (init x) next l
+  let toks := l.map tok
+  let cont (j : ℕ) : List Bool := (l[j]?.map encA).getD []
+  let es (j : ℕ) : List Bool := (l[j]?.map fun a => encE (emit (st j, a))).getD []
+  have hcont (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : cont j = encA l[j] := by
+    simp [cont, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj]
+  have hes (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : es j = encE (emit (st j, l[j])) := by
+    simp [es, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj]
+  have hx : encIn x = toks.flatten := by rw [hL, List.flatMap_def]
+  have htoks : ∀ t ∈ toks, t ≠ [] := by
+    intro t ht
+    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
+    exact htok a
+  have hlen : toks.length = n := by simp [toks, n]
+  have hread' : ∀ j (hj : j < toks.length), r.read r.q₀ (toks.flatten.drop
+      ((toks.take j).flatten).length) = (cont j, toks[j].length) := by
+    intro j hj
+    rw [drop_flatten_take toks hj]
+    simp [toks, hcont j (by omega), hread]
+  -- the four machines on the common tapes
+  have hI := ((htmI x).outputToWord.imp
+      (P' := fun inp ws => inp = encIn x ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.last kI) [])
+      (Q' := fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws (Fin.last kI)
+        (frame (encS (init x))) ∧ em = [])
+      (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin, by simp [hws]⟩)
+      (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by simp [hws', hws], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+    ).extendTapes_update eI
+  rw [heI] at hI
+  have hI₀ := hI.imp (P' := fun inp ws => inp = toks.flatten ∧ ws = fun _ => [])
+    (Q' := fun _ _ ws' em => ws' = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (frame (encS (st 0))) ∧ em = [])
+    (fun _ _ ⟨hin, hws⟩ => ⟨hin.trans hx.symm, by simp [hws]⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨_, hws⟩ ⟨hws', he⟩ => ⟨by rw [hws', hws]; simp [st], he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  have hE : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes ((tmE.inputFromWord true).extendTapes eE)
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (frame (encS (st j)) ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = es j)
+      ((l[j]?.map fun a => tE (st j, a) + 4).getD 0)
+      ((l[j]?.map fun a => sE (st j, a) + 2 * ((encPair encS encA (st j, a)).length + 2) +
+        2 * kE + 8 + (M + 3 - (kE + 2))).getD 0) := by
+    intro j hj
+    have hjn : j < n := by omega
+    have h := ((htmE (st j, l[j])).inputFromWord true).extendTapes_update eE
+    rw [heE] at h
+    refine h.imp (fun _ _ hws => ⟨trivial, by rw [hws, hcont j hjn]; rfl⟩)
+      (fun _ ws _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws, hcont j hjn, Function.update_idem]; rfl,
+        by rw [he, hes j hjn]⟩) ?_ ?_ <;> simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjn]
+  have hN : ∀ j < toks.length, TransformsTapes ((tmN.onWords true).extendTapes eN)
+      (fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V (frame (encS (st j)) ++ cont j))
+      (fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = Function.update ws N (frame (encS (st (j + 1)))) ∧ em = [])
+      ((l[j]?.map fun a => tN (st j, a) + cfr * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) +
+        cN * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) + (frame (encS (next (st j, a)))).length +
+        6).getD 0)
+      ((l[j]?.map fun a => sN (st j, a) + cfr * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) +
+        cN * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) + 2 * (encPair encS encA (st j, a)).length +
+        2 * (frame (encS (next (st j, a)))).length + 3 * kN + 18 +
+        (M + 3 - (kN + 1 + 2))).getD 0) := by
+    intro j hj
+    have hjn : j < n := by omega
+    have h := (((htmN (st j, l[j])).onWords true).imp
+      (P' := fun _ ws => True ∧ ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) (Fin.natAdd (kN + 1) 0)
+        (encPair encS encA (st j, l[j])))
+      (fun _ _ h => h.2) (fun _ _ _ _ _ h => h) le_rfl le_rfl).extendTapes_update eN
+    rw [heN, heN'] at h
+    refine h.imp (fun _ _ hws => ⟨trivial, by rw [hws, hcont j hjn]; rfl⟩)
+      (fun _ _ _ _ _ ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h]; simp only [st, streamState_succ _ _ _ hjn]; rfl, he⟩)
+      ?_ ?_ <;> simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjn]
+  have hF := (((htmF (st toks.length)).inputFromWord true).extendTapes_update eF)
+  rw [heF] at hF
+  have hF₀ := hF.imp (P' := fun _ ws => ws = Function.update (fun _ => []) V
+      (frame (encS (st toks.length))))
+    (Q' := fun _ ws ws' em => ws' = ws ∧ em = encF (finish (st toks.length)))
+    (fun _ _ hws => ⟨trivial, hws⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ _ hws ⟨h, he⟩ => ⟨by rw [h, hws, Function.update_idem]; rfl, he⟩) le_rfl le_rfl
+  -- the space of a round, bounded by the largest one
+  let sRound (j : ℕ) : ℕ := (frame (encS (st j)) ++ cont j).length + 2 + (M + 3 - 1) +
+    (((l[j]?.map fun a => sE (st j, a) + 2 * ((encPair encS encA (st j, a)).length + 2) +
+        2 * kE + 8 + (M + 3 - (kE + 2))).getD 0) +
+      (((l[j]?.map fun a => sN (st j, a) + cfr * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) +
+        cN * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) + 2 * (encPair encS encA (st j, a)).length +
+        2 * (frame (encS (next (st j, a)))).length + 3 * kN + 18 +
+        (M + 3 - (kN + 1 + 2))).getD 0) +
+      (((frame (encS (st j)) ++ cont j).length + 1 + (M + 3)) +
+        ((4 * (frame (encS (st (j + 1)))).length + (M + 3) + 15) +
+          ((frame (encS (st (j + 1)))).length + 1 + (M + 3))))))
+  have h := computesTidily_streamTM (r := r) hVN hVF hNF toks htoks cont

+    (sR := (Finset.range toks.length).sup sRound)
+    (fun j hj => Finset.le_sup (f := sRound) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hj))
+  simp only [streamRoundTime] at h
+  rw [← hx, hlen] at h
+  rw [hg x, streamEmit_eq]
+  -- bounds on the words involved
+  set L := lMax x with hLdef
+  have hSj (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) : (encS (st j)).length ≤ L := hS x j hj
+  have hround (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) :

+            cN * ((encS (next (st j, a))).length + 1) + (frame (encS (next (st j, a)))).length + 6)
+              l[j]?).getD 0 +
+            (3 * ((frame (encS (st j)) ++ cont j).length + 1) +
+              (3 * (frame (encS (st (j + 1)))).length + 10 +
+                3 * ((frame (encS (st (j + 1)))).length + 1))))) + 1 ≤

+    have h₁ := hSj (j + 1) hj
+    have hA' := hA x j hj
+    have ht := htMax x j hj
+    have hnext : next (st j, l[j]) = st (j + 1) := (streamState_succ _ _ _ hj).symm
+    have hm₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cfr (Nat.add_le_add_right h₁ 1)
+    have hm₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cN (Nat.add_le_add_right h₁ 1)
+    simp only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, hnext,

+  have hSn : (encS (st n)).length ≤ L := hSj n le_rfl

+    have f₄ : n * (tMax x + (cfr + cN + 60) * (L + 1)) ≤ D * (n * (tMax x + L + 1)) :=

+    refine le_trans

+    have z₂ := Nat.zero_le (D * n)

+    linarith

+    rw [← hn, ← hLdef]

+      have hnext : next (st j, l[j]) = st (j + 1) := (streamState_succ _ _ _ hj).symm
+      have hm₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cfr (Nat.add_le_add_right h₁ 1)
+      have hm₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left cN (Nat.add_le_add_right h₁ 1)
+      simp only [sRound, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, hnext,

+      have : kE ≤ M := by omega

+      have : M + 3 - 1 = M + 2 := by omega
+      have : M + 3 - (kE + 2) ≤ M + 1 := by omega
+      have : M + 3 - (kN + 1 + 2) ≤ M := by omega
+      have := Nat.zero_le (M * L)
+      linarith
+    clear_value D L
+    have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := by omega
+    have hED : cfr + cN + 20 * M + 100 ≤ 20 * D := by omega
+    have g₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * (M + 3)) hsup
+    have g₂ : 2 * (M + 3) * ((cfr + cN + 20 * M + 100) * (L + 1)) ≤
+        (40 * M + 120) * (D * (L + 1)) :=
+      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hED)).trans_eq (by ring)

+

+/-!
+# Branching on a work tape
+
+`branch i tm₁ tm₂` reads the cell under the head of work tape `i` and then runs `tm₁` if that cell
+is not blank and `tm₂` if it is. On a `Turing.MultiTapeTM.wordsCfg` configuration the head of tape
+`i` is on the first cell of its word, so the machine runs `tm₂` exactly when the word on tape `i`
+is empty.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.branch`: the branching machine.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapes_branch`: a specification of `branch i tm₁ tm₂` from
+  specifications of `tm₁` for a non-empty word on tape `i` and of `tm₂` for an empty one.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol S₁ S₂ : Type*} {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- Reads the cell under the head of work tape `i`, moving no head and writing nothing, then runs
+`tm₁` if the cell is not blank and `tm₂` if it is. -/
+public noncomputable def branch (i : Fin k) (tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁)
+    (tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂)) :=
+  ofTr none fun q inp work =>
+    match q with
+    | none =>
+      { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun _ => (none, 0), output := none,
+        state := some (some ((work i).elim (.inr tm₂.q₀) fun _ => .inl tm₁.q₀)) }
+    | some (.inl q) =>
+      let a := tm₁.tr q inp work
+      { a with state := a.state.map (some ∘ .inl) }
+    | some (.inr q) =>
+      let a := tm₂.tr q inp work
+      { a with state := a.state.map (some ∘ .inr) }
+
+namespace Branch
+
+variable {i : Fin k} {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁} {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂}
+
+/-- If `branch i tm₁ tm₂` acts in the state `f q` as `tm` acts in `q`, its runs from such states
+follow the runs of `tm`. -/
+lemma runFrom_mapState {S : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S} {f : S → Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂)}
+    (htr : ∀ q inp work, (branch i tm₁ tm₂).tr (f q) inp work =
+      { tm.tr q inp work with state := (tm.tr q inp work).state.map f })
+    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol S input) (n : ℕ) :
+    (branch i tm₁ tm₂).runFrom (cfg.mapState (Option.map f)) n =
+      (tm.runFrom cfg n).mapState (Option.map f) := by
+  refine (Function.Semiconj.iterate_right (fun c => ?_) n cfg).symm
+  cases hq : c.state with
+  | none => rw [step_of_halt hq, step_of_halt (by simp [hq])]
+  | some q => rw [step_of_state hq, step_of_state (q := f q) (by simp [hq]), htr]; rfl
+
+/-- The first step reads tape `i` and starts `tm₁` or `tm₂`. -/
+lemma step_check (ws : Fin k → List Symbol) (out : List Symbol) :
+    (branch i tm₁ tm₂).step (wordsCfg input (some none) ws out) =
+      if ws i = [] then (wordsCfg input (some tm₂.q₀) ws out).mapState (Option.map (some ∘ .inr))
+      else (wordsCfg input (some tm₁.q₀) ws out).mapState (Option.map (some ∘ .inl)) := by
+  have hsym : (wordsCfg input (some (none : Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂))) ws out).workTapeSymbols i =
+      (ws i).head? := by
+    simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, wordsCfg, tapeOfList_zero]
+  rw [step_of_state rfl]
+  simp only [branch, tr_ofTr, hsym]
+  split_ifs with h
+  · rw [h]
+    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [Action.apply, Cfg.mapState, wordsCfg]
+  · obtain ⟨a, l, hl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil h
+    rw [hl]
+    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [Action.apply, Cfg.mapState, wordsCfg]
+
+/-- If the first step starts `tm`, with its states mapped by `f`, then a specification of `tm`
+gives one of `branch i tm₁ tm₂`, with one more step and at most `k` more cells. -/
+lemma transformsTapes_of_step {S : Type*} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S}
+    {f : S → Option (S₁ ⊕ S₂)}
+    (htr : ∀ q inp work, (branch i tm₁ tm₂).tr (f q) inp work =
+      { tm.tr q inp work with state := (tm.tr q inp work).state.map f })
+    {P : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      List Symbol → Prop} {t s : ℕ}
+    (hstep : ∀ input ws out, P input ws →
+      (branch i tm₁ tm₂).step (wordsCfg input (some none) ws out) =
+        (wordsCfg input (some tm.q₀) ws out).mapState (Option.map f))
+    (h : TransformsTapes tm P Q t s) :
+    TransformsTapes (branch i tm₁ tm₂) P Q (1 + t) (k + s) := by
+  -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+  refine transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr fun input ws out hP => ?_
+  obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun', hQ, hsp⟩ := transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp h input ws out hP
+  rw [show (branch i tm₁ tm₂).q₀ = none from rfl]
+  refine ⟨ws', e, ?_, hQ, (space_add_le _ _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_)⟩
+  · rw [runFrom_add, runFrom_one, hstep _ _ _ hP, runFrom_mapState htr, hrun']; rfl
+  · -- the first step does not move any head
+    refine space_le_of_workTapePos_const _ _ fun m hm => ?_
+    rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hm with rfl | rfl
+    · rfl
+    · rw [runFrom_one, hstep _ _ _ hP]; rfl
+  · rw [runFrom_one, hstep _ _ _ hP, space_eq_of_workTapePos (tm' := tm) _
+      (wordsCfg input (some tm.q₀) ws out) t fun m _ => by rw [runFrom_mapState htr]; rfl]
+    exact hsp
+
+end Branch
+
+open Branch in
+/-- If `tm₁` performs the transformation `Q` within `t₁` steps and `s₁` cells whenever the word on
+tape `i` is non-empty, and `tm₂` within `t₂` steps and `s₂` cells whenever it is empty, then
+`branch i tm₁ tm₂` performs `Q` with one more step and at most `k` more cells. -/
+public theorem transformsTapes_branch (i : Fin k)
+    -- vendored: `tm₁` and `tm₂` are bound here, as `autoImplicit` is off
+    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁} {tm₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂}
+    {P : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      List Symbol → Prop} {t₁ s₁ t₂ s₂ : ℕ}
+    (h₁ : TransformsTapes tm₁ (fun inp ws => P inp ws ∧ ws i ≠ []) Q t₁ s₁)
+    (h₂ : TransformsTapes tm₂ (fun inp ws => P inp ws ∧ ws i = []) Q t₂ s₂) :
+    TransformsTapes (branch i tm₁ tm₂) P Q (max t₁ t₂ + 1) (max s₁ s₂ + k) := by
+  intro input ws out hP
+  by_cases hi : ws i = []
+  · exact ((transformsTapes_of_step (f := some ∘ .inr) (fun _ _ _ => by simp [branch])
+      (fun _ _ _ h => by rw [step_check, ite_eq_left h.2]) h₂).mono (by omega) (by omega))
+      input ws out ⟨hP, hi⟩
+  · exact ((transformsTapes_of_step (f := some ∘ .inl) (fun _ _ _ => by simp [branch])
+      (fun _ _ _ h => by rw [step_check, ite_eq_right h.2]) h₁).mono (by omega) (by omega))
+      input ws out ⟨hP, hi⟩
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+module
+-- upstream: vendored crei:crei/tidy-universal @7f7c0696 (unsubmitted)

+
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.ExtendTapes
+public import Cslib.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.RewindInput
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.Sequential
+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.TransformsTapes
+
+/-!
+# Tape transformations with the input head anywhere
+
+A `Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapes` specification starts and ends with the input head on the
+first symbol of the input. A machine that reads its input once, from left to right, keeps a
+*cursor* there instead: its input head stays where the last round left it.
+`TransformsTapesAt` is the same specification format with the position of the input head as part
+of the precondition and the postcondition.
+
+A machine that never needs the input is run with its input head frozen (`freezeInput`): then every
+`TransformsTapes` specification of it holds at any position of the input head
+(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapes.freezeInput`).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.wordsCfgAt`: `Turing.MultiTapeTM.wordsCfg` with the input head anywhere.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapesAt`: the specification format.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.freezeInput`: a machine run on a blank input, with its input head fixed.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapesAt_seq`: sequential composition.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.TransformsTapes.freezeInput`: a specification of `tm` gives one of
+  `tm.freezeInput` at any position of the input head, which it keeps.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapesAt_rewindInput`: rewinding the input head.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol State State₀ State₁ : Type*}
+
+/-- The configuration whose work tape `i` holds the word `ws i` with its head at the start, with
+the input head at position `p`, in state `q` with output `out`. -/
+@[simps]
+def wordsCfgAt (input : List Symbol) (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (q : Option State)
+    (ws : Fin k → List Symbol) (out : List Symbol) : Cfg k Symbol State input :=
+  ⟨q, p, fun i => tapeOfList (ws i), fun _ => 0, out⟩
+
+@[simp]
+lemma wordsCfgAt_one (input : List Symbol) (q : Option State) (ws : Fin k → List Symbol)
+    (out : List Symbol) : wordsCfgAt input 1 q ws out = wordsCfg input q ws out := rfl
+
+@[simp]
+lemma withState_wordsCfgAt {State' : Type*} (input : List Symbol) (p : Fin (input.length + 2))
+    (q : Option State) (ws : Fin k → List Symbol) (out : List Symbol) (q' : Option State') :
+    (wordsCfgAt input p q ws out).withState q' = wordsCfgAt input p q' ws out := rfl
+
+/-- `TransformsTapesAt tm P Q t s`: started in its initial state with the input head at position
+`p` and on tapes holding words `ws` with `P input p ws`, the machine is halted after `t` steps with
+the input head at a position `p'`, on tapes holding words `ws'`, having appended `emitted` to the
+output, with `Q input p ws p' ws' emitted`, and having used at most `s` work-tape cells. -/
+def TransformsTapesAt (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
+    (P : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop)
+    (Q : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → List Symbol → Prop)
+    (t s : ℕ) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (input : List Symbol) (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (ws : Fin k → List Symbol)
+    (out : List Symbol), P input p ws →
+    ∃ p' ws' emitted,
+      tm.runFrom (wordsCfgAt input p (some tm.q₀) ws out) t =
+        wordsCfgAt input p' none ws' (out ++ emitted) ∧
+      Q input p ws p' ws' emitted ∧
+      tm.space (wordsCfgAt input p (some tm.q₀) ws out) t ≤ s
+
+namespace TransformsTapesAt
+
+variable {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+  {P P' : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+  {Q Q' : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+    Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → List Symbol → Prop} {t s t' s' : ℕ}
+
+/-- A stronger precondition, a weaker postcondition and larger bounds. -/
+theorem imp (h : TransformsTapesAt tm P Q t s) (hP : ∀ input p ws, P' input p ws → P input p ws)
+    (hQ : ∀ input p ws p' ws' e, P' input p ws → Q input p ws p' ws' e → Q' input p ws p' ws' e)
+    (ht : t ≤ t') (hs : s ≤ s') : TransformsTapesAt tm P' Q' t' s' := by
+  intro input p ws out hP'
+  obtain ⟨p₁, ws₁, e, hrun, hQ₁, hsp⟩ := h input p ws out (hP input p ws hP')
+  have hhalt : (tm.runFrom (wordsCfgAt input p (some tm.q₀) ws out) t).Halted := by
+    rw [hrun]; rfl
+  exact ⟨p₁, ws₁, e, by rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ ht hhalt, hrun], hQ input p ws p₁ ws₁ e hP' hQ₁,
+    by rw [space_eq_of_halt _ ht hhalt]; exact hsp.trans hs⟩
+
+end TransformsTapesAt
+
+/-- A `TransformsTapes` specification is a `TransformsTapesAt` specification with the input head at
+the start before and after. -/
+theorem TransformsTapes.transformsTapesAt {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+    {P : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      List Symbol → Prop} {t s : ℕ} (h : TransformsTapes tm P Q t s) :
+    TransformsTapesAt tm (fun input p ws => p = 1 ∧ P input ws)
+      (fun input _ ws p' ws' e => p' = 1 ∧ Q input ws ws' e) t s := by
+  rintro input _ ws out ⟨rfl, hP⟩
+  -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+  obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, hQ, hsp⟩ := transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp h input ws out hP
+  exact ⟨1, ws', e, hrun, ⟨rfl, hQ⟩, hsp⟩
+
+/-- A `TransformsTapesAt` specification from and to the start of the input is a `TransformsTapes`
+specification. -/
+theorem TransformsTapesAt.transformsTapes {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+    {P : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → List Symbol → Prop} {t s : ℕ}
+    (h : TransformsTapesAt tm P Q t s)
+    (hQ : ∀ input p ws p' ws' e, Q input p ws p' ws' e → p' = 1) :
+    TransformsTapes tm (fun input ws => P input 1 ws) (fun input ws ws' e => Q input 1 ws 1 ws' e)
+      t s := by
+  -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+  refine transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mpr fun input ws out hP => ?_
+  obtain ⟨p', ws', e, hrun, hQ', hsp⟩ := h input 1 ws out hP
+  obtain rfl := hQ _ _ _ _ _ _ hQ'
+  exact ⟨ws', e, hrun, hQ', hsp⟩
+
+open Sequential in
+/-- **Sequential composition.** If the postcondition of the first specification implies the
+precondition of the second, the composed machine performs the two one after the other. -/
+theorem transformsTapesAt_seq {tm₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State₀}
+    {tm₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State₁}
+    {P₀ P₁ : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q₀ Q₁ : (input : List Symbol) → Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      Fin (input.length + 2) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → List Symbol → Prop} {t₀ s₀ t₁ s₁ : ℕ}
+    (h₀ : TransformsTapesAt tm₀ P₀ Q₀ t₀ s₀) (h₁ : TransformsTapesAt tm₁ P₁ Q₁ t₁ s₁)
+    (hmid : ∀ input p ws p' ws' e, P₀ input p ws → Q₀ input p ws p' ws' e → P₁ input p' ws') :
+    TransformsTapesAt (tm₀.seq tm₁) P₀
+      (fun input p ws p'' ws'' e => ∃ p' ws' e₀ e₁, Q₀ input p ws p' ws' e₀ ∧
+        Q₁ input p' ws' p'' ws'' e₁ ∧ e = e₀ ++ e₁)
+      (t₀ + t₁) (s₀ + s₁) := by
+  intro input p ws out hP₀
+  obtain ⟨p', ws', e₀, hrun₀, hQ₀, hspace₀⟩ := h₀ input p ws out hP₀
+  obtain ⟨p'', ws'', e₁, hrun₁, hQ₁, hspace₁⟩ :=
+    h₁ input p' ws' (out ++ e₀) (hmid input p ws p' ws' e₀ hP₀ hQ₀)
+  have hstart : wordsCfgAt input p (some (tm₀.seq tm₁).q₀) ws out =
+      leftCfg tm₁ (wordsCfgAt input p (some tm₀.q₀) ws out) := rfl
+  refine ⟨p'', ws'', e₀ ++ e₁, ?_, ⟨p', ws', e₀, e₁, hQ₀, hQ₁, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
+  · rw [hstart, runFrom_seq hrun₀ rfl (by simpa using hrun₁) rfl]
+    rfl
+  · rw [hstart]
+    refine (space_seq_le hrun₀ rfl (by rw [withState_wordsCfgAt, hrun₁]; rfl)).trans ?_
+    simpa using Nat.add_le_add hspace₀ hspace₁
+
+/-! ### Freezing the input head -/
+
+/-- `tm`, run as if on a blank input: it reads a blank on the input tape and never moves its input
+head. -/
+noncomputable def freezeInput (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State :=
+  ofTr tm.q₀ fun q _ work => { tm.tr q none work with inputTape := 0 }
+
+namespace FreezeInput
+
+variable {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- A configuration on the empty input, with the input head placed at `p` on `input`. -/
+def atPos (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (c : Cfg k Symbol State []) : Cfg k Symbol State input :=
+  ⟨c.state, p, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, c.output⟩
+
+lemma step_atPos (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (c : Cfg k Symbol State []) :
+    tm.freezeInput.step (atPos p c) = atPos p (tm.step c) := by
+  cases hq : c.state with
+  | none =>
+    rw [step_of_halt (show (atPos p c).state = none from hq), step_of_halt hq]
+  | some q =>
+    rw [step_of_state (show (atPos p c).state = some q from hq), step_of_state hq,
+      inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (cfg := c)
+        (by have := c.inputPos.isLt; simp only [List.length_nil] at this ⊢; omega),
+      show (atPos (input := input) p c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols from rfl]
+    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [freezeInput, atPos, Action.apply, moveInputPos_zero]
+
+lemma runFrom_atPos (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (c : Cfg k Symbol State []) (n : ℕ) :
+    tm.freezeInput.runFrom (atPos p c) n = atPos p (tm.runFrom c n) :=
+  (Function.Semiconj.iterate_right (fun c => (step_atPos (tm := tm) p c).symm) n c).symm
+
+end FreezeInput
+
+open FreezeInput in
+/-- A specification of `tm` on the empty input is a specification of `tm.freezeInput` at any
+position of the input head, which it keeps. -/
+theorem TransformsTapes.freezeInput {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
+    {P : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → Prop}
+    {Q : (input : List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) → (Fin k → List Symbol) →
+      List Symbol → Prop} {t s : ℕ} (h : TransformsTapes tm P Q t s) :
+    TransformsTapesAt tm.freezeInput (fun _ _ ws => P [] ws)
+      (fun _ p ws p' ws' e => p' = p ∧ Q [] ws ws' e) t s := by
+  intro input p ws out hP
+  -- vendored: `TransformsTapes` is stated with run paths since cslib #1117
+  obtain ⟨ws', e, hrun, hQ, hsp⟩ := transformsTapes_iff_runFrom.mp h [] ws out hP
+  have hstart : wordsCfgAt input p (some tm.freezeInput.q₀) ws out =
+      atPos p (wordsCfg [] (some tm.q₀) ws out) := rfl
+  refine ⟨p, ws', e, ?_, ⟨rfl, hQ⟩, ?_⟩
+  · rw [hstart, runFrom_atPos, hrun]
+    rfl
+  · rw [hstart, space_eq_of_workTapePos _ (wordsCfg [] (some tm.q₀) ws out) t
+      fun m _ => by rw [runFrom_atPos]; rfl]
+    exact hsp
+
+/-! ### Rewinding the input head -/
+
+/-- `rewindInput` on a machine with `k` work tapes. -/
+noncomputable def rewindInputOn (k : ℕ) (Symbol : Type*) :
+    MultiTapeTM k Symbol RewindState :=
+  (rewindInput Symbol).extendTapes (noTapes k)
+
+/-- `rewindInputOn k Symbol` moves the input head from anywhere on the input `x` back to its start
+and changes nothing else. -/
+theorem transformsTapesAt_rewindInput (x : List Symbol) :
+    TransformsTapesAt (rewindInputOn k Symbol) (fun input _ _ => input = x)
+      (fun _ _ ws p' ws' e => p' = 1 ∧ ws' = ws ∧ e = []) (x.length + 2) k := by
+  rintro input p ws out rfl
+  have hrun : (rewindInputOn k Symbol).runFrom
+      (wordsCfgAt input p (some (rewindInputOn k Symbol).q₀) ws out) (p.val - 1 + 2) =
+        wordsCfgAt input 1 none ws (out ++ []) := by
+    have hcfg : noTapesCfg (wordsCfgAt input p (some (rewindInputOn k Symbol).q₀) ws out) =
+        ⟨some (rewindInput Symbol).q₀, p, nofun, nofun, out⟩ :=
+      Cfg.ext rfl rfl (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl
+    rw [rewindInputOn] at hcfg ⊢
+    rw [runFrom_noTapes, hcfg, runFrom_rewindInput, List.append_nil]
+    rfl
+  have hhalt : ((rewindInputOn k Symbol).runFrom
+      (wordsCfgAt input p (some (rewindInputOn k Symbol).q₀) ws out) (p.val - 1 + 2)).Halted := by
+    rw [hrun]; rfl
+  refine ⟨1, ws, [], ?_, ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, space_noTapes_le _ _ _⟩
+  rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ (by have := p.isLt; omega) hhalt, hrun]
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+module

+public import Complexity.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Plumbing.Cursor

+/-!
+# Reading from the input at the input head
+
+An `InputReader` is a finite-state device that reads the input from the input head on: in state
+`q` on the symbol `a` it emits at most one symbol and continues in a new state, or stops after `a`.
+It also stops at the end of the input. `appendRead r i` appends what `r` emits to the word on work
+tape `i` and leaves the input head after what `r` read. Reading one token of a self-delimiting
+encoding is an instance.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.InputReader`: finite-state input readers.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.InputReader.read`: the word a reader emits and the number of symbols it
+  reads.
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.appendRead`: the machine that runs a reader, appending to a work tape.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.transformsTapesAt_appendRead`: its specification.
+-/
+
+namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM
+
+variable {k : ℕ} {Symbol Q : Type*} {input : List Symbol}
+
+/-- A finite-state input reader: in state `q` on the symbol `a` it emits `(step q a).2` and
+continues in `(step q a).1`, or stops after `a` if that is `none`. -/
+public structure InputReader (Symbol Q : Type*) where
+  /-- The initial state. -/
+  q₀ : Q
+  /-- The next state, or `none` to stop, and the emitted symbol, if any. -/
+  step : Q → Symbol → Option Q × Option Symbol
+
+namespace InputReader
+
+variable (r : InputReader Symbol Q)
+
+/-- The word `r` emits on `w` from state `q`, and the number of symbols it reads: it stops after a
+symbol leading to `none`, or at the end of `w`. -/
+@[expose] public def read : Q → List Symbol → List Symbol × ℕ
+  | _, [] => ([], 0)
+  | q, a :: w =>
+    match (r.step q a).1 with
+    | none => ((r.step q a).2.toList, 1)
+    | some q' => ((r.step q a).2.toList ++ (read q' w).1, (read q' w).2 + 1)
+
+public lemma read_cons_of_none {q : Q} {a : Symbol} (w : List Symbol) (h : (r.step q a).1 = none) :
+    r.read q (a :: w) = ((r.step q a).2.toList, 1) := by
+  simp [read, h]
+
+public lemma read_cons_of_some {q q' : Q} {a : Symbol} (w : List Symbol)
+    (h : (r.step q a).1 = some q') :
+    r.read q (a :: w) = ((r.step q a).2.toList ++ (r.read q' w).1, (r.read q' w).2 + 1) := by
+  simp [read, h]
+
+public lemma read_snd_le (q : Q) (w : List Symbol) : (r.read q w).2 ≤ w.length := by
+  induction w generalizing q <;> grind [read]
+
+public lemma length_read_fst_le (q : Q) (w : List Symbol) :
+    (r.read q w).1.length ≤ (r.read q w).2 := by
+  induction w generalizing q <;> grind [read]
+
+/-- `r` as a machine with one work tape: it appends what it emits to the work tape, with the head
+on the cell after the word, and moves the input head over what it reads. -/
+noncomputable def core : MultiTapeTM 1 Symbol Q :=
+  ofTr r.q₀ fun q inp _ =>
+    match inp with
+    | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
+    | some a =>
+      ⟨1, fun _ => ((r.step q a).2.map some, if (r.step q a).2.isSome then 1 else 0), none,
+        (r.step q a).1⟩
+
+/-- A configuration of `core` reading position `j` of the input, with `u` on the work tape. -/
+def coreCfg (q : Option Q) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ input.length) (u out : List Symbol) :
+    Cfg 1 Symbol Q input :=
+  ⟨q, ⟨1 + j, by omega⟩, fun _ => tapeOfList u, fun _ => (u.length : ℤ), out⟩
+
+lemma core_step_of_lt (q : Q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < input.length) (u out : List Symbol) :
+    r.core.step (coreCfg (some q) j hj.le u out) =
+      coreCfg (r.step q input[j]).1 (j + 1) hj (u ++ (r.step q input[j]).2.toList) out := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, inputSymbolInner j rfl hj]
+  have hpos : moveInputPos (⟨1 + j, by omega⟩ : Fin (input.length + 2)) 1 =
+      ⟨1 + (j + 1), by omega⟩ :=
+    (moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp; omega)).trans (Fin.ext (by simp; omega))
+  cases he : (r.step q input[j]).2 with
+  | none =>
+    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [core, coreCfg, Action.apply, he, hpos]
+  | some s =>
+    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
+      simp [core, coreCfg, Action.apply, he, hpos, tapeOfList_append_single]
+
+lemma core_step_end (q : Q) (u out : List Symbol) :
+    r.core.step (coreCfg (input := input) (some q) input.length le_rfl u out) =
+      coreCfg none input.length le_rfl u out := by
+  rw [step_of_state rfl, inputSymbol_eq_none_of_boundary (.inr (by simp [coreCfg]; omega))]
+  refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> simp [core, coreCfg, Action.apply, moveInputPos_zero]
+
+/-- The run of `core` from state `q` at position `j`, where the rest of the input is `w`: after
+reading `n` symbols and emitting `e`, where `(e, n) = r.read q w`, it halts within `n + 1` steps. -/
+lemma core_runFrom (w : List Symbol) (q : Q) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ input.length)
+    (hw : input.drop j = w) (u out : List Symbol) :
+    ∃ hn : j + (r.read q w).2 ≤ input.length,
+      r.core.runFrom (coreCfg (some q) j hj u out) ((r.read q w).2 + 1) =
+        coreCfg none (j + (r.read q w).2) hn (u ++ (r.read q w).1) out := by
+  induction w generalizing j q u with
+  | nil =>
+    obtain rfl : j = input.length := by
+      have := congrArg List.length hw; simp at this; omega
+    refine ⟨by simp [read], ?_⟩
+    simp only [read, List.append_nil]
+    exact r.core_step_end q u out
+  | cons a w ih =>
+    have hlen := congrArg List.length hw
+    simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_cons] at hlen
+    have hj' : j < input.length := by omega
+    obtain ⟨ha, hw'⟩ := List.cons_eq_cons.mp ((List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj').symm.trans hw)
+    have h1 : r.core.runFrom (coreCfg (some q) j hj u out) 1 =
+        coreCfg (r.step q a).1 (j + 1) hj' (u ++ (r.step q a).2.toList) out := by
+      rw [show r.core.runFrom _ 1 = r.core.step _ from rfl, core_step_of_lt r q hj' u out, ha]
+    cases hq : (r.step q a).1 with
+    | none =>
+      rw [hq] at h1
+      rw [read_cons_of_none r w hq]
+      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
+      rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt (τ := 1) _ _ (by omega) (by rw [h1]; rfl), h1]
+    | some q' =>
+      rw [hq] at h1
+      obtain ⟨hn, h⟩ := ih q' (j + 1) hj' hw' (u ++ (r.step q a).2.toList)
+      rw [read_cons_of_some r w hq]
+      refine ⟨by simp; omega, ?_⟩
+      rw [show ((r.step q a).2.toList ++ (r.read q' w).1, (r.read q' w).2 + 1).2 + 1 =
+        1 + ((r.read q' w).2 + 1) by simp; omega, runFrom_add, h1, h]
+      refine Cfg.ext rfl (Fin.ext ?_) ?_ ?_ rfl <;> simp [coreCfg]
+      omega
+
+/-- The head of `core` never moves left. -/
+lemma core_workTapePos_le_step (c : Cfg 1 Symbol Q input) :
+    c.workTapePos 0 ≤ (r.core.step c).workTapePos 0 := by
+  cases hq : c.state with
+  | none => rw [step_of_halt hq]
+  | some q =>
+    rw [step_of_state hq]
+    simp only [Action.apply_workTapePos, core, tr_ofTr]
+    split
+    · simp
+    · split_ifs <;> simp [SignType.cast]
+
+lemma core_workTapePos_mono (c : Cfg 1 Symbol Q input) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
+    (r.core.runFrom c m).workTapePos 0 ≤ (r.core.runFrom c n).workTapePos 0 := by
+  induction h with
+  | refl => exact le_rfl
+  | step _ ih => exact ih.trans (by rw [runFrom_succ]; exact r.core_workTapePos_le_step _)
+
+/-- During its run, the head of `core` stays between the end of the old word and the end of the
+new one. -/
+lemma core_workTapePos_mem (q : Q) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ input.length) (u out : List Symbol) (m : ℕ) :
+    (r.core.runFrom (coreCfg (some q) j hj u out) m).workTapePos 0 ∈
+      Set.Icc (u.length : ℤ) (u ++ (r.read q (input.drop j)).1).length := by
+  obtain ⟨hn, h⟩ := r.core_runFrom _ q j hj rfl u out
+  refine ⟨r.core_workTapePos_mono _ (Nat.zero_le m), ?_⟩
+  rcases Nat.le_total m ((r.read q (input.drop j)).2 + 1) with hm | hm
+  · refine (r.core_workTapePos_mono _ hm).trans ?_
+    rw [h]
+    simp [coreCfg]
+  · rw [runFrom_eq_of_halt _ _ hm (by rw [h]; rfl), h]
+    simp [coreCfg]
+
+end InputReader
+
+/-- `r` run on one work tape: move the head to the end of the word, append what `r` emits while
+reading the input, and move the head back to the start. -/
+public noncomputable def InputReader.appendOne (r : InputReader Symbol Q) :
+    MultiTapeTM 1 Symbol (Unit ⊕ Q ⊕ RewindWorkState) :=
+  (forwardWork Symbol).seq (r.core.seq (rewindWork Symbol))
+
+/-- `r` run on work tape `i`, appending what it emits to the word there. -/
+public noncomputable def appendRead (r : InputReader Symbol Q) (i : Fin k) :
+    MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Unit ⊕ Q ⊕ RewindWorkState) :=
+  r.appendOne.extendTapes (tapeEmb i)
+
+namespace InputReader
+
+variable (r : InputReader Symbol Q)
+
+/-- The configuration in which `core` starts within `appendOne`. -/
+lemma withState_eq_coreCfg (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (hp : p.val ≠ 0) (v out : List Symbol) :
+    (⟨none, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => (v.length : ℤ), out⟩ :
+      Cfg 1 Symbol Unit input).withState (some r.core.q₀) =
+        coreCfg (some r.q₀) (p.val - 1) (by have := p.isLt; omega) v out :=
+  Cfg.ext rfl (Fin.ext (by simp [coreCfg]; omega)) rfl rfl rfl
+
+open Sequential in
+lemma appendOne_runFrom (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (hp : p.val ≠ 0) (v out : List Symbol)
+    (rd : List Symbol × ℕ) (hrd : rd = r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1))) :
+    ∃ p' : Fin (input.length + 2), p'.val = p.val + rd.2 ∧
+      r.appendOne.runFrom ⟨some r.appendOne.q₀, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => 0, out⟩
+          (v.length + 1 + ((rd.2 + 1) + ((v ++ rd.1).length + 2))) =
+        ⟨none, p', fun _ => tapeOfList (v ++ rd.1), fun _ => 0, out⟩ := by
+  have hp' : p.val - 1 ≤ input.length := by have := p.isLt; omega
+  have h₀ := runFrom_forwardWork p v out (p := 0) (n := v.length) (by simp)
+  have hmid := r.withState_eq_coreCfg p hp v out
+  obtain ⟨hn, h₁⟩ := r.core_runFrom _ r.q₀ (p.val - 1) hp' rfl v out
+  subst hrd
+  generalize r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1)) = rd at hn h₁ ⊢
+  have h₂ := runFrom_rewindWork_none (input := input) ⟨1 + (p.val - 1 + rd.2), by omega⟩
+    (tapeOfList (v ++ rd.1)) out rfl le_rfl
+  refine ⟨⟨1 + (p.val - 1 + rd.2), by omega⟩, by change 1 + (p.val - 1 + rd.2) = _; omega, ?_⟩
+  have h₁₂ := runFrom_seq h₁ rfl h₂ rfl
+  rw [← hmid] at h₁₂
+  exact (runFrom_seq h₀ rfl h₁₂ rfl).trans rfl
+
+open Sequential in
+/-- The head of `appendOne` stays within `[-1, |v ++ e|]`, so it uses at most `|v ++ e| + 2`
+cells. -/
+lemma appendOne_space_le (p : Fin (input.length + 2)) (hp : p.val ≠ 0) (v out : List Symbol)
+    (t : ℕ) :
+    r.appendOne.space ⟨some r.appendOne.q₀, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => 0, out⟩ t ≤
+      (v ++ (r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1))).1).length + 2 := by
+  have hp' : p.val - 1 ≤ input.length := by have := p.isLt; omega
+  set L := (v ++ (r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1))).1).length
+  have hvL : v.length ≤ L := by simp [L]
+  have h₀ := runFrom_forwardWork p v out (p := 0) (n := v.length) (by simp)
+  have hmid := r.withState_eq_coreCfg p hp v out
+  obtain ⟨hn, h₁⟩ := r.core_runFrom _ r.q₀ (p.val - 1) hp' rfl v out
+  have hinv : ∀ m, (((forwardWork Symbol).seq (r.core.seq (rewindWork Symbol))).runFrom
+      (leftCfg (r.core.seq (rewindWork Symbol)) ⟨some (forwardWork Symbol).q₀, p,
+        fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ), out⟩) m).forgetState.workTapePos 0 ∈
+        Set.Icc (-1 : ℤ) L := by
+    refine forgetState_runFrom_seq (P := fun c => c.workTapePos 0 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℤ) L) h₀ rfl
+      (fun m _ => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
+    · have := workTapePos_runFrom_forwardWork p v out (p := 0) (Nat.zero_le _) m
+      simp only [Cfg.forgetState_workTapePos, Set.mem_Icc] at this ⊢
+      omega
+    · rw [show (⟨none, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => (v.length : ℤ), out⟩ :
+          Cfg 1 Symbol Unit input).withState (some (r.core.seq (rewindWork Symbol)).q₀) =
+          leftCfg (rewindWork Symbol) ((⟨none, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v,
+            fun _ => (v.length : ℤ), out⟩ : Cfg 1 Symbol Unit input).withState (some r.core.q₀))
+          from rfl, hmid]
+      refine forgetState_runFrom_seq (P := fun c => c.workTapePos 0 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℤ) L) h₁ rfl
+        (fun m _ => ?_) (fun n => ?_) n
+      · have := r.core_workTapePos_mem r.q₀ (p.val - 1) hp' v out m
+        simp only [Cfg.forgetState_workTapePos, Set.mem_Icc] at this ⊢
+        omega
+      · exact workTapePos_runFrom_rewindWork (input := input) none
+          ⟨1 + (p.val - 1 + (r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1))).2), by omega⟩
+          (tapeOfList (v ++ (r.read r.q₀ (input.drop (p.val - 1))).1)) out rfl le_rfl n
+  rw [space_eq_sum_spaceUsedByTape, Fin.sum_univ_one]
+  refine (spaceUsedByTape_le_card _ (S := .Icc (-1) (L : ℤ)) fun m _ => ?_).trans ?_
+  · exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hinv m)
+  · rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
+
+end InputReader
+
+/-- `appendRead r i`, started with the input head at `p` on the input `x` and `v` on work tape `i`,
+appends what `r` emits reading `x` from `p` on to `v`, moves the input head over what `r` read, and
+changes nothing else. -/
+public theorem transformsTapesAt_appendRead (r : InputReader Symbol Q) (i : Fin k)
+    (x : List Symbol) (p₀ : Fin (x.length + 2)) (hp₀ : p₀.val ≠ 0) (v : List Symbol) :
+    let rd := r.read r.q₀ (x.drop (p₀.val - 1))
+    TransformsTapesAt (appendRead r i) (fun input p ws => input = x ∧ p.val = p₀.val ∧ ws i = v)
+      (fun _ _ ws p' ws' e => p'.val = p₀.val + rd.2 ∧ ws' = Function.update ws i (v ++ rd.1) ∧
+        e = [])
+      (v.length + 1 + ((rd.2 + 1) + ((v ++ rd.1).length + 2)))
+      ((v ++ rd.1).length + 2 + (k - 1)) := by
+  intro rd
+  rintro input p ws out ⟨rfl, hp, hv⟩
+  obtain rfl : p = p₀ := Fin.ext hp
+  obtain ⟨p', hp', hrun⟩ := r.appendOne_runFrom p hp₀ v out rd rfl
+  have hcfg : oneTapeCfg i (wordsCfgAt input p (some (appendRead r i).q₀) ws out) =
+      ⟨some r.appendOne.q₀, p, fun _ => tapeOfList v, fun _ => 0, out⟩ := by
+    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl <;> funext _ <;> simp [oneTapeCfg, wordsCfgAt, hv]
+  refine ⟨p', Function.update ws i (v ++ rd.1), [], ?_, ⟨hp', rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
+  · rw [appendRead, runFrom_tapeEmb, ← appendRead, hcfg, hrun]
+    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ (by simp [embed]) <;> funext l <;> by_cases hl : l = i <;>
+      simp [embed, hl, partialInv_tapeEmb, wordsCfgAt]
+  · refine (space_tapeEmb_le _ _ _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right ?_ _)
+    rw [hcfg]
+    exact r.appendOne_space_le p hp₀ v out _
+
+end Turing.MultiTapeTM

+    (ip : Fin (input.length + 2)) (t : ℤ → Option Symbol) (out : List Symbol) {w : List Symbol}
